article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases In Congo Exceed 5,000, Government Data Shows
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached unprecedented levels in its 17th outbreak. As of Aug 20, 2026, government data show confirmed Ebola cases exceeding 5,000, with the death toll at 2,378, making it the largest outbreak in the country’s history by case count and surpassing the 2018-2020 crisis. Health officials warn that response efforts are failing to contain the disease. The report, from Kinshasa, highlights ongoing challenges in a protracted epidemic. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases. The trajectory to-date indicates a continuing escalation beyond the 5,000-case threshold, emphasizing the severity and persistence of the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が5,000人を超える、政府データが示す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（5,000症例超、死者2,378人）が継続的に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 過去最大規模のエボラ流行として2018-2020年の危機を上回り、封じ込めに失敗していると当局が警告。症状・検査確認・感染源・輸出入症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Detectan en Hiroshima un caso de cólera en viajero procedente de Bangladesh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera case detected in Hiroshima in a traveler from Bangladesh.
article.articleSummary: Cholera case detected in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan, in a foreign man in his twenties who recently arrived from Bangladesh. He entered Japan on August 7, developed diarrhea and abdominal pain, and sought care on August 12; laboratory tests confirmed cholera. Authorities believe the infection was acquired in Bangladesh before arrival. The patient is hospitalized and progressing well. The case underscores ongoing vigilance for imported infections in Japan, with Fukuyama previously reporting three cholera cases in travelers from Myanmar last year, maintaining surveillance for travel-associated cases. Cholera is an acute infectious disease transmitted mainly via contaminated water or food and can cause dehydration, but early diagnosis and proper treatment commonly yield favorable outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 広島でバングラデシュから来た旅行者のコレラ感染例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 日本国内での輸入例1件であり、感染源国（バングラデシュ）は対象国リストに含まれず、患者は回復傾向で国内二次感染の兆候もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 感染は渡航前のバングラデシュで発生したとされているが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれない。日本国内での二次感染や集団発生の情報はなく、単発の輸入症例として管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ação contra a dengue identifica 35 criadouros na região do Ouro Verde em Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Action Against Dengue Identifies 35 Breeding Sites in the Ouro Verde Region of Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Dengue control mutirão in Limeira, Brazil identified 35 Aedes aegypti breeding sites in the Ouro Verde region, covering Jardim Ouro Verde, Jardim Nova Europa, and Jardim Residencial Alto da Graminha. On Saturday the 15th, 94 agents inspected 1,427 properties; 1,040 were closed at the time. Of the breeding sites, 31 contained water and one had larvae, signaling active mosquito habitats requiring intervention. The operation aims to eliminate potential vector breeding and educate residents on preventing dengue transmission. Authorities urge households to keep yards and outdoor areas free of containers that collect water. This effort supports ongoing arbovirus prevention and control in the municipality and aligns with SDG 3 on health and well-being.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラのオウロ・ヴェルデ地域でデング熱対策により35カ所の発生源を特定 - Portal Veloz
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱蚊対策（幼虫発生源調査）に関する日常的な公衆衛生活動の報告であり、症例急増や異常な流行の兆候は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リメイラ市における日常的なデング熱媒介蚊(Aedes aegypti)の発生源調査・駆除活動を報じるもので、症例数や死亡者数、異常な流行状況への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Aulas são suspensas após casos de catapora em escola de João Pessoa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classes are suspended after cases of chickenpox at a school in João Pessoa.
article.articleSummary: Nine suspected cases of chickenpox (varicella) were identified among students at Escola Estadual Desembargador Boto de Menezes in the 13 de Maio neighborhood of João Pessoa, Paraíba, prompting temporary class suspension as a preventive measure. A coordination meeting between the school and the Executive Management of Integrated Schools on 19 August 2026 defined initial control actions to curb transmission. Varicella is highly contagious and commonly causes fever and skin lesions. Vaccination is the principal prevention, with immunization available through Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) according to the National Immunization Program (PNI) criteria. The report does not detail laboratory confirmation, specific exposure sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジョアン・ペソアの学校で水痘の症例が発生し、授業が休講に
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的で通常軽症の疾患であり、学校内での限定的な集団発生であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: 水痘はヒト-ヒト感染しやすい疾患だが、学校単位の小規模発生であり重症例や死亡の報告もないため、社会的関心も低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Cases Increase | राज्यात डासांचा डंख 'डेंजरस'; ४ वर्षांत रुग्ण ६५ टक्क्यांनी वाढले!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito Cases Are Increasing | In the state, the mosquito sting is 'Dangerous'; patients have risen by 65 percent in four years!
article.articleSummary: Kolhapur, Maharashtra—A mosquito-borne disease surge is described as dangerous, with dengue, malaria, and chikungunya cases rising 65% over four years and total cases nearing 150,000. The monsoon season has heightened mosquito activity across the state. Combined case counts were 25,116 in 2022, rising to 41,433 by 2025. Patients typically present with fever and headache, often incurring substantial hospital bills. The report highlights the growing burden of these three vector-borne diseases and the financial impact on families during the rainy season. While the data emphasize Maharashtra’s increasing exposure to dengue, malaria, and chikungunya, Kolhapur is singled out as part of the state’s broader seasonal transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介感染症が増加｜州内で蚊の被害が「危険」な状況に；4年間で患者数が65%増加！
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州における季節性（モンスーン時期）の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア）の増加傾向を報じる定例的な統計記事であり、突発的異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う毎年恒例の蚊媒介性疾患増加を報じるローカル統計記事。過去4年間の経年比較データが中心で、突発的アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cần Thơ: Khởi tố hàng loạt đối tượng mua bán thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can Tho: Prosecution of a number of suspects in the sale of pork infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Can Tho City, Vietnam reports prosecutions over selling pork infected with African swine fever (ASF). Suspects Trương Văn Công (1984) and Hứa Hoàng Khởi (1984) are indicted for food safety violations and prohibited from leaving their residence; they allegedly conspired with Thị Hồng Cam (1995) to buy diseased or dead pigs, have them slaughtered, and sell the meat. At the Đặng Phú Tỷ slaughterhouse in Vĩnh Viễn Commune, 9 Oct 2025 inspection found 40 live pigs and one slaughtered pig with ASF-positive meat. Two pork lots totaling 840.7 kg from Vĩnh Viễn market yielded 10 of 12 samples ASF-positive. On 10 Nov 2025, three employees from Trạm Chăn nuôi-Thú y khu vực XIII—Phan Ngọc Toại (1977), Lê Quốc Nhiên (1979), Phạm Hồng Phúc (1980)—were charged with abusing public duties. On 12 Feb 2026, Lưu Văn Nam (1981) and Thị Hồng Cam were additionally charged with food safety violations; investigation ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: カントー市:アフリカ豚熱感染豚肉の販売で複数の容疑者を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人間の公衆衛生への直接的影響はなく、食品安全法違反に関する司法対応の記事であるため、ヒトの感染症シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物疾病であり、ヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上のリスクは低い。記事は食品安全法違反に関する刑事訴追の内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-epidemie in Congo wordt de dodelijkste ooit en nepnieuws maakt het nog erger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo is the deadliest ever, and misinformation makes it worse.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered on the Bundibugyo variant, has persisted since May. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo and no effective antiviral; care is supportive, addressing fever, headache, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea and bleeding. The World Health Organization warns it could become the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak to date, surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic of about 11,323 deaths. Misinformation and fear, including claims that white people created Ebola or that vaccines contain coronavirus, hinder response. The Balobaki fact-check collective works with local radio to inform community leaders in the hardest-hit areas. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne; many infections occur during funerals due to traditional washing and touching of the deceased. Attacks on ambulances in Bunia illustrate hostility toward responders. AI-generated misinformation on TikTok, X and Facebook worsens the problem.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上最悪の致死的流行になる恐れ、フェイクニュースが状況を悪化
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最大・最悪の致死率となる可能性を警告しているエボラ流行であり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（ブニアを含む）でのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行を主題としており、アンゴラは発生地域として言及されていないため除外。ワクチン・有効な抗ウイルス薬がなく、SNS上の誤情報が対応を妨げている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: 小心感染性腹泻的"头号"病原菌！它是这样"入侵"人体的→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware the #1 pathogen causing infectious diarrhea! This is how it invades the human body.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella infection (salmonellosis) is the leading bacterial cause of infectious diarrhea worldwide. Global burden: about 115 million illnesses and 370,000 deaths annually, with roughly 95 million gastroenteritis cases and over 50,000 deaths. In China, about 90 million people are infected each year, with incidence near 1,300 per 100,000 in several provinces; among children under five, Salmonella is the third leading cause of death from diarrheal diseases. Transmission occurs through contaminated foods (poultry, pork, beef, dairy, eggs), contaminated water, contact with animals, and cross-contamination during food handling; transmission is year-round with peaks in summer and autumn. Symptoms typically appear 6–72 hours after exposure and last 4–7 days, including diarrhea, abdominal cramps, nausea/vomiting, and fever around 38–39°C. Prevention emphasizes thorough cooking, avoiding raw/undercooked foods, handwashing, preventing cross-contamination, and proper refrigeration.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo top 5,000 - Africa health agency
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak declared May 15 has surpassed 5,000 cases, with 5,021 confirmed and 2,378 deaths, according to Africa CDC data. The Bundibugyo virus drives the surge; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though clinical trials are underway. The hardest-hit areas are in the north and east, where weak state presence, poor health infrastructure, and armed groups hinder response. WHO Director-General Tedros warned the epidemic is far from under control and the risk of further national and international spread remains high. Criticism has focused on slow, disorganized responses and mistrust, including refusals of testing. In response, WHO efforts to scale up activities and reach communities are under way, and the European Union is sending testing kits worth 2.5 million euros to aid containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例、5,000件を突破 - アフリカ保健機関
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（5,000症例超、死亡2,378人）で、WHOが国際的拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによる第17次アウトブレイクで承認済みワクチン・治療法なし。WHOおよびEUが国際支援を実施中。武装勢力や医療インフラ不足が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 4,6 millions de dollars pour le paludisme, débloqués pour accélérer le tri des cas suspects d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: $4.6 million for malaria, released to speed up triage of suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, DRC, on Aug 14 the National Public Health Institute launched mass antimalarial drug distribution across Bunia, Nyankunde, Mongbwalu, and Rwampara, covering over one million people in four days to support Ebola triage. The Global Fund approved $4.6 million in emergency funding for two phases: initial mass drug administration, followed by a second phase with more than 500,000 bed nets and about 400,000 spatial repellents to reduce malaria fever and aid differentiation of suspected Ebola cases. SANRU maintains 903 community malaria sites across 36 health zones. WHO notes that distinguishing Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease from malaria requires laboratory confirmation. UNICEF DHIS2 data (Apr–Jun 2026) show essential health services down 42% in four outbreak foci and 12.6% province-wide; measles vaccination in Mongbwalu down 69%; and 239 malaria cases per 1,000 people in 2023, with 33 malaria deaths per 100,000.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:マラリア対策に460万ドル拠出、エボラ疑い例のトリアージ迅速化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で継続中のエボラ(Bundibugyo)アウトブレイクに関連し、必須医療サービスの大幅低下や麻疹ワクチン接種率低下など公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認され、国際機関(Global Fund, WHO, UNICEF)による大規模支援が行われているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州における既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応(マラリアとの鑑別診断支援のための大規模薬剤配布・資金拠出)に関する内容。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中で言及されておらず、除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 21 rings de décontamination ouverts sur 171 attendus en Ituri, 74 cas suspects non investigués sur les provinces rapportantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 21 decontamination rings opened out of 171 expected in Ituri, 74 suspected cases not investigated in the reporting provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains severe as of 15 August: 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths (case fatality 47.0%), across six provinces and 55 health zones. Ituri bears the majority with 4,194 confirmed cases (84.8% of total) and 1,838 deaths, 1,040 recoveries, and 730 in isolation. In Ituri, 171 decontamination rings were expected; 21 opened due to staffing gaps in Bambu-mine and Mangala, supply shortages in Mandima, resistance from families in Kilo, untraceable addresses, and decontaminator strikes. Surveillance logged 1,730 alerts, with 1,575 verified; 380 suspected; 306 investigated; 263 transferred to treatment centers. Tshopo did not report. Contact tracing reached 85.3% (20,791/24,383). Burial operations show 39 death alerts, 37 swabs and burials, with community resistance in Beni and Kalunguta. Entry-screening refusals: 2,187 (2.78%). Ambulance capacity strained; multiple treatment centers saturated in Ituri and Nord-Kivu. Infodemic and fear drive self-medication among displaced communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イトゥリ州で予定171基の消毒リングのうち21基のみ開設、報告州で未調査の疑い例74件
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率47%に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、封じ込め対策（消毒リング設置、接触者追跡、埋葬対応）に深刻な遅れと住民の抵抗が見られるため、国際的拡大リスクが高くフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるオーストラリア（South Australia, Commonwealth of Australia）は記事主題と無関係であり、Bluedotの地域付与誤りと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Rougeole : 34 913 cas suspects au Sud-Kivu, 66 prélevés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: 34,913 suspected cases in South Kivu, 66 samples collected.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers on North Kivu and South Kivu. South Kivu reports 34,913 suspected cases since Jan 1 with 540 deaths; 66 samples collected and 24 IgM confirmations. North Kivu records 19,431 suspected cases and 62 deaths; 366 samples collected with 137 IgM confirmations. Nationally, 114,004 suspected cases have been reported with 1,487 deaths and 1,289 IgM confirmations; among confirmed cases, 81% are under five, with 34% vaccinated, 48% unvaccinated, and 18% unknown. Lab turnaround is slow: 52.1% of samples take over 8 days to reach a lab, and in South Kivu none arrive before 7 days. Measles-Rubella vaccination campaign (Block 3) began Aug 10, targeting 24,791,774 children aged 6 months–14 years across eight provinces, including North and South Kivu; vaccination started Aug 11 at 13 sites, with four postponed to Aug 17 due to kit deployment delays. UNICEF-backed funding totals $3.008 million for the campaign and $1 million for routine vaccination. Context: Ebola has 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths as of Aug 15; in Oicha (Nord Kivu), 29,458 of 53,201 targeted were vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:南キブ州で疑い症例34,913件、66件の検体採取
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国全土で麻疹疑い症例114,004件・死亡1,487人という大規模な流行が継続しており、5歳未満が81%を占め、ワクチン接種率も不十分。国際的な資金支援（UNICEF）も投入されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（4,945例確定、死亡2,325人）についても同地域の文脈情報として記載されているが、本記事の主題は麻疹の大規模流行である。検体の検査室搬送の遅延（52.1%が8日以上）も管理上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Charbon bactéridien à Vitshumbi : une alerte sur le lac Édouard, sans vaccination de routine du bétail depuis plus de dix ans selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterial anthrax at Vitshumbi: an alert on Lake Edward, with no routine livestock vaccination for more than ten years according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax alert on Lake Edward at Vitshumbi, Virunga National Park, DRC. A hippopotamus found dead on Aug 8, 2026 tested positive for Bacillus anthracis; alert issued Aug 17 by the Kibirizi health zone. Authorities are tracing handlers and meat consumers; residents urged to report skin lesions or fever. No human cases reported as of Aug 18. WHO Africa notes no routine livestock vaccination against anthrax for more than a decade, increasing vulnerability. Risk factors include handling animals or products, bushmeat consumption, and illegal fishing in Lake Edward; there is no evidence that fish consumption transmits the disease. The outbreak history shows 2025 wildlife deaths in Virunga and 17 human cases (1 confirmed, 1 death; CFR 5.9%), with 24 suspects by May 2025. Ongoing armed conflict and water shortages hinder response; July 2026 cholera cases reported in Lubero health zone.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィツンビの炭疽菌感染:エドワード湖での警戒、WHOによれば10年以上家畜への定期予防接種なし
triage.triage_reason: エドワード湖周辺で野生動物(カバ)の炭疽菌感染が確認され、過去に人への感染・死亡例もあり、保健当局が警戒を発令し接触者追跡を実施中であるため、WPRO基準(異常性・曝露継続)と社会的関心(行政対応)の両方を満たす。
triage.notes: 現時点で人の感染例は報告されていないが、2025年に17例の疑い症例(1死亡)があった前例があり、紛争や水不足が対応を困難にしている。同記事内でルベロ保健区でのコレラ症例(2026年7月)にも言及があるが詳細情報は不足しており別途注視が必要。南オーストラリア州・ルワンダは地理データノイズと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Spreading Faster Beyond Congo Epicenter, Straining Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, Ebola is spreading rapidly beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo's main epicenter, intensifying transmission in areas outside Ituri and challenging local health systems. The outbreak is overwhelming treatment capacity in some sites, with hospitals and isolation units struggling to accommodate new patients. Public health teams are facing mounting pressure to trace contacts, identify exposures, and quickly isolate cases to prevent further spread. Transmission outside Ituri—the province where the epidemic began—appears to be accelerating, suggesting a growth in transmission networks beyond the initial cluster. The developing pattern increases the risk of wider regional spread and tests the efficiency of outbreak response, surveillance, and community engagement essential to containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、震源地イトゥリ州を超えて拡大、北キブ州でも症例増加により対応が逼迫
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州を超えて拡大し、医療体制が逼迫していることが報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR2005の常時通知対象疾患であり、地理的拡大と医療キャパシティ逼迫が確認されているため優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت: ابولا در کنگو از کنترل خارج شده است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control, with 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths reported as of 16 August 2026 across 55 health zones in six provinces, yielding a case-fatality rate of 47.4%. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated the outbreak is out of control and warned of high risk of wider spread within the country and globally, speaking at the opening of a WHO Emergency Committee meeting. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. Declared by DRC authorities on 15 May 2026, it is described as the largest Ebola outbreak on record and the second-largest globally, with transmission continuing intensively.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱は制御不能な状態
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が「制御不能」と発言し、国内外への拡大リスクを警告している大規模アウトブレイク（致死率47.4%、ワクチン・治療法なし）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO緊急委員会が開催されており、史上最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクとされる。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 中 7월 코로나19 확진 52만명...한 달 새 6배 이상 급증
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: 520,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases in July, up more than sixfold in a month.
article.articleSummary: China reported 522,000 new COVID-19 cases in July, more than sixfold from June’s 79,000. The China CDC says transmission remains mid-level with volatility at a peak, recording 487 severe cases and 1 death in July. In the August 3–9 surveillance, SARS-CoV-2 positivity rose to 21.2%, the highest among major respiratory pathogens. Some overseas experts caution official tallies may undercount, citing mild or untested infections and self-test results not included in stats; concerns cited about testing frequency in Zhejiang and Shanghai. Mainland China authorities say Omicron lineage NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages are now dominant; in Taiwan and Hong Kong, PQ.16.1.1, derived from NB.1.8.1, is increasing. Taiwan (Aug 2–8) reported 24,645 confirmed cases, 72 severe, and 14 deaths. Authorities warn to prepare for possible autumn/winter resurgences, while explanations for data gaps were not provided.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、7月のコロナ感染確認52万人…1か月で6倍以上急増
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数は急増しているが重症化率・死亡率は低く、渡航制限や国際的拡大のリスクも明確でないため、フルRRAではなく経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾・香港のデータも記事に含まれるが、対象国リストの規定によりChinaに統合。重症例・死亡数の割合は低く、季節性の流行拡大とみられるため、追加情報（秋冬の再流行動向等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS maintient l'urgence internationale, l'épidémie est devenue le 17 août la plus meurtrière de l'histoire de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO maintains the international emergency; as of August 17 the outbreak had become the deadliest in the history of the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after the WHO Emergency Committee met on Aug 18, recommending maintenance of the PHEIC first declared on May 17. As of Aug 15, 2026, 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths (case fatality rate 47.0%), with the toll by Aug 17 surpassing the 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,381 cases). Globally, it ranks as the second-deadliest after 2014–2016 West Africa. Six provinces are affected; risk of spread is very high within DRC and high in Uganda and neighboring states. Response includes 100 epidemiologists, 500 community-health workers, about 400 beds added in two weeks; 60% of $115 million mobilized; target 3,000 beds in 12 weeks. No vaccine for Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo protects only Zaïre strain. Key sites: Mongbwalu (Ituri), Lita, Nizi, Kigonze; Bunia coordinating.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:WHOが国際緊急事態を維持、8月17日時点でコンゴ民主共和国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持し、DRC史上最多の死者数を記録する重大なエボラ流行であり、周辺国への拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ等周辺国への拡大リスクが指摘されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ルーマニア・アンゴラは記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Had Dengue Once? You Can Get It Again: Doctor Explains Why A Second Infection Can Be More Severe
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, dengue can be reinfected with different serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4). Infection with one serotype generally confers lifelong immunity to that type but only temporary protection against others, so a person can contract dengue multiple times, potentially even in the same year. A second infection with a different serotype raises the risk of severe dengue, a phenomenon linked to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) as existing antibodies fail to neutralise a new virus. There is no specific antiviral treatment; prevention and early medical care are essential. Expert Dr. Sandeep Budhiraja of Max Healthcare, Delhi, notes that dengue can occur up to four times in a lifetime. Prevention includes eliminating stagnant water, protecting homes from mosquitoes, using repellents, wearing long clothing, and using nets; vaccination may be part of strategies in certain populations per WHO. World Mosquito Day (Aug 20) underscores these measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に一度罹患したら再感染する可能性がある：医師が二次感染がより重症化する理由を解説
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報じるものではなく、デング熱の再感染メカニズムに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生イベントではなく、World Mosquito Day関連の一般啓発記事。デリーの症例数増加等の具体的データは含まれていないため、地域特定情報としては該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm - RSV - Phế cầu: Ba 'kẻ thù thầm lặng' của người lớn tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza – RSV – Pneumococcus: The three 'silent enemies' of older adults
article.articleSummary: Influenza, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and pneumococcus are highlighted as three silent enemies of older adults in Vietnam. In the elderly, flu and RSV are viral infections; pneumococcal disease is caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae bacteria. These infections can begin with fever, cough, fatigue, or malaise but may progress to severe illness requiring hospitalization and respiratory support, especially in those with chronic conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, COPD, asthma, heart failure, or chronic kidney disease. The article stresses that early recognition of risk groups, awareness of warning signs, timely medical evaluation, and preventive measures are crucial. The program 'Dr says: Flu – RSV – Pneumococcus: The Three Silent Enemies of Older Adults' is a collaboration between Thanh Niên and Ho Chi Minh City University of Medicine and Pharmacy Hospital, funded by Pfizer Vietnam. Experts Dr Nguyen Huy Luan and Prof. Le Thuong Vu discuss real cases and how to differentiate the diseases and prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ・RSV・肺炎球菌：高齢者を狙う『3つの静かな敵』
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではなく、高齢者向け一般啓発・広告記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は製薬会社（Pfizer Vietnam）協賛の健康啓発企画であり、具体的な発生状況や症例数増加の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 一旦接触就是Ⅲ级暴露！携带大量病毒，现在正是高峰期，多地出现
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Any contact equals Level-3 exposure! Carrying a large amount of virus, currently at its peak, has appeared in many regions.
article.articleSummary: Beijing reports more indoor bat intrusions during summer. In Fengtai District, bat-disturbance calls numbered 203 from May 1 to Aug 18 this year, nearly double last year’s 102, reflecting urban ecological improvements and favorable summer conditions that boost bat activity and roosting in gaps such as air-conditioning ducts and cracked walls. The East Asian vesper bat is shy and not typically aggressive, but direct contact with bats carries a high rabies risk. Any contact is treated as Category III exposure; immediately wash the contact area with soap and water for about 15 minutes, then use a low-concentration antiseptic and seek urgent medical evaluation for post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). If a bat is in a room, do not handle it; evacuate, close doors, switch off lights, and open windows to let it fly out. Parents should educate children about risks and seek help promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 接触すればすべてⅢ級曝露！大量のウイルスを保有、現在ピーク期で各地に出現
triage.triage_reason: 北京市内でのコウモリ侵入増加と狂犬病曝露リスクに関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、実際のヒト感染例や集団発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は北京市内でのコウモリ目撃・侵入件数の増加と、接触時の狂犬病曝露予防に関する啓発情報であり、実際の感染症発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mid-day meal scare: 38 children fall ill after eating 'kheer' at Kullu school, report sought
article.articleSummary: 38 students from Bari Primary School in Manali subdivision, Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, fell ill after consuming kheer served as part of the mid-day meal on Tuesday. Of 51 students at the school, 38 were taken to Patlikuhal Community Health Centre; 15 were discharged on Wednesday, with the rest reported as improving. Symptoms included dizziness, fainting, vomiting, with deterioration between 4 pm and 5 pm; all 38 children were brought to CHC by about 7 pm. The exact cause remains unknown pending testing of samples from the ration ingredients. The administration launched an inquiry led by the Manali SDM; samples have been collected for laboratory analysis. Education Minister Rohit Thakur has sought a report from the director of education. Former education minister Govind Singh Thakur visited the Patlikuhal CHC. No fatalities reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: 給食騒動：クル郡の学校で「キール」を食べた児童38人が体調不良、報告書提出を要請
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食による局所的な食中毒疑い事例で、死亡例なく、感染性拡大の懸念や国際的リスクも認められないため。
triage.notes: 食材の検査結果待ちだが、症状（めまい、失神、嘔吐）と経過から食中毒の可能性が高く、感染症としてのシグナルではないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 4 843 cas confirmés et 2 272 décès au 14 août, 116 nouvelles confirmations en vingt-quatre heures
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 4,843 confirmed cases and 2,272 deaths as of August 14, 116 new confirmed cases in twenty-four hours.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of August 14, 2026, COUSP reports 4,843 confirmed cases and 2,272 deaths (case fatality 46.9%), with 116 new confirmed cases and 58 deaths in 24 hours. Ituri remains the epicenter, contributing 84.8% of cumulative cases and 73.3% of new cases, for 4,105 cases and 1,791 deaths; North Kivu has 588/411; Haut-Uélé 135/62; other provinces (Tshopo, Sud-Kivu, Bas-Uélé) have smaller totals. Wamba in Haut-Uélé accounts for all 12 new confirmations (total 53 cases, 20 deaths). The report notes 777 patients in isolation and 83.2% of contacts followed (13,987 of 16,802). Care and treatment centers are saturated in Bambu and Fataki; Nord-Kivu suspect-bed occupancy at 103%; the Wamba isolation center exceeds capacity. Butembo zone has 110 cases and 91 deaths (létalité 82.7%). No new health zones; 55 of 151 zones affected. Vaccination is not used for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaïre; WHO aims 3,000 beds and 95% contact tracing in 12 weeks; Bunia flights suspended affect economy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：8月14日時点で確認症例4,843件、死亡2,272人、過去24時間で新規確認116件
triage.triage_reason: 致死率46.9%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続拡大しており、複数州にまたがり医療施設が飽和状態、WHOも介入しているため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断。
triage.notes: Ituriが症例の84.8%を占め流行の中心。医療キャパシティ飽和、隔離センター超過、ブニア便運休など経済影響も発生。WHOが3000床・接触者追跡95%を12週間で目指す支援計画を提示しており、既にWHO/国際社会が関与中。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les décès de femmes en couches ont doublé depuis le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: deaths of women in childbirth have doubled since the start of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, six or more maternal deaths per week since May 25 signal a collateral toll of the 17th Ebola outbreak (declared May 17, 2026; PHEIC). Ituri accounts for 3,636 of 4,209 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,551 of 1,916 deaths nationwide (86.4%). Twenty-eight of 36 health zones are affected; three treatment centers saturated. Nationally, 53 of 140 health zones are affected; North Kivu occupancy peaked at 139% (674 patients). The Ebola response strains maternal care: 63,700 pregnant women are in affected areas; UNFPA has deployed over 150 midwives but funding for reproductive/maternal health ($17.1 million requested) is under 10%. 114 health workers are infected, 36 dead. Many maternal deaths occur outside Ebola case counts, as fear of isolation reduces prenatal care; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラ流行開始以来、妊産婦死亡数が倍増
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの第17次エボラ流行（コンゴ民主共和国）で確定4,209例・死亡1,916例に達し、医療体制崩壊による妊産婦死亡増加という二次的被害も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済みの第17次エボラ流行。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチンが存在せず、医療従事者114名感染・36名死亡、妊産婦63,700人が影響地域に居住、UNFPAの資金不足（要請額の10%未満）も深刻。国際的な緊急支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: World Mosquito Day 2026 : കൊതുക് പരത്തുന്ന രോഗങ്ങൾ ഏതൊക്കെ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Mosquito Day 2026: Which diseases are transmitted by mosquitoes?
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, World Mosquito Day highlights diseases transmitted by mosquitoes, including dengue, malaria, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and Zika. Dengue, a major viral disease in India, is spread mainly by Aedes aegypti and presents with fever, rash, body pains, and retro-orbital pain. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium and spread by Anopheles, features sudden fever with chills and headaches; severe cases risk organ damage. Chikungunya, also transmitted by Aedes, causes fever, skin rashes, and often prolonged severe joint pain. Japanese encephalitis, carried by Culex, can cause brain inflammation. Zika, transmitted by Aedes, may cause mild fever, rash, and joint pain, though many infections are asymptomatic. Increased rainfall and humidity during and after the monsoon boost mosquito breeding, underscoring preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊の日2026：蚊が媒介する主な病気は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、世界蚊の日に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、蚊媒介性疾患全般に関する啓発・教育目的の一般記事である。具体的な症例数や地域的異常は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Baghpat Rabies Death: Dog Bite Victim Dies After 3 Months, 55 Villagers Get Anti-Rabies Shots (Video)
article.articleSummary: In Baghpat district of Uttar Pradesh, 35-year-old Anees died nearly three months after a dog bite, triggering fear in Laliyana village. The bite occurred about three months earlier; family says initial response was lax, but Anees later developed rabies-like symptoms and deteriorated, dying after his condition became critical. Following his death, around 55 people, including family members, visited the Ratol Primary Health Centre to receive anti-rabies injections as a precaution; 37 were residents of Laliyana. Health official Selekshi explained that rabies spreads through animal bites with saliva entering broken skin, not by ordinary contact with an infected person. Doctors urged immediate medical attention after animal exposures and completion of post-exposure vaccination. The incident underscores the importance of prompt care after dog bites to prevent fatal rabies and warns residents against ignoring bites.

triage.headline_ja: バグパット狂犬病死亡事例：犬咬傷被害者が3ヶ月後に死亡、村民55人が狂犬病予防接種を受ける（動画あり）
triage.triage_reason: 単発の犬咬傷による狂犬病死亡例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクなし、国際的拡大の可能性もない散発事例のため見送り。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドの農村部で風土病的に発生しており、本事例は個別の犬咬傷後の死亡例。予防接種対応も地域の保健センターで完結しており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Llaman a la población panameña a involucrarse en la eliminación de criaderos del mosquito Aedes aegypti, transmisor del dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panamanians urged to participate in eliminating breeding sites of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, dengue vector.
article.articleSummary: Panama's Chiriquí province urges residents to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb dengue. Through last weekend, 336 dengue cases were recorded, including 70 with warning signs and two male deaths (ages 54 and 45) from David Este corregimiento. Ages include two cases under 1 year and 40 cases over 65. In David, 5% of Los Abanicos homes harbored active breeding; other districts showed 1–3% infestation (San Mateo 2.5%, Doleguita 2.2%, Barú 2%, Río Mar 2%, Palmar Norte 1%). District totals: David 364; Bugaba 65; Dolega 26; Barú 17; Boquerón 14; Boquete 12; San Lorenzo 10. Cross-border dengue prevention with Costa Rica occurred in Progreso (Barú) and Paso Canoas. Dengue is categorized as without alarm signs, with alarm signs, or severe; early detection and prompt care reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: パナマ国民に対し、デング熱媒介蚊ネッタイシマカの発生源除去への参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: パナマのチリキ州における季節性デング熱対策に関する記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等）のいずれにも該当しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにフィリピンが含まれるが、記事の主題はパナマのデング熱流行であり、フィリピンでの発生は確認できない。対象国リストにパナマは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫称3个月内可控，刚果埃博拉却扩散至第六省
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says it can be controlled within three months, but Ebola in Congo has spread to the sixth province.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to Ituri's Bunia, the sixth province, with at least 2,325 deaths. WHO says the outbreak could be controlled within three months if resources are mobilized. Funding requested of $115 million is about 60% funded, leaving roughly $46 million short. Response challenges include delayed case finding, overwhelmed surveillance teams, ongoing armed conflict, and lack of vaccines and therapies for the rare Bundibugyo subtype. In the past two weeks, 400 new beds have been added and more epidemiologists will be deployed to speed up contact tracing. About 70–80% of new cases are unlinked to known patients, indicating widespread transmission. WHO Emergency Committee will meet to decide whether to extend the PHEIC and adjust control guidance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOは3か月以内に制御可能と発表するも、コンゴのエボラは第6州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が第6州まで拡大し死者2,325人超、資金不足・紛争下での対応困難、WHOがPHEIC延長を検討中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ亜型に対するワクチン・治療薬の不足、武力紛争による対応の遅延、新規症例の70-80%が既知患者と関連しない広範な伝播が確認されており、WHO緊急委員会がPHEIC延長を協議中。資金は要求額の約60%のみ確保（約4,600万ドル不足）。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola devient l'épidémie la plus meurtrière de l'histoire du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola becomes the deadliest outbreak in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak has 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths (case fatality rate 47%). It is caused by Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus); this lineage was first identified in Uganda in 2007. Historical CFRs for Bundibugyo range around 30–50%, with the 2018–2020 Zaïre outbreak in North Kivu/Ituri recording 66% mortality. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus. Animal data suggest 70–80% cross-protection, not yet confirmed in humans. Experimental MBP134/MBP431 antibodies, remdesivir activity in vitro, oral obeldesivir, and the rVSV-BDBV GP vaccine are in development; the PARTNERS trial includes >100 confirmed cases as of 14 August. Incubation is 2–21 days; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. Transport and care disruptions: six weeks of treatment-center strikes, with contact-tracing at 75.3% (target 95%), 140 frontline workers infected in Ituri (43 dead). WHO PHEIC, in effect since 17 May, was reaffirmed on 18 August.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱が同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC発令中の大規模エボラ流行（致死率47%、感染者4,945人、死者2,325人）であり、IHR基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行でIturi州が中心。ワクチン未承認、治療施設ストライキや接触者追跡率不足（75.3%/目標95%）など対応上の課題あり。ウガンダは疾患起源として言及されるが現時点で発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Classes in Zamboanga City suspended due to extreme heat, classroom cleanup drive vs dengue
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, Zamboanga City suspended classes due to extreme heat, while a dengue-focused classroom cleanup drive was launched to curb mosquito breeding in schools. Dengue is the infectious disease highlighted; the article provides no dengue case counts, laboratory confirmations, or clinical details. The dual response links weather-related disruption to public health action, emphasizing in-school sanitation efforts as a vector-control measure. The initiative aims to protect students and maintain some continuity of education by addressing environmental risk factors inside classrooms. The report centers on local authorities’ actions in Zamboanga City, with the cleanup drive described as a preventive measure against dengue rather than a description of an outbreak.

triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生報告ではなく、予防的な教室清掃活動と猛暑による休校に関する記事であり、症例数や異常な流行の兆候は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana में मौसम बदलते ही इस बीमारी का अटैक, स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय की चेतावनी, भूलकर भी न करें ये 5 गलतियां
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the weather changes in Haryana, an attack of this disease; Health Ministry's warning; do not make these five mistakes.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (influenza A H1N1) risk rises as weather changes in Haryana, prompting the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to issue an advisory to the public. Key symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, breathing difficulties, headache, body and joint pain, fatigue, reduced appetite, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. The advisory urges people with fever, cough or sneezing to maintain distance in public spaces, follow preventive guidelines, cover mouth and nose with a cloth while coughing or sneezing, wash hands frequently with soap and water, and stay hydrated with water and nutritious meals. Those showing Swine Flu symptoms should not delay and should promptly seek medical evaluation and treatment. Chandigarh reports the warning; the public should stay alert during seasonal weather changes.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州で季節の変わり目に豚インフルエンザ流行の兆し、保健省が警告、犯しがちな5つのミス
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のスワインフルー（H1N1）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: インド保健省による季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）への注意喚起記事。具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告はなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Tomato flu outbreak forces closure of government girls' school in Thiruvananthapuram
article.articleSummary: Tomato flu ( tomato fever ) outbreak in Thiruvananthapuram prompts closure of Government Model Girls Higher Secondary School, Pattom. Thirty-two LKG/UKG students fell ill with rashes and fever, triggering a one-week shutdown. Health officials will disinfect classrooms, toys and study materials, and compile a detailed patient line list from parents to confirm the outbreak. Tomato fever is a rare viral illness that primarily affects children under five and spreads via direct contact, close proximity, and touching contaminated surfaces. The Pattom division councillor, Reshma, alleged miscommunication from school authorities. Outbreak confirmation depends on the patient list and details; laboratory confirmation and epidemiological assessment are ongoing.

Vaccination is free, and activities will continue in other kelurahan, including for stray animals in coordination with communities. Since September 2025, East Jakarta has vaccinated 13,135 animals, including 10,833 cats, 2,218 dogs, 45 primates, and 39 civets. Information is disseminated via RW/RT and LMK networks to residents. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Liver abscess due to bacterial co-infection and dog and cat roundworms.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, a 73-year-old woman (Ba Hau) presented with high fever and rigors. MRI revealed a liver abscess measuring 36×47×52 mm, adjacent to the liver capsule. Blood tests at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi showed leukocytosis (11.79 G/L) and elevated procalcitonin (1.58 ng/mL). Serology was positive for antibodies against Toxocara canis/cati (dog and cat roundworms), indicating parasitic exposure; the purulent fluid drained from the abscess was cultured and yielded Streptococcus intermedius. The patient underwent ultrasound-guided drainage (~30 mL of blue-green pus) and received intravenous antibiotics, with antibiotic therapy tailored after culture and susceptibility results. After 5 days, fever resolved and fatigue improved; drain output decreased and ultrasound suggested abscess shrinkage. She was discharged after 10 days with continued antibiotic therapy and follow-up. Toxocara canis/cati infection occurs via exposure to eggs in soil or contaminated environments; pet hygiene and deworming are advised to prevent infection.

article.articleHeadline: Σαν σήμερα το 1987 ο γιατρός Ρόναλντ Ρος ανακάλυψε στην Ινδία το κουνούπι ως "ένοχο" της ελονοσίας και έσωσε εκατομμύρια ζωές - HuffPost - Ειδήσεις και Απόψεις από την Ελλάδα και τον ΚόσμοΣαν σήμερα το 1987 ο γιατρός Ρόναλντ Ρος ανακάλυψε στην Ινδία το κουνούπι ως "ένοχο" της ελονοσίας και έσωσε εκατομμύρια ζωές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On this day in 1987, Dr. Ronald Ross discovered in India the mosquito as the 'culprit' of malaria and saved millions of lives.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 1897 in India, Ronald Ross made the decisive observation that linked Anopheles mosquitoes to malaria transmission by detecting the parasite's development in the mosquito’s stomach. This evidence established the mosquito as the malaria vector and spurred public health measures, including removal of standing water, bed nets, larval control, and later insecticides. Ross's meticulous 1897 notebooks documented his dissections and observations. In 1902, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine and was later knighted. The event is commemorated today as World Mosquito Day, underscoring that mosquito-borne diseases continue to pose a global challenge. While malaria remains central, mosquitoes can transmit other illnesses such as dengue fever, yellow fever, Zika, chikungunya, and West Nile virus. Ross died in 1932, but his discovery transformed malaria control and public health.

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Diseases: मच्छरों का आतंक! डेंगू, मलेरिया समेत इन 5 जानलेवा बीमारियों से कैसे बचें?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito Diseases: The Mosquito Menace! How to protect yourself from these five deadly diseases, including dengue and malaria?
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day 2026 on August 20 marks Sir Ronald Ross's 1897 discovery that malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes. The article highlights five diseases transmitted by mosquitoes—dengue, malaria, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and Zika—focusing on India and global risk. Rainfall, humidity, and standing water during and after the monsoon elevate transmission. Dengue, spread by Aedes aegypti, is among India's most common viral illnesses; symptoms include high fever, headache, body pains, retro-orbital pain, and rashes. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium and transmitted by female Anopheles, presents with sudden fever, chills, and headache, potentially leading to organ failure or death if untreated. Chikungunya, also Aedes-borne, causes fever, rashes, and severe joint pain that can persist. Japanese encephalitis, transmitted by Culex, can cause brain inflammation; Zika, another Aedes-borne virus, may cause mild fever, rash, joint/muscle pain, and red eyes, though many infections are asymptomatic.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest: the epidemic is ravaging uncontrollably, and the death toll is rising rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is confronting the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 4,945 cases and 2,325 deaths reported as of 2026-08-20. This is the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak and already surpasses the severity of 2018–2020 epidemics. The spread is accelerating; in comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak took about five months to reach 1,000 deaths, whereas the current crisis has surpassed 2,000 deaths in under three months. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus; there is no licensed vaccine or effective treatment for this subtype. Case fatality has risen from about 20% in early June to 46%, meaning nearly half of confirmed cases are fatal. The rapid transmission and lack of targeted medical tools complicate response.

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se extiende a una velocidad más rápida que nuestra capacidad para contenerlo": el brote está fuera de control en Congo, según la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola is spreading at a rate faster than our ability to contain it": the outbreak is out of control in Congo, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant is spreading rapidly, with more than 5,100 cases and 2,420 deaths since early 2026. Six eastern provinces are affected: Ituri (centered on Bunia), Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, North Kivu, and South Kivu, across about 55 health zones. Over 1,000 patients have recovered with symptomatic care. The outbreak is not under control; WHO and the UN warn of very high risk in the DRC and high risk in neighboring countries. No vaccine or treatment exists specifically for Bundibugyo; existing vaccines for Zaire are ineffective. UN's Tom Fletcher notes a death roughly every 30 minutes in the DRC. Uganda contained a Bundibugyo outbreak in July after about two dozen cases, illustrating the value of early diagnosis and intense contact tracing. The outbreak was declared in May after late recognition and initial misdiagnosis.

article.articleHeadline: Tin mới y tế ngày 20/8: Giành lại sự sống từ Covid-19 biến chứng suy đa tạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest medical news on August 20: Fighting for survival from COVID-19-induced multi-organ failure.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19-induced ARDS with septic shock and multi‑organ failure in a 43-year-old man (D.V.N.) treated at Hanoi’s Hospital 19-8 after July 20 diagnosis. Despite oxygen, antibiotics, corticosteroids, and anticoagulation, his condition deteriorated, requiring intubation, ARDSnet ventilation, prone positioning, and renal support. A multidisciplinary plan included cytokine‑adsorption with dual‑filter hemofiltration and preparation for VV‑ECMO; antiviral therapy and intensive monitoring continued. After nearly 30 days, lung and organ function improved; he was weaned from the ventilator and discharged on August 19, 2026. The report notes COVID-19 can still cause severe disease despite lower overall incidence. Separately, a 46-year-old woman, Thu, had an incidental 25×26 mm nodule in the right upper lobe, S1 subsegment, suspicious for cancer. A Da Vinci Xi robotic right upper‑lobe subsegmentectomy was performed to biopsy while preserving lung tissue, illustrating challenges in pulmonary nodule management.

article.articleHeadline: Nhận diện sớm não mô cầu từ những dấu hiệu tưởng như cảm cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early recognition of meningococcal meningitis from flu-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningitis can begin with flu-like symptoms—sudden high fever, severe headache, fatigue, and nausea—yet it can rapidly progress to meningitis or septicemia, risking death within hours. In Ho Chi Minh City, the HCDC notes that early recognition is crucial: abrupt fever with severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, confusion, photophobia, fast breathing, cold extremities, or a purpuric rash warrants urgent medical evaluation. Even with antibiotics, meningococcal disease kills about 10–15% of patients and can cause lasting sequelae such as hearing loss, brain injury, kidney problems, or limb loss. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets. Infants may lack classic signs, appearing lethargic, irritable, or poorly fed. Prevention relies on vaccination (groups B, BC, A/C/Y/W-135) and hygiene. Vietnam offers vaccines for various ages; group B from 2 months to 50 years, BC from 6 months to 45 years, and A/C/Y/W-135 from 6 weeks onward. Early diagnosis and timely antibiotic therapy are essential.

article.articleHeadline: 首破锥体虫基因 深窥大黄鱼"病原" - 社会 - 东南网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First genome of cone-shaped parasite revealed; an in-depth look at the yellow croaker's pathogen
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, researchers from the Fujian Province Agricultural Academy and collaborators announced the first chromosome-level, gapless reference genome of the large yellow croaker cone-shaped parasite, the pathogen behind cone-shaped parasite disease in Larimichthys crocea. The genome measures about 51.04 Mb and is assembled into 35 pseudochromosomes. Comparative genomics place the parasite within its genus and reveal 515 expanded gene families. These expansions are enriched in host–pathogen interactions, immune evasion, metabolic regulation, and cell signaling, suggesting virulence mechanisms that enhance infection and immune escape. Published in Scientific Data, the genome provides a crucial resource for developing diagnostic markers, deciphering host–parasite interactions, tracking evolution and spread, and enabling precise surveillance and control of cone-shaped parasite disease in the large yellow croaker aquaculture industry, which is notably prevalent in Fujian and other major producing regions.

triage.headline_ja: 円錐虫のゲノムを初解読、大黄魚の「病原体」を深く探る
triage.triage_reason: 魚類（大黄魚）養殖業における寄生虫の研究成果に関する記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 対象は魚類病原体（円錐虫）のゲノム研究であり、ヒト感染症事案ではないため公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 5 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo surpass 5,000
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases, registering 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths according to Africa CDC. The World Health Organization says the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, warning of continued risk of local and international spread and calling for intensified response and resources. The outbreak, declared in May, extends across northern and eastern regions of the DRC, where weak health systems complicate containment. Major challenges include limited access to some areas and community resistance to testing, hindering surveillance and case-finding. The report highlights the need for sustained international and national support to curb transmission and protect frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が5000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと表明しており、致死率も高く(約47%)、国際的拡大リスクや医療体制の脆弱性、地域住民の検査拒否などIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言を継続中であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの深刻化を示す続報。5000例超・死者2378人という規模で、コミュニティの検査抵抗や医療アクセスの制限が拡大を助長している。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện thêm ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết ở Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another dengue fever outbreak reported in Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with 21 confirmed cases in Ky Hoa Commune. Eight locally clustered cases are in the Văn Miếu–Trung Thượng area, while the Tan Đức cluster added five cases on August 7, bringing Tan Đức total to nine; an additional four scattered cases in Ky Hoa raise the overall count to 21. The Ha Tinh CDC has launched urgent containment, including field assessment, targeted vector control, and improved environmental sanitation to reduce Aedes breeding. Around 172 households near cases underwent cleaning and larval source reduction, with pesticide spraying. CDC Ha Tinh supplied 19 liters of insecticide for perimeter spraying and urged door-to-door outreach: “go to every alley, knock on every house.” Health authorities will monitor and treat cases, transferring severe patients as needed. Since April 2026, Ha Tinh has reported 215 dengue cases in several localities.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省でデング熱の新たな流行地が発生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（今年215例）で地元CDCが対応中だが、重症度や今後の拡大の見通しに関する情報が不足しており、季節性流行の範囲内である可能性が高い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病的疾患であり、毎年季節性の流行が報告される。今回の事例は地元CDCが既に対応（殺虫剤散布、環境衛生改善等）しており、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。重症患者の割合や致死率など重症度に関する詳細情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak remains far from control - WHO - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bundibugyo, DRC remains far from control with nearly 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths across six provinces and 55 health zones. WHO says it is the second-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-spreading to date. Insecurity, displacement, and heavy population movements via roads, rivers, and mining routes are accelerating transmission. Many deaths occur at home or in communities, outside treatment centers and not on known contact lists, signaling unidentified transmission chains that must be found to end the epidemic. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern three months ago. The threat extends beyond DRC, with a traveller carrying the virus to France; Uganda has successfully stopped transmission after an initial spillover, showing decisive action can contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行、依然として制御には程遠い状況―WHO
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、感染者約5000人・死者2300人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、フランスへの越境事例も確認されるなど国際的拡大が現実化している。IHR基準を複数満たすため即PICKUP。
triage.notes: ウガンダは初期の波及後に伝播を制御済みとされ、フランスは輸入症例1例のみで対象国リストにも含まれないため、主たる発生国はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: World Mosquito Day: मॉनसून में ही नहीं, अब सालभर मच्छरों से अलर्ट, बदला डेंगू-मलेरिया का कैलेंडर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Mosquito Day: Not only during the monsoon, now alert against mosquitoes year-round, the dengue-malaria calendar has changed.
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day highlights year-round risk of dengue and malaria. An Internal Medicine physician at Sharda Care-Health City notes that mosquito-repellent measures or devices can only reduce mosquitoes temporarily; reproduction sites must be eliminated to prevent return. Breeding hotspots include water collected under potted plants, coolers, flower vases, buckets, discarded cans, tires, and stagnant rainwater on rooftops or balconies. The dengue-malaria calendar has changed, signaling ongoing, non-seasonal transmission risks. Public health emphasis shifts from solely repelling mosquitoes to removing breeding habitats and preventing stagnant water around homes. The article stresses practical steps for households to curb proliferation and reduce vector-borne disease risk. As of 20 August 2026, awareness campaigns stress year-round vigilance against mosquitoes to mitigate dengue and malaria.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊の日：モンスーン時期だけでなく、今や一年中蚊への警戒が必要に。デング熱・マラリアの発生カレンダーが変化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、世界蚊の日に関連した一般的な啓発・予防に関する記事であり、緊急性や異常性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の症例数やアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、季節性・予防啓発の一般記事であるため、対象国であるインドが発生地域とされているが具体的な流行状況の言及がなく、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Filipinas emite alerta sanitaria ante riesgo de leptospirosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Philippines issues health alert amid risk of leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in the Philippines after floods; health authorities escalated to Code White hospital alert in Manila and across the country to ready hospitals and specialized staff for potential emergencies. The Department of Health is coordinating with the National Council for Disaster Risk Reduction and Management to ensure a rapid, government-wide response as floods persist in several areas. Central stockpiles include about 3.1 million doxycycline capsules, with reserves also held by 17 district health offices. Authorities are closely monitoring leptospirosis trends linked to contaminated water and are safeguarding medication supply and surge capacity at local facilities. No formal outbreak figures are reported; emphasis remains on preparedness, medical readiness, and contingency planning for possible increases in patients due to flood-related exposure.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、レプトスピラ症リスクの高まりを受け健康警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症リスク増大を受け、保健省がコードホワイト警戒を発令し災害対策機関と全国的な対応を調整しており、政府・社会的関心が高く継続的な曝露リスクもあるためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 正式な発生件数の報告はなく、予防的な医療体制強化とドキシサイクリン備蓄確保が主な対応内容。洪水の継続により曝露リスクが持続している点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Faperta UNIKI Terapkan Teknologi Pakan Pelet dan Gertak Birahi Pascawabah PMK di Padang Sakti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNIKI Faculty of Agriculture Adopts Pellet Feed Technology and Estrus Stimulation Following Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) Outbreak in Padang Sakti.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) outbreak in Padang Sakti village, Bireuen District, Aceh, spurred UNIKI’s Faculty of Agriculture and Animal Science to launch a post-outbreak recovery program on 20 August 2026. The project, titled 'Application of Pellet Feed Technology and Estrus Induction for Increased Production and Reproduction After PMK Outbreak,' is led by Drh. Ahmad Syakir, M.Si., and funded by a Diktisaintek grant. Local farmers partnered with the team to receive education, demonstrations, training, and mentoring on converting feed ingredients into pellets and on estrus detection and timed mating, with emphasis on reproductive-record keeping. The integrated approach aims to restore livestock productivity, improve feed efficiency, and accelerate herd reproduction after PMK, supporting sustainable farming livelihoods in Padang Sakti.

triage.headline_ja: UNIKI農学部、パダン・サクティ村における口蹄疫(PMK)発生後の家畜生産回復に向けペレット飼料技術と発情誘起技術を導入
triage.triage_reason: 動物の口蹄疫(PMK)発生後の復興支援・技術導入に関する記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の懸念や人への影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は口蹄疫(PMK)の過去の発生後の家畜生産・繁殖回復支援プログラムに関するもので、動物疾病であり新規の感染拡大情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز 5 آلاف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 5,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 5,021 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,378 deaths, with the outbreak concentrated in northern and eastern regions and Kinshasa noted in the dateline. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, officially arising on 15 May, with continued risk of spread to neighboring countries. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments yet; clinical trials are ongoing to identify preventive and therapeutic options. Africa CDC data underscore surveillance and health-system challenges, including weak state presence and armed conflict, and a substantial portion of the population refusing testing, hindering contact tracing and containment. The report highlights ongoing transmission and concern about cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者5000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な稀少株、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%と非常に高く、稀少なブンディブギョ株でワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しない点、武力紛争や検査拒否による接触追跡困難など、コンテインメントの著しい障壁が報告されている。国境を越えた拡大リスクへの言及もあり、緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chăn nuôi Bắc Ninh giữ đà tăng trưởng, chủ động 'lá chắn' dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bắc Ninh Livestock Farming Maintains Growth Momentum, Proactively Acts as a Shield Against Disease
article.articleSummary: By August 2026, Bắc Ninh's livestock, veterinary and fisheries sectors maintain growth while strengthening biosecurity and technology-enabled farming and linkage. Meat production reached about 275,000 tons, 69.6% of the plan; target 402,200 t. Buffalo 29,500; cattle 114,700; pigs 1.183 million; poultry 27.45 million (24 million chickens). Aquaculture area in production 16,200 ha; 2,966 river cages; total fish production 71,071 t (68,264 farming, 2,807 harvesting), target 105,000 t. Disease threats persist: African swine fever outbreaks in Ngọc Thiện, Chi Lăng, Đa Mai, Nhân Hòa with 1,628 pigs culled; avian influenza in Đông Cứu, Đại Lai, Chi Lăng, Đa Mai with 4,223 birds culled; as of 19 Aug, one Đa Mai household still under 21 days clearance. Vaccination totals: 14.2 million poultry vaccines, 305,000 rabies vaccines; surveillance, biosecurity, and transport controls; 14,233 shipments checked, 52 violations fined 415 million VND. Future focus: disease monitoring, vaccination above 80%, biosecurity, digitalization, and linkage.

triage.headline_ja: バクニン省の畜産、成長基調を維持しつつ疫病への「盾」を主体的に構築
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（豚・鳥）における豚熱・鳥インフルエンザの発生は地域の通常の防疫対応の範囲内で管理されており、ヒトへの感染や異常な拡大は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナム・バクニン省の畜産業全般の成長と疫病対策（ASF・鳥インフルエンザの家畜間発生とワクチン接種・検疫実績）に関する定例報告であり、ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。

article.articleHeadline: गौतमबुद्ध नगर में बढ़ा डेंगू का खतरा, 15 हाईराइज सोसाइटियों को नोटिस जारी - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk increases in Gautam Buddh Nagar; notices issued to 15 high-rise housing societies
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk is rising in Gautam Buddh Nagar, including Noida and Greater Noida, during the monsoon as rainwater creates Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The district health department has intensified surveillance and inspections, issuing 15 notices to high-rise housing societies for larvae and waterlogging. Hospitals report an uptick in viral-fever cases, with roughly 30–40% of daily patients presenting with fever-like illness, complicating dengue diagnosis. Officials warn dengue vectors can breed in clean, stagnant water, meaning risk extends beyond dirty drains. Inspections focus on basements, parking areas, construction zones, rooftops, planters, coolers, and water tanks; wherever water stagnates, notices are issued. Previously, four societies were warned in October 2025. Public guidance emphasizes removing standing water, cleaning plant trays, and regular anti-larval spraying in homes and societies.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタムブッダ・ナガルでデング熱リスク増加、高層住宅15施設に通知発出
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱リスク増加の通常業務的な行政対応であり、IHR基準の該当は低いが、地域的な流行拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節性のデング熱リスク増加に関する地方自治体の予防的対応の記事であり、重症例や死亡者数についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Des bébés contaminés par Ebola durant l'allaitement en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Babies infected with Ebola during breastfeeding in Ituri
article.articleSummary: During World Breastfeeding Week, in Ituri, Ebola virus infected some infants during breastfeeding, with others dying from the disease. The National Nutrition Program (PRONANUT) urged stronger protection for breastfeeding mothers and their children and called for tailored care for infected women, including, in some cases, weaning to lower transmission risk. 'During an Ebola outbreak, breast milk is contraindicated. When a mother is affected, she should be separated from her child to avoid contamination. Once the illness is treated, the mother can resume breastfeeding, which remains essential for the child’s survival,' explained Cosma Bakemwanga, provincial PRONANUT coordinator. The program notes transmission can occur both from mother to child and vice versa through breast milk. The guidance aligns with HIV-prevention logic, given breastfeeding can transmit both infections.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州で授乳を介して乳児がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行において、母乳を介した母子感染で乳児死亡が発生しており、重症度・拡大リスクともに高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラ流行に関連する続報。母乳感染という新たな伝播経路が強調されており、公衆衛生対応（授乳指導・母子分離）の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: 不只長輩！醫點名「肺炎鏈球菌」高危族群　重症恐致命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not just the elderly! Doctors identify high-risk groups for Streptococcus pneumoniae; severe illness could be fatal.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae causes community-acquired pneumonia and invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) in adults, potentially leading to sepsis, meningitis, or death. In Taiwan, high-risk adults beyond seniors face severe risk, including workers under high stress, irregular hours, frequent travelers, smokers, heavy drinkers, and those with diabetes, hypertension, or hyperlipidemia. Travel to Japan, China, Hong Kong, and the United States can introduce the bacterium to households, heightening risk for elderly and chronically ill family members. Serotype replacement continues; newly funded 21-valent vaccines cover serotypes aligned with current Taiwanese adult epidemiology, while 20-valent vaccines remain an important public option. With autumn–winter influenza approaching, post-flu immune suppression raises pneumococcal infection risk. The message stresses integrated prevention: protect against influenza and pneumococcus; vaccination decisions should be made with a clinician.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者だけじゃない！医師が肺炎球菌の高リスク群を指摘　重症化で死亡の恐れも
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における肺炎球菌感染症予防・ワクチン啓発を目的とした一般的な医療情報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれる中国（香港含む）は記事中で渡航先の一例として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地ではない。台湾・日本・米国は対象国リスト外。記事は一般的な予防啓発であり、特定のアウトブレイク事案ではない。

article.articleHeadline: गौतमबुद्ध नगर में बढ़ा डेंगू का खतरा, 15 हाईराइज सोसाइटियों को नोटिस जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk has increased in Gautam Buddh Nagar, notices issued to 15 high-rise societies.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, dengue risk has risen in Gautam Buddh Nagar, including Noida and Greater Noida high-rise societies. Monsoon rains have produced water-logging, prompting intensified surveillance; 15 notices have been issued for larvae and stagnant water. Hospitals report rising viral-fever cases, with about 30–40% of daily OPD patients presenting with fever. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes—dengue vectors—can breed in clean standing water; breeding sites include basements, parking, construction zones, rooftops, plant pots, coolers, and water tanks. In July 2026, Barola, Surajpur, Kasna, and Sector-50 were flagged for dengue cases and breeding sites, triggering campaigns. Authorities urge eliminating water accumulation, regularly changing cooler water, cleaning pots/trays, and routine anti-larval spraying; residents should seek medical testing for persistent fever.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタム・ブッダ・ナガルでデング熱リスクが上昇、高層住宅15施設に通知発行
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱発生増加を伝える地方ニュースであり、通常の公衆衛生対応（通知・防除活動）の範囲内。国際的拡大や渡航制限の可能性は低いが、症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性モンスーンに伴うデング熱媒介蚊の繁殖増加が主因。地方自治体レベルでの通常の防除・監視活動が行われており、深刻な公衆衛生上の危機や国際的懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is spreading faster beyond Congo epicentre, straining outbreak response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding beyond the Ituri epicentre, with confirmed infections rising to 5,208 and deaths to 2,476 (case-fatality 47.5%) as of Aug 18, according to the government. Transmission is accelerating in North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo, with Bas-Uélé newly affected, bringing 56 health districts under risk. Health-system strain is evident: North Kivu’s Ebola treatment facilities were over capacity in July; bed shortages persist in Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé report, while Wamba and Isiro show patient-to-bed mismatches. Contact tracing performance is uneven (64.3% in Haut-Uélé on Aug 17 vs 93% in Ituri; Bas-Uélé <20%). WHO is deploying 100 epidemiologists and over 500 community health workers for tracing and outreach. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine is used, with 2,000 doses in Tshopo and a request for 500,000 more; it targets Zaire strain, with studies on cross-protection against the current outbreak strain planned. Educational districts (18, about 2,890 schools) will switch to printed/radio/TV lessons as Sept 1 opening is postponed for four weeks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ震源地を越えて拡大速度増加、対応が逼迫
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当し、WHOによる大規模支援投入など社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 感染者数5,208人、死者2,476人（CFR47.5%）、56保健地区がリスクに晒される大規模アウトブレイク。WHOが100名の疫学者と500名以上のコミュニティヘルスワーカーを派遣。既存ワクチン（Ervebo）は現行株への交差防御が未確認で、追加50万回分の要請あり。学校閉鎖等社会的影響も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: خبرگزاری آریا - هشدار سازمان جهانی بهداشت درباره شیوع جهانی ابولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aria News Agency - WHO warns about the global Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spiraled beyond control, raising the risk of becoming the deadliest Ebola epidemic worldwide. As of last week, more than 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths have been reported across 55 health zones in six provinces. The agency notes this is the largest Ebola outbreak in Congo and the second-largest in world history, with no clear evidence of transmission slowing. Africa CDC cautions the disease now claims about one life every 30 minutes, underscoring the urgency of containment. The report highlights the severity of the outbreak but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: アリアニュース通信 - WHO、世界的なエボラ流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5000例超・死者2378人と制御不能な規模に拡大し、WHOが世界最大級の流行と警告しており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準にも合致するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国における大規模エボラ流行に関するWHO・Africa CDCの警告を報じている。検査確認、感染源、越境事例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: World Mosquito Day 2026: History, diseases, symptoms and ways to prevent mosquito bites
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day on August 20 highlights mosquito-borne diseases in India amid monsoon conditions in New Delhi, where stagnant water around homes, roads, and construction sites fosters breeding. The observance marks Sir Ronald Ross’s 1897 discovery that malaria parasites develop in Anopheles mosquitoes, a finding later honored with the 1902 Nobel Prize. Mosquito-borne infections discussed include malaria (Plasmodium; Anopheles), dengue, chikungunya (Aedes), Zika, and Japanese encephalitis (Culex). Early symptoms resemble viral fever and include sudden high fever, chills, headaches, body aches, fatigue, nausea, or rash; severe signs require urgent care. At-risk groups are children, older adults, and pregnant women; those in tropical areas or with stagnant water, poor drainage, or construction sites face greater exposure. Prevention emphasizes repellents, long sleeves, screens, nets, emptying standing water, and larvicides; testing during monsoon aids diagnosis and treatment decisions.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue threat has increased in Gautam Buddh Nagar, notices issued to 15 high-rise societies.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk is rising in Gautam Buddh Nagar during the monsoon, with Noida and Greater Noida high-rise societies now affected. After-rain water-logging and increased mosquito breeding prompted intensified surveillance, and 15 notices were issued to high-rise communities for larval breeding in basements, parking areas, rooftops, plant trays, coolers, and water tanks. October 2025 saw four societies warned for larvae and water stagnation. In July 2026, campaigns targeted Barola, Surajpur, Kasna, and Sector-50 after dengue cases and breeding sites were detected. Aedes aegypti can breed in clean, standing water, not only dirty drains, raising concerns in large populations. Hospitals report rising viral fever admissions; about 30-40% of daily fever patients. Dengue symptoms resemble viral fever: high fever, headache, body and muscle pain, weakness, vomiting. Public urged to prevent water stagnation, change cooler water, keep plants/trays clean, and ensure regular anti-larval spraying by society management and AOAs.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタムブッダナガルでデング熱の脅威が増大、高層住宅15団地に通知発行

triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性風土病であり、モンスーン期の恒常的な公衆衛生対応（幼虫駆除通知等）を報じる内容。重症度や死亡者数についての具体的情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố thêm 2 đối tượng mua bán thịt nhiễm dịch tả heo châu Phi ra thị trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two more individuals charged with selling meat infected with African swine fever on the market.
article.articleSummary: Two individuals, Trương Văn Công and Hứa Hoàng Khởi, were charged on 20 August 2026 by Can Tho City Police with violations of food safety regulations after allegedly colluding with Thị Hồng Cam to buy diseased or dead pigs, have them slaughtered, and sell the meat on the market. The case centers on the Đặng Phú Tỷ slaughterhouse in Vĩnh Viễn, with investigations dating to 10 November 2025. A 9 October 2025 inspection found 40 live pigs and one slaughtered pig bearing veterinary seals; rapid tests on the slaughtered meat were positive for African swine fever (ASF). Separately, authorities tested two pork lots tied to Cam and Trương Văn Mười at the Vĩnh Viễn market (totaling 840.7 kg); 10 of 12 samples were ASF-positive. Earlier, on 10 November 2025, three workers were charged with abuse of power, and on 12 February 2026 Lưu Văn Nam and Cam were charged with food-safety violations; investigation ongoing.

triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は人に感染しない動物疾病であり、本記事は食品安全法違反に関する刑事訴追の続報であって新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や新たな流行拡大を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov Gorontalo perkuat penemuan kasus TBC melaui tracing-CKG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gorontalo Provincial Government Strengthens TB Case Finding Through Tracing-CKG
article.articleSummary: Gorontalo province strengthens TB case finding by integrating contact tracing with Free Health Check (CKG) in Molombulahe village, Paguyaman district, Boalemo Regency. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus conveyed appreciation via WhatsApp; Anang S Otoluwa notes the approach expands access and engages government, health workers, communities, and private providers. Tracing targets close contacts, especially family and neighbors, directing them for TB testing and follow-up. Integrating tracing with CKG broadens community health services, offering general health screenings and TB education on symptoms, transmission, risk factors, and early detection. A MoU with private clinics and TPMD strengthens Public-Private Mix (PPM); coordinated referral, recording, reporting, treatment, and monitoring must be ensured. The strategy aims to reduce stigma and reinforce prevention messaging, ventilation, and prompt testing. Desa Molombulahe illustrates a community-based, networked TB response.

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini TBC, Rutan Balikpapan Gelar Rontgen Dada dan Cek Kesehatan Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection of Tuberculosis, Balikpapan Detention Center Holds Chest X-Rays and Free Health Checks.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening and free health checks were conducted at Balikpapan Class IIA Detention Center on 20 August 2026. The program used a mobile chest X-ray unit to screen inmates for active TB and to support early detection, complemented by general health checks to monitor overall health. The screening, conducted in collaboration with Balikpapan City Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Kota Balikpapan) and Puskesmas Damai, aims to detect potential TB cases early, including among asymptomatic individuals, to prevent transmission in the crowded, closed detention environment. The effort underscores health as a basic right and aligns with Indonesia's Law No. 22 of 2022 on the corrections system. By identifying cases promptly, the Rutan Balikpapan seeks to safeguard inmates' health and ensure smooth custodial processes.
