article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ebola : " On n'a jamais vu ça ", Jean Kaseya alarmé par une flambée de 70 à 100 nouveaux cas par jour
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ebola: "We've never seen anything like this," Jean Kaseya alarmed by a flare-up of 70 to 100 new cases per day.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows an unprecedented acceleration: 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality rate 47.5%) since May, per INSP. In the last 24 hours, 70–100 new confirmed cases and 50–60 deaths per day. The outbreak spans six provinces and 56 health zones, with Ituri the hardest hit (28 of 36 zones), Nord-Kivu (12), Tshopo (7), Haut-Uélé (6), Bas-Uélé (2); Sud-Kivu now has only one active zone with no new cases in 79 days. Recoveries: 1,115; 730 patients in care; 84% contact-follow-up. Response focuses on vaccination scale-up—2,000 Ervebo doses available in Tshopo, in addition to a request for 500,000 more—and expanded therapeutics, including remdesivir and monoclonal antibodies under consideration. The 2026-2027 school year will be adjusted in 18 high-risk zones with four weeks of reduced-distance learning.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ出血熱：「これまで見たことがない」、ジャン・カセヤ氏が1日70〜100件の新規感染急増に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.5%の大規模エボラ流行が6州56保健地区に拡大し、1日70〜100件の新規感染という「前例のない」急拡大がWHOアフリカ地域事務局長級によって警告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域事務局長（Jean Kaseya）自らが「前例のない」急拡大と警告しており、ワクチン50万回分の追加要請や治療薬（レムデシビル、モノクローナル抗体）の検討、学校閉鎖措置も報じられていることから、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。IHR国際保健規則に基づくWHO緊急事態宣言の可能性も含め、フルRRAへの移行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se ceba con el Congo: hay más de 2.300 muertos y el brote está "lejos de estar bajo control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Congo: there are more than 2,300 deaths and the outbreak is far from under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to worsen, recording more than 5,000 suspected or confirmed cases and at least 2,378 deaths as of 20 August 2026. The Bundibugyo variant drives the surge, with the epidemic spreading to six of the 26 eastern and northeastern provinces and the death toll rising, roughly one every 30 minutes. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is far from under control and is the fastest-growing Ebola crisis to date, second only to the 2014–2016 Liberia/Sierra Leone/Guinea outbreak, which killed over 11,300. Declared late and with no approved vaccine or licensed treatment, containment hinges on interrupting transmission chains. The WHO is boosting community surveillance and engagement, and advancing clinical trials of treatments and two experimental vaccines to accelerate response.

article.articleHeadline: 'पशुओं और पक्षियों से फैलने वाले संक्रामक रोग चुनौती'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Challenge of Infectious Diseases Transmitted by Animals and Birds
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Microbiology Department at Almora Medical College convened a one-day technical workshop on monitoring zoonotic diseases, highlighting public health challenges in mountainous Kumaon. Principal Dr. G.S. Titiyal inaugurated the session, while experts discussed effective control of infectious diseases and protection for health workers. The discourse emphasized that diseases transmitted from animals and birds to humans in hilly, forested regions pose ongoing public health challenges, underscoring the need for a coordinated One Health approach integrating human, animal, and environmental health to enable timely identification, prevention, and control. Nodal officer Dr. Vikrant Negi presented data on zoonotic disease figures in Kumaon. The event aimed to strengthen surveillance and response capabilities in the Almora/Kumaon corridor.

article.articleHeadline: उज्जैन में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक: 60 वर्षीय महिला की मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग की कार्यशैली पर उठे सवाल; जानें H1N1 के लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Ujjain: death of a 60-year-old woman, questions raised about the health department's functioning; know the symptoms of H1N1.
article.articleSummary: 60-year-old woman from Rishi Nagar, Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, died of swine flu (H1N1) after lab confirmation on July 31. She was admitted July 27, transferred to Indore on August 3, and after 16 days of intensive care was discharged to home, dying about an hour later. CMHO reports 28 households (104 people) were screened; all tests were negative. Family alleges negligence by the health department, citing lack of family screening and absence of clear guidance. Investigations note a nearby drain and pigs near the residence; the patient also had diabetes and other conditions. Lab results confirmed Influenza A and H1N1; the infection source remains undetermined. Area under heightened surveillance. WHO-linked swine flu precautions are mentioned, and symptoms are noted to typically appear 1–4 days after exposure, though specific patient symptoms aren’t enumerated in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ウッジャインでスワインフル発生：60歳女性が死亡、保健局の対応に疑問の声；H1N1の症状について

triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる単発死亡例。家族は保健局の対応（家族への検査未実施等）に不満を表明しているが、周辺世帯（28世帯104人）の検査は全て陰性であり、地域的な感染拡大の証拠はない。記事は地方メディアによる保健行政への批判的論調が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa có dấu hiệu gia tăng, chuyên gia cảnh báo phụ huynh không chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu on the rise, experts warn parents not to be complacent.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza is rising in Vietnam. The National Children’s Hospital in Hanoi reports 60–80 lab-confirmed influenza cases per week during late summer 2026, with about 20% of these patients hospitalized. Globally, influenza annually causes millions of cases; children under 5, especially under 2, are at high risk of severe complications. Infected children typically present with sudden high fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, muscle aches, and fatigue. Most recover in about a week, but severe cases can lead to pneumonia, otitis media, bronchiolitis, sinusitis, myocarditis, encephalitis, sepsis, or exacerbation of conditions like asthma and congenital heart disease. Children’s immune systems are still developing, and prolonged viral shedding makes them important transmission sources in schools and homes. Prevention centers on hygiene, handwashing, masking, environmental cleaning, proper nutrition and sleep, and most effectively, annual influenza vaccination to reduce infection, hospitalization, and severe outcomes and to bolster herd immunity.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行報道であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、小児の入院率が高い点から経過観察の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病毒感染抗病毒治疗如何应对毒株迭代？民得维提供循证参考_中华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to cope with SARS-CoV-2 variant evolution in antiviral therapy for COVID-19 infection? Mindewei provides evidence-based references — Zhonghua Net
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China as of 2026-08-20 shows periodic waves with summer travel. Mindewei (deuterated remdesivir hydrobromide tablets), a domestically developed antiviral, targets the conserved SARS-CoV-2 RdRp, giving activity across variants. Deuterium at the C7 position improves metabolic stability and may enhance potency. In laboratory passaging with Omicron BA.5, resistance remained minimal through 5 passages and only modestly declined by 10, suggesting a slow resistance trajectory; the standard 5-day course further mitigates resistance risk. Clinically, a Phase 3 trial in 1,347 Chinese patients with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 showed median time to symptom resolution shortened by 48 hours and faster viral clearance versus placebo. Another Phase 3 head-to-head trial in 771 high-risk patients, reported in NEJM, favored Mindewei for non-inferiority against a 3CL inhibitor, with shorter recovery time and fewer adverse events. Overall, Mindewei offers stable efficacy during variant circulation and supports early antiviral treatment under physician guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症の抗ウイルス治療、変異株の進化にどう対応するか？民得維がエビデンスに基づく参考情報を提供 — 中華網

triage.notes: 記事は中国国内の季節的なCOVID-19流行を背景に、新規抗ウイルス薬Mindewei（重水素化レムデシビル）の臨床試験結果を紹介する製薬関連ニュースであり、感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Giornata internazionale della zanzara (non in suo onore) per ricordare la lotta alla malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Day of the Mosquito (not in its honor) to remember the fight against malaria.
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day on August 20 commemorates Ronald Ross's 1897 discovery in India that mosquitoes transmit malaria. Giovanni Battista Grassi later defined which genera are involved: Anopheles carries malaria, while Aedes and Culex transmit other diseases. The World Health Organization estimates roughly 700,000 mosquito-borne deaths annually, with malaria, yellow fever, dengue, West Nile, Zika, and chikungunya highlighted. In Italy, about 70 species exist, but risk of dangerous infections remains very low. The Italian Istituto Superiore di Sanità advises defending against bites with window/door screens; indoor use of tablet or liquid insecticide devices; outdoor use of mosquito coils or citronella candles; and careful repellent use (read labels, avoid under age 2, avoid applying with sunscreen or on cuts). Traditional tips include light-colored clothing and covering exposed skin; DEET is one of the safest, most effective repellents. A humorous note: Iceland is mosquito-free.

article.articleHeadline: MP: उज्जैन की महिला की स्वाइन फ्लू से मौत..... इंदौर के निजी अस्पताल में थी भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MP: Woman from Ujjain dies of swine flu... was admitted to a private hospital in Indore.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) infection confirmed in a woman from Ujjain who died after treatment in Indore, India. The patient, resident of Rishi Nagar, Ujjain, was initially hospitalized for six days at Avanti Super Hospital in Ujjain, then transferred to Kokilaben Hospital in Indore for about two weeks of care. Due to lack of improvement, her family returned her to Ujjain, where she died at home. Nasal and throat swabs tested positive for H1N1, with symptoms of shortness of breath, cold, and cough. As of 20 August 2026, health authorities have not officially confirmed that the death was due to swine flu; the Chief Health Officer noted no hospital had informed the department of a swine flu case. Travel history indicated limited movement beyond home, with occasional park visits; illness began after July 25.

article.articleHeadline: BMKG Peringatkan El Nino Sampai November, Awas Nyamuk DBD Makin Ganas dan Agresif Saat Udara Panas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BMKG Warns El Niño Through November, Beware Dengue Mosquitoes Are Becoming More Ferocious and Aggressive in Hot Weather
article.articleSummary: El Niño is intensifying Indonesia's dry season, keeping heat through November 2026, with the peak from August to September 2026, especially in urban Jabodetabek. Warmer temperatures accelerate Aedes aegypti, the dengue fever vector, shortening the blood-feeding cycle of female mosquitoes from roughly every five days to about every two days. Water-storage practices during drought create more breeding sites, and parched conditions push mosquitoes to invade indoor spaces in search of humidity. These climatic conditions could markedly expand Aedes aegypti habitats in residential areas and significantly raise the risk of dengue virus transmission to households. No laboratory-confirmed case counts are provided, but health experts warn of potential dengue outbreaks as the El Niño-driven heat persists.

triage.headline_ja: BMKGがエルニーニョは11月まで続くと警告、暑さでデング熱媒介蚊がより凶暴・攻撃的になる恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や発生報告はなく、気候要因によるデング熱リスク上昇に関する注意喚起記事であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 気象条件によるデング熱リスク上昇の予防的警告記事であり、実際の症例数データは含まれていない。今後の症例報告動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is spreading faster beyond Congo epicenter, straining outbreak response
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 18, 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 5,208 confirmed cases (+103) and 2,476 deaths (CFR 47.5%). The epidemic, which began in Ituri, is spreading to North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé (56 districts affected). Outside Ituri, case growth accelerates, straining treatment facilities already at capacity; beds are scarce—Wamba reports four times as many confirmed patients as beds; Isiro more than twice beds; only one of seven Haut-Uélé centers meets standards. Contact tracing lags: Haut-Uélé 64.3% of contacts traced (Aug 17); Bas-Uélé under 20%. Community deaths remain high (29 of 42 on Aug 17). WHO deploying 100 epidemiologists; 500+ health workers support tracing and outreach. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine: 2,000 doses in Tshopo; 500,000 more requested; approved for Zaire ebolavirus; study planned for current strain. Schools in 18 high-risk districts (~2,890) to reopen Sept 1 with four weeks of measures, using printed materials and radio/TV.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴの震源地を越えて拡大速度が加速、対応体制が逼迫
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例5,208例、死亡2,476例（致死率47.5%）に達し、震源地イトゥリ州外への拡大が加速。ベッド不足・接触者追跡の遅れ・地域社会での死亡増加など対応体制の逼迫が深刻であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが100名の疫学者を派遣、500人以上の保健従事者が接触者追跡を支援。Ervebo(Merckのワクチン)の追加50万回分を要請しており、現行株への有効性評価も計画中。学校再開（9月1日、高リスク18地区約2,890校）による感染拡大リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Klaten Turun Signifikan pada 2026, Warga Diminta Tetap Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases in Klaten Decline Significantly in 2026, Residents Urged to Remain Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Klaten Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, declined sharply in 2026. Up to week 32, 2026, there were 124 dengue cases and 1 death, compared with 419 cases and 3 deaths in the same period in 2025. The drop is attributed to stronger community engagement in the Mosquito Nest Elimination program (PSN) and the active role of larval inspectors (jumantik) at village and urban levels, along with better environmental cleanliness, faster medical response for early dengue symptoms, and intensified health education campaigns. Officials warn against complacency, noting that weather shifts and neglected environments could trigger a resurgence, so PSN and jumantik activities must continue effectively. No information on imported or exported dengue cases is provided; transmission is driven by Aedes aegypti within Klaten.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、クラテンのデング熱症例が大幅減少、住民には引き続き警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は前年比で大幅に減少しており、地域の風土病的状況の改善を伝える内容で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年より減少しており、地域内の風土病的デング熱の季節報告。異常な増加や新規変異等の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал первый российский тест на гепатит Е
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor registered the first Russian-made test for hepatitis E.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, Russia's Central Research Institute of Epidemiology (CRIE) of Rospotrebnadzor announced the development, registration, and start of production of Russia’s first domestically produced hepatitis E test. The molecular assay detects hepatitis E virus genetic material at early infection stages when antibody-based serology can yield false negatives. The system can also be used to test environmental samples to promptly implement measures to prevent spread. Health experts cited by Rospotrebnadzor note that hepatitis E is widespread in China and Russia and is transmitted via water, similar to hepatitis A. The release emphasizes diagnostic capability and public health utility, rather than reporting of specific case counts. No outbreaks or case numbers were provided in the statement.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ロシア初の国産E型肝炎検査を登録
triage.triage_reason: 新しい診断検査の開発・登録に関する発表であり、具体的な発生・症例数の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの検査キット開発・登録に関する発表であり、具体的な発生国での症例報告ではない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、中国についても発生事例としての記載はなく一般的な流行地域として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت: ابولا در کنگو از کنترل خارج شده است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola in Congo has gotten out of control.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is out of control, with 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths (case fatality 47.4%) across 55 health zones in six provinces, as of August 16. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no vaccine or treatment, making this the largest Ebola outbreak on record and the second-largest globally, with ongoing intense transmission and no clear downturn. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking at an Emergency Committee meeting, said the outbreak is out of control and risks spreading within the DRC and internationally. Africa CDC warned the epidemic could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak ever unless the trajectory reverses immediately, with roughly one death every 30 minutes. The report underscores the urgent need for intensified response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ出血熱は制御不能となっている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を「制御不能」と表明し、致死率47.4%・国際拡大リスクありと明言しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO緊急委員会での発言として報道されており、史上最大規模のエボラ流行との指摘あり。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株である点も重症度・拡大リスクを高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Tk 25 cr budget fails to stop Chattogram dengue surge
article.articleSummary: Chattogram’s dengue surge continues despite a record Tk 25 crore budget for mosquito control in the CCC for 2026-27, nearly five times the previous year. District cases this year total 1,455, with 620 in the city and 618 in upazilas; August’s first 18 days saw 621 infections. Eight wards are high-risk hotspots: 10 North Kattali; 3 Panchlaish; 2 Jalalabad; 17 West Baklia; 19 South Baklia; 39 South Halishahar; 34 Patharghata; 32 Anderkilla. On-site checks show drains clogged by plastic and polythene waste; CDA and WASA excavation has created stagnant water for Aedes. The CCC has spent 41 crore on mosquito control over 25 years; 2026-27 allocates 25 crore with 165 regular spraymen, 60 from special teams, 74 fogging machines and over 160 spray machines. A 2021 CCC study found larvicide kill at 16% after two hours and fogging mortality below 20%. Experts urge moving toward eco-friendly controls (Singapore-style drones, Brazil-style Wolbachia) and improved interagency coordination; Mayor defends BTI claim; critics warn against overreliance on awareness and home breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 25億タカの予算でもチッタゴンのデング熱急増を止められず
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュ・チッタゴンでの季節性デング熱流行に関する記事であり、対象国（Brazil、Singaporeは対策事例として言及されているのみで発生地ではない）に該当する感染事例がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はバングラデシュ・チッタゴンにおける季節性デング熱流行と蚊対策予算の話題。SingaporeとBrazilは先進的な媒介動物対策（ドローン、Wolbachia法）の事例として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生地ではない。バングラデシュ自体は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: एक सैकड़ा से अधिक परिवारों पर संक्रामक बीमारी का खतरा -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of an infectious disease among more than a hundred families.
article.articleSummary: Singrauli, India: Residents of Housing Board Colony behind Pachkhoora, Ward 30, led by retired Army man Arun Singh, report that poor drainage construction during road work has left a clogged drain, causing rainwater and sewage to backflow into homes. Long-standing stagnation has increased filth and odour, putting at risk the area’s drinking water supply. More than 100 families face potential outbreaks of cholera, kala-azar, diarrhea, jaundice, and dengue. Singh says responsible officials have delayed decisive action despite complaints to the district collector, the public hearing portal, and the CM helpline; he asserts drainage could be cleared in minutes. The case highlights an urgent public-health threat from contaminated water and vector exposure, necessitating immediate drainage restoration and water-quality safeguards to avert disease transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 100世帯以上に感染症の危険
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、排水不良による将来的な感染症リスクへの住民の懸念を伝える地域ニュースであり、確定症例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の疾患の実際の発生報告ではなく、排水インフラ不備による衛生環境悪化とそれに伴う感染症リスクを住民が訴える内容。地元行政への対応要求が主眼であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す確定的な症例情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa desenvolve dispositivo portátil para diagnosticar tuberculose em cinco minutos | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers develop a portable device to diagnose tuberculosis in five minutes | South Zone.
article.articleSummary: Portable tuberculosis diagnostic device under development in Brazil, capable of detecting Mycobacterium tuberculosis in under five minutes from a sputum sample. Initiated by Ana Paula de Oliveira Lopes Antunes, a PhD student at the Federal University of Rio Grande (FURG), and the Nernst startup incubated in Innovatio/Furg. Aimed for use in primary health units, rural communities, Indigenous populations, and prisons lacking laboratory infrastructure. The system uses a disposable sensor with a portable reader, delivering results faster than current methods. The standard Teste Rápido Molecular para Tuberculose (TRM-TB) takes about two hours and requires lab facilities; the new device intends to operate without lab dependence or highly specialized staff, with training. Current prototype is at TRL 4, with planned real-use testing and regulatory approval (ANVISA). Expect ~70% cost reduction versus existing diagnostics. Tuberculosis is airborne and primarily affects lungs; treatment involves antibiotics via SUS for at least six months.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが結核を5分で診断する携帯型デバイスを開発 | ゾーナ・スル
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断技術開発に関する研究報道であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける結核診断機器の研究開発に関する内容であり、疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: এডিস মশা মারার ছয় ওষুধের পাঁচটিতেই কাজ হচ্ছে না, ডেঙ্গু বাড়ার শঙ্কা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five of the six Aedes mosquito-killing drugs are not working; dengue cases feared to rise.
article.articleSummary: Five of six insecticides tested against Aedes aegypti in Dhaka and Chittagong, Bangladesh show resistance; across three chemical classes, some doses up to tenfold higher still left up to 84% of mosquitoes alive. Two genetic mutations linked to resistance identified in mosquitoes. Organic phosphate group (organophosphate) malathion remained effective: within 24 hours, 98% of field-collected Aedes died in both cities after application. The study, led by Prof. Kabirul Bashar of Jahangirnagar University with Japan’s Institute of Health Security collaborators, began in 2023 and is ongoing. Findings were presented at the Asia-Pacific Mosquito and Vector Control Conference in Bangkok earlier this month, timed with World Mosquito Day (Aug 20). Implications point to potential resurgence of dengue cases if resistance spreads, underscoring need for alternative control strategies in Bangladesh.

triage.headline_ja: アカイエカ駆除薬6種のうち5種が効果を発揮せず、デング熱増加の懸念
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の直接的な発生報告ではなく、媒介蚊の殺虫剤耐性に関する研究発表だが、将来的な流行拡大リスクを示唆する内容であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにバングラデシュは含まれていないため verified_locations は空。タイ・日本は研究発表・協力機関の所在地であり、疾病発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường giải pháp sàng lọc và chẩn đoán bệnh lao tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening TB screening and diagnostic solutions in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening and diagnostic enhancement is underway in Ho Chi Minh City through a 2026–2028 project led by Pham Ngoc Thach Hospital and Friends for International Tuberculosis Relief (FIT). Funded by Unitaid via Start4All and technically supported by the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, the initiative aims to boost active TB case finding, rapid diagnosis, and integrated treatment with other infectious diseases and non-communicable diseases at community and primary health care levels. Launched on 4 August 2026, the program unites Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health, National TB Programme, WHO Vietnam, LSTM, University of Ottawa, and local partners, with activities extending to Hanoi until March 2027. In Ho Chi Minh City, participants will access AI-assisted chest X-rays and Near-Point-of-Care tests on oral swabs and sputum smears using miniDock Pluslife, enabling same-day diagnosis and treatment linkage. Findings will inform policy and nationwide scale-up.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市における結核の検診・診断強化策
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの強化・拡充に関する平常業務的な報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 国家結核プログラムの一環としての診断・検診体制強化に関する計画発表記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: BRIN peringatkan risiko amplifikasi ekologi dan wabah pascabencana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN warns of the risk of ecological amplification and post-disaster outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Post-disaster ecological amplification may trigger vector-borne disease outbreaks in Indonesia, BRIN warns. In an online Jakarta discussion, BRIN Public Health and Nutrition Research Center scientist Ristiyanto explains disasters do not immediately cause epidemics but create environmental conditions that boost vector and reservoir populations, elevating human exposure. Floods and tsunamis often leave freshwater or brackish standing water; droughts drive unsafe water storage. As habitats for mosquitoes and rodents shift, ecological amplification can escalate, potentially yielding diseases not previously common in a region. Affected diseases include dengue fever, malaria, leptospirosis, and salmonellosis. Ristiyanto emphasizes ecological changes can serve as early warning signals before case numbers rise, enabling rapid response to protect services in impacted areas such as Jakarta. The article does not report specific case counts or outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN、災害後の生態学的増幅とアウトブレイクのリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例数やアウトブレイク発生の報告はなく、専門家による災害後の一般的なリスク啓発・警鐘記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、BRIN科学者による災害後の生態学的変化とベクター媒介感染症リスクに関する一般的な啓発・警告記事である。ジャカルタでの発生地域情報が付与されているが、実際の症例発生を示す内容ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: La rougeole au Yémen constitue-t-elle une menace pour l'ensemble de la région ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is measles in Yemen a threat to the entire region?
article.articleSummary: As of July 2026, a CDC statistic places Yemen (population ~39 million) third worldwide in measles cases, behind Bangladesh and India. Measles has been endemic in Yemen since 2021, with sustained transmission reflecting a severely weakened health system amid protracted conflict and vaccination service disruptions. In July 2026, MoPHP with WHO and UNICEF launched a vaccination campaign in southern governorates, aiming to vaccinate children against measles and rubella; a second phase is planned for September to reach all under-5s in the south. On the technical side, rapid cold chain and vaccine management assessments are underway, alongside strengthened surveillance and mobile vaccination teams to reach missed children. WHO officials emphasize that access barriers, not vaccine hesitancy, drive missed vaccinations, and highlight communities' determination to protect children amid ongoing hardship.

triage.headline_ja: イエメンの麻疹は地域全体への脅威となるか？
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はイエメンにおける麻疹の流行であり、対象国（バングラデシュ・インドは比較統計としての言及のみ）に直接関係する事案ではないため、監視対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はイエメンの麻疹流行が地域的脅威となりうるかを論じているが、対象国リストにイエメンは含まれない。バングラデシュ・インドは症例数比較のための言及であり、記事の主題国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DLH Jambi Uji Kualitas Air Dua Kali Setahun, E-Coli dan TSS Dominan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jambi Department of Environment Tests Water Quality Twice a Year, E. coli and TSS Dominate
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Total Suspended Solids (TSS) dominate water quality concerns in Jambi, Indonesia. The Jambi Province Environmental Agency (DLH) conducts twice-yearly testing of rivers under provincial jurisdiction, including Batang Tebo, Batang Tembesi, Batang Bungo, and Pengabuan. Laboratory analyses take about 14 working days after sampling. E. coli levels exceed standards at multiple points, originating from domestic activity and household wastewater discharged directly into rivers. Elevated TSS relates to upstream deforestation, erosion, sedimentation, and illegal mining; El Niño-induced lower river discharge can amplify TSS concentrations. Challenges include resource consistency and budget constraints. Governance: cross-provincial rivers like Batanghari fall under national authority per PP 38/2011 and PP 22/2021, while counties monitor rivers within their borders. DLH provides environmental-quality data; health and ecological impacts are addressed by related sectors.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンビ環境局、年2回の水質検査を実施 大腸菌とTSSが優勢
triage.triage_reason: 河川の水質モニタリングに関する行政報告であり、ヒトへの健康被害や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は環境水質モニタリングに関する内容であり、ヒト感染症のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。E. coliは水質指標として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares polio outbreaks over in five African countries
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms the closure of poliovirus type 2 outbreaks in Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of Congo and Uganda after assessments in 2026 found transmission interrupted. The stoppage followed vaccination campaigns, epidemiological investigations and environmental surveillance. Burundi’s outbreak, declared March 2023, was halted through intensified routine vaccination and surveillance with GPEI support; Uganda detected polio in May 2024 and strengthened surveillance and response; Ghana combined lab investments with surveillance and rapid response; Guinea-Bissau’s campaigns and surveillance targeted underserved populations, with no detections since July 2021; the Republic of Congo conducted multiple campaigns after detections, last in December 2023. Nigeria has six years of zero wild poliovirus but ongoing cVDPV2 concerns; the National Polio Laboratory in Ibadan analyzes over 23,000 stool samples annually from 26 states and FCT and >1,000 poliovirus isolates since Feb 2025, aiming for full accreditation by Sep 2026. Vigilance remains essential; Madagascar’s recent detection underscores ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカ5カ国でポリオ流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWHOによる5カ国でのポリオアウトブレイク終息宣言という進捗報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 地域リストに含まれるDRC(コンゴ民主共和国)は誤り。記事本文では'Republic of Congo'（コンゴ共和国、Congo-Brazzaville）と明記されており、対象国リストのDRC（Congo-Kinshasa）とは別国のため除外した。ナイジェリアのcVDPV2継続懸念やマダガスカルでの新規検出も言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 129 साल पहले : एक मच्छर, एक खोज और बदल गई मलेरिया की पूरी कहानी | Malaria History Sir Ronald Ross
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 129 years ago: A mosquito, a discovery, and the entire story of malaria changed | Malaria History Sir Ronald Ross
article.articleSummary: Malaria history milestone: On 20 August 1897, Sir Ronald Ross, born in Secunderabad, Hyderabad Presidency, India, observed pigment-containing malaria parasite cells in the gut wall of an Anopheles mosquito, confirming the vector-borne transmission of malaria. This landmark finding, conducted in British India, established the role of Anopheles mosquitoes in spreading malaria and became a turning point for global public health policies aimed at vector control. The observation linked the parasite's life cycle to the mosquito's gut, a key step toward understanding transmission, and informed subsequent laboratory confirmation and public health strategies to reduce malaria incidence and mortality. The article situates this event in malaria history and highlights its geographic and medical significance.

triage.headline_ja: 129年前:一匹の蚊、一つの発見、そしてマラリアの物語すべてが変わった | マラリア史 ロナルド・ロス卿
triage.triage_reason: 1897年の歴史的発見に関する記念記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は1897年のロナルド・ロス卿によるマラリア媒介蚊発見の歴史を振り返る記念コラムであり、現在の感染症発生事例ではないため対象国の現行イベントとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo climb to 5,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Congo has surged to about 5,000 cases as of August 19, with 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths recorded through August 16 by the Ministry of Health. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province and affecting remote areas, faces severe response barriers from insecurity and displacement. The World Health Organization warned the epidemic is far from under control and is spreading at an unprecedented pace—roughly three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. The risk of further spread within Congo and to neighboring countries remains high. Security issues impede operations, including a mob attack on responders in Aru after a suspected case, underscoring ongoing containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が5,000人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の症例数が5,000人、死者2,378人に急増し、WHOが過去最速ペースでの拡大を警告しているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは近隣国として拡大リスクが言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations から除外した。治安悪化・住民移動・対応者への暴力事案が封じ込めを困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: क्या हर बुखार में स्वाइन फ्लू टेस्ट करवाएं? महिला की मौत के बाद देशभर में हलचल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should swine flu tests be done for every fever? Nationwide stir after a woman's death.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) triggers a nationwide alert in India after a 60-year-old woman dies of swine flu in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, on August 19, 2026. Delhi reports a sixfold rise in swine flu cases versus last year; Bengaluru school outbreak affects 500+ students and 21 staff; Meerut records seven cases. Advisories issued by Haryana, Chandigarh, and Uttar Pradesh, with public health messaging across states. Surge linked to monsoon weather—humidity and temperature fluctuations that favor the virus; August–September are typical peak months, though current numbers are unusually high. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; an infected person can spread the virus from one day before symptoms and for about seven days (ten days in children). RT-PCR nasal/throat swab testing is preferred. Not a coronavirus-like pandemic; authorities emphasize precautions and risk-based testing.

triage.headline_ja: すべての発熱で豚インフルエンザ検査をすべきか？ 女性の死亡後、全国的な波紋
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な影響」「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当し、インド複数州で豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）の異常な急増と死亡例、学校での大規模アウトブレイクが報告されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: デリー、ベンガルール、メーラト、インドールなど複数州・都市で症例報告。季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）としては例年より規模が大きいとされるが、当局は新型コロナのようなパンデミックではないと強調し、国内対応（アドバイザリー発行）で管理している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू की महिला मरीज की मौत, उज्जैन से इलाज के लिए आई थी इंदौर, स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य विभाग हुआ अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman dies of swine flu; she had come to Indore for treatment from Ujjain; Health department issued an alert.
article.articleSummary: A woman admitted to a private hospital in Indore died after testing positive for H1N1 influenza (swine flu). She lived in Rishi Nagar, Ujjain, and was brought to Indore for treatment. Nasal and throat swabs were collected; H1N1 infection was confirmed, though health authorities have not officially attributed the death to swine flu. She had breathlessness, cold, and cough; symptoms began around July 25. She was first hospitalized at Avanti Super Hospital in Ujjain for six days without improvement, then shifted to Kokilaben Hospital in Indore, where she remained for about two weeks. After deteriorating, the family took her back to Ujjain, where she died at home. On record, the health department issued an alert regarding swine flu linked to this case. Reported travel history suggested limited exposure, with the patient mostly at home.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフル(H1N1)の女性患者死亡、ウッジャインからインドールへ治療のため搬送、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: H1N1による単発の死亡例であり、季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であるため異常性は低いが、保健当局が警戒を発令している点から今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、大規模な集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染拡大の明確な証拠はない。季節性H1N1インフルエンザとしてインドでは既知の疾患であるため、IHR基準には該当しないが、地元保健当局の警戒発令があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: BRIN peringatkan risiko amplifikasi ekologi dan wabah pascabencana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Warns of the Risk of Ecological Amplification and Post-Disaster Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: After disasters such as tsunamis, floods, and droughts in Indonesia, ecological amplification of vectors and reservoirs can trigger post-disaster outbreaks. BRIN researcher Ristiyanto, speaking in an online discussion in Jakarta, warned that disasters do not instantly cause outbreaks but create environmental conditions that favor rapid growth of disease-carrying vectors (notably mosquitoes) and reservoirs (e.g., rodents). The sequence is disaster, environmental change, altered vector/reservoir distribution and contact with humans, and rising disease risk. Standing fresh or brackish water after floods, or water storage practices during droughts, reshape habitats and foster transmission. If not addressed promptly, ecological amplification can intensify risks and lead to diseases not previously common in a region. Potential diseases include dengue fever, malaria, leptospirosis, and salmonellosis. Ristiyanto advocates monitoring ecological signals early to prevent health system collapse.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN、生態学的増幅と災害後の感染症流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な発生事例ではなく専門家による一般的な警告・啓発情報であり、現時点で実際の症例報告や規模を示す情報がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なアウトブレイク発生報告ではなく、研究者による災害後の生態学的リスク（デング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症、サルモネラ症）に関する一般的な警告・提言である。実際の感染者数や発生地域の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: One more Shigella case reported in state; Three-year-old girl in Thiruvananthapuram confirmed of disease
article.articleSummary: One more Shigella case confirmed in Kerala state, a three-year-old girl from Nannamkuzhi, Kottukal gram panchayat, Thiruvananthapuram, diagnosed after visiting a temple in Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu on August 12. Symptoms began August 13 with diarrhea and vomiting; she was admitted to SAT Hospital. Shigellosis, caused by Shigella, transmits via contaminated water or food, unwashed fruits and vegetables, close contact with infected people, or meals prepared by them. Public health guidance urges avoiding food prepared in unsanitary conditions during the rainy season. Symptoms include diarrhea, fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, fatigue, and possibly bloody stools, with diarrheal duration of 2–7 days, though longer courses occur and some infections may be asymptomatic. Higher risk of death is noted in children under five and in individuals with weakened immune systems.

triage.headline_ja: 州内でシゲラ症の新規症例が1件確認、ティルヴァナンタプラムの3歳女児が感染確定
triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。既知の感染経路による個別症例で、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 3歳女児の単発症例で、寺院訪問後に発症。地域内での散発例と考えられ、アウトブレイクの兆候は記事上確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में स्वाइन फ्लू से उज्जैन की महिला की मौत, भोपाल में 6 मरीजों में पुष्टि
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indore: Woman from Ujjain dies of swine flu; six patients confirmed in Bhopal.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) activity in Madhya Pradesh, India, shows one fatal case and six confirmed infections. A 60-year-old woman from Ujjain tested positive for H1N1 in Indore and died after about 16 days of treatment. In Bhopal, six swine flu patients have been confirmed. MP has not issued an alert yet. Testing bottlenecks are reported, with H1N1 kits unavailable at GSC and some testing centers like AIIMS Bhopal reportedly not conducting tests. The monsoon season in Bhopal coincides with rising viral and respiratory illnesses presenting with fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, and fatigue, underscoring the need for timely diagnosis and treatment, especially for the elderly, children, and those with comorbidities. Nationwide, Delhi, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh are experiencing increased swine flu activity, guiding heightened vigilance in MP for potential imported/exported cases and increased surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: インドール：ウッジャイン出身の女性が豚インフルエンザで死亡、ボパールで6人の患者が確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の国内複数州での増加と死亡例が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の要素は見られず、検査体制の不備が懸念材料であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の国内流行であり、モンスーン期の呼吸器感染症増加と関連。検査キット不足など医療体制の課題が報告されているが、州として警戒情報は未発出。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisadores criam 'vacina inteligente' e mais segura contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers create a 'smart' vaccine and a safer one against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP) in Brazil and the University of Bonn in Germany report a new 'smart' vaccine platform against chikungunya in npj Vaccines. They engineered a replication-limited chikungunya virus that can enter cells and briefly replicate once but cannot become infectious. The key modification replaces the furin-dependent maturation site with a tobacco etch virus (TEV) protease recognition sequence, and uses a human cell line lacking furin; TEV is absent in humans and mosquitoes, so no further rounds of infection occur. In mice, a single dose elicited protective immunity, without disease. The approach aims to improve safety, enabling vaccination for immunocompromised individuals and the elderly. In addition to protection against chikungunya, immunized mice neutralized Mayaro virus, hinting at broader arboviral protection and potential adaptation to Zika, dengue, and yellow fever. Funding by FAPESP; collaboration with University of Bonn.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らがチクングニア熱に対するより安全な「スマートワクチン」を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発に関する研究成果の報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ大学とドイツ・ボン大学によるチクングニアウイルスワクチンの基礎研究報告であり、疾患の流行や症例発生に関する情報は含まれていない。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Climate Change Fuels Rise of New Mosquito Species in Cold Himalayan Region
article.articleSummary: Rising temperature and humidity in the cold western Himalayan region are turning high-altitude areas into breeding grounds for malaria- and dengue-transmitting mosquitoes. Researchers report 13 new Anopheles species, including Anopheles fluviatilis detected year-round (365 days), alongside Anopheles culicifacies and 11 other Anopheles species. The findings stem from a National Institute of Malaria Research (NIMR) study surveying 22 villages at 800–1,000 metres elevation over five years, published in Scientific Reports in 2026. Mosquitoes now breed indoors in damp spots of homes, cattle sheds, water tanks and drains. Three factors underpin this emergence in cold regions: indoor temperatures more than 3°C warmer than outdoors, indoor humidity about 8% higher, and ongoing increases in both. The study raises serious concerns for continued malaria and dengue transmission as these vectors expand into previously inhospitable areas.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動が寒冷なヒマラヤ地域で新種の蚊の増加を促進
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング媒介蚊の生息域拡大という長期的リスクを示す研究報告だが、現時点で具体的な症例急増や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 研究report記事であり、実際の症例数や発生状況についての言及はない。今後の症例動向の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM tăng cường kiểm soát dịch bệnh trên đàn vật nuôi cao điểm mùa mưa bão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City intensifies disease control for livestock during the peak of the rainy and storm season.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, Ho Chi Minh City's Department of Agriculture and Environment organized a conference to strengthen animal disease surveillance and control amid the rainy and storm season. Citywide, about 1.3 million pigs and 21 million poultry are reared; high-tech pig farming reaches ~80% and poultry farming ~53%. Despite stable growth in the first seven months, 16 disease outbreaks were recorded across several districts, with ongoing risk from neighboring provinces where outbreaks remain complex. As the city enters the peak rainy season and cooler weather ahead, animal health could be challenged and livestock movement for holidays increases transmission risk. Experts note rising farm-scale operations with better biosafety, but backyard farming remains the main risk due to incomplete biosafety practices and inadequate transport/slaughter compliance. Phước Thành commune advocates proactive detection and local action; requests continued technical guidance and coordination with neighboring localities to maintain safe, stable production.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、雨季・台風シーズンのピークにおける家畜疾病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病サーベイランス強化に関する一般的な行政会議の報告であり、具体的な病原体・ヒトへの健康影響・異常事態の記述がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜（豚・家禽）の疾病管理に関する行政的取り組みを報告するもので、具体的な疾患名や人への感染リスクの記述はない。'Unknown Illness'という疾患名も内容と一致せず、実質的にはルーティンの動物衛生管理に関する報道。

article.articleHeadline: Вернулись из отпуска с опасным сюрпризом: у двух жителей Уфы подтвердили тяжелую экзотическую инфекцию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back from vacation with a dangerous surprise: two residents of Ufa diagnosed with a severe exotic infection.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases were confirmed in Bashkiria (Bashkortostan), with two Ufa residents diagnosed after returning from abroad. As of 20 August 2025, the first patient acquired the virus during a March holiday in Phuket, Thailand, and the second after a July trip to Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Laboratory confirmation occurred at the Republican Infectious Hospital; overall regional incidence remains well below national averages. Dengue is not transmitted via casual contact; primary vectors are mosquitoes. Reported import sources include Thailand, Vietnam, India, and UAE. In 2024 the region recorded five cases, and in 2023 three. Classic symptoms: sudden high fever up to 40°C, myalgia, and rash; incubation typically spans 3–15 days after a mosquito bite and can be up to two weeks. Severe forms risk internal bleeding requiring hospitalization. Prevention emphasizes repellent-use and bed nets. After returning, a severe headache or nausea warrants prompt medical evaluation, with travel history disclosed to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 休暇から危険な土産を持ち帰る:ウファの住民2名が重篤な外来感染症と診断される
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・バシコルトスタン共和国における輸入デング熱の散発例であり、対象国での発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・バシコルトスタン共和国での輸入デング熱2例で、感染地はタイ（プーケット）とUAE（アブダビ）。対象国リストにあるタイ、ベトナム、インドは輸入元として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Shigellosis resurfaces in Keralam; 3-year-old from capital hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis (bacillary dysentery) resurged in Kerala (Keralam) with a three-year-old from Kottukal, Thiruvananthapuram, admitted to SAT Hospital; case confirmed Aug 18, 2026. The child had traveled to Nagercoil on Aug 12 and reportedly consumed cold drinks from a wayside vendor. Additional cases were reported from Vizhinjam (Thiruvananthapuram), Pazhayannur (Thrissur), Kattipara (Kozhikode), and Noolpuzha (Wayanad). Kerala notes Shigellosis is sporadic year-round, spreading via contaminated water, food and surfaces, and can trigger local outbreaks. Symptoms include fever, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, blood in stools, and frequent urges to defecate; it is self-limiting in healthy adults but can be fatal for children under five, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. Public health measures emphasize oral rehydration and timely treatment; an outbreak calendar is planned. By Aug 18, 2026, Kerala reported 441 confirmed, 106 probable cases and eight deaths; June outbreaks totaled 225+ cases and six deaths across Kozhikode, Malappuram, and Wayanad, with additional district cases. Last year saw 133 cases and zero deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でシゲラ症が再発、州都出身の3歳児が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2項目に該当し、死者8名・確定441例・疑い106例と前年（133例・死者0）から大幅増加している。
triage.notes: ケーララ州内の複数地区（Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, Kozhikode, Wayanad）で発生。汚染された水・食品を介した感染拡大が疑われ、5歳未満児や高齢者、免疫不全者への重症化リスクが指摘されている。国境を越えた拡大の証拠はなく、渡航・貿易制限の兆候もない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Five African Countries End Polio Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Five African countries—Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda—have halted transmission of poliovirus type 2 outbreaks after Independent Outbreak Response Assessment (OBRA) reviews conducted January–June 2026. The WHO Regional Office for Africa confirmed outbreak closures, noting interruption of transmission based on analyses of surveillance, laboratory, and epidemiological data. Burundi (outbreak declared March 2023) and Uganda (detection May 2024) intensified routine vaccination and surveillance; the Republic of the Congo (last detection December 2023) conducted high-quality vaccination campaigns to rapidly interrupt spread; Ghana and Guinea-Bissau upgraded laboratory capacity and surveillance, with Guinea-Bissau reporting no poliovirus detections since July 2021. Despite these milestones, reimportation risk persists, as shown by Madagascar’s recent detection. Authorities emphasize sustained vigilance, robust surveillance, and high immunization coverage to protect children and prevent future outbreaks, supported by GPEI, Rotary, UNICEF and partner efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ:5カ国がポリオ発生を終息
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はガーナを含む5カ国におけるポリオウイルス2型アウトブレイクの終息（伝播遮断確認）を伝える内容であり、新規発生や拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に『Democratic Republic of the Congo』が含まれているが、記事本文では『Republic of the Congo（コンゴ共和国）』と明記されており、DRCとは異なる国であるため除外した。マダガスカルでの再輸入例も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo - "Save the Children": Hohe Belastung von Kindern in Ebola-Epidemie, auch Sterblichkeit bei erkrankten Kindern höher
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo - "Save the Children": High burden on children during the Ebola outbreak; mortality among infected children is also higher.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo disproportionately harms children, according to Save the Children. Katharina von Schröder from the country office told Deutschlandfunk that pediatric Ebola patients have higher mortality. Children make up about 25% of Ebola cases, and nearly one-third of deaths occur among children. Very young children are especially at risk due to close contact with sick mothers during breastfeeding and caregiving; when mothers fall ill, infants often become infected. The outbreak has left thousands of children as orphans, with at least 180 losing both parents. A substantial care gap for affected children persists, highlighting the need for targeted support amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - 「セーブ・ザ・チルドレン」：エボラ流行における子どもへの高い負担、感染した子どもの死亡率も高い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、子どもへの高い死亡率や孤児の増加など深刻な影響が報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は子ども特有の被害（死亡率上昇、孤児化）を強調しており、既存のエボラ流行の深刻さを補強する情報。国際的拡大・渡航制限については本記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Tausende Kinder verlieren ihre Eltern -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Thousands of children lose their parents.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, the Ebola outbreak has claimed the lives of both parents for nearly two children per day in the first 100 days after official confirmation, totaling about 180 children affected. Affected children are living with relatives or in state facilities, while thousands more have lost a parent or caregiver, exposing them to abuse, exploitation, child trafficking and severe psychosocial distress. Save the Children, with the government and partners, is establishing secure Observation Care Centers to shelter children whose parents are treated at Ebola Treatment Centers on the same site, offering 24/7 care as parents receive treatment. The crisis compounds armed conflict and displacement; the charity urges stronger protection in Ebola responses, including safe caregiving, psychosocial support, and community-based child protection. Save the Children has worked in DRC since 1994, coordinating with 13 local and international partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：数千人の子どもが両親を失う
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行により多数の死者・孤児が発生しており、重症度・流行継続性・社会的関心（NGO・政府の対応）が高いためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 既に確認から100日以上経過している既知の流行に関する人道的影響（孤児問題）の報道であり、新規シグナルというより既存流行の継続的評価が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : d'une à 6 provinces touchées, Jean Kaseya dresse le bilan alarmant de la propagation d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: from one to six provinces affected, Jean Kaseya presents an alarming assessment of Ebola's spread.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak has expanded from a single province and two health zones at declaration in May to six provinces and 56 health zones. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warns against underestimating the crisis and notes that Uganda soon declared an outbreak on its territory. As of August 18, the Institut national de santé publique reports 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality rate 47.5%). Ituri remains the hardest hit (28 of 36 health zones), followed by Nord-Kivu (12), Tshopo (7), Haut-Uélé (6), Bas-Uélé (2); Sud-Kivu has one active zone with no new cases in 79 days. There are 1,115 recoveries and 730 patients currently in care; contact tracing rate is 84%. Vaccination features 2,000 Ervebo doses in Tshopo, with 500,000 more requested; remdesivir is being added and monoclonal antibody therapies are under consideration. Schools in 18 high-risk zones will switch to four weeks of distance learning without internet.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：1州から6州へ拡大、ジャン・カセヤ氏がエボラ流行の憂慮すべき現状を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで宣言以来1州から6州・56保健区へ急速に拡大し、致死率47.5%、5,208症例・2,476死亡と極めて深刻。ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Africa CDC長官による警告や大規模ワクチン要請（50万回分）など国際的関心・支援需要が高い。

article.articleHeadline: जम्मू वालों सावधान! बारिश के बाद डेंगू ने बढ़ाई चिंता, 3 दिन में 39 नए केस; निगम ने उठाया बड़ा कदम - dengue alert 39 new cases in 3 days jmc launches fogging
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attention Jammu residents! Dengue concerns rise after rainfall; 39 new cases in 3 days; JMC takes a major step — dengue alert: 39 new cases in 3 days, JMC launches fogging.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a rising threat in Jammu city after monsoon rains, with 39 new dengue cases reported in the past three days and nearly 70 cases overall this season. Residents fear dengue, malaria, and chikungunya as stagnant floodwater in several areas creates mosquito breeding sites. In response, Jammu Municipal Corporation (JMC), with the Malaria Department, has launched a citywide fogging campaign through 10 September 2026 to destroy breeding sites and curb spread. A ward-wise fogging roster runs from 21 August to early September across multiple wards. Authorities urge residents to prevent water stagnation around homes and regularly clean coolers, pots, and tires. Health officials, including Dr. Shahid Husain, say fogging is conducted with the health department, though rainfall can reduce effectiveness. Past dengue totals: about 1,441 cases in 2025; 4,028 in 2024; 4,035 in 2023, with a decline last year due to control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ジャム市民に注意!雨後にデング熱への懸念高まる、3日間で39件の新規症例；JMCが大規模対策に着手
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行で例年発生している事象であり、地方自治体による通常の対応（燻蒸）が行われている段階。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 毎年季節性に発生するデング熱流行であり、過去数年と比較して顕著な異常性は確認できない（2025年1,441件、2024年4,028件、2023年4,035件）。地元自治体が独自に対応中で、外部支援の必要性は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện thêm ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết ở Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another dengue fever outbreak detected in Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, dengue fever outbreak in Ky Hoa Commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam adds 8 new cases, raising the local total to 21 infections. Ha Tinh Center for Disease Control (CDC Ha Tinh) coordinates with the Ky Hoa People’s Committee to contain the cluster. Investigations identify high-density housing with poor environmental hygiene and unmanaged waste and water containers, creating Aedes mosquito breeding sites. The Ky Hoa Commune Health Station, with village teams, conducted environmental sanitation, larval source reduction, and insecticide spraying for 172 surrounding households, though some homes were not thoroughly cleaned. Authorities warn the outbreak could expand and urge intensified door-to-door vector control, public education, and resident environmental sanitation. The Health Station will monitor and triage cases, with severe patients referred upward. Since April 2026, Ha Tinh has recorded 215 dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省でデング熱の新たな流行が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのハティン省における通常規模のデング熱地域流行であり、季節性の風土病として国内で管理されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、地方CDCが通常の対応（環境衛生、幼虫駆除、殺虫剤散布）を実施中。重症例や死亡の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM tiêu hủy hơn 7.300 con vật do dịch bệnh, tiêm phòng dại chó mèo mới đạt 42%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City euthanizes more than 7,300 animals due to a disease outbreak; rabies vaccination for dogs and cats has only reached 42%.
article.articleSummary: 16 animal disease outbreaks were recorded in Ho Chi Minh City in 2026, affecting 18 farming households across 13 communes/wards. In total, 7,393 animals were infected, 779 died, and 7,393 were culled (weight of culled animals: 329,069 kg). African swine fever accounted for 12 outbreaks across 14 farms in 9 communes/wards; animal rabies occurred in 3 outbreaks across 3 farms in 3 communes/wards; lumpy skin disease appeared in 1 outbreak in 1 farm across 3 communes/wards. Rabies vaccination for dogs and cats reached 42.10% of the population as of July 30, 2026 (132,028/313,591). Violations: 47 cases fined totaling over 333 million VND; 29 inter-agency violations, including 3 referred to the Economic Police for suspected illegal pig transport; 26 penalties totaling 174 million VND. Dĩ An Ward reported 48 stray dogs captured; 28 cases fined for not muzzling dogs in public. Authorities urge intensified stray-dog management, vaccination, and surveillance, especially before year-end activities.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で家畜7,300頭以上を疾病により殺処分、犬猫の狂犬病ワクチン接種率は42%にとどまる
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱、狂犬病、ランピースキン病）の発生であり、現時点でヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の重大な影響は報告されていないが、狂犬病の低ワクチン接種率など今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物疾患（家畜・ペット）の発生報告であり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。ただし狂犬病はヒトへの感染リスクがあり、ワクチン接種率の低さ（42%）と野良犬管理の課題が指摘されているため、継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo aumenta a 2.476 la cifra de muertos y 5.208 los casos confirmados de ébola - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the death toll to 2,476 and reports 5,208 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 2,476 Ebola deaths and 5,208 confirmed cases in the eastern outbreak declared May 15, with data through August 18. Case fatality is 47.5%. About 730 patients remain isolated or hospitalized; 1,115 recovered; contact tracing at 84%. Six provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele. The response is strengthened by vaccination with Ervebo and intensified surveillance and care in affected areas. Ervebo targets the Zaire ebolavirus, with indications of potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo, the strain behind the current outbreak, though no specific vaccine or treatment exists yet. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in Phase 1 trials and deemed safe by WHO. The epidemic is the second-deadliest and largest in DRC history and the fastest-growing since declaration; Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and was declared Ebola-free on July 28. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数を2,476人、感染確定者数を5,208人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.5%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、DRC史上2番目に致命的かつ最大規模、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境感染事例（20例、うち15例DRCからの輸入）が報告されたが、7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みであり、対象国リストにも含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主な発生地はDRC東部6州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、チョポ、バスウエレ）。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi's H1N1 Surge Sparks Concern: Expert Reveals When Swine Flu Can Turn Life-Threatening
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a rising surge of influenza A(H1N1) cases, raising concerns among doctors as the outbreak continues into August 2026. While most people recover from swine flu with appropriate rest and medical care, some patients in Delhi are developing serious respiratory complications. Influenza A(H1N1) can progress to pneumonia and, in severe instances, respiratory failure. Children, the elderly, and vulnerable patients are at higher risk of these complications. The update underscores an ongoing outbreak in the national capital, with clinicians urging vigilance for early signs and timely treatment to prevent progression. Public health officials monitor the trend as of 20 August 2026 and emphasize that H1N1 can worsen existing illnesses and lead to critical illness in a subset of patients.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのH1N1急増が懸念拡大：専門家が豚インフルエンザが生命を脅かす状態になる条件を解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染症例が急増し、重症化・呼吸不全に至る例が報告されており、メディア注目度も高いためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)のデリーでの流行拡大に関する報道。重症化リスクへの言及はあるが、死亡者数や医療体制逼迫の具体的データは記事内に不明。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusive: US warns 'long' road ahead in Ebola response
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo became the deadliest in its history earlier this week, with ongoing transmission across affected areas in Africa. The United States has contributed more than $500 million to the response, funding border screening, contact tracing, and specialized treatment facilities. Officials warn the rising death toll shows the outbreak is not yet under control, with fatalities outside health facilities indicating undetected transmission chains. Uganda has declared an end to its outbreak, but transmission is moving toward South Sudan, increasing cross-border spillover risk per humanitarian groups such as Mercy Corps. The situation underscores a need for a larger international response and investment to turn the tide sooner rather than later.

triage.headline_ja: 独占：米国、エボラ対応は『長期化』すると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、国際的拡大（南スーダンへの越境リスク）や国際支援の必要性が明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息宣言済み、南スーダンへの越境リスクが指摘されているが対象国リストに南スーダンは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: From control to elimination: India's fight against mosquito-borne diseases
article.articleSummary: India is shifting from reactive to preventive, pursuing zero indigenous malaria by 2027 and national elimination by 2030 under the National Framework for Malaria Elimination. A decade of micro-planning, block-by-block transmission mapping, and integrated vector control has strengthened surveillance and diagnostics, complementing immunisation efforts and kala-azar control. The National Academy of Medical Sciences Task Force on Vector Borne Diseases and Parliament's Health Committee advocate Integrated Vector Management, broader vaccination, diagnostics, and reporting. India exited WHO's High Burden to High Impact group for malaria in 2024. Yet the malaria burden remains severe, with India accounting for about 73.3% of the 2.7 million malaria cases in the WHO SE Asia region in 2024. Dengue remains substantial (about one-third of global cases, ~300,000 annually). The recent dengue vaccine approval, alongside the Japanese encephalitis vaccine in the Universal Immunisation Programme and NCVBDC surveillance, offers a forward path.

triage.headline_ja: 制圧から撲滅へ：インドの蚊媒介疾患との闘い
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾病（マラリア、デング熱等）に関する政策動向・進捗の総説記事であり、新規または異常な発生事例の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性疾患（マラリア、デング熱、日本脳炎、リーシュマニア症）に対するインドの国家戦略・政策進捗をまとめた総説であり、突発的な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既存の恒常的な疾病負荷に関する内容のため、フルRRAの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: World Mosquito Day 2026: History, Diseases, Symptoms and Prevention
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day 2026, observed August 20, highlights dengue, malaria, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and Zika transmitted by Aedes, Anopheles, and Culex mosquitoes. Since Ronald Ross' 1897 discovery that malaria is spread by female Anopheles, awareness campaigns have underscored prevention through mosquito control. In India, key mosquito-borne diseases include dengue (Aedes aegypti), malaria (Plasmodium spp. via Anopheles), chikungunya (Aedes), Japanese encephalitis (Culex), and Zika (Aedes). Symptoms range from fever, headaches, joint and muscle pain, rash, to vomiting; severe dengue and falciparum malaria require hospitalization; Zika poses risks for pregnant women; Japanese encephalitis can cause brain complications. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, sealing tanks, cleaning containers, gutters, tires; personal protection (repellent, protective clothing, screens, nets); community-driven cleanups and adherence to local guidelines. The article notes campaigns, awareness, and the need for timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊の日2026：歴史、疾患、症状、予防
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、世界蚊の日に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、蚊媒介性疾患全般に関する啓発記事のため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。

article.articleHeadline: पटना में डेंगू का बढ़ता प्रकोप, 24 घंटे में मिले 10 नए मरीज, बारिश के बाद जलभराव से बढ़ी चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising dengue outbreak in Patna, 10 new patients in 24 hours, concern heightened due to waterlogging after rainfall.
article.articleSummary: Patna, Bihar, India reports a rising dengue outbreak, with 10 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing 2026's total to 131. Monthly data show 44 cases (Jan–Jun), 26 in July, and 61 in August. Heavy rainfall and waterlogging are expanding Aedes mosquito breeding sites. Administrative claims of ongoing fogging and larviciding contrast with residents’ reports of little to no ground spraying. Principal dengue symptoms include abrupt high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, joint and muscle pains, nausea, fatigue, and rash. Prompt blood testing and hydration are advised; avoid aspirin and ibuprofen. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water in homes (coolers, pots, buckets, tires, and other containers) to reduce transmission. The situation underscores gaps between official measures and ground realities amid ongoing urban flooding.

triage.headline_ja: パトナでデング熱の流行拡大、24時間で新規患者10人、降雨後の冠水で懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行で症例が増加しているが、インド国内の地域的流行の範囲にとどまり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・ビハール州パトナで季節性・毎年発生する感染症。行政の対策と住民の実感に乖離があるとの指摘があるが、重症度や死亡者数の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola más rápida de la historia avanza a ciegas para la ciencia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest Ebola epidemic in history advances blindly for science.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has become the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in history. As of August 2026, Congo reports more than 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths across 49 health zones in five provinces; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, with a case fatality rate around 44–47%. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. This outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (not Zaire ebolavirus), lacks a licensed vaccine or approved antiviral treatment; patient care relies on isolation, supportive care, and containment. Africa CDC models warn that without intensified case isolation and contact tracing, the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014 West Africa crisis. Genomic surveillance platforms like GenomicEpi, with INRB Congo, show steep transmission curves, signaling a potential for the most deadly outbreak yet if trends persist.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ流行、科学は手探りの対応を迫られる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで拡大中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、致死率約44-47%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、Africa CDCも2014年西アフリカ流行規模への拡大を警告している点で緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Do fumacê ao 'exército' de mosquitos, como o combate à dengue evoluiu no CE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From fogging to the 'mosquito army': how the fight against dengue has evolved in Ceará
article.articleSummary: In Ceará, Brazil, dengue control has shifted from fumacê (Ultra Low Volume insecticide spraying) to integrated vector management. Aedes aegypti, the arbovirus vector, transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya; Ceará has reported more than 885,000 dengue infections. Fumacê dominated from the 1980s to early 2000s but declined due to mosquito resistance and environmental/health concerns from DDT used in the 1950s. While UBV spraying persists in specific situations, current efforts emphasize elimination of larval habitats and focal interventions, with intradomiciliary sources accounting for about 80% of transmission. In August, Sobral (north Ceará) began a new cycle of car fumacê to interrupt transmission, framed as supplementary and reliant on community participation to remove breeding sites. Endemias agents and other SUS workers lead these efforts, now complemented by new technologies such as Estações D in Fortaleza, marking an evolution in the state’s dengue battle.

triage.headline_ja: 燻煙から「蚊の軍隊」へ、セアラ州のデング熱対策はどう進化したか
triage.triage_reason: 新規の異常な発生を報じるものではなく、セアラ州における長期的なデング熱媒介蚊対策の歴史的変遷を解説する特集記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策の歴史的発展を紹介する解説記事であり、急性の発生増加や新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。累計88万5千件超という数字も過去の累積データであり、直近の急増を示すものではない。
