article.articleHeadline: 60-Year-Old Succumbs To Swine Flu During Treatment In Indore
article.articleSummary: 60-year-old Ujjain resident Saroj Nagar died in Indore’s Kokilaben Hospital while undergoing treatment for swine flu (H1N1), Madhya Pradesh’s first seasonal death. Lab tests confirmed influenza A with the 2009 H1N1 strain; influenza B and SARS-CoV-2 were negative. Nagar fell ill around July 31; samples were sent to an Ahmedabad laboratory, with confirmation reported Aug 3. She had been under treatment for about 16 days and died Aug 19 evening. She reportedly had no other underlying illness. Family alleged no screening of close contacts after infection; Anganwadi workers visited to list family members but did not test anyone. The health department is gathering information and monitoring the situation. Swine flu transmits via droplets; typical symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headache and fatigue, with breathing difficulties in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: インド・インドールで60歳男性が豚インフルエンザ治療中に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる単発死亡例であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発死亡例で、州における今季初の死亡と報告されているが、地域的なアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, oltre 2mila morti di ebola. Nell'ospedale di Neisu, dove si combattono virus e malnutrizione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, over 2,000 Ebola deaths. In the Neisu hospital, where viruses and malnutrition are being fought.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to escalate. As of August 16, 2026, the Health Ministry reports 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, with 76 new cases in the last 24 hours. The epidemic spans six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. Neisu Hospital in Haut-Uélé, led by Father David Moké of the Consolata mission, serves as reference center with radiology, ultrasound, ECG, and laboratory. Nine suspected cases were evaluated; six confirmed, including three deaths. The facility receives patients from affected zones and beyond and has isolated rooms for suspected cases prior to transfer to treatment centers. WHO reports at least 155 health-care worker infections and 45 deaths. The Maria Bonino Foundation supports Neisu Hospital, highlighting the link between malnutrition and Ebola; it also funds nutrition programs. Needs include PPE, handwashing systems, disinfection supplies, and nutritional and agricultural provisions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ死者2000人超え。ウイルスと栄養失調が同時に闘われるネイス病院
triage.triage_reason: 6州にわたる大規模エボラ流行で症例・死者数が多数、医療従事者感染も発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOも医療従事者感染155人・死亡45人を報告しており、既知の大規模流行の継続報道。フルRRAが既に実施されている可能性が高いが、状況悪化のため再評価推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le comité d'urgence de l'OMS maintient l'alerte, la RDC dément un cas à Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Emergency Committee Maintains the Alert; DRC Denies a Case in Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, driven by Bundibugyo; Kinshasa reports no cases. As of 20 August 2026, counts exceed 5,000 confirmed cases (5,021) and 2,378 deaths across six eastern provinces, surpassing the 2018–2020 North Kivu–Ituri outbreak (3,381 cases, 2,299 deaths). Bundibugyo spreads faster than Zaïre but with a lower fatality rate. The WHO Emergency Committee, meeting 18 August in Geneva, kept the health emergency in place; risk is very high in DRC, high in Uganda and neighbors, and low elsewhere. Uganda declared its outbreak over on 28 July (20 cases, 2 deaths). Insecurity hampers response, including an ambulance attack in Ituri. WHO will deploy 100 additional epidemiologists plus 500 community health workers; about 60% of the $115 million appeal is mobilized. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugro yet; two Phase 1 trials underway. DRC plans distance learning in 18 high-risk zones for 2026–2027.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO緊急委員会が警戒を維持、DRCはキンシャサでの症例を否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は5,000例超・死者2,378人に達し過去最大規模となり、WHO緊急委員会が緊急事態を維持、ウガンダなど周辺国への越境リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。スイス（ジュネーブ）はWHO緊急委員会開催地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry expands free TB screening to Islamic boarding schools
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry expands free tuberculosis (TB) screening and early-detection services to Islamic boarding schools, starting with Tebuireng Islamic Boarding School in Jombang, East Java. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin announced plans to purchase thousands of X-ray devices to enable widespread screening at schools, boarding schools, and correctional facilities with high-density living. During monitoring, 26 Tebuireng students tested positive for TB. Officials emphasize reducing stigma since diagnosed individuals can receive free treatment, and after about a month of therapy transmission risk is significantly reduced. The program aims to extend to approximately 42,000 other Islamic boarding schools. President Prabowo Subianto has urged rapid TB elimination. Indonesia faces an estimated 120,000–140,000 TB deaths annually, about two deaths every five minutes, ranking second globally after India in TB burden despite available effective treatments. Late detection remains a major factor, with traditional screening relying on X-rays and, in some cases, PCR tests.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、無料結核スクリーニングをイスラム寄宿学校にも拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する政府の通常のスクリーニング拡大策であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インドは結核負荷ランキングの比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 157 إصابة و13 وفاة بفيروس غرب النيل في اليونان منذ بداية 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 157 cases and 13 deaths from West Nile virus in Greece since the start of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Greece reports 157 West Nile virus infections and 13 deaths in 2026 as of August 19, per the Hellenic Ministry of Health's National Public Health Organization. The average age of decedents is 82 years. In the last week alone, 47 new infections were recorded, lifting the year-to-date total from 110 to 157 and indicating a rise compared with the same period in 2025 (47 infections and 2 deaths). West Nile virus is transmitted to humans mainly through bites from infected mosquitoes; about 80% of infections are asymptomatic. The virus is circulating across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and West Asia, with Greece experiencing ongoing transmission. There is currently no vaccine or specific antiviral treatment available for West Nile virus.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャで2026年初頭から西ナイル熱157例、死亡13例
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャでの西ナイル熱流行は深刻ではあるが、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）に該当する発生地域がなく、モニタリング対象外のため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生国はギリシャであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国・アフリカ大陸が発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文はギリシャの状況のみを主題としており、これらは誤付与と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: De vandrar mil i bergen för att rädda barn från polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They trek miles in the mountains to save children from polio.
article.articleSummary: India has kept polio-free for more than a decade, sustained by nationwide vaccination campaigns that target all children under five and run four to six times annually. Frontline vaccinators traverse difficult terrain to reach remote communities, ensuring no child is missed. Shameema, 45, checks a vaccine cooler before dawn and sets out with drops of oral polio vaccine, accompanied by Tanzeela, 28, as they trek miles into the mountains. They confront steep paths, low pay, and long hours, yet view the work as essential to safeguarding children’s health. The campaigns aim to maintain eradication by delivering vaccines to hard-to-reach populations, illustrating how persistent outreach keeps polio eliminated in India even in challenging landscapes.

triage.headline_ja: 彼女たちは子どもをポリオから救うため、山々を何マイルも歩く
triage.triage_reason: インドは10年以上ポリオフリーを維持しており、本記事は予防接種活動を紹介する内容で、新規感染や異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオ根絶維持のためのワクチン接種活動に関する啓発的な内容であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではないため、対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Maï-Ndombe : 77 décès sur plus de 1 900 cas de choléra enregistrés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maï-Ndombe: 77 deaths among more than 1,900 recorded cholera cases.
article.articleSummary: Cholera continues in Maï-Ndombe province, reporting 1,950 cases and 77 deaths (case fatality rate 4%) through the 6th epidemiological week of 2026. Eight of the province’s fourteen health zones are affected: Bokoro, Bolobo, Bosobe, Kwamouth, Mushie, Nioki, Oshwe and Yumbi. The situation remains worrisome due to a recent uptick; week 32 of 2026 saw increased cases compared with the previous two weeks. The response faces a major funding/operational gap, with no partners currently supporting cholera response activities in the province. This resurgence echoes a 2025 outbreak that affected several health zones, with authorities previously flagging difficulties in accessing potable water as a key transmission driver.

triage.headline_ja: マイ・ンドンベ州：コレラ症例1,900件以上のうち77人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率4%と高く、資金・支援パートナー不在という管理体制の脆弱性が確認され、複数の保健地域に拡大する進行中のアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 致死率4%はコレラとしては非常に高く、標準治療（<1%）が機能していない可能性を示唆。パートナー支援の欠如が明記されており、外部支援ニーズが明確。2025年のアウトブレイクの再燃であり、飲料水アクセスの問題が根本要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola "loin d'être maîtrisée", alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola outbreak 'far from under control', WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the deadliest in the country’s history, with nearly 5,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths as of August 18, 2026. The 17th outbreak shows rapid spread, with Ituri province alone accounting for about 90% of cases; Haut-Uélé, Nord-Kivu, and Tshopo remain under surveillance. Regional spread concerns are heightened by proximity of Haut-Uélé to Uganda and South Sudan. Many patients die at home due to limited access to care, insecurity, and logistics gaps, complicating contact tracing as community deaths outside centers rise. Fifty-five health zones are affected, roughly 8% of the national territory. The WHO calls for faster sharing of new case information, sustained funding, stronger cross-border cooperation, and protection for frontline workers. The government asserts a robust response, but intensified community follow-up and medical care are needed, especially before the school year.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行「制御には程遠い」とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で約5000例・2325人死亡、国境地帯への拡大懸念とWHOの警告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大懸念が記載されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内（Ituri, Haut-Uélé, Nord-Kivu, Tshopo）が主要発生地。

article.articleHeadline: How a BGU researcher is manipulating crustaceans to protect the environment - and fight disease
article.articleSummary: Crustacean biology underpins environmental protection and disease control: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev's Prof. Amir Sagi studies crustaceans' external skeleton formation (molting) and sex-determination, revealing a insulin-like hormone that dictates male development. This enables single-sex populations in aquaculture, with Vietnam and Thailand-based companies commercializing monosex crustacean larvae. Beyond farming, the research aims to reduce disease risk by leveraging crustaceans as biocontrol agents against snail hosts of schistosomiasis (bilharzia), a parasitic disease affecting millions, notably children in freshwater-dependent regions. While the predator approach offers environmental benefits, introducing predators into ecosystems carries ecological risks. The work blends functional genomics with practical applications to improve food security and public health.

triage.notes: 本記事はイスラエルの大学研究者による甲殻類を用いた住血吸虫症対策の学術研究紹介であり、タイ・ベトナムは養殖業のビジネス文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の疾病発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Fast zwei Kinder pro Tag verlieren beide Eltern
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Almost two children per day lose both parents.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province: in the first 100 days since the outbreak was officially confirmed, almost two children per day have lost both parents to Ebola, totaling 180 affected children, with thousands more who have lost a parent or caregiver. Many are living with relatives or in state facilities pending permanent family placement. Save the Children, with the government and partners, is establishing safe Observation Care Centers to provide 24/7 care for children whose parents are treated in Ebola treatment centers on the same site, while their parents receive treatment. The crisis compounds existing crises from armed conflict, displacement, and ongoing humanitarian needs. Germany’s enhanced support for the Ebola response is welcomed, but child protection, psychosocial support, secure caregiving options, and community child-protection programs must be central alongside infection prevention and health referrals. Save the Children has worked in DR Congo since 1994 with 13 local partners, delivering health, nutrition, education, child protection, food security, and WASH.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：1日に約2人の子どもが両親を失っている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱の流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生・人道的影響と国際支援の必要性が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行による子どもへの人道的影響とドイツの支援を報じている。ドイツは支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。感染拡大や渡航制限に関する具体的情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Three Months Into Fast-Spreading Ebola Epidemic, Direct Relief's Response Spans Three Nations
article.articleSummary: DRC eastern Ebola outbreak has >4,400 confirmed cases and >2,000 deaths through Aug. 11 (CFR ~46%); WHO warns it could become the deadliest since 2014–2016 West Africa. Genomic sequencing shows the virus circulating since February, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid. Three months after WHO declared a global health emergency, Direct Relief has delivered 19.5 tons of PPE and essential medicines worth $11.3 million to partners in DRC, Uganda and South Sudan since May, with shipments en route. Public health leaders are shifting to community-led response: Aug. 5 village-centered strategy; >21,000 community health workers trained; door-to-door case finding; contact tracing now reaches ~80% of known contacts (target 95%). Most deaths occur in communities, underscoring safe burials and early care. VillageReach coordinates with the DRC MOH in Ituri, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bunia; PPE, including 341 cases of 3M PPE and N95s, pending import docs.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大するエボラ流行から3か月、ダイレクト・リリーフの対応は3か国に及ぶ

triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・南スーダンが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: 上班遭蜱虫叮咬 女子及时就医
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman bitten by a tick at work seeks medical treatment promptly.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, a woman in her 20s in Fujian, China, was bitten by a tick at her workstation and promptly sought care at the Affiliated Third People’s Hospital of Fujian University of Traditional Chinese Medicine. Dermatologist Zhang Yuxin noted the bite showed no immediate redness or pus due to timely treatment. Ticks pose risk not from bite pain but from mouthparts with barbs that anchor in skin and can carry multiple pathogens; improper removal increases infection risk. Common errors include forceful pulling, squeezing, burning, or applying irritants. Safe removal requires a sterile, sharp-tipped tweezers disinfected with 75% alcohol or povidone-iodine; grasp near the skin, pull the tick out vertically without twisting, and avoid crushing the body. After removal, disinfect the wound and hands; store the tick in a sealed container for potential testing. Tick bites can be painless initially with incubation up to two weeks; seek care promptly if redness, swelling, fever, fatigue, muscle pain, erythema migrans, or lymphadenopathy develops.

triage.headline_ja: 職場でマダニに刺された女性、速やかに受診

article.articleHeadline: Congo's M23 rebels introduce new movement restrictions over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts movement restrictions by the AFC/M23 rebel alliance in North and South Kivu. To curb transmission in Ebola-affected zones, shared taxis on the Goma–Kirumba corridor will be suspended for one month from Aug 22, 2026, and pirogue boats on select Lake Edward routes restricted; taxi-buses remain allowed on Goma–Kirumba with health and safety controls, and trucks carrying goods are permitted. The measure follows two travellers from Lubero who tested positive for Ebola in a village under M23 control, highlighting cross‑zone transmission risk. The context is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, amid ongoing hostilities with the Rwanda‑backed rebels who control major towns including Goma and Bukavu and have declared Ebola-free territories in June. Government data show confirmed Ebola cases exceeding 5,000.

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-猕猴桃黄叶别盲目补铁！病毒会借昆虫扩散
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - Don't blindly supplement iron for kiwifruit yellowing leaves! Viruses spread via insects.
article.articleSummary: Actinidia yellow ring spot virus (AYRSpV) infects kiwifruit in China, causing systemic leaf yellowing during flowering. The study, conducted at Northwest A&F University, shows AYRSpV CP (capsid protein) directly binds and promotes degradation of the host enzyme Mg-protoporphyrin IX methyltransferase (ChlM), a key chlorophyll biosynthesis enzyme, suppressing chlorophyll production and triggering widespread chlorosis. Field observations reveal virus-infected plants become highly attractive to pollinators at bloom, suggesting the yellowing acts as a visual cue to facilitate pollen-mediated spread. Loss-of-function of ChlM via gene editing in kiwifruit yielded almost identical yellowing and heightened AYRSpV susceptibility, confirming the CP-ChlM axis as a “symptom-mediated transmission” mechanism. The authors emphasize that yellowing should prompt testing rather than iron supplementation; control measures should target vectors and graft/transmission pathways to interrupt the transmission cycle. Published in Horticultural Research (DOI:10.1093/hr/uhag325).

triage.headline_ja: 科学網-キウイフルーツの葉が黄変しても闇雲に鉄分補給しないで！ウイルスは昆虫を介して拡散する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はキウイフルーツの植物ウイルス（AYRSpV）に関する農業・植物病理学の研究報告であり、ヒトの公衆衛生に関わる感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 対象は植物病害（キウイフルーツのウイルス感染）であり、ヒトの感染症サーベイランス対象外のため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola confirmed cases top 5,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola confirmed cases exceed 5,000 with more than 2,320 deaths as of 19 August 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and declared on 15 May, spans six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo. Africa CDC warns it could become the deadliest Ebola epidemic ever recorded globally unless its trajectory is urgently reversed, with the case fatality ratio near 50 percent and about one death every 30 minutes. It is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record and the deadliest in DRC history. Uganda’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak ended on 28 July 2026, illustrating containment is possible with rapid, comprehensive public health measures centered on communities. The report notes the May 15 declaration date for the DRC outbreak and ongoing elevated risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、確定症例5,000人超、死者2,320人超という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、史上最悪・最速拡大のエボラ流行と評価され、複数州に拡大しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダの同系統アウトブレイクは終息済みと記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCの継続中の大規模流行。Africa CDCが史上最悪のエボラ流行になる可能性を警告しており、国際的な支援・監視が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Population mobility mapping (PMM) report for Bundibugyo Virus disease (BVD) Preparedness in Arua District, Uganda, 6-8 July 2026 - Uganda
article.articleSummary: PMM exercise in Arua District, Uganda (6–8 July 2026) supports preparedness for Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD) amid an Ebola-like outbreak affecting DRC and Uganda. The exercise, led by IOM with Uganda MOH and district authorities, mapped population movements, priority mobility corridors, congregation points, and formal/informal entry points to inform targeted preparedness interventions and risk-informed planning. As of mid-July 2026, the DRC reported over 2,100 confirmed BVD cases and more than 800 deaths (crude CFR ≈39%), while Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths (CFR 10%), with no new cases since 21 June 2026. The outbreak is concentrated in eastern DRC (Ituri, North Kivu) with cross-border transmission linked to Uganda. Arua’s location on major regional routes underscores the need for coordinated multi-sector response among government and partners.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ・アルア県における人口移動マッピング(PMM)報告:ブンディブギョウイルス病(BVD)への備え(2026年7月6-8日) - ウガンダ

article.articleHeadline: बरसाती मौसम का असर... बच्चों से बड़ों तक वायरल का संक्रमण फैल रहा, ओपीडी में बढ़े मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impact of the monsoon season... Viral infections spreading from children to adults, with more patients in the OPD.
article.articleSummary: Ujjain, India — Monsoon-driven weather changes are fueling a surge of viral infections spreading from children to adults. The district Charak Hospital's outpatient department reports hundreds of children daily presenting with cold symptoms, sore throat, and high fever. In many cases, fever accompanies dehydration, low blood pressure, vomiting or diarrhea, poor appetite, and muscle or joint pains; some children become too weak to walk. Adults exhibit similar patterns with fever, sore throat, headaches, body aches, and fatigue; a few report diminished sense of smell or taste. Infections have sparked family clusters, with other members developing comparable symptoms. Health officials caution against ignoring persistent high fever and systemic symptoms. Dr. Jitendra Sharma stresses careful diet and hygiene, and urges medical consultation for children with high fever, dehydration, or poor intake.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の影響…子供から大人までウイルス感染が拡大、OPD受診患者が増加

triage.notes: モンスーン季節に典型的なウイルス性疾患の増加を報じるローカル記事。病原体特定なく、重症度や死亡例の報告もない。家族内クラスターは見られるが、地域の医療体制内で対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's M23 Rebels Introduce New Movement Restrictions Over Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: AFC/M23 rebels in the Democratic Republic of Congo impose movement restrictions over Ebola concerns as authorities contend with what officials call the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Starting Aug 22, 2026, shared taxis on the Goma–Kirumba corridor will be suspended for one month, and pirogue boats on select Lake Edward routes will be halted. Taxi-buses on the Goma–Kirumba road remain under health controls, as do trucks carrying goods. The measures follow two travellers from Lubero, a government-held town, testing positive for Ebola in a village inside M23-controlled territory, according to a rebel response team. The rebels control large parts of North and South Kivu, including Goma and Bukavu, and have run a separate Ebola response after declaring Ebola-free territories in June. Congo’s government reported more than 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases this week.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's M23 rebels introduce new movement restrictions over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, the AFC/M23 rebel alliance in the Democratic Republic of Congo said it will impose new movement restrictions on movements to and from Ebola-affected government-held zones, citing Ebola containment efforts in territory it controls. The group has highlighted its capability to tackle the spread of Ebola in areas under its control. The article does not provide Ebola case or death counts, timing of the outbreaks, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or details on whether the restrictions apply to all civilians or specific routes. It notes only that the measures are intended to curb the spread of Ebola in affected zones. No imported/exported case information is mentioned. This development highlights the intersection of security actions and public health responses amid Ebola concerns in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: 北京今夏蝙蝠入户增多，医生提醒：咬伤抓伤后需尽快就医
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Beijing this summer, bats entering homes have increased; doctors remind: seek medical attention promptly after bites or scratches.
article.articleSummary: Beijing reports more bats entering homes this summer, East Asian vesper bats. Any bat bite or scratch requires immediate action: rinse the wound with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then flush with saline if available, and apply diluted povidone-iodine or chlorhexidine. Unless there is heavy bleeding, do not bandage. Seek care at a rabies exposure prevention and post-exposure prophylaxis (RPEP) clinic; clinicians will re-clean the wound and give rabies vaccine plus rabies immunoglobulin, with tetanus antitoxin or antibiotics. After vaccination, observe in clinic for at least 30 minutes. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear; direct contact with bats is a Level III exposure. If indoor bat droppings are found, wear gloves and a mask and disinfect with chlorine or other disinfectant for at least 30 minutes. Do not chase bats; open doors/windows or call 119. Beijing has 136 facilities offering RPEP clinics.

article.articleHeadline: WATCH: 'Will You Wait Until People Die?' NCP Protests Rising Dog Attacks, Threatens To Bring Rabid Dogs Inside PCMC Office
article.articleSummary: Rising stray dog attacks in Pimpri-Chinchwad, PCMC, India trigger protests by the NCP outside the civic building, with threats to bring stray dogs into PCMC premises if action falters. The opposition cites a recent attack on a young girl and public safety concerns as residents struggle with morning walks. PCMC data show dog bite cases climbing to 38,004 in 2025-26 and 13,615 from April–July 2026, continuing a decade-long rise from 10,165 in 2015-16 and 28,099 in 2024-25. Critics fault veterinary staffing and tender-focused priorities; the new PCMC Commissioner Dr Vijay Suryawanshi is urged to act. Measures underway include expanding the dog sterilisation programme, increasing cages and manpower at the Nehru Nagar sterilisation centre, and providing free rabies vaccines at Yashwantrao Chavan Memorial Hospital, with treatment available for bite victims.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV di Halmahera Selatan Bertambah 27, Dinkes Temukan Banyak dari Screening CKG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Cases in South Halmahera Increase by 27; Health Office Finds Many from CKG Screening
article.articleSummary: HIV cases in South Halmahera Regency, North Maluku, Indonesia rose by 27 in January–July 2026, with 2024 reporting 49 cases and 2025 rising by 12 from the previous year to 61. Most new infections were detected through the Free Health Check (CKG) program, which includes school screenings but predominantly identifies adult cases. Health authorities underscore ongoing screening at hospitals and public health centers, while current patients receive routine treatment at Puskesmas Labuha and RSUD Labuha. The warning from the Halmahera Selatan Health Office, led by Asia Hasyim, emphasizes vigilance against transmission, noting HIV is a sexually transmitted virus that attacks the immune system; parents are advised to monitor adolescents’ activities and the behavior of couples. No laboratory-confirmation details or imported/exported case data are specified beyond the CKG-driven detection effort. Published August 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 南ハルマヘラのHIV症例が27件増加、保健局はCKGスクリーニングで多数発見
triage.triage_reason: HIVの通常のスクリーニングによる症例増加であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の定期的なHIVサーベイランス報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性やアウトブレイクの兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: World Mosquito Day : डेंगू से आगे निकला मलेरिया, आठ साल के आंकड़ों में 125% ज्यादा मामले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Mosquito Day: Malaria has surpassed dengue, 125% more cases in eight years of data.
article.articleSummary: Lucknow’s World Mosquito Day data show malaria cases outpacing dengue by 125% over eight years. As of August 19, 2026, dengue is 92 cases and malaria 207, with a shift from dengue dominance to malaria escalation starting in 2025. Eight-year trend (2019–2026): 2019—dengue 2,162; malaria 146; 2020—882/25; 2021—1,978/34; 2022—2,648/157; 2023—2,749/97; 2024—3,244/492; 2025—930/676; 2026 (Jan–Aug 19)—92/207. Aedes mosquitoes transmit dengue (and chikungunya, yellow fever), Anopheles transmit malaria, and Culex transmit filariasis and Japanese encephalitis. A local concern is the Nawab Kishore Road CHC campus where open malathion drums and accumulating rainwater create breeding sites; malaria department office is housed there, yet lapses persist. CMO Dr. NB Singh says a probe will be conducted, underscoring need to eliminate standing water and raise awareness to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊の日:デング熱を上回るマラリア、8年間のデータで125%増加
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日に合わせた統計報告であり、既知の季節性媒介感染症の年次データ推移を伝える内容で、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ラクナウ市内の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア・デング熱）の年次統計データ記事。局所的な繁殖地（CHC施設）への懸念はあるが、緊急対応を要する異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola se dispara: ya supera los 5.000 casos y 2.300 muertos y la OMS alerta de que sigue fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spiraling: it has already surpassed 5,000 cases and 2,300 deaths, and the WHO warns that it remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,300 deaths, becoming the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country and among the worst globally since 2014-2016 West Africa. As of August 2026, reports show more than 5,100 infections and about 2,400 fatalities, with tallies rapidly updating. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak remains out of control, with transmission focused in communities and outside health facilities, complicating case finding and contact tracing. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo provinces are affected, with Ituri about 90% of confirmed cases in early August. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or targeted treatment; experimental vaccines and therapies are being explored. Uganda reported related cases but ended transmission on 28 July 2026; Congo remains the main hotspot.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が急拡大：感染者5,000人、死者2,300人を超え、WHOは「依然として制御不能」と警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで5,000人超の感染、2,300人超の死者を出し、WHOが制御不能と警告するなど、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連症例は2026年7月28日に終息が報告されており、対象国リストにウガンダ・アンゴラは含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。有効なワクチン・治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行であり、国際的な支援・監視が急務。

article.articleHeadline: اليونان تسجل 13 وفاة و157 إصابة بفيروس "غرب النيل"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Greece records 13 deaths and 157 cases of West Nile virus.
article.articleSummary: Greece has recorded 157 West Nile virus cases and 13 deaths in 2026 through 19 August, with an average age of 82 among the deceased. A report by the National Public Health Organization under the Ministry of Health notes 47 new cases in the past week. In the same period of 2025, Greece reported 47 cases and 2 deaths. West Nile virus is transmitted to humans by mosquito bites; about 80% of infections are asymptomatic. The virus circulates in Africa, Europe, the Middle East, North America and West Asia, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment available for prevention or cure.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャで西ナイル熱13人死亡、157人感染
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はギリシャでの西ナイル熱発生であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChina(Shanghai)やAfricaが含まれるが、記事本文はギリシャの事例のみを扱っており、対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: जांच में परिवार के 2 और सदस्य मिले डेंगू पॉजिटिव -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two more members of the family tested positive for dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak linked to a Satna, Madhya Pradesh, India family in Life Jyoti Colony. A 60-year-old woman, Rajdulari, died after dengue was confirmed in her blood during transfer from a private hospital to another facility (16 August hospitalization; death en route). In response, malaria authorities sampled 12 family members. By 20 August 2026, two additional women—Kavita (36) and Ankita (17)—tested dengue-positive by ELISA, both feverish previously. A third relative, Baby (26), was ELISA-negative but RD-kit positive for dengue. The family largely seeks care in Nagpur; Baby is hospitalized there, while Ankita and Kavita were not admitted. Persistent transmission risk prompted larval source elimination and adult mosquito control around the residence, including Liquid Pyrethrum spraying and fogging to neutralize adult mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: 検査で家族の2人がデング熱陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の一家族内でのデング熱クラスターで死亡例1名を含むが、地域限定的な事例であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。防疫対応も既に実施されており継続監視で十分と判断。
triage.notes: 家族内クラスターであり、地域の保健当局（マラリア対策部門）が既に幼虫源除去・成虫駆除（ピレスロイド散布・燻蒸）を実施済み。インドではデング熱は季節性の流行病であり、この事例自体は異常性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Keralam minister urges public cooperation to prevent mosquito-borne diseases
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram, Aug 20 – Keralam Health Minister K Muraleedharan urged public participation to prevent mosquito-borne and other communicable diseases, ahead of the World Mosquito Day observance at Vattiyoorkavu. He emphasized elimination of stagnant water and mosquito breeding, and urged strict adherence to Dry Day practices: schools on Fridays, government offices on Saturdays, households on Sundays. With dengue continuing to spread, he called for prompt reporting of fever symptoms in children to Health Department for timely intervention. Hotels and roadside eateries were instructed to serve only boiled and cooled water to prevent water-borne diseases, with intensified inspections and penalties for unhygienic establishments. Health authorities promised adequate stock of medicines at primary health centres. Arogyakeralam State Mission Director Anu S Nair presided; participants took a mosquito-eradication awareness pledge during the event.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州保健相、蚊媒介感染症予防への協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の継続的な流行が言及されているが、具体的な症例数や重症度データがなく、内容は季節性の啓発キャンペーンにとどまるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: インド・ケララ州における季節性のデング熱予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria Municipal de Saúde intensifica trabalho de eliminação de larvas e mosquitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Health Department intensifies efforts to eliminate larvae and mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa’s Municipal Health Department (SMS) via the Environmental Vigilance Management (GVAM) intensified Aedes aegypti control ahead of World Mosquito Day (Aug 20). The effort targets dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. From January–July this year, 554 ovitraps were placed citywide, neutralizing 27,843 mosquito eggs; in November–December 2025, 162 traps eliminated 6,233 eggs. Beginning September, GVAM will deploy Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDLs) to disseminate larvicide via female mosquitoes; the first installations are planned for Sept 14. Currently, 625 ovitraps monitor presence and reproduction to map risk and guide interventions. EDLs attract females to a larvicide-coated surface, which they carry to other breeding sites, preventing larvae from maturing. Residents can report potential breeding sites through Disk Dengue at (83) 3213-7781/7782 or 99395-1971; arboviral symptoms warrant care at a Family Health Unit (USF), with more acute cases at UPA or Hospital Municipal do Valentina for children.

triage.headline_ja: 市保健局、幼虫・蚊の駆除作業を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的公衆衛生活動（蚊媒介病対策の定期的強化）を報じる内容であり、異常な流行や新規事例の急増を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事はジョアン・ペソア市の平時の蚊媒介病予防活動（世界蚊デーに合わせた取り組み）を伝えるもので、具体的な症例数増加や流行拡大の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Le Gouvernement renforce la riposte avec vaccins et mesures scolaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: The Government Strengthens the Response with Vaccines and School Measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) totals 5,208 laboratory-confirmed cases as of 18 August 2026, with the outbreak active across six provinces—Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo—and 56 health zones affected. Clinically, 730 patients are isolated or hospitalized; 1,115 have recovered; 2,476 deaths, for a case fatality rate of 47.5% and 84% contact-tracing coverage. Vaccination efforts deploy ERVEBO, with 2,000 doses available in Tshopo and a request for 500,000 additional doses to broaden coverage. Remdesivir has been introduced in treatment centers, while monoclonal antibodies and other antivirals are under review to improve survival. The school year 2026-2027 will be adapted in 18 high-risk zones: four weeks of remote instruction using printed materials and local radio, with no internet or devices required, to protect children and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：政府がワクチンと休校措置で対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6州56保健地区に及ぶエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率47.5%と極めて深刻で、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 累計5,208例確定、死亡2,476例、致死率47.5%という大規模かつ致死性の高いアウトブレイクであり、500,000回分のワクチン追加要請や学校対応措置が取られていることから、国際支援の必要性も示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜39歲男確診 潛伏期赴泰與陌生男「高風險接觸」 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | 39-year-old man diagnosed; traveled to Thailand during the incubation period and had high-risk contact with a stranger | am730
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox diagnosed in a 39-year-old man in Hong Kong as an imported case. He developed sore throat, fever, and a generalized rash including genital areas, trunk, and limbs starting on the 12th of the month, sought care at a private clinic, then at Ruttonjee Hospital emergency department, and is now isolated at Queen Mary Hospital in stable condition. Laboratory testing by the Centre for Health Protection's Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox positivity. He had not received monkeypox vaccination and had high-risk contact with a stranger in Thailand during the incubation period. Investigations are ongoing; authorities are tracing contacts and will notify the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has reported 96 monkeypox cases (76 local, 20 imported), all male, with most cases linked to high-risk sexual activity with strangers or unprotected sex.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘｜39歳男性が確定診断、潜伏期にタイへ渡航し見知らぬ男性と「高リスク接触」
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入例1件で、症状は安定しており既知の感染パターン（2022年以降96例）に合致する。異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、フルRRAの必要性は乏しい。
triage.notes: 診断・発症は香港（中国特別行政区）で発生。タイは潜伏期間中の渡航・接触先として言及されているのみで、タイでの発生事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 5000 cas confirmés dans 6 provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 5,000 confirmed cases in six provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spans six provinces and 56 health zones. As of 18 August 2026, 5,208 confirmed cases have been reported; 730 patients are currently isolated or hospitalized; 1,115 have recovered; 2,476 have died, for a case-fatality ratio of 47.5%. Contact tracing coverage stands at 84%. The affected provinces are Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo. Response efforts are intensifying vaccination with the ERVEBO vaccine, alongside strengthened surveillance and case management in the affected health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：6州で5,000人以上の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 6州にまたがる大規模なエボラ流行で、致死率47.5%と高く、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 5,208例、死亡2,476例（CFR47.5%）と非常に高い致死率。6州56保健地域に拡大しており、ワクチン接種（ERVEBO）を含む対応が継続中。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: New PhilHealth President, CEO urges Filipinos to avail of free leptospirosis medicine through YAKAP
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines targeted by PhilHealth's GAMOT (Guaranteed and Accessible Medications for Outpatient Treatment) and YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program). Free doxycycline for prevention and treatment is available through GAMOT providers with free consultations; YAKAP covers outpatient medicines up to 20,000 PHP. Hospital care for leptospirosis is expanded to 63,000 PHP for moderate to severe cases, with overall benefits potentially up to 411,000 PHP for complicated scenarios such as hemodialysis, mechanical ventilation, and pulmonary rehabilitation. Nationwide, nearly 3,000 GAMOT providers and about 4,000 YAKAP clinics dispense GAMOT prescriptions. From Jan 4 to Aug 8, 2026, the DOH recorded 3,440 leptospirosis cases and 220 deaths, lower than 5,318 cases in the same period last year. PhilHealth Acting President Dr. Beverly Lorraine C. Ho urged at-risk Filipinos to utilize the prophylaxis and outpatient services.

triage.headline_ja: 新PhilHealth会長兼CEO、フィリピン国民に「YAKAP」を通じたレプトスピラ症無料治療薬の利用を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の症例数は前年より減少しており、記事は医療保険制度・医薬品給付プログラムの案内が主旨で、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年フィリピンで発生する風土病であり、本記事は保険給付制度の広報が主目的。症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश के मौसम में गौवंश और भैंसों पर मंडरा रहा इन 3 खतरनाक बीमारियों का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the monsoon season, the looming threat of these three dangerous diseases to cattle and buffaloes.
article.articleSummary: Pali district, Rajasthan faces monsoon-linked threats to cattle and buffaloes from three diseases: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), Lameness fever, and a severe ailment called galghontu. The Department of Animal Husbandry is conducting a free vaccination campaign against all three diseases, alongside ongoing awareness drives and daily progress reporting. Last year, Pali recorded Lameness fever cases, prompting heightened preventive measures this season. In addition to vaccines, the government has organized farmer meetings and training via a Jodhpur-based training center, enabling 30–40 farmers from Pali and the Jodhpur division to learn disease management and proper livestock care. The emphasis throughout is on vaccination, hygiene, and adherence to departmental guidelines to safeguard livestock during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンシーズン、牛や水牛に迫る3つの危険な病気の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ランピースキン病等）に関する予防的ワクチン接種の啓発記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 家畜（牛・水牛）を対象とした動物疾患の予防接種キャンペーンに関する地方ニュースであり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜39歲男確診　潛伏期曾在泰國與陌生男子高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | 39-year-old man diagnosed; during the incubation period he had high-risk contact with a stranger man in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: One imported monkeypox case reported in Hong Kong on 20 August 2026: a 39-year-old man who developed sore throat, fever, and rashes from 12 August, with lesions on genitals, trunk, and limbs. He sought care at a private clinic and then at the emergency department on 17 August; laboratory testing by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox. During the incubation period he had high‑risk contact with a stranger man in Thailand. He is isolated at Princess Margaret Hospital and is clinically stable. He had not received monkeypox vaccination. There is no current epidemiological link to previously recorded local cases; ongoing epidemiological investigation and contact tracing will proceed, with notification to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has tallied 96 monkeypox cases (76 locally acquired, 20 imported).

triage.headline_ja: サル痘｜39歳男性が確診　潜伏期にタイで見知らぬ男性とハイリスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入mpox症例1件で、症状は安定・隔離済みであり地域内拡大の兆候はないが、性的接触による感染しやすさがある点でWPRO基準に一部該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例は香港（中国特別行政区）で確診。タイでの接触は感染源として言及されているが、疾病発生国はタイではなく香港であるため、Thailandはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲漢染猴痘　潛伏期曾在泰國與陌生男有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old man infected with monkeypox; during the incubation period he had high-risk contact with a stranger in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong: a 39-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox, currently isolated and in stable condition at Queen Mary Hospital. He developed sore throat, fever, and rashes on the genitals, trunk, and limbs starting August 12, with care sought at a private clinic on August 13 and emergency admission on August 17. Laboratory confirmation from the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service. The patient reports no monkeypox vaccination and notes high-risk contact with a stranger in Thailand during the incubation period; contact tracing will reach individuals with exposure. The case is not yet epidemiologically linked to prior HK monkeypox cases, and outbreak investigations continue. HK authorities will report this case to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 96 monkeypox cases (76 local, 20 imported), all male, with most linked to high-risk sexual activity with strangers or unprotected sex.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性が猿痘に感染　潜伏期間中にタイで見知らぬ男性とハイリスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港における既知のMpox流行パターンに沿った単発の輸入疑い症例であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常性は認められないが、性的接触を介した感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港では2022年以降96例（うち20例が輸入例）が確認されており、本症例も既存のサーベイランス体制下で管理されている。タイでの接触歴があるが、タイ国内でのアウトブレイクを示す情報はないため、Thailandはverified_locationsに含めなかった。当局はWHOへの報告を予定している。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲男子確診猴痘情況穩定 潛伏期曾在泰國有高風險接觸 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old man diagnosed with Monkeypox; condition stable; had high-risk exposure in Thailand during the incubation period - Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 39-year-old man diagnosed; onset Aug 12 with throat pain, fever, and rashes on genitalia, trunk, and limbs; hospitalized Aug 17 at Queen Mary Hospital, isolated, stable. Laboratory confirmation by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service. He had not received the Monkeypox vaccine and had high-risk exposure in Thailand with a stranger male during incubation. There is no confirmed epidemiological link to previously reported Hong Kong cases; epidemiological investigation and contact tracing are ongoing, and the case will be reported to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 96 Monkeypox cases (76 local, 20 imported), all male; most involve high-risk sexual activity with strangers or unprotected sex. This case is an imported infection under investigation for possible local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）と診断、容体は安定 – 潜伏期間中にタイで高リスク接触あり（香港文匯報）
triage.triage_reason: 香港で輸入例のサル痘症例が確認され、性的接触による感染で地域内伝播の可能性が調査中。WHOへの報告義務があり、当局（衛生防護センター）が疫学調査を実施中であることから、社会的・行政的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 本症例は香港（中国特別行政区）で診断された輸入例で、潜伏期間中にタイで高リスク接触があったとされるが、タイ国内での感染確認例ではないためタイは検証地域に含めない。香港では2022年以降96例の猴痘症例（うち76例が地域内感染）が報告されており、性感染を伴う感染拡大の継続的リスクが懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل أول إصابة بشرية في الصين بانفلونزا الخنازير... ما أعراض المرض؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first human case of swine flu recorded in China... What are the symptoms of the disease?
article.articleSummary: China reports its first human case of swine influenza, a two-year-old child, confirmed by laboratory testing. The patient had exposure to pet pigs in a household environment and developed dyspnea, cough, and fever, prompting hospitalisation; he recovered after appropriate treatment. Investigations found no secondary infections among close contacts. The World Health Organization notes that human cases of swine influenza have been rare, typically linked to direct or indirect animal contact or contaminated environments, and human-to-human transmission remains uncommon. Swine influenza viruses circulate among pigs, with zoonotic transmission possible but unusual. Authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance given the animal reservoir and the potential for spillover. Symptoms commonly seen with influenza-like illness include fever, cough, fatigue, respiratory symptoms, and sore throat, which can overlap with other illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で豚インフルエンザの初のヒト感染例を記録…病気の症状は？
triage.triage_reason: 中国で初めてのヒト豚インフルエンザ感染例が報告されたが、単一症例で回復済み、二次感染も確認されておらず、現時点では拡大の兆候はない。新規人獣共通感染症としてサーベイランス継続の観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 初のヒト豚インフルエンザ症例だが軽症で回復、濃厚接触者に二次感染なし。動物リザーバーからのスピルオーバーとして今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito pequeno, doenças graves: combate deve ser diário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Small mosquito, serious diseases: the fight must be daily.
article.articleSummary: On World Mosquito Day (August 20, 2026), Espírito Santo’s Health Secretariat (SESA) through NEVE warns that tiny mosquitoes can spread arboviruses such as dengue, chikungunya, Zika, Oropouche fever, Yellow fever, and West Nile fever. Symptoms range from mild fever, body and joint pain, and rashes to potentially fatal complications. Prevention must be year-round to curb Aedes breeding in standing water, with attention to home and public spaces. Key domestic breeding sites include containers that collect rainwater: plant dishes, open bottles, buckets, toys, unsealed water tanks, clogged gutters, and other water-holding items, especially in yards, balconies, and gardens. Public spaces—vacant lots, construction sites, schools, workplaces, condominiums, cemeteries, and squares—also require vigilance. Since 2025, four arboviruses (dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and Oropouche) are monitored via the real-time dashboard “Monitoramento das Arboviroses no Espírito Santo.” Prevention relies on shared responsibility between the public and authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな蚊、深刻な病気：対策は毎日行うべき

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la Société civile alerte sur la crise humanitaire et le retard de la gratuité des soins face à Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Civil society warns of the humanitarian crisis and the delay in free healthcare amid Ebola - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, civil society warns of a worsening humanitarian crisis as thousands displaced by armed violence live in dire conditions. In Mambasa, more than 1,500 people from the Pygmy community lack food and shelter, with other residents fleeing ADF attacks and long-term camp dwellers. Beyond aid, they condemn the delayed implementation of the government’s promise of free healthcare in Ebola-affected areas, a pledge made since June but not yet enacted as of 19 August 2026. They argue free care would improve access amid the Ebola outbreak. Security improvements are needed to facilitate returns to home villages; aid must be paired with durable peace and safety measures. Authorities should ensure access to care and enable voluntary, secure returns of displaced.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州: 市民社会がエボラ対策における人道危機と医療無償化の遅れを警告 - LePotentiel

article.articleHeadline: "咬人最凶"的蚊子 认识白纹伊蚊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mosquito That Bites People Most Ferociously: Understanding Aedes albopictus
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day (2026-08-20) highlights mosquito-borne disease risks. Globally, about 4000 mosquito species exist, but only roughly 100 transmit pathogens. Mosquito genera differ: Aedes bite during the day and include dengue fever and chikungunya vectors; Anopheles transmit malaria and primarily bite at night; Culex bite at night and spread Japanese encephalitis. In China, the most harmful and aggressive biters are Aedes albopictus, the white-striped mosquito commonly known as the 'flower mosquito,' capable of transmitting multiple pathogens and biting fiercely. The article notes that welts from Aedes bites are driven by saliva proteins triggering allergic reactions, with cold compresses reducing exudate and antihistamines or desensitization therapy alleviating itching.

triage.headline_ja: "咬人最凶"の蚊 白紋伊蚊(ヒトスジシマカ)を知る
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日にちなむ一般啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: 223.000 Kasus TBC di Indonesia Belum Terdeteksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: 223,000 TB cases in Indonesia have not yet been detected.
article.articleSummary: TB in Indonesia: an estimated 1,090,000 cases occurred in 2025, with only about 867,000 detected (80%). Wamenkes Benjamin Paulus Octavianus notes many cases remain undetected. To improve case finding, the Health Ministry will expand screening through the Free Health Check program (CKG) in 2026, aiming to detect 90% of TB cases. Detected individuals will receive intensive treatment promptly to prevent further transmission. For 2025, the target for TB preventive therapy (TPT) among household contacts was 72%, but provincial performance lagged: Banten 61%, East Java 46%, Central Java 28%; Papua Highlands 0%, North Sulawesi 1%, and Aceh 1%. The ministry urges the public to participate in CKG to enable earlier detection, diagnosis, and treatment, reducing TB transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省:インドネシアで結核患者223,000人が未検出
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核流行状況に関する行政報告であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、未検出率の高さと地域格差は継続的な公衆衛生課題として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 結核は地域流行性疾患であり突発的な公衆衛生危機ではないが、未検出症例が多数存在し地域間で予防治療達成率に大きな差があることから、今後の政策実施状況を継続観察する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Побуњеници због ширења еболе уводе ограничења кретања становништва
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rebels impose movement restrictions on the population due to the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Rebel coalition AFC/M23, which controls large parts of North and South Kivu in the Democratic Republic of Congo, announced new movement restrictions in response to the Ebola outbreak. Beginning this Saturday, taxi services between Goma and Kirumba will be suspended for one month, and passenger pirogues on select Lake Edward routes will be halted; trucks carrying goods may continue, and travel along the Goma–Kirumba corridor will proceed under health and security checks. The measures followed two Lubero travelers testing Ebola positive in a village under M23 control. Health authorities say it is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with confirmed cases in Congo surpassing 5,000 according to government data this week. M23 has controlled vast areas since a 2025 offensive that captured Goma and Bukavu. UN and Western governments accuse Rwanda of backing the group, which Kigali denies. M23 had declared Ebola-free in their territories by June.

triage.headline_ja: 反乱軍、エボラ拡大を受け住民の移動を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例が5000例を超え、史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が紛争地域で継続しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争地帯（M23/AFC支配地域）でのエボラ拡大であり、アクセス制限や保健システムの機能不全により対応が困難。ルワンダは記事に登場するが発生国ではなく非難の対象として言及されているのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola dispara las alarmas en África: "El brote está lejos de estar bajo control" - La Voz De Ibiza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola raises alarms in Africa: "The outbreak is far from being under control" - La Voz De Ibiza
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with no approved vaccine or antiviral for this variant. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By mid-August, reports showed more than 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths in the DRC across 49 health zones in five provinces; later updates cited over 5,100 cases and about 2,420 deaths across six of 26 provinces and more than 55 health zones. Uganda recorded about 20 cases and two deaths, but ended its Bundibugyo outbreak in July via early diagnosis and extensive contact tracing. Case fatality is 44–47%; deaths have largely occurred in communities rather than hospitals (60–70%). Diagnostic delays were due to misattribution to malaria/typhoid/flu and tests designed for Zaire ebolavirus. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak, with highest risk in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで警戒を引き起こす：「発生はコントロール下からほど遠い」 - La Voz De Ibiza
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、致死率44-47%、5000例超・2000名超の死亡と深刻。国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心も高くフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言しており既にフルリスク評価対象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 2.400 muertos: el virus del ébola sacude el Congo y la OMS alerta de que está "fuera de control"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,400 dead: the Ebola virus shakes the Congo and the WHO warns that it is "out of control".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, has reached 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, with 730 in isolation or hospitalized and 1,115 recovered. Six provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. Contact tracing stands at 84%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is the second deadliest in history and the largest in the DRC, with a reported mortality of 30-50%. Transmission is non-airborne, occurring via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or infected corpses; initial symptoms are fever, muscle pain, fatigue, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) is used, with indications of possible cross-protection against Bundibugyo; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in Phase 1 trials. The WHO declares a public health emergency; Tedros warns the outbreak is far from contained due to insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: 死者2,400人超:エボラウイルスがコンゴを揺るがし、WHOは「制御不能」と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行(5,208症例、死者2,476人)が発生し、WHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言、制御不能と警告しており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: WHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言し、治安悪化・住民移動・越境移動により流行制御が困難と報告されている。史上2番目に致死率が高い流行かつDRC史上最大規模。

article.articleHeadline: Muỗi truyền sốt xuất huyết thường đốt vào thời điểm nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When do dengue-carrying mosquitoes usually bite?
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, dengue fever is transmitted mainly by female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes living near human dwellings. Unlike some nocturnal species, A. aegypti bites primarily during the day, with peaks in the morning and late afternoon, but can bite at other times in shaded indoor spaces. An infected mosquito can transmit the virus to several people during successive blood meals as the virus develops within the insect, contributing to rapid community spread when mosquito density and human cases are high. Therefore, dengue prevention requires reducing mosquito populations and eliminating breeding sites, not only avoiding bites. Protective measures include wearing long sleeves and pants, using window screens and bed nets (including for daytime naps), and applying approved repellents containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 per label. Do not rely on natural oils or DIY mixtures, keep homes ventilated, remove standing water, and follow local mosquito-control guidance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱を媒介する蚊はいつ刺すことが多いのか？
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防・啓発に関する一般的な情報記事であり、特定の疫学的異常事態や症例急増を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo set to receive 70,000 Ervebo vaccines to contain Ebola outbreak, WHO says
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Congo Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, prompts WHO to allocate 70,000 Merck Ervebo vaccine doses from the ICG stockpile; 20,000 will be used in a late-stage trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo in humans remains unproven. WHO stresses uncertainty about cross-protection and the need for trials. Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 5,000 with 2,378 deaths as of late July, making this the largest Ebola epidemic by case count in the country’s history. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus calls the outbreak a global emergency. The ICG partnership—WHO, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, Médecins Sans Frontières and UNICEF—manages the vaccine stockpile allocation to support containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ流行封じ込めのため7万回分のエルベボワクチンを受領へ、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行(5000例超、死亡2378人)が発生し、WHO事務局長が「世界的緊急事態」と表明。ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性と国際支援の必要性が明確でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種による流行で、既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)の交差防御効果が未確認である点が特に懸念される。WHOはこれを世界的緊急事態と呼称しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಬಂದು ಗುಣವಾಗಿದ್ಯಾ? ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಬಂದ್ರೆ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಈ ಅಪಾಯ ಕಟ್ಟಿಟ್ಟ ಬುತ್ತಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When dengue strikes, does it become severe? If it recurs and is neglected, this danger looms.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, is a major public health challenge in Bengaluru. There are four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4). After recovery from a first infection with one serotype, antibodies against that serotype persist, but a subsequent infection with a different serotype can be more dangerous due to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Severe secondary infections can cause dengue hemorrhagic fever (bleeding from damaged blood vessels), thrombocytopenia (low platelets), and dengue shock syndrome (rapid blood pressure drop risking organ failure). Preventive measures emphasize vector control and early medical care: seek prompt testing if fever recurs after prior dengue, maintain hydration, and use paracetamol only as advised by a doctor while avoiding NSAIDs; eliminate standing water around the home; cover water tanks and containers; use mosquito nets, repellents, and protective clothing to prevent bites.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に一度感染して治癒しましたか？再感染時に放置すると、この危険は避けられません
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の一般的な疫学・予防啓発記事であり、特定の流行や異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の病態（二次感染によるADE、出血熱等）や予防策に関する一般啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な発生・流行データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose ainda é um problema de saúde pública; veja causas e sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis is still a public health problem; see the causes and symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis remains a Brazil-wide public health challenge across five regions. A 2026 Ministry of Health surveillance and control manual documents 24,454 human cases from 2015–2024, with new cases down 69.7% from 2017–2024, yet widespread distribution sustains risk. August is Agosto Verde-Claro, a month of awareness. Transmission occurs via sandflies (phlebotomine) with dogs as the main urban reservoir; infection results from vector exposure, not direct dog–human contact. Prevention requires integrated actions: vector control, environmental management (clean yards, reduce organic matter), periodic veterinary oversight, and canine repellents; delt amethrin-impregnated collars are used in priority municipalities. Ourofino Pet’s Leevre collar targets Lutzomyia longipalpis and supports flea/tick control, per Brasileish guidance. No single measure suffices; routine, region-tailored prevention should be coordinated with a veterinarian to reduce disease burden and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア症は依然として公衆衛生上の問題である;原因と症状について
triage.triage_reason: 内容は既知の風土病に関する啓発・予防に関する一般的な公衆衛生記事であり、新規発生や異常な増加、国際的拡大リスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 報告は2015-2024年の統計データに基づく啓発記事で、新規症例数はむしろ減少傾向（69.7%減）にあり、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 本港錄一宗猴痘輸入個案 患者曾泰國高風險接觸｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records one imported case of monkeypox; the patient had high-risk exposure in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Hong Kong reports one imported monkeypox case in a 39-year-old man. Onset 12 August with sore throat, fever, and skin rashes on genitals, trunk, and limbs; he sought care 13 August at a private clinic and was admitted after 17 August at Ruttonjee Hospital. Public-health testing confirmed mpox; he is isolated at Princess Margaret Hospital and is stable. He had no prior vaccination and had high‑risk exposure in Thailand with a stranger male. There is no identified epidemiological link to a prior local case; contact tracing is ongoing and the WHO has been notified. Since 2022, Hong Kong has had 96 mpox cases (76 local, 20 imported), all male, with most reporting high‑risk sexual behavior. Vaccination for high‑risk groups is voluntary and available at DOH Social Hygiene Clinics, Kowloon Bay Integrated Treatment Centre, Yau Ma Tei Integrated Treatment Centre, and Queen Elizabeth Hospital and Princess Margaret Hospital special internal medicine clinics. Mpox is not generally transmitted by air; seek care for fever with rash and lymphadenopathy.

triage.headline_ja: 本港で猴痘（サル痘）輸入症例を1件確認、患者はタイで高リスク接触歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港での単発の輸入mpox症例であり、隔離済みで地域内伝播の証拠はないが、タイでの性的接触歴があり国境を越えた曝露リスクを示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 患者はタイで感染源となる可能性のある高リスク接触があったとされるが、発症・診断・隔離は香港（中国特別行政区）で行われており、タイでの発生確認記事ではないためタイは対象地域に含めない。香港では2022年以降96例（うち局所76例）の蓄積があり、性的接触を介した既知の流行パターンに合致する単発輸入例と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le bilan de l'épidémie d'Ebola continue de s'alourdir, atteignant 2 476 morts dans six provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The toll of the Ebola outbreak continues to rise, reaching 2,476 deaths in six provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,476 deaths and 5,208 confirmed cases across 56 health zones in six provinces: Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. As of August 18, 730 patients are in isolation or hospital care, and 1,115 have recovered. The case-fatality rate is 47.5%, with 84% of contacts tracked. Authorities are intensifying the response with ERVEBO vaccination and by bolstering epidemiologic surveillance and patient management in the affected zones. The ongoing outbreak underscores sustained transmission in eastern and northeastern DRC and the need for continued vaccination and surveillance to curb further deaths and cases.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行による死者数が拡大を続け、6州で2,476人に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に加え、致死率47.5%と高い重症度を伴う持続的な大規模流行であるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の継続的アウトブレイクであり新規発生ではないが、死者数・症例数の増加と6州にわたる拡大が続いており、ワクチン接種と監視体制の強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: São Julião promove ações de conscientização e formação no combate à Leishmaniose Visceral - Portal É Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Julião promotes awareness-raising and training activities in the fight against Visceral Leishmaniasis - Portal É Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Visceral Leishmaniasis awareness and training activities were conducted in São Julião by the Municipal Health Secretariat to prevent and combat visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar). On Tuesday, August 18, a Blitz Educativa against Leishmaniasis traversed the stretch from Praça do Matadouro to Cohab São José, delivering guidance on prevention and reducing transmission risk. A concurrent Training Course on Visceral Leishmaniasis gathered Community Health Agents (ACS), Endemic Control Agents (ACE), APASJU members, and professionals from Sanitary Surveillance and Epidemiology. The session was led by nurse Sodson Rocha, with veterinarian Pedro Ricardo participating. Actions are coordinated by Health Secretary Dra. Saara Jane, with support from Mayor Renaldinho and Vice-Mayor José Neci. The municipality emphasizes expanding knowledge and strengthening prevention and control through community involvement, encapsulated in the motto: Leishmaniasis: prevention is care.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ジュリアォン市、内臓リーシュマニア症対策として啓発・研修活動を実施
