article.articleHeadline: Congo vai receber 70 mil doses de vacina em surto de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo will receive 70,000 vaccine doses amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine to help contain the Ebola outbreak in the eastern part of the country, according to the WHO, announced today. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a Phase 3 clinical study evaluating the vaccine's effect against Bundibugyo virus, the strain causing the current outbreak. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo. The remaining 50,000 doses will be allocated to health-care workers and frontline responders, per WHO recommendations. Ervebo is licensed to protect against one Ebola virus species but is not approved for Bundibugyo. The distribution aims to bolster outbreak control and does not imply a fully protective solution for this Bundibugyo-driven transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱流行を受けてワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 現行株（ブンディブギョ）に対する承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、第3相臨床試験としてワクチン接種が実施される点が特筆される。WHOが対応主導しており国際的関与が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola OMS Qué Se Sabe Del Brote Y Cómo Protegerse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO — What Is Known About the Outbreak and How to Protect Yourself
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are being monitored by the World Health Organization. The article emphasizes that the key questions are how cases have been detected and contained, and what risks persist. Ebola is described as a severe viral disease causing fever, severe weakness, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding; transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with blood or other body fluids of an infected person or contaminated surfaces. Early detection is critical to isolate patients, protect health workers, and interrupt transmission; rapid diagnosis allows timely care and contact tracing. WHO responses include surveillance, laboratory confirmation, case management centers, and community engagement. The piece also notes broader health crises in eastern DRC (malaria, measles, cholera) and the importance of trust, clear communication, and maintaining essential services during outbreaks. No specific case or death counts are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO ― アウトブレイクについて分かっていること、身を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視するコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、重症・致死性の高い疾患であることに加え、麻疹・コレラ・マラリアなど複合的な公衆衛生危機が同時進行しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事には具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載がなく、感染規模や国際拡大リスクの評価には追加情報が必要。東部DRCではマラリア・麻疹・コレラも併発しており複合的な公衆衛生危機となっている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes terus masifkan CKG untuk skrining Tb di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health continues to massively scale up CKG for TB screening in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is massively scaling up the free health check program (CKG) for tuberculosis (TB) screening nationwide, starting with Tangerang, Banten. Last year Indonesia had an estimated 1.09 million TB cases, but only 867,000 (80%) were detected. The CKG expansion targets 90% detection by 2026 to accelerate identification and treatment and curb transmission. The program also promotes TB preventive therapy for close household contacts of TB patients. Nationally, the 2025 target for preventive therapy among household contacts was 72%, but regional uptake ranges from 0% in Papua Highlands to 61% in Banten, 46% in East Java, and 28% in Central Java; North Sulawesi and Aceh are at 1%. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus urged media outreach to increase participation in CKG to ensure TB cases are found and treated promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、インドネシアにおけるTBスクリーニングのためCKGの拡大を継続
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるTB対策プログラムの拡大に関する行政的な発表であり、新規性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: TBは既知の風土病であり、本記事は保健省によるスクリーニング事業（CKG）の拡大に関する通常の公衆衛生施策の報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ebola: Plus de 2.300 décès et près de 5.000 cas confirmés et 55 zones de santé dans six provinces touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ebola: More than 2,300 deaths and nearly 5,000 confirmed cases and 55 health zones in six affected provinces.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is battling its 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Official health authorities report 4,945 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths, with 1,040 recoveries, yielding a case-fatality rate around 47%. The outbreak covers 55 health zones across six provinces and was officially declared on May 15. If current trends persist, it is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date, surpassing the 2018–2020 East of the country outbreak, which had 2,299 deaths and 3,481 cases total (3,323 confirmed), and it surpasses the West Africa epidemic (2014–2016) which infected more than 28,600 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ:死者2,300人超、確定症例約5,000人、6州55保健地区で被害
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者2,300人超・確定症例約5,000人に達し、6州55保健地区に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に焦点を当てており、致死率約47%、史上最悪規模となる可能性が指摘されている。Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Escola suspende aulas após surto de catapora em alunos, em João Pessoa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School suspends classes after chickenpox outbreak among students in João Pessoa.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak leads to school closure in João Pessoa, Paraíba, Brazil, at Escola Integral Desembargador Boto de Menezes in the Treze de Maio district. Nine students contracted the disease, prompting suspension of classes by the Paraíba State Health Secretariat. Infectologist Fernando Chagas explains varicella is highly contagious and starts with flu-like symptoms (fever, runny nose) followed by skin lesions that crust over; vaccination sharply reduces incidence and the risk of severe illness. Immunization is given in children from 15 months with a booster at 4–6 years. The disease is usually milder in children but can be serious in adolescents and adults, with potential complications such as pneumonia or meningitis; transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and through active lesions until they crust. No laboratory confirmation details are provided; vaccination remains the key measure to interrupt transmission. As of 20 August 2026, authorities are monitoring the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘の集団発生を受け、ジョアン・ペソアの学校が休校
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一学校での水痘（水疱瘡）の小規模集団発生であり、既知の疾患で予防接種も確立しているため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 水痘は感染力が強くヒト-ヒト感染するが、ワクチンが存在し重症化は稀。地方自治体レベルの対応で完結しており、国際的な広がりや渡航制限のリスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não Nhật Bản có thể chuyển nặng sau vài ngày sốt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japanese encephalitis can worsen after a fever for a few days.
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis virus causes acute CNS infection in Vietnam, with 2–3 days of fever, headache and malaise, followed by seizures, altered consciousness, coma or respiratory failure. In August, a 9-year-old boy from Lao Cai presented with coma, respiratory failure and quadriparesis after two days of fever; a 7-month-old girl treated at Bach Mai Hospital required 24 days of intensive care for prolonged seizures. These cases show severe progression across ages. There is no specific antiviral; treatment is supportive. A 2017–2023 study of 360 hospitalized children at National Pediatric Hospital found 42.2% with long-term sequelae or death: 29 deaths; 41 severe, 56 moderate, 23 mild. Risk factors for lasting disability or death included ventilation, tracheostomy, and stays over two weeks. Vietnam’s Expanded Immunization Program uses JeVax (three-dose primary series with boosters); verify vaccine history at centers like VNVC; also emphasize mosquito bite prevention and elimination of standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎は発熱から数日で重症化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はベトナムで流行が定着している日本脳炎の重症化事例や過去の研究データを紹介する啓発・医療情報記事であり、新規の異常な発生や国際的拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はベトナムの既知の風土病であり、本記事は個別重症例の紹介と2017-2023年の研究データ、ワクチン接種の重要性を伝える教育的内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : 70.000 doses de vaccin Ervebo mises à disposition de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths—the deadliest Ebola surge in the country—with the Bundibugyo strain circulating. The World Health Organization announced the immediate deployment of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses from the global stock: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus and is unproven against Bundibugyo, though early lab and animal data hint at possible protection. The outbreak was declared on 15 May in northern and eastern regions, where state capacity is fragile and health infrastructure strained. The GIC, with UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and Gavi, facilitated vaccine supply. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials (Moderna mRNA, Oxford), and a promising rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories; Tedros warns the epidemic remains far from under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国にエルベボワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例5,105人・死亡2,420人という同国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、通常型と異なるブンディブギョ株が流行しており、国際的なワクチン供給・臨床試験が展開されている重大事案のため。
triage.notes: 既承認ワクチン(Ervebo/Zaire株対応)がBundibugyo株には未証明であり、国際機関(WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, Gavi)が対応中。WHO事務局長も流行制御には程遠いと警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS déploie 70 000 doses du vaccin Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO deploys 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine were announced by the World Health Organization to address an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The vaccine is licensed for the Zaire strain of Ebola, enabling deployment against this outbreak; however, it does not protect against the Bundibugyo strain mentioned in the outbreak context. The announcement was issued on Thursday, 20 August 2026. This strain-specific limitation informs the public health response in the DRC, underscoring the need for additional measures beyond Ervebo in case Bundibugyo is involved. No further details on case counts, fatalities, or laboratory confirmation are provided in the excerpt. The report centers on expanding vaccine availability to target the Zaire strain, with explicit caveats regarding Bundibugyo coverage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国でWHOがエルベボワクチン7万回分を展開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR即時通報対象疾患であり、WHOによるワクチン大規模展開が行われていることから公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事には症例数・死亡者数・株の確定情報が記載されていないため、詳細はフルRRAでの確認が必要。ブンディブギョ株の関与可能性についても要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : 70 000 doses de vaccin Ervebo allouées à la RDC | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine allocated to the DRC | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: On August 20, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO), with Africa CDC, allocated 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to strengthen the response to Bundibugyo virus disease. Of these, 50,000 doses are for health workers and frontline staff in line with WHO/SAGE recommendations; the remaining 20,000 will support a Phase 3 clinical trial to assess whether Ervebo can provide protection against Bundibugyo virus disease. Efficacy against Bundibugyo in humans is not yet established; early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. The DRC trial aims to generate new evidence to guide future vaccine-use decisions for Bundibugyo. WHO and Africa CDC also endorse the community-centered response adopted by the DRC. Since 2021, the global stockpile mechanism has allocated over 56,000 Ervebo doses to the DRC for Ebola outbreaks, coordinated by ICG.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：エルベボワクチン7万回分がDRCに配分
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ属）に対しWHO/Africa CDCがワクチン配分と臨床試験を実施しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルス病はエボラ属の一種で、ワクチン有効性は未確立。既存のアウトブレイク対応としてWHO/Africa CDCが介入している段階であり、感染拡大状況の詳細（国際拡大や渡航制限の有無）については記事内に情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: WHO extends Ebola alert as DRC outbreak death toll surpasses 2 300
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, WHO extends Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with more than 2,300 deaths and nearly 5,000 infections since mid‑May 2026 in north‑eastern DRC. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province including Bunia town and the Nyamurongo cemetery, has no approved vaccine or treatment. The death of Dr Tibenderana Katho Blaise at Centre Medical Evangelique in Hoho commune underscores frontline losses. Delayed detection, security challenges, and community mistrust are hampering containment. WHO calls for a coordinated international response and increased funding. The escalation signals ongoing transmission and marks this as the worst DRC Ebola outbreak since 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ流行拡大を受けて緊急事態宣言を延長、死者2,300人超え
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが延長され死者2,300人超・感染5,000人近くに達する大規模流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、国際的対応要請もありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを延長し国際的な資金・対応支援を要請していることから、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Конгу 70.000 вакцина против еболе, иако оне не делују на вирус који је изазвао епидемију
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 70,000 vaccines against Ebola, although they do not work on the virus that caused the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On August 20, 2026, Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, previously deployed to curb Ebola outbreaks. Ervebo is approved for Ebola virus (EBOV) but not for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO states that while it is not known if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo, early laboratory data and animal studies suggest a potential protective effect. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for a Phase 3 trial to determine efficacy against Bundibugyo, with the remaining 50,000 reserved for vaccination of health workers and frontline responders. In the ongoing Congo Ebola outbreak, 5,208 confirmed cases have been reported, resulting in 2,476 deaths. The arrangement aims to shield frontline personnel while advancing evaluation of cross-protection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラワクチン7万回分、流行を引き起こしたウイルスには効果がないにもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが5,208例・2,476死亡と深刻化しており、既存ワクチンの有効性が不確実な異常事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイクは既知だが、新株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチン有効性の不確実性という新たな側面があり、continuous monitoringおよびフルRRAが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲男子染猴痘　曾在泰國與陌生男子有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 39-year-old man contracted monkeypox after high-risk exposure to a stranger in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection is investigating an imported monkeypox case involving a 39-year-old man who had high-risk exposure to a stranger in Thailand during the incubation period. The patient developed widespread skin rashes last week, initially seeking care at a private clinic, then being treated at Ruttonjee Hospital's emergency department. He is currently isolated at Queen Mary Hospital; he has not received monkeypox vaccination. CHP says there is no current evidence of epidemiological linkage with previously reported local cases, and the investigation will include tracing high-risk contacts and notifying the World Health Organization. The case underscores ongoing monkeypox vigilance in Hong Kong following international exposure, with authorities monitoring for imported infections.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）に感染　タイで見知らぬ男性と高リスク接触歴
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発の輸入mpox症例で、他の地域症例との疫学的関連は現時点で確認されていない。深刻性や国際的拡大の兆候は乏しいが、続報（接触者調査結果やWHO通知の詳細）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者はタイで感染源とされる人物と接触した後に香港で発症・確定診断されたため、確定症例発生国は香港（Chinaとして分類）とした。タイは曝露地として言及されているのみで、当該国での症例発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo krijgt 70.000 vaccins tegen ebolavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo gets 70,000 vaccines against the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo receives 70,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine from the World Health Organization. The vaccine is proven effective against the more common Zaire (Zaïre) Ebola variant, but there is currently no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant circulating in the country, which has caused about 2,500 deaths. WHO data from laboratory and animal studies suggest some protection against Bundibugyovariant. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a study to assess the vaccine’s effects on Bundibugyovariant, while the remainder will be allocated to frontline health workers and caregivers. WHO anticipates that the study will provide important new evidence. Several Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are currently under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラウイルスワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo型エボラの流行により約2,500人の死亡が報告されており、既存ワクチンの有効性が不明な新規変異株が拡大している重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラに対する承認済みワクチンが存在しないため、WHOが臨床研究を実施予定。既に約2,500人の死亡が報告されており、重大な流行状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲男子確診猴痘 潛伏期在泰國與陌生男子有高風險接觸 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox; high-risk contact with a stranger man in Thailand during the incubation period - Hong Kong Commercial Daily.
article.articleSummary: Imported monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 39-year-old man developed sore throat, fever, and widespread rash (genital, trunk, and limbs) beginning August 12. He sought care August 13 and was hospitalized after August 17; exam and Public Health Laboratory Service testing confirmed monkeypox. He is isolated and stable at Princess Margaret Hospital. He had no vaccination and had high-risk contact with a stranger man in Thailand during the incubation period. No epidemiological link to prior HK cases yet; ongoing epidemiological investigation with contact tracing and WHO notification planned. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 96 monkeypox cases (76 local, 20 imported), all male, with most linked to high-risk sexual behavior. Monkeypox vaccination is available on a voluntary basis for high-risk groups, including those with high-risk sexual activity, healthcare workers, laboratory personnel handling orthopoxviruses, and animal-care staff during animal outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性がサル痘（Mpox）と確定診断、潜伏期間中にタイで見知らぬ男性と高リスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入例1件（安定・入院中）であり、2022年以降96例の既知の流行状況の延長線上にあるため新規性は低いが、性的接触による感染拡大の可能性があり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はタイでの高リスク接触が疑われるが、確定診断・入院は香港で行われており、感染発生国としてはタイではなく香港（中国）と判断した。クレードの種別は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Congo recibirá 70.000 dosis de la vacuna contra el ébola Ervebo, eficaz en brotes anteriores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo, effective in previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, a major boost amid the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record in the eastern DRC. Of the total, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo virus, while 50,000 doses will be used to protect frontline workers and healthcare personnel per World Health Organization guidance. Ervebo is licensed against Ebola virus (Zaire ebolavirus) but not Bundibugyo; preliminary lab/animal data hint at possible protection against Bundibugyo, though efficacy remains unconfirmed. The outbreak has caused 2,476 deaths among 5,208 laboratory-confirmed cases and is spreading about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Widespread transmission beyond monitored contacts highlights surveillance challenges and the urgent need for vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、以前の流行で有効性を示したエボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率が高く、監視外での感染拡大や新種（ブンディブギョ株）関連の懸念もあるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（ブニア）のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。致死率は約47.5%（2476/5208）と高く、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行より約3倍速い拡大速度が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes terus masifkan CKG untuk skrining Tb di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia's Ministry of Health continues to massively scale up CKG for TB screening.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is massively scaling up free health checkups (CKG) across districts to boost tuberculosis (TB) screening and shorten undetected cases. Last year Indonesia reported 1,090,000 TB cases, with only about 80% detected (867,000). The government aims to raise detected cases to 90% in 2026. This year includes an 'extraordinary' push to accelerate screening, so diagnosed patients can start treatment promptly and reduce transmission. In addition to case finding, authorities are pushing TB preventive therapy (TPT) for household contacts of TB patients, especially co-residents. National TPT target for 2025 was 72% of household contacts; performance varies: Banten 61%, East Java 46%, Central Java 28%, Papua Highlands 0%, North Sulawesi 1%, Aceh 1%. Remarks by Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus in Tangerang underscore media collaboration to raise CKG participation and TB case finding.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、結核スクリーニングのためCKG（無料健康診断）を大規模に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的な結核対策プログラムに関する政策報告であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態ではないため。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は政府の既存プログラム（CKGスクリーニング拡大、TPT推進）の進捗報告。緊急のシグナルではないがサーベイランス強化の文脈として参考情報。

article.articleHeadline: Nam bệnh nhân nguy kịch vì COVID-19, hồi phục sau gần 30 ngày điều trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A male patient in critical condition due to COVID-19 recovered after nearly 30 days of treatment.
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old man (D.V.N.) in Vietnam developed severe COVID-19 with pneumonia, progressing to septic shock and multi-organ failure due to ARDS. After initial outpatient treatment failing, he tested positive on July 20 and was admitted to 19-8 Police Hospital. He required invasive mechanical ventilation, prone positioning, vasopressors, antibiotics, corticosteroids, and anticoagulation, with continuous renal replacement therapy. An aggressive multidisciplinary approach included dual cytokine adsorption with CRRT within 72 hours and contingency plans for venovenous ECMO if needed, alongside antiviral therapy and comprehensive supportive care. After nearly 30 days in ICU, his lung and organ functions recovered sufficiently to wean from ventilation, and he was discharged on August 19, 2026. The report notes COVID-19 remains capable of severe disease; isolation policies have shifted toward sustainable management, but early diagnosis and close monitoring are still crucial.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19で重篤化した男性患者、約30日間の治療の末に回復
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の治療経過を報じる記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 個別患者の重症例報告であり、集団発生や新たな変異株、感染拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam ghi nhận ca mắc giun rồng thứ 44: Người đàn ông phát hiện con giun dài hơn 20 cm chui ra từ cánh tay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam records its 44th case of Guinea worm disease: A man discovered a worm longer than 20 cm emerging from his arm.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (Dracunculus medinensis) case in Vietnam: A 1977-born man from Mậu A commune, Lào Cai Province, was diagnosed with the 44th Vietnamese case since 2020. On Aug 19, 2026, at Dang Van Ngu Hospital, he presented with two lesions on the left forearm and swelling; family members had removed a worm longer than 20 cm, though it broke. Ultrasound showed subcutaneous thickening (6–8 mm) in the left forearm; no fever, itching, or pain at presentation. Diagnosis typically occurs when the worm emerges, as there is no pre-emergence test, and there is no specific drug; treatment is complete worm extraction with careful handling to prevent infection and environmental spread. Prevention stresses keeping wounds dry, avoiding water contact, and boiling drinking water. Most Vietnamese cases are in the northern mountains: Lao Cai (26), Phú Thọ (14), Thanh Hóa (3), with men predominating.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでギニア虫症の44例目を確認：男性の腕から20cm超の虫が出現
triage.triage_reason: WHO根絶計画対象の希少疾患（ギニア虫症）の症例で、ベトナムでの発生自体は異例だが、2020年以降の累積44例目という定常的な症例報告であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や国際的拡大の兆候は確認できない。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症はWHOの根絶対象疾患であり、ベトナムでは2020年以降累計44例（うちLao Cai省26例、Phú Thọ省14例等）が報告されている。人-人感染はなく水系媒介（ケンミジンコ）による感染のため、急速な拡大リスクは低いが、根絶計画の観点から継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Congo recibirá 70.000 dosis de la vacuna contra el ébola Ervebo, eficaz en brotes anteriores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo, which has proven effective in previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo. The shipment to Bunia was announced by the World Health Organization and partners, described as a major boost to efforts to contain what authorities call the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. Ervebo has proven effective in previous Ebola outbreaks, supporting containment efforts in affected regions. The announcement signals continued international support as the response progresses; the brief report provides no additional details on case counts, transmission specifics, or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、過去の流行で有効性が確認されたエボラワクチン「Ervebo」7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で「史上最速の拡大」と報じられており、国際機関からのワクチン大量供給が行われるなど公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: 記事は簡潔でケース数や感染経路等の詳細情報はないが、『史上最速拡大』という表現やWHOによる大規模ワクチン供給の報道は重大なシグナルと判断される。フルRRAでの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Hit DR Congo Gets 70,000 Doses Of Ervebo Vaccine: WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers, in line with WHO guidance. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire Ebola strain; no vaccine is approved for Bundibugyo. The release follows a DRC government request as the 17th outbreak, declared May 15, has spread for weeks and surpassed 5,000 cases and 2,300 deaths. Affected regions include parts of the north and east where state presence is weak and health infrastructure limited. WHO notes the allocation supports trials and limited use per SAGE recommendations. Early animal data suggests some cross-protection against Bundibugyo, but there is no specific treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行のコンゴ民主共和国、WHOからエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が5,000症例・2,300人以上の死者に達し、承認ワクチンのない新規株への対応としてWHO支援下でワクチン配布が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は承認ワクチンがなく、エルベボ（ザイール株用）の交差防御を検証する第3相試験が実施される点が異常性の根拠。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報は記事内に明記されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo će dobiti 70.000 vakcina protiv ebole, iako one ne deluju na virus koji je izazvao epidemiju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo to receive 70,000 Ebola vaccines, though they do not act against the virus that caused the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccines (Ervebo). Ervebo is approved against Ebola virus but not against Bundibugyo virus, which drives the current outbreak. WHO notes that it is unknown whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo, but early lab and animal data suggest possible protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for a Phase 3 trial to determine efficacy against Bundibugyo; the remaining 50,000 doses will vaccinate health workers and frontline responders per WHO guidance. In the ongoing Congo Ebola outbreak, 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths have been reported to date. The initiative aims to support outbreak response while awaiting clearer evidence of vaccine effectiveness against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラワクチン7万回分を受け取るも、現在の流行を引き起こしたウイルスには効果がない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例5,208例・死亡2,476例に達する進行中のエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）流行であり、既存ワクチンの有効性が不明な点も含め公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため。
triage.notes: 致死率が約47.5%と非常に高く、ワクチン（Ervebo）が原因ウイルス（Bundibugyo species）に対して有効かどうか未確認のため、第3相試験が並行実施される。既存の大規模アウトブレイクとして継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den KDC'ye 70 Bin Doz Ebola Aşısı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses from WHO to the DRC
article.articleSummary: 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses are being sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) by the World Health Organization via the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision. Of these, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 study to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 doses will be allocated to frontline workers per SAGE recommendations. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola caused by Zaire ebolavirus and is recommended for outbreaks; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus is unknown, though early lab and animal data suggest some protection. The Ituri province outbreak involved 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths and was declared on May 15. There are no approved treatments or vaccines specific for Bundibugyo virus. WHO Director-General Tedros underscored global solidarity and pledged strengthened surveillance, rapid detection, quality care, community engagement, and vaccination in collaboration with Africa CDC and national authorities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOからコンゴ民主共和国へエボラワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイク（疑い症例246例、死亡65例）が発生しており、WHOが緊急ワクチン供給を行うなど国際的対応が進行中であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 対象のエボラウイルス種はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスであり、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性は未確認。第3相試験としての位置付けも含まれており、国際的な支援・監視体制の強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО праща 70 000 ваксини срещу ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sends 70,000 Ebola vaccines to DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to protect frontline workers and to test efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in a phase 3 trial. Of the total, 20,000 doses are for the trial to determine protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses will be allocated to frontline healthcare workers per current guidelines. It remains uncertain whether Ervebo provides protection against Bundibugyo in humans; early animal data suggest possible protection. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, and the DR Congo trial will provide data on future use. WHO has labeled regional risk as high; on May 17, Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda were declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Latest counts: over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRコンゴにエボラワクチン7万回分を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が既に宣言されており、5000例超・2300人超の死者が報告されているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRコンゴでのワクチン供給であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。すでにPHEICが宣言済みの重大イベントであり、既存の対応状況を含めたフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Über 2400 Tote im Kongo: WHO schickt Impfstoff - doch ob er gegen dieses Ebola-Virus wirkt, ist unklar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,400 deaths in the Congo: WHO sends vaccine — but whether it will work against this Ebola virus is unclear.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) has dispatched 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to Congo to help contain the current outbreak. Ervebo has proven effective in past Ebola outbreaks but is not licensed against Bundibugyo virus, which is responsible for this outbreak; it is unclear whether it will protect against the Bundibugyo variant. The Congo outbreak has surpassed 2,400 deaths and over 5,200 infections as of mid-May when officially announced. WHO plans to allocate 20,000 doses for a clinical study to assess effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus; early laboratory and animal data hint at some protection, and the study is expected to yield important insights for future deployment decisions. The remaining doses are intended for frontline workers and healthcare staff in direct contact with patients.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで2400人以上死亡：WHOがワクチンを送付ーだがこのエボラウイルス株に効果があるかは不明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで死者2,400人超・感染5,200人超という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、既存ワクチンの有効性が不明という異常性・公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的対応（WHOによるワクチン配布）が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株によるもので、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性が未確認である点が特筆される。致死率・規模ともに大きく、WHOが介入している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'OMS annonce l'envoi de 70 000 doses du vaccin Ervebo face à l'épidémie d'Ebola, alors que le bilan s'alourdit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO announces shipment of 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine in response to the Ebola outbreak, as the death toll rises.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus with 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths across six provinces (Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo) and 56 health zones. As of August 18, 2026, 730 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,115 have recovered. The World Health Organization announces shipment of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses from the global stock: 20,000 for a phase 3 trial evaluating efficacy against Bundibugyo virus, and 50,000 for frontline health workers and professionals per SAGE recommendations. Ervebo is approved and recommended against Ebola virus disease, and its use against Bundibugyro will proceed within the announced clinical trial. The response accompanies ongoing outbreak management in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:世界保健機関(WHO)がエボラ流行拡大を受けエルベボワクチン7万回分の配送を発表、死者数は増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行が5,208例・死者2,476人に達し6州56保健区に拡大、WHOが緊急ワクチン投入を発表するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的関心が高い事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約47.5%と非常に高く、6州56保健区に拡大している大規模アウトブレイク。WHOによるワクチン配布（第3相試験含む）が進行中で、フルRRAによる継続評価が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta na Zona da Mata: Febre Maculosa é Diagnosticada em Ponte Nova
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Zona da Mata: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever Diagnosed in Ponte Nova.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever diagnosed in Ponte Nova, Zona da Mata, Minas Gerais, Brazil. On 19 August 2026, Ponte Nova authorities confirmed one case in a 69-year-old man who fishes in a rural area. The patient was hospitalized at Hospital Nossa Senhora das Dores and discharged after clinical improvement. Ponte Nova is described as an endemic area for tick-borne disease and signage warns of tick infestation. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, myalgias, and weakness; rash may occur. Transmission occurs via bite from infected ticks in rural, grassy, or animal-present areas. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment are crucial to reduce severe complications and death. Preventive measures include tick checks, repellents (icaridin), light-colored clothing, long sleeves, closed footwear, and vegetation management; animals may carry ticks and require veterinary measures.

triage.headline_ja: マタの森地帯で警戒:ポンテノーバでロッキー山紅斑熱が診断される
triage.triage_reason: 単発の既知の風土病症例で、患者は回復・退院しており、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国はBrazilだが、この記事はブラジル国内で発生した既知の風土病（マダニ媒介性）の単発症例報告であり、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Marataízes entra em alerta após confirmar mais de 50 casos de catapora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marataízes goes on alert after confirming more than 50 cases of chickenpox.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak in Marataízes, Espírito Santo, Brazil, with 55 confirmed cases as of Aug 15, 2026, per the Municipal Health Department (Semus) epidemiological bulletin released Aug 19. Two suspected cases under investigation and five ruled out. No severe cases reported. Infections identified across 13 schools and daycare centers. The municipality published a contingency plan for varicella on Aug 8, the only municipality in Espírito Santo to adopt a disease-specific plan. Semus epidemiological surveillance issued technical guidance for schools, with related outbreak documentation. State Health Secretariat (Sesa) conducted technical visits. Health and Education secretariats (Semus and Semed) collaborate to monitor cases and enforce control measures per MoH and WHO varicella protocols. Semus will maintain epidemiological monitoring and update as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: マラタイゼス市、水痘50例以上確認で警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症で重症例なし。国際的拡大リスクや異常性も認められず、地域の公衆衛生対応で管理可能な事例。
triage.notes: 自治体レベルで独自の対応計画を策定し監視を継続しているが、重症例なく規模も限定的なブラジル国内の水痘集団発生。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak gains momentum in DR Congo | CNBC Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 5,021 reported cases with 2,378 deaths, as the outbreak gains momentum. The World Health Organization projects the outbreak could be brought under control within about three months if required resources and public health measures are made available. The report underscores the need for sustained funding, case management, contact tracing, and safe burials to curb transmission. Separately, health ministers and senior officials from the WHO African Region's 47 Member States will convene in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, for the 76th Session of the WHO Regional Committee for Africa, highlighting regional coordination. Dr. Francis Ohanyido, Director General of the West African Institute of Public Health, joins CNBC Africa to discuss the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大の勢いを見せる | CNBC Africa
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数5,021人、死者2,378人に達し流行が拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にエチオピア（WHOアフリカ地域委員会開催地）とアンゴラが含まれるが、記事の主題である感染発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみであり、両国は対象国リスト外または主題ではないため除外した。致死率が約47%と極めて高く、資金・封じ込め策の緊急性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتلقى 70 ألف جرعة لقاح لمواجهة أسرع تفشٍ لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo receives 70,000 vaccine doses to combat the fastest Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization and partners announced Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to help curb the fast-moving outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The vaccine is licensed to combat Ebola virus but is not approved against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which is responsible for the current outbreak; preliminary laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a phase 3 trial to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while the remaining 50,000 will go to frontline health workers per expert recommendations. The eastern DRC outbreak has killed 2,476 people out of 5,208 confirmed cases. Responders face challenges due to rapid spread and shortages of vaccines and approved treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Most new cases occur outside people under surveillance, hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、最速のエボラ流行に対応するためワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で急速に拡大するエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が5,208例・死亡2,476人に達しており、既存ワクチンの効果も限定的で国際支援（WHO主導のワクチン供給）が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 現在の流行はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるもので、既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)は本来ザイール株用であり有効性未確立。サーベイランス外での新規感染が多く封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: قيود جديدة للحد من انتشار ''إيبولا'' في مناطق المتمردين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: New restrictions to curb the spread of Ebola in rebel-held areas.
article.articleSummary: Two travelers from Lubero in government-controlled territory were confirmed to have Ebola after arriving in a village controlled by the M23 alliance in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting new movement restrictions to curb spread. As of 2026-08-20, the outbreak persists with more than 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide. The Congo River Alliance, which includes the M23 rebels, announced a one-month suspension of shared taxis on the Goma–Kirumba road, and of passenger boats on certain routes on Lake Edward; buses on the Goma–Kirumba corridor will continue with health screening, and cargo trucks remain allowed. The measure follows the confirmed infections of two travelers from Lubero and illustrates the rebel group’s capacity to manage Ebola in areas under its control. The conflict with government forces continues as officials highlight Ebola’s rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：反政府勢力支配地域でのエボラ拡散を抑制するための新たな移動制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,000例超のエボラ確定例が継続し、紛争地域（M23支配地域）への拡大と、それに伴う移動制限措置が実施されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的・国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにAustralia（South Australia等）が含まれているが、記事本文では言及がなく誤付与と判断し除外した。エボラは致死率が高くヒト-ヒト感染するため、紛争地域での医療アクセス制限は流行拡大リスクを高める重大な要因。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie Ebola En RDC : 70000 Doses De Vaccin Ervebo Mobilisées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine mobilized.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine are mobilized to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a 17th outbreak. The outbreak has 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, making it the deadliest in the DRC. Declared May 15, it is concentrated in the north and east, where health systems are fragile. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are for a Phase 3 trial to test Ervebo’s efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 will protect frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed only for the Zaïre strain; efficacy against Bundibugyo in humans is not known, though lab and animal data hint at possible cross-protection. The trial, approved by the WHO on August 7, will occur in DRC. The vaccine stock is managed by the International Coordination Group on Vaccine Provision. Additional Bundibugyo vaccines in trials include Moderna and Oxford candidates, with rVSV Bundibugyo highlighted as promising by WHO. Logistical challenges on deployment are significant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：エルベボワクチン7万回分が動員
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（確定5,105例、死亡2,420例）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とWHO主導の国際ワクチン治験・支援体制が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本流行はDRC史上最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、WHO承認の第3相試験（Bundibugyo株対応）が進行中。国際的なワクチン供給調整（ICG）が行われており、地域の医療体制の脆弱性も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : plus de 5 000 cas et 2 370 décès en trois mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: more than 5,000 cases and 2,370 deaths in three months.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri epicenter, 85–90% of cases; Nord-Kivu second; additional cases in Tshopo, Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uele). Declared three months ago; by 19–20 August 2026, more than 5,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 2,370 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a strain different from Ebola Zaïre; it spreads rapidly but causes fewer hemorrhagic symptoms. Early presentations are non-specific—headache, fever, abdominal pain—progressing to diarrhea and vomiting; hemorrhages occur in less than 10% of cases, potentially facilitating community transmission as patients stay at home. The public health response expanded from zero laboratories to about 20 and from zero beds to roughly 1,600. Ituri remains the epicenter, with 55 health zones affected; about 8% of health zones (roughly 10,000-person catchment areas) are impacted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行：3か月で5,000人以上の症例と2,370人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: 3か月間で5,000例以上・死亡2,370人という大規模な致死的アウトブレイクであり、複数州に拡大し公衆衛生対応が大幅に拡充されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルス株による出血症状が少ないタイプのため、患者が自宅に留まりやすく地域内伝播を助長している点に注意。イツリ州が震源地で55の保健地域に影響、検査施設・病床が大幅増強されている。

article.articleHeadline: L'epidemia più letale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Deadliest Epidemic
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its deadliest Ebola outbreak, with more than 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,300 deaths, and an ongoing risk of international spread. UNICEF reported on August 2 that at least 743 infections and 330 child deaths have occurred among minors. Fear of contagion and disruption to health services have reduced care-seeking and vaccination, weakening the outbreak response. Analysts describe it as the 'second front' of the epidemic, noting that 'Ebola has emptied clinics' as ambulatory services collapse. The situation underscores a severe burden within DR Congo and the persistent threat of cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 最も致死的な流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模となるエボラ流行が発生し、5,000人超の症例・2,300人超の死亡、医療体制の崩壊、国際拡散リスクが報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行で、医療インフラ崩壊・子供の死亡例増加・国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが強調されている。UNICEF等国際機関の関与も確認され、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: ذكرى اكتشاف انتقال الملاريا وتحديات القضاء على المرض 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anniversary of the discovery of malaria transmission and the challenges of eradicating the disease, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Aug 20, 2026 marks the 129th anniversary of Ronald Ross’s discovery that Anopheles mosquitoes transmit malaria, based on his 1897 microscopy work in India; Italian scientists later confirmed the Anopheles genus as the malaria vector. Despite this breakthrough, malaria remains a major burden: in 2024 about 282 million infections and roughly 610,000 deaths worldwide. Africa bears the majority, with 94% of cases and 95% of deaths, and children under five account for about three-quarters of African malaria fatalities. Eradication faces rising insecticide resistance, with pyrethroid resistance reported in 48 countries, and partial resistance to artemisinin-based therapies. Control relies on treated nets and rapid diagnosis with timely treatment; ongoing conflict, displacement, and limited access in remote areas hinder prevention and sustain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア感染発見記念日と2026年の撲滅への課題
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア発見129周年を記念した歴史的・総説的な内容であり、特定の国での新規発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的記念日とグローバルなマラリア統計・課題に関する総説記事であり、インドやアフリカ特定国での新規発生事例を報告するものではないため、対象国のverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sensor detecta contaminação alimentar em menos de um minuto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sensor detects food contamination in less than a minute.
article.articleSummary: READ (Rapid Electroanalytical Device), a portable sensor from University of Texas researchers, detects food contamination in under a minute. The device mixes a small food sample with water, applies drops to the sensor, enabling simultaneous identification of multiple contaminants, with results shown via a smartphone app. Led by Bianca and Kondam, the project spans over four years and targets preventing foodborne illness amid rising outbreaks. In Brazil, Ministry of Health data show nearly 6,900 outbreaks related to water and food from 2014–2023, with pathogens such as norovirus, rotavirus, Salmonella, and Escherichia coli, and concerns about residual pesticides. The system is currently experimental in the United States; next steps include securing commercial partners for large-scale production. If scaled, it could provide rapid, consumer-facing screening for foods like salads, enhancing public health responses to contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 1分以内に食品汚染を検知するセンサー
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、米国で開発中の食品汚染検知技術に関する紹介記事であり、実際の発生イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事は技術紹介が主題であり、ブラジルの過去統計データ（2014-2023年の食品・水関連アウトブレイク）は背景情報として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生イベントではない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून सीजन में बढ़ा डेंगू का खतरा, कूलर, गमले, टूटे बर्तन, टायर में पानी जमा ना होने दें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk has increased during the monsoon season; do not let water accumulate in coolers, flower pots, broken utensils, and tires.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk increases during the monsoon as mosquitoes breed in standing clean water. Dengue is not transmitted by touch. Prevent transmission by eliminating water accumulation around the home—in coolers, potted plants, broken utensils, and tires; completely drain cooler water at least weekly; keep water tanks and vessels covered. To prevent bites, wear full-sleeve clothing and use mosquito nets while sleeping day and night. If early symptoms appear—high fever, headache, or severe joint pain—seek immediate medical care and avoid self-medicating. Maintain hydration to prevent dehydration and continue household mosquito control. The article stresses that prevention, not drugs, is the best vaccine, with guidance from Dr. Aditya Parihar, MD Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期にデング熱リスク増加、クーラー・鉢植え・割れた容器・タイヤに水を溜めないように
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増、社会的関心の高まりは確認されない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や地域の発生状況の報告がなく、一般的な健康啓発記事であるため対象国発生としてもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's M23 rebels introduce new movement restrictions over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Movement restrictions imposed by Congo's M23 rebels over Ebola concerns as of August 20, 2026. Two travellers from the government-held town of Lubero tested positive for Ebola in a village under M23 control, prompting new controls on travel. Taxi-buses on the Goma-Kirumba road will be allowed subject to health and safety checks, as will trucks carrying goods. The measures underscore the challenge of responding to what health officials call the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record amid ongoing clashes with the Rwanda-backed rebel group. The AFC/M23 controls large parts of North and South Kivu after their early-2025 advance, including Goma and Bukavu. The UN and Western governments say the group is backed by Rwanda, a charge Kigali denies. Rebels have used the outbreak to showcase their administration, declaring territories under their control Ebola-free in late June. Congo’s government data this week reported Ebola confirmed cases exceeding 5,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのM23反乱軍、エボラ懸念で新たな移動制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例5,000人超、史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が紛争地域で継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北・南キブ州でのエボラ流行とM23反乱軍による移動制限を主題としている。ルワンダは反乱軍への関与疑惑の文脈で言及されているのみで、エボラ発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Taubaté tem cobertura contra sarampo abaixo da meta enquanto São Paulo enfrenta avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Taubaté has measles vaccination coverage below target while São Paulo faces a surge in measles
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil, reports measles vaccination coverage below targets: first dose 86.69% and second dose 71.22% for the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine, versus a 95% goal. To reach the second-dose target, Taubaté would need a 23.78-point increase (8.31 for the first dose). The state records 23 confirmed measles cases in 2026 as of Aug 7—20 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos; two imported cases; 16 of 23 unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Most cases involve babies under 1 year and adults 20–50. In Vale do Paraíba, regional coverage is 85.72% first dose and 71.07% second; São José dos Campos 83.19%/70.27%; Jacareí 84.79%/68.30%. Due to transmission risks, the Ministry expanded vaccination for 6 months–59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, with dose zero for 6–11 months, as part of the Multivacination campaign (Aug 3–Sep 1). Taubaté remains measles-free but under-vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: T7News | タウバテ市の麻疹ワクチン接種率が目標を下回る中、サンパウロ州では麻疹が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定国であるブラジルで麻疹症例が再興し、ワクチン接種率低下と未接種者中心の感染拡大が確認されており、保健省が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど行政の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 麻疹排除認定国であったブラジルでの症例再興という点で公衆衛生上重要。輸入症例2件を含み、未接種・不完全接種者が多数を占める。重症度（死亡等）に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Ho Chi Minh City culls nearly 7,400 animals amid disease outbreaks, rabies vaccination at only 42%
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City culled 7,393 animals, weighing more than 329 metric tons, due to disease outbreaks since January 2026. Rabies vaccination coverage is 42.1% (132,028 of 313,591 dogs and cats) as of July 30, 2026. The city reported 16 outbreaks at 18 livestock farms/households across 13 communes/wards: African swine fever caused 12 outbreaks at 14 farms/households in nine communes/wards; three rabies outbreaks at three farms/households in three communes/wards; and one lumpy skin disease outbreak at a livestock household. Government Decree 204/2026/ND-CP (effective Aug 1) imposes fines of 1–2 million VND for failing to vaccinate dogs or for letting dogs into public places without control. Authorities are expanding vaccination campaigns, coordinated inspections, and public awareness to curb outbreaks, with emphasis on end-year periods of increased transport, trade, and consumption of animal products and improved source-level enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、疾病流行により約7,400頭の動物を殺処分、狂犬病ワクチン接種率はわずか42%
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱・狂犬病・ランピースキン病など動物疾病の通常の発生報告であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 動物疾病（家畜・ペット）に関する行政対応の記事であり、ヒトの感染症アウトブレイクではない。狂犬病は人獣共通感染症だが、本記事はワクチン接種率と行政の取り組みに焦点を当てている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases, outpaces response efforts at unprecedented speed
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 cases, including 2,378 deaths, according to government data as of Sunday. The outbreak is spreading at unprecedented speed, outpacing response efforts in some of the nation’s remotest regions. Responders warn that insecurity, displacement and large-scale population movements are driving transmission and making containment exceptionally difficult. The data indicate this outbreak is infecting and killing more people at a greater rate than any previous Ebola outbreak in history, underscoring the extraordinary challenges faced in remote areas. The data were released as the outbreak continues to intensify in the Congo’s most challenging landscapes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、5,000症例に到達し前例のない速さで対応能力を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速のペースで拡大し、5,021症例・2,378人死亡と極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47%と非常に高く、治安不安・住民移動が感染拡大を助長していると報告されている。国際的な支援体制の強化が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Masifkan Cek Kesehatan Gratis untuk Skrining Tb di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health scales up free health checks for TB screening in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, Indonesia's Ministry of Health is intensifying the Free Health Check (CKG) program to expand tuberculosis (TB) screening nationwide, starting from Jakarta. 2025 TB estimates show about 1.09 million cases in Indonesia, with only about 867,000 detected—roughly 80%. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus warned that TB remains under-detected and underscored the need to close the gap. The government is targeting 90% case finding in 2026, describing the current push as extraordinary. The expanded CKG effort aims to accelerate identification and treatment initiation, reduce the hidden TB burden, and strengthen TB control by broadening access to free health assessments across regions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、インドネシアでの結核スクリーニングのため無料健康診断を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策として政府が既存の検診プログラムを拡大するという通常の公衆衛生施策であり、異常な発生や急激な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地域流行疾患であり、本記事は検診拡大という政策発表であるため新規シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : allocation de 70 000 doses de vaccin Ervebo pour faire face à l'épidémie meurtrière en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine allocated to tackle the deadly outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Seventy thousand Ervebo doses (Merck) have been allocated to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Of these, 20,000 are designated for a Phase 3 trial to assess impact against the Bundibugyo strain, with 50,000 for frontline health workers in the DRC. The outbreak, declared May 15, marks the 17th Ebola episode in the country, spreading in northern and eastern regions amid fragile state capacity and strained health systems; WHO reports 2,420 deaths among 5,105 confirmed cases, the deadliest Ebola surge in the DRC to date. DRC requested vaccines from the Global Coordinating Group stockpile (WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF) with Gavi support; 70,000 doses were made immediately available. Experts remain uncertain whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo in humans, though early lab/animal data suggest possible protection. The trial will be conducted in the DRC, the only country where Bundibugyo circulates. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials (Moderna mRNA and Oxford); an rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories is cited as most promising by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国での致死的アウトブレイクに対応するためErveboワクチン7万回分を割り当て
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、DRCで史上最多の死者数を記録するエボラ流行が継続中であり、WHO主導の国際対応が行われている。
triage.notes: DRCで史上最悪のエボラ流行(Bundibugyo株、5,105症例中2,420死亡)。WHO/UNICEF/IFRC/MSF/Gaviによる国際的なワクチン供給・臨床試験支援が進行中。既に大規模な国際対応が発動されている段階であり、フルRRAでの継続的評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite: JP tem 58 casos suspeitos; saiba como reconhecer sintomas e prevenir transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis: JP has 58 suspected cases; learn how to recognize symptoms and prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: 58 suspected meningitis cases among João Pessoa residents in 2026, with 13 confirmed and 4 deaths. Of the confirmed, 2 meningococcal meningitis, 1 Haemophilus influenzae, 2 other bacteria, 2 other etiologies, and 6 unspecified meningitis. Age distribution: <1 year (2); 1–9 years (2); 10–19 years (2); 20–49 years (3); ≥60 years (4). Deaths occurred in the 10–19, 20–49, and ≥60 groups; none under 10 among confirmed. Authorities say there is no meningitis outbreak in João Pessoa. In a school case, routine schooling is maintained. Transmission varies by agent; via close contact/droplets, contaminated objects, or fecal-oral routes. Prevention includes handwashing, not sharing personal items, and good ventilation. Vaccination is available through the public system: BCG, pentavalent, pneumococcal, meningococcal C and ACWY. Check vaccination status at health units, polyclinics, or mobile vaccination sites. Seek care at the Family Health Unit for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎:ジョアン・ペソア市で疑い例58件、症状の見分け方と感染予防法
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎の疑い例・死亡例が報告されているが、当局はアウトブレイクを否定しており、複数の病原体が混在するため単一の感染症イベントとしての急拡大リスクは低いが、死亡例もあり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 確定13例のうち髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は2例のみで、他はインフルエンザ菌や不明病原体を含む混合事例。当局はアウトブレイクを否定しており、学校でも通常授業継続。国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo recibirá 70,000 dosis de la vacuna Ervebo ante brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine as part of the response to an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, described by authorities as the fastest outbreak in Ebola history. The World Health Organization and partners announced the shipment, seen as a major boost to containment efforts. Ervebo is approved for use against Ebola virus disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus but not against Bundibugyo virus—the lineage responsible for the current outbreak. Preliminary data suggest the vaccine could offer some protection against this variant, even though it is not authorized for it. The deployment of doses to the DRC aims to enhance ring vaccination and outbreak control measures amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ発生を受けエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が「史上最速の発生」と報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 原因ウイルスはBundibugyoエボラウイルスであり、Ervebo（Zaire株用ワクチン）は未承認だが予備データで一定の防御効果が示唆されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarampo reforça necessidade de investir em saúde antes da doença | Claudio Lottenberg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak reinforces the need to invest in health before the disease | Claudio Lottenberg
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Brazil in 2026 prompts emphasis on preventive health investment. Brazil still holds certification of elimination of endemic measles circulation, with reported activity in São Paulo, including the capital and municipalities such as Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo. The Health Ministry recommends intensified vaccination for people between 6 months and 59 years in municipalities with active outbreaks. Declining vaccination coverage, the antivaccine movement, misinformation, political polarization, social vulnerability, regional inequalities, and access/logistics challenges help explain the resurgence. The piece argues for stronger primary health care as the entry point for prevention, early detection, and care, noting that avoided hospitalizations and prevented complications are key efficiency measures. It highlights risk communication and permanent prevention as core lessons and urges investing where impact is greatest to keep people healthy.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の流行は病気になる前の健康への投資の必要性を強調する｜クラウディオ・ロッテンベルグ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定を保持していたブラジルのサンパウロ州で麻疹の活動的な流行が報告され、保健省がワクチン接種強化を推奨するなど、公衆衛生上異常な事態として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は主に医療投資の必要性を論じるオピニオン記事だが、サンパウロ州（州都・グアルーリョス・サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ等）における麻疹流行の実態と、ワクチン接種率低下・反ワクチン運動等の背景要因が報告されており、フルリスク評価での確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 'ஓ' வகை ரத்தம் உள்ளவர்களை அதிகம் கடிக்கும்: கொசு ஆய்வுகளில் உறுதி என தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People with Type O blood are bitten more often: confirmed in mosquito studies.
article.articleSummary: Madurai observes World Mosquito Day on August 20 to honor Sir Ronald Ross’s 1897 discovery that mosquitoes transmit malaria. The health department uses the day to raise awareness about malaria, dengue, and chikungunya and to promote mosquito elimination and preventive measures. Assistant Professor M. Rajesh of the Zoology Department at Madurai American College notes there are over 3,000 mosquito species worldwide, most of which do not bite humans; many feed on birds, bats, and other animals, underscoring their ecological role. The article highlights ongoing public-health actions to control vectors and educate residents about prevention, situating these efforts within Madurai and broader India’s efforts against vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: O型の血液を持つ人はより多く刺される：蚊の研究で確認との情報
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊デーに関する啓発・教育記事であり、具体的な感染症の発生や症例急増を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界蚊デー（World Mosquito Day）に関連した予防啓発・教育目的の内容であり、マラリア・デング・チクングニアの実際の発生報告ではないため対象国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC receberá 70.000 doses da vacina Ervebo contra o ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC to receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization allocates 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): 20,000 reserved for a Phase 3 trial to assess impact against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 for frontline workers and health professionals. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus strain; Bundibugyo strain circulating in the DRC is not covered by this vaccine. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15 in northern and eastern regions, where state presence is weak, health infrastructure is precarious, and the response is overwhelmed by rising cases. The outbreak has caused 2,420 deaths out of 5,105 confirmed cases, according to WHO, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date, with unprecedented speed of spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（症例5,105・死亡2,420）のエボラ流行が進行中で、既存ワクチンが対応しない変異株（ブンディブギョ株）が流行しており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既存承認ワクチンがザイール株用であり、現流行の主因であるブンディブギョ株には非対応（20,000回分は第3相試験用）。国家統治の弱い地域での流行拡大により対応能力が限界に達している。

article.articleHeadline: Mataram segera melaksanakan vaksinasi anjing semi-liar antisipasi rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mataram to immediately carry out vaccination of semi-feral dogs to prevent rabies.
article.articleSummary: Mataram City, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, will vaccinate semi-feral dogs to prevent rabies transmission to humans. The program, led by the City Agriculture Service, starts August 26, 2026, in four kelurahan—Cakra Timur, Cilinaya, Taliwang, and Mataram Barat—with a target of 100 dogs (about 25 per kelurahan). Around 12 personnel, including veterinarians, medical staff, and field workers, will administer the vaccines, with doses prepared as needed. The effort shifts focus from owned pets to semi-feral dogs that are released in yards and roam, which pose higher bite and rabies risks. Public guidance includes reducing garbage to limit stray dogs and not provoking dogs. As of January–July 2026, there were no dog-bite reports, and Mataram’s rabies cases remain zero.

triage.headline_ja: マタラム市、狂犬病予防のため半野生犬へのワクチン接種を近く実施
triage.triage_reason: 予防的なワクチン接種プログラムであり、咬傷報告や狂犬病症例はゼロで、公衆衛生上の異常な事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による予防的な狂犬病対策活動の報道であり、実際の症例発生や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ - Έμπολα: Εβδομήντα χιλιάδες δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo τίθενται στη διάθεση της ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO - Ebola: Seventy thousand doses of the Ervebo vaccine are made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO has allotted 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the ongoing outbreak in northern and eastern regions. Of the total, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against the Bundibugyo strain, and 50,000 doses will go to frontline workers and health professionals in DRC. The country declared on May 15 its 17th Ebola outbreak, amid weak governance and collapsing health infrastructure. The outbreak has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola surge in the DRC. The doses come from the Global stockpile distributed by the GIG, with WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and funding from Gavi. It remains uncertain if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo; early data suggest possible protection. WHO also recommended evaluating Ervebo in DRC; other vaccines in trials include Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford, and the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories.

triage.headline_ja: WHO - エボラ出血熱：エルベボワクチン7万回分がコンゴ民主共和国に提供される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、5,105例・2,420人死亡と過去最悪規模に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的対応（WHO・UNICEF・Gavi等）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%と非常に高く、統治機能や保健インフラの弱体化も指摘されており、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC va recevoir 70 000 doses du vaccin Ervebo contre l'Ebola | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC to receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, with 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial targeting Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers, following an emergency request from the DRC government. Ervebo is approved against Ebola virus but not confirmed for Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. The six-province eastern outbreak has infected 5,208 confirmed cases and caused 2,476 deaths, spreading roughly three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic and faster than prior outbreaks. Doses are being released immediately by the International Coordinating Group on Vaccines, with WHO support, as Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called this a global solidarity act. The overall case fatality rate is 47.5%, rising to 70% in North Kivu. The outbreak may have started in Mongbwalu in February, before the May 15 declaration.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラワクチン「Ervebo」7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部6州で確認例5,208人・死亡2,476人、致死率47.5%（北キブでは70%）という大規模かつ急速に拡大するエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な緊急ワクチン支援も行われているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaやBundibugyoが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内（Ituri州・北キブ州等6州）の流行について述べており、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。過去の西アフリカ流行（2014-2016）より約3倍速い拡大速度である点も重大な異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Dia Mundial do Mosquito: BC realiza diversas ações de prevenção e conscientização contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Mosquito Day: BC conducts various dengue prevention and awareness activities.
article.articleSummary: On World Mosquito Day, Balneário Camboriú’s Health Department reports sustained dengue prevention and awareness efforts. In 2025, the city recorded 724 dengue cases and 5 chikungunya cases, with no deaths; in 2026 to date, 11 dengue cases and no chikungunya, and no deaths. This follows a 2023–2024 dengue epidemic that totaled about 11,000 cases and 13 deaths. Improvements in equipment and field operations contributed to the decline, including 22 new motorcycles, a van, three double-cab pickups, a seven-seat vehicle, drones, stereomicroscopes for the lab, and staff training. Activities include domiciliary visits, trap inspections, targeted insecticide and larvicide applications, and full mapping of all properties (100%). Public education in health units, schools, and businesses, mutirões to eliminate breeding sites, and complaint channels are ongoing. The Wolbachia method (Aedes aegypti) was released in four neighborhoods from Aug 2025, totaling 52 releases; impact to be evaluated in 2–3 years. Vigiagua monitors drinking-water quality.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊デー:バウネアリオ・カンボリウ市がデング熱予防・啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の発生件数は前年比で大幅減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は見られず、通常の予防啓発活動の報告に留まる。
triage.notes: ブラジルの記事だが、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。2023-2024年に大規模流行があったが、2025-2026年は症例数が大幅減少し死亡者もゼロで、現状は平常時の予防活動の報告。
