article.articleHeadline: Sanidad acota el riesgo de ébola a los trabajadores en primera línea del brote en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry limits Ebola risk to frontline workers of the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo drives concerns about frontline exposure. As of the update, DRC reports 2,476 deaths and 5,208 confirmed cases since May 15, the second deadliest outbreak in history, with Uganda adding 20 infections and 2 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on July 28. The Spanish Ministry of Health limited infection risk to frontline health workers, deeming travel to Spain as low, but advised against travel to affected areas. If travel is unavoidable, individuals should consult an International Vaccination Center for guidance. The Central Coordination of Alerts and Health Emergencies (CCAES) notes ongoing monitoring. Imported cases include two US citizens evacuated to Germany; a French doctor returning from RDC; and a UK NGO worker. Spain’s Red Uatan network ensures specialist care, and authorities maintain contact with NGOs to track personnel deployed to outbreak zones; preventive precautions for any travel are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、DRCでのエボラ流行における感染リスクを最前線の医療従事者に限定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで死者2,476人・症例5,208人という史上2番目に致命的なエボラ流行が継続中で、複数国への輸入症例（米・仏・英）も発生しており、国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は7月28日に終息宣言済み。米・仏・独・英・スペインは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCの流行は史上2番目の致死規模であり、既に複数の輸入症例が国際的に報告されている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en el epicentro del brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo: 'No estamos pudiendo acceder a algunas comunidades'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 'We are unable to access some communities'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality ~47.5%), three months after the emergency was declared on May 15, amid weeks of delayed response. Originating in Ituri, the outbreak has surged into North Kivu, Alto Uele, Tshopo and Bas Uele, now affecting 56 health districts. The healthcare system is collapsing: in Wamba admissions far exceed beds; in Isiro, capacity is exceeded; only one of seven treatment centers in Alto Uele meets basic isolation and biosafety standards. Displacement and violence hinder access to communities; Plaine Savo camp houses about 80,000 people. Contact tracing lags: Ituri 93% traced, Alto Uele 64.3%, Bas Uele under 20%. Western donors’ funding cuts erode routine surveillance and essential services; measles and cholera remain ongoing (108,000 suspected measles; 35,000 cholera cases Jan–Jul 2026). The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行震源地で警戒:『一部コミュニティへのアクセスができていない』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当する大規模エボラ流行であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行に加え、麻疹（疑い10.8万例）・コレラ（3.5万例）も同時進行しており、医療体制崩壊と資金不足により対応が困難な状況。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO and Africa CDC welcome the allocation of Ebola vaccines to the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC reports Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak; WHO and Africa CDC welcome allocation of Ervebo Ebola vaccine from the ICG stockpile. ICG released 70,000 doses: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess vaccine impact on Bundibugyo virus and 50,000 for frontline health workers per WHO SAGE guidance. It is not yet known if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo virus in humans; early laboratory/animal data hint at possible protection, with the trial providing needed efficacy evidence for policy. Informed consent emphasized for participants. ICG partners are WHO, IFRC, MSF, and UNICEF; Gavi funds the stockpile. WHO and Africa CDC support a community-led response to protect populations and end the outbreak while generating data for future preparedness. Since 2021, ICG has allocated over 56,000 Ervebo doses to Ebola responses in DRC and used 167,000 doses in preventive campaigns across DRC, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Sierra Leone and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国へのエボラワクチン配分を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョウウイルス病のアウトブレイクが発生し、WHO・Africa CDC・ICGが国際的にエボラ関連ワクチンを配分する対応を行っており、フィロウイルス属の新規流行として社会的関心・国際支援の両面で重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのブンディブギョウウイルス病（エボラ属だがブンディブギョウウイルス種）のアウトブレイクへのワクチン配分に関するもの。Sierra Leone、Kenya、Guinea-Bissau、Ugandaは過去の予防的キャンペーン実施国として言及されているのみで、現在のアウトブレイク発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan TB, Dinkes PPKB Pesisir Selatan Perkuat Deteksi Dini di Nagari Koto Baru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent TB Transmission, South Pesisir Health Office PPKB Strengthens Early Detection in Nagari Koto Baru
article.articleSummary: TB prevention efforts in South Pesisir Regency are intensified through integrated TB case finding with free health checks in Nagari Koto Baru, under Puskesmas Koto Berapak, on August 19. The Dinkes PPKB of Pesisir Selatan targeted 100 residents to raise awareness of early detection and TB prevention. Tuberculosis is a contagious disease, primarily affecting the lungs, curable with early diagnosis and full treatment. Key symptoms include a cough lasting two weeks or more (may be sputum with blood), fever or night sweats, unexplained weight loss, reduced appetite, and fatigue. People with symptoms or close contacts are urged to seek examination at the Puskesmas promptly. Suspected TB cases will receive follow-up testing per standard service procedures. Early case finding speeds treatment and helps prevent transmission to family and community. The effort is a collaboration among Dinkes PPKB, Puskesmas Koto Berapak, Nagari Koto Baru government, health cadres, and the community.

triage.headline_ja: 結核感染予防のため、南プシシル県保健局PPKBがナガリ・コトバルでの早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域保健活動としての結核早期発見・啓発キャンペーンであり、異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局による通常の結核対策プログラムの報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's M23 rebels impose new Ebola movement restrictions
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the AFC/M23 rebel alliance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has imposed new movement restrictions in areas under its control after Ebola cases linked to travel from government-held territory were detected. Shared taxis between Goma and Kirumba will be suspended for one month from Saturday; passenger pirogue boats on certain Lake Edward routes will be barred. Taxi-buses will continue on the Goma–Kirumba corridor but subject to health and safety controls; trucks carrying goods will be allowed along the route. The measures underscore challenges in containing the Ebola outbreak amid ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo, described as the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. The AFC/M23 controls large areas of North and South Kivu after capturing Goma and Bukavu in early 2025. DR Congo has reported 5,021 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,378 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のM23反乱軍、エボラ関連の新たな移動制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する大規模エボラ流行（累計5,021症例、死亡2,378人）が紛争地域で継続しており、封じ込めが困難な「史上最速拡大」の流行とされているためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 武装勢力(M23/AFC)支配地域での移動制限は感染拡大防止の困難さを示す。紛争により保健当局のアクセスが制限され、国際支援の必要性が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Gov't steps up free health checks to detect tuberculosis cases
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces an estimated 1.09 million TB cases in 2025, with only about 867,000 (80%) detected. The Ministry of Health is intensifying the Free Health Check Program (CKG) to accelerate screening, aiming to reach 90% detection in 2026. In Tangerang, Deputy Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus emphasized rapid treatment for anyone diagnosed to curb transmission and to promote TB preventive therapy for household contacts. For 2025, Indonesia targeted 72% coverage for preventive therapy among close contacts, but regional progress varies: Banten 61%, East Java 46%, Central Java 28%, while Highland Papua records 0%, North Sulawesi 1%, and Aceh 1%. The initiative seeks earlier case finding, prompt treatment initiation, and heightened public awareness via media engagement, contributing to broader TB control goals toward elimination in the long term.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、結核症例発見のため無料健康診断を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する政府の通常の検診・対策強化に関する報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、緊急の社会的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、本記事は政府の検診プログラム強化に関する定例的な公衆衛生施策報道。緊急シグナルではないが、TB負担の大きさから継続的なモニタリング対象ではある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Deadliest Ebola Outbreak Is a Symptom of Its Governance Crisis
article.articleSummary: Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province near the Uganda border, has become the deadliest on record, with more than 2,300 deaths from about 5,000 confirmed cases. Since its emergence earlier this year, the virus has spread to five neighboring provinces, with 20 cases in Uganda and one in France attributed to cross-border transmission. Ituri accounts for roughly 85 percent of cases and over 1,800 deaths. Health workers struggle to treat the surge and sustain contact tracing amid a highly mobile population engaged in cross-border trade and artisanal mining. The outbreak's trajectory was worsened by a months-long delay in detection, allowing wider spread. Burial rites, where the dead remain highly contagious, and resistance to isolation efforts have hindered containment, complicating a response within a governance-crisis context at Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの最も致死的なエボラ流行は、その統治危機の一症状である
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最多の死者数（2300人超）を記録するエボラ流行で、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20例）およびフランス（1例）への越境感染が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内、特にイトゥリ州（症例の約85%）が主たる発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 70 000 doses d'Ervebo attendues dans les prochaines 48 heures - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 70,000 doses of Ervebo expected in the next 48 hours - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo driven by Bundibugyo virus; as of 20 August 2026, 5,208 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths; 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses expected within 48 hours, first delivery toward a 500,000-dose request. Of the 70,000, 50,000 are for frontline health workers; 20,000 support a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo. Ervebo is not licensed for Bundibugyo; efficacy against this strain is unproven though preliminary lab/animal data suggest possible protection. The operation aims to provide immediate protection for responders and generate data to inform a potential broader vaccination campaign, contingent on results and outbreak evolution.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国：今後48時間以内にエルベボ7万回分が到着予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）によりDRCで5,208例確認、2,476人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクや国際的拡大の懸念もあるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の継続報道。ワクチン(Ervebo)がブンディブギョ株には未承認で有効性未確認という点が新たなリスク要素。致死率が約47.5%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: आमजन की जागरूकता मच्छर जनित एवं मच्छर रचित मलेरिया एवं डेंगू बीमारी को समाप्त कर सकती है - पटेल -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public awareness can eradicate mosquito-borne malaria and dengue - Patel -
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, Bagli Civil Hospital, Devas, organized a mosquito-borne disease awareness program under CMHO Devas and Block Medical Officer Dr. Amit Nagar. Dr. Hemant Patel urged collective action to eradicate malaria, stressing timely treatment and eliminating mosquito breeding sites. Malaria's four Plasmodium species (vivax, falciparum, ovale, malariae) were noted, with night biting linked to dehydration, olfactory cues, and carbon dioxide. A female mosquito lays 100–200 eggs (up to 300) per cycle, about every 2–3 days, across 3–5 cycles. Preventive measures: remove standing water around homes; regularly clean coolers, pots, and tanks; sleep under nets and wear long sleeves; follow health department guidelines. Blood group O individuals may attract roughly twice as many bites; India has over 400 mosquito species, about 31 of which transmit malaria, dengue, and chikungunya. Attendees included health staff; program concluded with thanks.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆の意識向上が蚊媒介性のマラリア・デング熱を根絶できる - パテル氏
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、通常の蚊媒介感染症啓発プログラムに関する記事であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の症例数や流行状況を報告するものではなく、地域病院による一般的な啓発活動の紹介記事であるため、対象国であるインドでの実際のアウトブレイクイベントとは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS disponibiliza 70.000 doses da vacina Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO makes 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine available.
article.articleSummary: WHO allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): 20,000 for a phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus; its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven, though laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection. The Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern DR Congo has caused 2,476 deaths among 5,208 confirmed cases, the deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. WHO Director-General Tedros warned the situation remains far from controlled, with ongoing risk of national and international spread. The virus began circulating in eastern DR Congo in February, with a Science study suggesting January as the start. The outbreak spread to Uganda (20 cases, 15 imported), with Uganda declaring Ebola-free on July 28. Bundibugyo fatality 30–50%; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:WHOがエルベボワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで致死率30-50%、既にウガンダへの越境拡大歴があり、WHO事務局長が国内外拡大リスクを警告しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大があったが7月28日にエボラフリー宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクは確定5208例・死亡2476例で過去最悪規模、承認ワクチンなく治験段階。

article.articleHeadline: ԱՀԿ-ն հայտարարել է էբոլայի դեմ 70 000 չափաբաժին պատվաստանյութ Կոնգո ուղարկելու մասին
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AHK has announced that it will send 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to Congo.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to protect frontline healthcare workers and support clinical testing. Of these, 20,000 doses are for a phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 doses align with current immunization expert advisory group recommendations. The WHO notes that it is not yet known whether Ervebo provides protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; animal data suggest possible protection, but human data are needed. The outbreak began May 15 in the DRC and in Uganda, becoming Africa’s second deadliest Ebola outbreak; Bundibugyo ebolavirus is the cause. It has affected six provinces in the DRC, centered in Ituri. Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28. In the DRC, deaths reached 2,378, with confirmed cases over 5,000.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラワクチン7万回分をコンゴに送付すると発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）はアフリカ史上2番目に致死的な流行となっており、死者2,378人、確定症例5,000人超に達し、複数州に拡大、ウガンダへの越境も確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも同流行が確認されたが、7月28日に終息宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生国として継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Teen dies of leptospirosis 4 days before birthday
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis caused the death of 17-year-old Justin Espinosa four days before his birthday after a rat bite and exposure to Navotas City floodwaters. Two weeks post-bite, he developed weakness and was admitted to Navotas City Hospital, where clinicians suspected leptospirosis. Concurrently, San Lazaro Hospital reported a surge of cases, with 26 admissions on Thursday and a death the previous night, bringing total cases to 96 since January. Transmission is linked to floodwater exposure; other patients include a 5-year-old with fever, a 37-year-old delivery rider with fever, vomiting, and diarrhea after wading through floods, and an 11-year-old with muscle pain. Incubation ranges from 2 to 30 days, typically about two weeks. Severe disease can affect the kidneys, causing reduced urination, and may entail severe respiratory symptoms requiring intubation.

triage.headline_ja: 10代の少年、誕生日4日前にレプトスピラ症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ナボタス市で洪水関連のレプトスピラ症患者が増加し死亡例も出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、既知の風土病的事象であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 洪水による毎年の季節的なレプトスピラ症流行と考えられ、地域内での既知の公衆衛生課題。国際的な拡大の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to be sent to DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the World Health Organization reports DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to protect health workers and support clinical trials. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to assess effectiveness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while 50,000 doses are allocated to frontline and healthcare workers per current immunization guidance. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; protection against Bundibugyo is unconfirmed, with early animal data suggesting possible protection. Trials in DRC will determine future use. The outbreak began in DRC and Uganda on 15 May and is the second deadliest in Africa, with six provinces affected and Ituri as the epicenter. Ugandan authorities reported the outbreak ended on 28 July. Death toll stands at 2,378 with more than 5,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラワクチン7万回分をコンゴ民主共和国へ送付へ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行（死者2,378人、症例5,000人超）で、複数州・複数国に拡大しており、WHOによるワクチン供給など国際支援が行われているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染が確認されたが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダ当局は7月28日に自国内での流行終息を報告済み。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила об отправке 70 тысяч доз вакцины от Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced the shipment of 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to Congo.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine shipped to the Democratic Republic of Congo: 20,000 for a Phase III trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 for frontline healthcare workers, per WHO. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; its protection against Bundibugyo in humans remains uncertain, though early data suggest possible protection. The DRC trial will provide data to guide future use. The WHO declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, with regional risk assessed as high. As of latest reports, over 2,300 deaths and more than 5,000 cases have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴへエボラワクチン7万回分の輸送を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC-ウガンダのエボラ流行はWHOによりPHEICが宣言され、死者2,300人超・症例5,000人超という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対するワクチン効果を評価する第III相試験実施中である点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: DRC to receive 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine used in past outbreaks
article.articleSummary: DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo after a government request, with 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire Ebola strain, not Bundibugyo, though early laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection. The International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision, with WHO and partners, will release doses immediately. The outbreak spans six eastern provinces, spreading about three times faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, with a case fatality rate around 47.5% (up to 70% in hard-to-reach areas like North Kivu). Since February, linked to the Mongbwalu mining town, more than 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths have been recorded; most new cases occur in people not under monitoring. Lack of approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo hinders response; vaccine delivery is a major boost.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、過去の流行で使用されたエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が6州に拡大し、致死率約47.5%、5000例超・2300人超の死亡が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念事案である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（東部6州、Mongbwalu鉱山町起源）の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株に対する承認ワクチンがない中での対応であり、国際調整グループ(ICG)とWHOが緊急対応している。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : 70.000 doses de vaccin Ervebo mises à disposition de la RDC, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the World Health Organization announced the allocation of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo for Ebola control, but not against Bundibugyo. Of these, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 trial to evaluate Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses are designated for frontline health workers. The outbreak, declared 15 May, has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, the deadliest Ebola wave in the DRC, spreading rapidly in northern and eastern regions with weak health systems. The GIC, with WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and funding from Gavi, arranged the stock. Laboratory data hint at possible protection against Bundibugyo, but human efficacy remains unconfirmed; informed consent is essential for trial participation or vaccine use. Additional vaccines in development include Moderna (mRNA), Oxford (UK), and rVSV Bundibugyo by Hilleman Laboratories.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOによるとErvebo(エルベボ)ワクチン7万回分がコンゴ民主共和国に提供される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（確認症例5,105人、死者2,420人）のエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際機関による大規模支援が行われている。
triage.notes: 本流行はコンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、Bundibugyo株に対する新規ワクチン第3相試験も進行中。医療インフラの脆弱な北部・東部地域で急速に拡大しており、越境拡大リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية ترسل 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح إيبولا إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization sends 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization dispatched 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to protect health workers and support a clinical trial. The package comprises 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 doses for frontline healthcare workers per current recommendations. The WHO states there is no conclusive evidence that Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo virus; early data and animal studies indicate possible protection, and Ervebo is licensed for Ebola Zaire. The Congo trial will yield data to inform future use of Ervebo. The May 17, 2026 declaration designated the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with high regional risk. Latest counts report over 2,300 deaths and more than 5,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、エボラワクチン7万回分をコンゴ民主共和国へ発送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行は既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定されており、死者2,300人超・症例5,000件超と深刻。IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。PHEICは2026年5月17日に既に宣言済みで、本記事はワクチン供給とPhase3臨床試験に関する続報。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種に対するErvebo有効性は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo recibirá 70,000 vacunas para el ébola sin certeza de su efecto en actual variante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo will receive 70,000 Ebola vaccines without certainty of their effectiveness against the current variant.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses will be delivered to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the Bundibugyo variant, the second-worst outbreak of the virus in history, with more than 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,300 deaths reported in recent months. Of the shipment, 50,000 doses are earmarked for frontline health workers and community members; the remainder will be used in a clinical trial to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo, though no proven protection in humans exists yet. The World Health Organization says preliminary laboratory and animal data suggest potential protection, but the ongoing trial will provide clear evidence. Bundibugyo, first identified in 1976, exhibits a case fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50% and currently has no specific treatment. The vaccine supply is provided by an international group coordinating emergency reserves, with funding from GAVI; partners include WHO, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, Doctors Without Borders, and UNICEF.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、現行の変異株への効果不確実なままエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行（Bundibugyo変異株、5000人超感染・2300人死亡、致死率30-50%）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現行流行株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチンの有効性は未確立であり、臨床試験段階。致死率が高く、国際機関（WHO、GAVI、UNICEF等）による緊急支援が行われている点からも重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dagboek uit ebolagebied: 'Hoe kan er in zo'n mooi land zoveel ellende zijn?'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diary from the Ebola region: 'How can there be so much misery in such a beautiful country?'
article.articleSummary: An Ebola treatment center in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, opened amid protests against the government and security concerns. Staff debate infection-control and entry/egress routes; a boy with fever at a checkpoint is quickly ruled non-Ebola. A nurse directive enforces one-way movement to limit cross-patient transmission. A man and woman report their priest father has fallen ill; lab testing confirms Ebola. A pregnant patient arrives after bleeding and miscarriage; another pregnant patient later stabilizes, and a 24-year-old male improves. A five‑month‑old dies in triage; the body is prepared with chlorine and a shroud, with family allowed to witness and later grieve together. Lab results are slow; two negative tests can allow discharge, but a subsequent positive result is possible. A tent collapse from heavy rain prompts a drainage plan; the narrator travels past Virunga National Park and reflects on the country’s beauty amid misery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行地からの日記：『こんなに美しい国で、なぜこれほどの悲惨が起こるのか？』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニのエボラ治療センターで新規確定例（司祭）と死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はジャーナリスティックな日記形式だが、治療センターでの新規確定例（司祭）、乳児の死亡、感染管理体制の詳細な描写があり、進行中の流行状況を示している。政府への抗議活動も報告されており、社会的緊張が高い地域であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: El mayor grupo rebelde del Congo restringirá la movilidad en el este del país por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The largest rebel group in Congo will restrict mobility in the eastern part of the country because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompts movement restrictions by the AFC/M23 rebel alliance controlling parts of North and South Kivu. After two travelers from Lubero in North Kivu tested positive in a village under M23 control, the group announced a one-month ban on shared taxis on the Goma–Kirumba road and on certain lake transport on Lake Edward, with taxis-buses and cargo trucks allowed under health and security checks. The move comes as the current outbreak becomes the fastest-growing since its May 15 declaration and the second deadliest in DRC history. The M23, backed by neighboring Rwanda, controls large swaths of North and South Kivu following early-2025 advances that saw Goma and Bukavu fall. The Congolese government reported 2,476 deaths and 5,208 confirmed cases as of the latest figures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ最大の反政府勢力、エボラ流行を理由に東部での移動を制限へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で拡大が最速かつ史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行が続いており、反政府勢力による移動制限が発動されるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にState of South Australia等が含まれるが記事内容と無関係なため除外。RwandaはM23の後ろ盾として言及されるのみで、感染発生地としての言及はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ο ΠΟΥ στέλνει 70.000 δόσεις εμβολίων στη ΛΔ Κονγκό για αντιμετώπιση του έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO sends 70,000 vaccine doses to the DRC to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization announced that the Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of Congo will receive 70,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine. The vaccine has been approved to protect against the Ebola virus, but not against the strain currently circulating within the country. The vaccination effort is intended to bolster outbreak response, though the mismatch between the vaccine’s approved protection and the circulating strain may limit effectiveness. The report does not provide figures for confirmed cases or deaths, nor details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any imported/exported cases. No additional locations are mentioned beyond the DRC, and no deployment timelines are specified.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策のためコンゴ民主共和国に70,000回分のワクチンを送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生事象であり、WHOによる大規模ワクチン支援が実施されている点、および流行株とワクチンの不一致という異常性から国際的関心が高く、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数などの疫学的詳細は記事に記載されておらず不明。流行株とワクチンの不一致が有効性に影響する可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC recibirá 70 mil dosis de la vacuna Ervebo para combatir el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: WHO announced 70,000 Ervebo doses for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), approved against the Zaire ebolavirus strain but not Bundibugyo. Of these, 20,000 are for a Phase 3 trial to assess Bundibugyo protection; 50,000 are for frontline workers. The DRC declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak governance and fragile health systems; 2,420 deaths among 5,105 confirmed cases, the deadliest and fastest-spreading outbreak to date. DRC requested Ervebo from Global stock reserves (GIC) with support from UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and Gavi. Experts remain uncertain if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo; early lab/animal data hint at possible protection. On August 7, WHO advised evaluating Ervebo in a trial in the DRC, where Bundibugyo circulates. Merck manufactures Ervebo. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials (Moderna mRNA and Oxford). A promising rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine will be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対策のためエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）は史上最大・最速拡大で致死率も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既往の第17次エボラ流行（Zaire株ベースの流行にBundibugyo株が混在）に関するワクチン供給ニュース。5,105症例中2,420死亡と致死率が極めて高く、統治力・医療体制の脆弱な地域での流行拡大が懸念される。ErveboのBundibugyo株への有効性は未確定でPhase3試験実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Μαζικός εμβολιασμός με 70.000 δόσεις για την αντιμετώπιση του Έμπολα - Πάνω από 2.400 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Mass vaccination with 70,000 doses to combat Ebola - Over 2,400 dead.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, marking the deadliest surge in the country. The World Health Organization announced the distribution of 70,000 Ervebo doses (rVSV-ZEBOV) to DRC, with 20,000 earmarked for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The outbreak was declared on 17 May in northern and eastern DRC, in regions with weak state presence and strained health infrastructure. DRC sought vaccines from the Global Vaccine Stockpile coordinated by GIG, with WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, and MSF involved and funding from Gavi. It remains uncertain whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo; early lab data suggest possible protection. On 7 August, WHO recommended evaluating Ervebo in a clinical trial in DRC. Other vaccines in development include Moderna and Oxford candidates, and a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories is anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ対策のため7万回分のワクチンで大規模接種―死者2,400人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確認症例5,105例、死亡2,420人）で公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国際的な支援（WHO、UNICEF、Gavi等）が動員されていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で2026年5月17日に宣言されたエボラ流行が拡大中。ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン効果は不明で、第3相試験が計画されている。国際機関（WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, Gavi）が支援に関与しており、致死率も高いため深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Oms: Rdc riceverà 70.000 dosi di vaccino anti-Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: DRC will receive 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to help contain the Bundibugyo outbreak in the east. Of these, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 trial to test Ervebo's efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses will go to frontline health workers, following government request. Ervebo is licensed for the Zaire ebolavirus strain and not officially approved for Bundibugyo, though early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. The six eastern provinces are affected; the virus is spreading at unprecedented speed, about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak; the case count exceeds 5,000 with over 2,300 deaths, CFR about 47.5% overall and up to 70% in hard-to-reach areas such as North Kivu. The virus likely circulated since February in Mongbwalu, with official outbreak declared May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros stresses global solidarity, enhanced surveillance, rapid case finding, care, and vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国がエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の大規模流行（症例5,000超、致死率約47.5%）で東部6州に拡大、前例のない速度で感染が広がっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが記事本文では言及がないため除外。ブンディブギョ株はエルベボ（Ervebo）ワクチンの正式承認対象外で、第3相試験として使用される点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: 70.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses for its 17th outbreak, declared May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak government presence and strained health systems. WHO allocates 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s effectiveness against the Bundibugyo strain, and 50,000 for frontline health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak has reached 5,105 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, the deadliest on record in the country. Last week, DR Congo requested vaccine allocations from the global stockpile coordinated by the GIG, with UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and Gavi. Experts do not yet know if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo in humans; early lab data suggest possible protection. Two other Bundibugyo vaccines are in trials (Moderna and Oxford University), with a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine from Hilleman Laboratories considered most promising. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and has killed at least 15,000 lives in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：DRコンゴにEbola vaccine「Ervebo」7万回分
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで過去最悪規模（5,105例確認、2,420人死亡）の第17次エボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%の大規模流行で、WHO・UNICEF・Gavi等国際機関が支援。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン有効性は未確立で、複数の治験薬が並行開発中。

article.articleHeadline: Sức khỏe hiện tại của nam bệnh nhân nguy kịch vì COVID-19 gần 1 tháng trước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current health of a male patient who was in critical condition due to COVID-19 about a month ago.
article.articleSummary: On 20 July, D.V.N., 43, developed rapid dyspnea with fever, cough and chest tightness; COVID-19 was confirmed. Admitted to the 19-8 Hospital, Ministry of Public Security, Hanoi, he deteriorated to septic shock and multiorgan failure from COVID-19 pneumonia with ARDS. Initial treatment included oxygen, antibiotics, corticosteroids, and anticoagulation; due to rapid decline, he was moved to intensive care. A multidisciplinary team secured antiviral therapy and prepared for VV-ECMO. He was intubated and ventilated per ARDSnet, placed in prone position, and received urgent renal replacement therapy and cytokine adsorption with CRRT, followed by hemodialysis. In the first 72 hours, double cytokine adsorption with CRRT was used. After about 30 days, pulmonary and organ function improved; he was weaned from the ventilator and discharged on 19 August 2026. COVID-19 is a Group B infectious disease in Vietnam; early diagnosis and close respiratory monitoring remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 約1ヶ月前にCOVID-19で重篤だった男性患者の現在の健康状態
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の経過報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常な拡大や新規性を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 個別患者の治療経過を伝える記事であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクの兆候は記載されていない。COVID-19はベトナムでB群感染症に分類されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola en RDC : " Les moyens déployés restent insuffisants face à la gravité de la menace "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: "The resources deployed remain insufficient in the face of the severity of the threat."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with more than 5,100 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola episode in the DRC to date. About 100 new infections per day, roughly one case every 15 minutes, have been reported. The epicenter remains Ituri, but five other provinces are affected: Sud-Kivu, Nord-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, and Bas-Uélé. There is currently no treatment or vaccine proven effective against the Bundibugyo variant driving this 17th outbreak, underscoring reliance on community awareness, triage, infection prevention in health facilities, and standard public health measures. The security and humanitarian context hampers response, with armed clashes restricting access and causing displacement; distrust of health services further drives avoidance of care, compounding deaths from other diseases like cholera in Sud-Kivu (notably Bukavu). Priorities: strengthen contact tracing (around 80–85%), expand infection-control coverage beyond the epicenter, and secure substantial funding for prevention in neighboring areas to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：「脅威の深刻さに対し、投入されたリソースは依然として不十分」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,100例以上、死者2,420人）が拡大中で、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ複数州に拡大、治安・人道状況が対応を阻害しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: コレラの併発（南キブ州、ブカブ）も報告されているが、記事の主題はエボラ流行であり、対象国はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo変異株による第17次流行で、ワクチン・治療法が未確立という異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mianmar: a cólera reabre as feridas de um país em guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myanmar: Cholera Reopens the Wounds of a Country at War.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar, as of August 9, with at least 500 hospitalizations for symptoms compatible with cholera. Rapid tests were positive in 149 cases, with 9 confirmations by the National Laboratory. More than 100 hospitalizations occurred last Thursday before authorities reported a decline in new cases. A 92-year-old man died after admission, with the death attributed to preexisting cardiac and pulmonary conditions. Health authorities are conducting epidemiological surveillance and containment in affected areas. Myanmar’s history of cholera includes large outbreaks in Yangon and Mandalay in 2004 during the monsoon, and concerns post-C cyclone Nargis in 2008. The country remains beset by five-plus years of war and internal displacement, factors that complicate outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー:コレラが戦争に苦しむ国の傷を再び開く
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで500人以上の入院を伴うコレラ流行が発生し、内戦下で衛生インフラが脆弱な状況下での対応が懸念されるため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 内戦下での人口移動・衛生状態悪化により感染拡大リスクが高い。国際的な支援体制の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ruotsin tuhkarokkoepidemia uhkaa laajeta yhä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sweden's measles epidemic threatens to spread further.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, the World Health Organization reports that 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine have been sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The vaccine is generally effective against Ebola overall, but not against the Ebola variant circulating in Congo. WHO experts note animal studies have hinted that the vaccine might offer some protection against this Congo variant, though there is no direct human data cited. Currently, there is no vaccine or effective specific treatment for infections caused by the Congo-circulating Ebola variant. This highlights ongoing regional concerns about Ebola spread and the gap in targeted countermeasures for this particular variant.

triage.headline_ja: スウェーデンの麻疹流行がさらに拡大の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で流行中のエボラ変異株に対して既存ワクチンの有効性が確認されておらず、有効な治療法も存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案である。
triage.notes: 見出しはスウェーデンの麻疹流行に関するものだが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ変異株とWHOによるワクチン配布に関するものであり、見出しと内容が一致していない点に注意。トリアージはサマリー内容（エボラ）に基づいて実施した。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo prejela 70.000 odmerkov cepiva ervebo proti eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo received 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Geneva/Kinshasa, 20 August 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo, struck by an Ebola outbreak in mid-May, has received 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine. Ervebo, approved to protect against Ebola virus, is not effective against the strain currently circulating in the country, according to today’s World Health Organization update. The shipment arrives as the outbreak continues in the DRC. The vaccine's deployment aims to bolster protection but its efficacy is limited to the virus strain it targets. The report, datelined Geneva and Kinshasa, confirms the involvement of international health authorities in supporting outbreak response and vaccination campaigns, even as strain mismatch poses challenges for immunization strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5月中旬から継続するエボラ流行に対し、既存ワクチンが現在流行中の株に効果がないとWHOが発表しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と対応の困難さが示唆される。
triage.notes: 現在流行中のエボラ株に既存承認ワクチン（エルベボ）が効果を示さない点が重大な懸念材料。WHOおよびジュネーブは支援側であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Philippine health authorities warn of leptospirosis amid floods
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 20, 2026, leptospirosis risk is elevated in the Philippines amid widespread floods. The Department of Health reports more than 3,000 leptospirosis cases nationwide in the past eight months. In Manila, San Lazaro Hospital has over 20 cases, three of them severe, with numbers expected to rise as heavy rains persist in the metropolis. The DOH has 3.1 million doxycycline capsules on standby and has raised a Code White Alert in affected areas to bolster the response. Public guidance urges avoiding wading in floodwaters and seeking immediate medical care for fever, headache, or muscle pain. DOH says facilities and medicine supplies are sufficient to handle the surge, highlighting preparedness and surveillance during the flood-related transmission risk in the capital region.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健当局、洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症の警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 洪水期に例年見られるレプトスピラ症の増加であり、当局は薬剤備蓄や警戒体制を整えているため深刻な国際的懸念には至らないが、症例数増加と重症例の存在から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで毎年の洪水期に発生する既知の感染症であり、DOHは十分な医療資源とサーベイランス体制を整えていると報告している。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果獲7萬劑伊波拉疫苗　但尚未證實對現行病毒株有效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine, but effectiveness against the circulating strain has not yet been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the World Health Organization is supplying 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo for trial and limited use against the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating there. Ervebo has demonstrated safety and efficacy against the Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unconfirmed. The International Coordination Group for Vaccine Provision allocated 20,000 doses for a phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo, with the remaining 50,000 doses allocated to frontline health workers. Administration follows the Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization guidance. Since May 15, the outbreak in DRC has reached over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths—the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country—prompting the government to request vaccine support last week.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラワクチン7万回分を受領　現行株への有効性は未確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5000人超の感染、2300人超の死亡と同国史上最悪のエボラ流行となっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性（新規株・ワクチン有効性未確認）の両基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 流行株はBundibugyo種であり、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo、Zaire株対象）の有効性が未確認である点が特に懸念される。政府が国際支援を要請し、WHOがワクチン供給を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo recibirá 70 mil dosis de vacuna contra el ébola - RNV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine - RNV.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, according to World Health Organization officials, as part of the response to what experts describe as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. About 50,000 doses will be prioritized to protect frontline health workers and community responders involved in the emergency. A portion of the remaining vaccine will be allocated to a specialized clinical trial evaluating the vaccine’s effectiveness against the Bundibugyo variant, a strain with a case-fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50%. The public health measure reflects the outbreak’s severity, which has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases and claimed more than 2,300 lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ - RNV
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大速度とされるエボラ流行で症例5000超・死者2300超、致死率30-50%のブンディブギョ株も関与しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOによる大規模ワクチン配布（エルベボ7万回分）が実施されるほど深刻な流行。ブンディブギョ株の臨床試験も進行中で、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: Jean Kaseya annonce 700 millions de dollars mobilisés, dont 452 millions déjà déboursés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Jean Kaseya announces $700 million mobilized, of which $452 million has already been disbursed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe. As of 18 August, the INSP reports 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality 47.5%), across six provinces and 56 health zones. Ituri is the hardest hit with 28 of 36 zones affected, followed by North Kivu (12), Tshopo (7), Haut-Uélé (6), Bas-Uélé (2); Sud-Kivu has one active zone with no new cases in 79 days. There are 1,115 recoveries and 730 patients in care; contact tracing is 84% complete. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya says over $700 million has been mobilized for the Ebola response in the DRC, $452 million already disbursed; the United States announced an additional $242 million on 5 August, bringing total mobilization to about $700 million. The response features high-level international fundraising and national coordination by the Congolese government. Ramaphosa visited, Uganda travel restrictions were discussed, and coordination includes engagement with President Tshisekedi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国:ジャン・カセヤ氏、7億ドルの資金動員を発表、うち4億5200万ドルは既に支出済み
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は致死率47.5%と極めて深刻で、6州56保健地区に拡大しており、国際的な資金動員・支援が継続している重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの渡航制限議論や米国の資金拠出が言及されているが、発生地はDRCのみであり、対象国リストのウガンダ・米国は含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo to receive 70K doses of Ebola vaccine to fight fastest outbreak in history
article.articleSummary: Congolese authorities will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to combat what officials describe as the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, spanning six eastern provinces and including North Kivu. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus, not Bundibugyo virus—the strain driving this outbreak—but early laboratory and animal data suggest it may provide some protection. Allocation includes 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to assess impact against Bundibugyo and 50,000 doses for front-line health workers. Doses will be released immediately following Congo’s request via the International Coordinating Group. The outbreak has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (overall CFR about 47.5%, up to ~70% in North Kivu). Spread is about three times faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. Investigators trace initial transmission to Mongbwalu, with activity possibly starting as early as February; outbreak declared May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最速のエボラ流行に対抗するためエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおいて史上最速とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が進行中で、症例数5,208例、死亡2,476例、致死率約47.5%（北キブでは最大70%）と極めて深刻。6州に拡大し国際的な緊急ワクチン供給が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 流行株はエボラウイルスではなくブンディブギョウイルスであり、既存のErveboワクチンの有効性は未確立（第3相試験実施中）。ICG（国際調整グループ）を通じた緊急対応が進行中で、国際的な支援体制が既に稼働している点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 70mila vaccini per fermare l'epidemia record in Congo: ma c'è una domanda ancora aperta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 70,000 vaccines to stop the record-breaking outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but there remains one unanswered question.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses were released for immediate use in the Democratic Republic of the Congo by the International Coordinating Group, aiming to curb the largest Ebola outbreak the country has seen. Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus, while the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a related but distinct species, so cross-protection in humans remains unproven. As of August 20, the Bundibugyo outbreak has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality ~48%). The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is spreading faster than any prior Ebola outbreak, with six provinces affected and new cases arising beyond known contact chains. Doses are allocated as 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess real-world efficacy and 50,000 for frontline health workers. By August 9, health workers had at least 155 infections and 45 deaths. Ongoing conflict, displacement, weak health services, and distrust in eastern DRC hinder rapid diagnosis, isolation, infection control, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での記録的な流行を止めるため7万本のワクチンを投入、しかし未解決の疑問が残る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・過去最速の拡大を見せるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、6州に拡大し既知の接触者以外にも感染が広がっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 現行流行の病原体はブンディブギョウイルスであり、承認済みワクチンErveboはザイールエボラウイルス向けのため交差防御は未証明。医療従事者にも多数感染が発生しており、紛争・避難民・医療体制の脆弱性が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: International Groups Sending 70,000 Doses of Ebola Vaccine to Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO and partners are sending 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine to Congo to support the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven, though preliminary lab and animal data suggest possible protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will back a phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo; the remainder is for frontline health workers. The International Coordinating Group, including Doctors Without Borders, the Red Cross, and UNICEF, approved the release, with a target to deliver within 10 days. Congo reported the outbreak began in mid-May with detection delays due to initial testing not identifying Bundibugyo. Totals: 5,208 confirmed cases, 2,476 deaths (case fatality rate 47.5%). The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak remains the deadliest Ebola event.

triage.headline_ja: 国際団体、コンゴへエボラワクチン7万回分を送付
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでブンディブギョ株エボラが5,208例・致死率47.5%という深刻な規模で発生しており、WHO・国際機関が緊急ワクチン投入を行っている異常事態のためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー中でAngolaへの言及はなくコンゴ国内の発生・対応のみが記述されているため除外した。既承認のZaire株用ワクチン(Ervebo)をBundibugyo株に適用する臨床試験の実施も含め、既に国際的な緊急対応が進行中の重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: La reserva mundial de vacunas libera 70.000 dosis de vacunas contra el ébola para la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The global vaccine stockpile releases 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Seventy thousand Ebola vaccine doses were released to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to aid the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak response. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a clinical trial to test whether Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) protects against Bundibugyo in humans, despite its approval for Zaire ebolavirus and limited evidence of efficacy for Bundibugyo. The remaining 50,000 doses are for frontline health workers. As of 2026-08-20, the DRC reports 5,021 laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease cases and 2,378 deaths across 55 health zones in six provinces, with intense transmission and geographic spread driven by population movement, complicating containment. OMS and Africa CDC emphasize community-focused response; the ICG, comprising WHO, IFRC, MSF, and UNICEF, coordinates stockpile management with Gavi funding.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ワクチン備蓄がコンゴ民主共和国向けにエボラワクチン7万回分を放出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,021例・2,378人死亡という大規模なBundibugyoエボラ流行が55保健区・6州に拡大しており、国際的なワクチン備蓄放出と臨床試験が行われるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対するErvebo(rVSV-ZEBOV)の有効性は限定的なエビデンスしかなく、臨床試験実施中。人口移動による地理的拡大が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Terceiro caso fatal de febre maculosa em Americana reforça o alerta para os cuidados com carrapatos e a proteção da família - Portal Pet News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third Fatal Case of Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Americana Reinforces the Warning About Tick Precautions and Protecting the Family - Portal Pet News
article.articleSummary: Third fatal Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever case in Americana, São Paulo, Brazil, underscores tick-borne disease risk. The fatal human infection is caused by Rickettsia rickettsii and transmitted by the star tick (Amblyomma sp.), with dogs potentially affected and acting as sentinels. The brown dog tick (Rhipicephalus sanguineus) thrives in urban/domestic spaces and is the main vector of canine hemoparasitoses such as ehrlichiosis and babesiosis. Even with regular antiparasitics, no method blocks tick contact; a tick may climb onto a dog during walks and be carried indoors before the medication acts, posing risk to families. Canine diseases can be subclinical for weeks or years and flare with immunity changes. Prevention advice: post-walk checks focusing on ears, paws, underbelly; consistent antiparasitic and deworming per vet; wear closed shoes and light clothing in grassy areas; keep yards trimmed and free of debris; routine monitoring to tailor protection. One Health context emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカーナ市でロッキー山紅斑熱による3例目の死亡例、マダニ対策と家族防護への警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州アメリカーナ市でマダニ媒介性のロッキー山紅斑熱による死亡例が3例確認されたが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。局所的な公衆衛生上の懸念として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本疾患はブラジルの都市部で既知のマダニ媒介性人獣共通感染症であり、記事はペットニュースサイトによる予防啓発記事。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、致死例の継続的発生には注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : 70.000 doses de vaccin Ervebo mises à disposition de la RDC, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine made available to the DRC, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the WHO allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses against Zaire ebolavirus, excluding Bundibugyo. Of them, 20,000 fund a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on Bundibugyo, while 50,000 are for frontline health workers. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15 in northern and eastern regions with fragile governance; the response has struggled amid surging cases. The outbreak has caused 2,420 deaths among 5,105 confirmed cases, the deadliest and fastest-growing in the country. The allocation follows a request to the Global Coordination Group stockpile, with Gavi support. WHO Director-General Tedros praised the decision. It remains uncertain whether Ervebo protects Bundibugyo in humans; early lab/animal data hint at possible protection. Trials include Moderna and Oxford vaccines; a promising rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine is in development by Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids and has killed over 15,000 in Africa in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOによると、コンゴ民主共和国にエルベボワクチン7万回分が提供された
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪・最速拡大とされる第17次エボラ流行が進行中で、死者2,420人・確定症例5,105人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHO・Gaviによる国際支援（ワクチン供給）が行われているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの第17次エボラ流行とワクチン配布に関するもの。シンガポールはワクチン開発機関（Hilleman Laboratories）の所在地として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ / 70.000 εμβόλια στο Κονγκό για τον Έμπολα χωρίς να έχει αποδειχθεί η αποτελεσματικότητά του στο συγκεκριμένο στέλεχος
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO / 70,000 vaccines in the Congo for Ebola without proven effectiveness against the specific strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO is coordinating a large vaccination campaign in the Democratic Republic of Congo for the current Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. A total of 70,000 doses of Ervebo (Zaire strain vaccine) will be distributed: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for the Zaire strain; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unproven, though early laboratory data and animal studies suggest potential protection. The outbreak, declared on May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, is concentrated in northern and eastern regions with weak health infrastructure. WHO data report 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country to date. Additional Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in development: Moderna and Oxford candidates, and a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine from Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: WHO／コンゴでエボラ対策として7万回分のワクチンを接種、当該株への有効性は未証明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最多の死者数を出す第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が継続中で、WHOが大規模ワクチン接種を主導しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: シンガポールはBundibugyo株用ワクチン（rVSV）の開発拠点として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCで史上最多となる5,105症例・2,420死亡が報告されており、ザイール株用ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性が未証明のまま大規模接種が実施されている点は重大な懸念事項。
