Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: A 60-Year-Old Succumbs To H1N1 Virus In Ujjain
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak continues in Madhya Pradesh during the monsoon, with a fatal case reported from Ujjain. A 60-year-old woman, Saroj Nagar of Rishi Nagar, died after testing positive for H1N1; swabs were sent to Ahmedabad on July 30 and showed no other infection. She first sought care in Ujjain on July 27 for breathing problems, cold and cough; RT-PCR testing at a Gujarat lab yielded confirmation on July 31. After confirmation, she was admitted to a private hospital in Indore on August 3 and treated for 16 days. She returned home to Rishi Nagar and died within an hour about two weeks later (around August 17, 2026). Family alleges health department negligence and lack of guidance post-diagnosis; Anganwadi workers subsequently collected information on the patient’s family members.

triage.headline_ja: ウッジャインでH1N1ウイルスにより60歳女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による単発の死亡例であり、地域的にモンスーン期に定期的に発生する既知の疾患であるため国際的な異常性は低いが、症例が死亡に至っている点と地域での流行継続の可能性から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドでモンスーン期に季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、本記事は単発死亡例と遺族による医療機関への対応不備の訴えを扱った地域ニュースの色合いが強い。マディヤ・プラデーシュ州での流行継続が記載されているため、続報があれば規模拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Difterite cos'è: sintomi, cause e vaccino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diphtheria: what it is, symptoms, causes, and vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria is an acute infection caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, mainly affecting the pharynx and nose, with skin ulcers in some forms. The toxin can damage the heart, kidneys, and nervous system. Transmission is primarily respiratory; incubation is 2–5 days and patients remain contagious for about six weeks, even if asymptomatic. Symptoms include sore throat, loss of appetite, and low fever, followed by a gray membrane on the tonsils or throat within 2–3 days, neck swelling, and possible airway obstruction. Skin infections cause painful lesions with a gray membrane. Severe complications include myocarditis, arrhythmias, heart failure, nerve palsies, and renal failure. Diagnosis relies on the membrane and laboratory confirmation from throat or skin samples; differential includes strep, mononucleosis, syphilis, candidiasis. Italy’s hexavalent vaccine at 3, 5, and 12 months, with boosters at 5–6 years and adolescence, yields very few cases; 2000–2018: five in the North. Endemic in South Asia, Africa, and Brazil; sporadic in Europe.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリアとは：症状、原因、ワクチンについて
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、ジフテリアに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、具体的な症例報告や公衆衛生上の緊急性は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患の一般解説であり、ブラジルは『流行地域』として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生事例の報告ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC va recevoir 70.000 doses de vaccin pour tenter d'enrayer l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC will receive 70,000 vaccine doses to try to curb the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine against Ebola from the WHO-managed global stock via the International Coordinating Group. Of these, 20,000 doses will support an advanced-stage clinical trial to evaluate Ervebo’s efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain; the remaining 50,000 doses will be used for frontline health workers and health professionals in line with WHO/SAGE guidance. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no vaccine or treatment is approved. It is unclear whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo, though laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection. All recipients will be informed and provide informed consent. To date, 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths have been reported, with about 730 hospitalized or isolated, 1,115 recovered, a 47.5% case fatality rate, and 84% contact tracing across 56 health zones in Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国が流行阻止のためワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ大流行で5,208例確定・2,476人死亡（致死率47.5%）、56保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、Ervebo（Merckのエボラワクチン）の有効性を検証する臨床試験が進行中。WHO/ICGを通じた国際支援が既に行われている大規模アウトブレイク事例。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya passa de 10 mil casos e volta a subir 66% em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Surpasses 10,000 Cases and Rises 66% Again in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, reaches 10,041 laboratory-confirmed cases and 30 deaths in 2026, with one death under investigation; 12,663 probable cases and 114 pregnant women infected, per SES-MS. By Aug 15, MS logged 12,663 probable cases this year (about 89.5% of 2025’s total). The week of Aug 9–15 recorded 178 probable cases, up from 107 in 2025’s 32nd week. Sidrolândia shows the highest recent incidence: 194 probable cases in 2026, with 74 in the first 15 days of August (157.1 per 100,000). Other early-August municipalities include Douradina, Amambai, Batayporã, Angélica, Ladário, Maracaju, Rio Verde de Mato Grosso, Bonito, Jardim, and Dourados. Dourados accounts for 18 deaths (60% of MS total). Victims ranged from 1 month to 94 years; 20 men and 10 women; comorbidities include hypertension, diabetes, cancer, cardiopathy, and chronic kidney disease, with five victims lacking known preexisting conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱が1万件を超え、再び66%増加
triage.triage_reason: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱の症例数が急増（前年比66%増、既に前年総数の89.5%に到達）し、死亡者30名・妊婦感染114名を記録するなど公衆衛生上の影響が大きく、複数自治体に拡大するベクター媒介感染症としてWPRO基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 州保健局(SES-MS)による公式データに基づく報道で、複数自治体（シドロランディア、ドウラードスなど）で症例増加。国際的拡大や渡航制限の言及はないが、地域内での急速な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ആഘോഷത്തിരക്കില്‍ പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധികൾക്കെതിരായ ജാഗ്രത കൈവെടിയരുത്: ആരോഗ്യമന്ത്രി മന്ത്രി കെ.മുരളീധരന്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't let your guard down against infectious diseases amid the celebrations: Health Minister K. Muralidharan.
article.articleSummary: Kerala Health Minister K. Muralidharan urged vigilance against mosquito-borne diseases during Onam celebrations in Thiruvananthapuram. The state marked World Mosquito Day with an inauguration at Valliyoorakkavu SFS Parish Hall. He warned against concealing the true burden of diseases and called for unified prevention efforts. Because Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays saw intensified anti-dengue vector-control campaigns in schools, offices, and homes, mosquito-borne illnesses have been contained. The next phase will coordinate health workers and local bodies to conduct door-to-door awareness campaigns. Ahead of the event, nursing college students performed a flash mob and health play. The programme was chaired by Health Kerala state program manager Anu.S. Nayar (IAS) with participation from the director of health, additional directors, the district medical officer, and the district malaria officer, among others. The gathering underscored ongoing public health education and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 祝祭の忙しさの中でも感染症への警戒を怠らないように：ケララ州保健大臣K.ムラリーダラン氏
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊デーに合わせた通常の啓発活動・予防キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な感染拡大や重症例の報告はなく、既に媒介制御で抑制されているとの記述がある。
triage.notes: 内容は世界蚊デーにあわせた保健大臣の啓発活動・注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: " L'assainissement du milieu, la seule voie pour éradiquer le paludisme en RDC " - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental sanitation: the only way to eradicate malaria in the DRC - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, World Mosquito Day, Kinshasa-based physician Dr. Patrick Masebo argued that environmental sanitation is the only route to eradicate malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Speaking to ACP, he, from La Main de Dieu health center in Lemba, said that malaria, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, remains the deadliest disease in the DRC and affects all ages. He noted that mosquitoes multiply most during the rainy season and still appear in the dry season, breeding in areas with trash and stagnant water. He added that hospitals routinely test for malaria due to sanitation-related health risks. He welcomed the government's creation of a National Service to combat urban unsanitation in Kinshasa and urged residents to support the effort toward a healthier, mosquito-free environment.

triage.headline_ja: 環境衛生こそがコンゴ民主共和国でマラリアを撲滅する唯一の道 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日に合わせた医師による一般的な公衆衛生啓発コメントであり、具体的な流行拡大や異常事態の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCで既知の風土病であり、本記事は世界蚊の日にちなむ啓発的コメント記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : des escortes armées annoncées pour la sécurisation des équipes de riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Armed escorts announced to secure Ebola response teams - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu Governor announces strengthened Ebola response in Beni following a Kisangani mission, including armed escorts for ambulances and intervention vehicles. The two-pronged strategy emphasizes population awareness and secured operations; any obstruction of health interventions or desecration of Ebola decedents will attract severe sanctions. The province has recorded multiple Ebola deaths, including a French neurosurgeon who aided local teams. Community resistance, linked to poorly informed youth, is condemned; authorities urge youths, civil groups, VDPs, and civil society to back health measures. Transmission is linked to high mobility between North Kivu and Ituri; multiple DRC provinces and Uganda are affected. Security committee convened to assess security and health situations. The response has strong support from the national government, WHO, ALIMA, IOM, and religious groups; ICCN provided five all-terrain vehicles, body bags, and thermo-flash devices. An extensive awareness campaign will be launched soon as part of the 17th Ebola outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ対応チームの安全確保のため武装護衛を発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで複数州とウガンダへの拡大が確認され、死亡例（フランス人医師含む）も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援が進行中のため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州・イトゥリ州における第17次エボラアウトブレイク対応に関するもの。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。コミュニティの抵抗や医療従事者の死亡など、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果獲7萬劑伊波拉疫苗　但尚未證實對現行病毒株有效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine, but its effectiveness against the current virus strain has not yet been proven.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization says the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine for trial and limited use to combat the outbreak, though its effectiveness against the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has not yet been proven. Ervebo is proven safe and effective against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but the ongoing outbreak in DRC involves Bundibugyo, a less common variant. Under the International Coordination Group for Vaccine Provision, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses are for frontline health workers. Uses align with SAGE recommendations. Since May 15, when the outbreak’s 17th wave was declared, DRC has reported over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths, the highest toll to date; the government requested vaccines last week.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラワクチン7万回分を獲得も、現行ウイルス株への有効性は未証明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行が継続し、5000例以上・2300人以上の死者と過去最悪の被害が報告されており、既存ワクチンの有効性も未確認であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 流行は2026年5月15日開始の第17波で、Bundibugyo株に対するErvebeワクチンの有効性は第3相試験で検証中。死者数が過去最多である点は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Συναγερμός στη ΛΔ Κονγκό - 70.000 δόσεις εμβολίου στη μάχη κατά της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Alarm in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - 70,000 vaccine doses in the fight against the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Ervebo are provided to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to confront a severe Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in the country, according to WHO. Ervebo is licensed for the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but not for Bundibugyo, the strain circulating in DRC. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will support a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 will be reserved for frontline health workers. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC, was declared on May 15 and is spreading in northern and eastern regions amid limited health infrastructure. WHO notes insufficient human data on Ervebo’s protection against Bundibugyo, though early lab/animal studies suggest potential protection; clinical evaluation in DRC is planned. The Global Interagency Coordination Group (GIG)—including WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF and funded by Gavi—coordinates vaccine supply and testing. Other vaccines in development include Moderna and Oxford candidates, plus rVSV Bundibugyo by Hilleman Laboratories.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で警戒 - 流行との闘いに7万回分のワクチン
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「同国史上最も致死的」とされる第17次エボラ流行が拡大中で、既存ワクチンが対象としないブンディブギョ株が原因であるという異常性・重大性がありIHR基準を2つ以上満たすため。
triage.notes: 流行株（ブンディブギョ）に対するワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性データが不十分であり、第3相試験を並行実施予定。国際機関（WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, Gavi）による支援体制が既に構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : l'assainissement recommandé aux habitants d'une commune pour éviter le paludisme - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Sanitation measures recommended to residents of a commune to prevent malaria - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo – In Bandalungwa commune, residents are urged to adopt sanitation measures to prevent malaria on World Mosquito Day (Aug 20, 2026). Malaria caused by Anopheles mosquitoes is highlighted; recommendations include eliminating standing water and discarding waste cans that serve as breeding sites. Control efforts by the Zone de Santé encompass insecticide-treated nets, rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs), and antimalarial medicines such as artesunate and Coartem (ACTs). At the Kimbondo Reference Health Center, semester data show 40% of malaria cases in children and 60% in adults; postpartum women are educated to reduce transmission, while cases declined during the dry season. The center, overseen by the Provincial Health Ministry in Bandalungwa’s urban zone, features a laboratory, delivery room, operating theater, and about 20 beds.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ:ある地区の住民にマラリア予防のための衛生対策が推奨される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日に合わせたルーティンの公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重症化の急増などを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: マラリアは同地域における風土病であり、季節性の啓発活動の一環と考えられる。乾季には症例が減少しているとの記載あり、異常な増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 70 ezer adag, korábbi járványoknál használt ebolavakcina érkezik a Kongói DK-ba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 70,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine used in previous outbreaks arriving in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO and partners announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, to be distributed immediately. Of these, 20,000 doses will enter a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo virus, while 50,000 doses go to frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and has not yet been approved for Bundibugyo; early lab and animal data hint at some protection. The outbreak, in eastern DRC across seven provinces, is spreading about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic and has a case fatality rate around 47.5%, potentially rising to 70% in hard-to-reach areas such as North Kivu. More than 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths have been recorded, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Most new cases occur among unregistered individuals, complicating tracking. Vaccine delivery is expected to bolster control along with surveillance, care, and community engagement; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the move a powerful example of global solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:過去の流行で使用されたエボラワクチン7万回分がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（症例5000超、死亡2300超、CFR約47.5%）が7州にわたり拡大中であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文で言及されているのはDRC国内（東部7州）のみであり、Angolaでの発生は記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 70.000 Dosen Ebola-Impfstoff gehen in Ausbruchsregion - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 70,000 Doses of Ebola Vaccine Go to Outbreak Regions - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleSummary: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses (Ervebo) to combat the outbreak. Of these, 50,000 are for frontline health workers, with 20,000 allocated to a Phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), the circulating variant. Ervebo was developed against Zaire ebolavirus; no BDBV-specific vaccine exists. WHO cites early lab data suggesting potential protection and hopes the trial will inform future use. Recipients will provide informed consent detailing risks, benefits, and limitations; vaccinated individuals should continue preventive measures. The attenuated live vaccine is approved for ages one year and older; safety in pregnancy is not established. The vaccine is provided by the WHO International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision, following a Congolese government request. The outbreak, detected May 15, affects northern and eastern provinces, with over 5,000 confirmed cases and more than 2,300 deaths—the worst Ebola outbreak in DR Congo history. Tedros warns it is not under control, with high risk of wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: 70,000回分のエボラワクチンが流行地域へ - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行（5000人超感染、2300人超死亡）で、WHO事務局長が制御不能かつ拡大リスク大と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行。新変種Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）に対する既存ワクチン（Ervebo、Zaire株用）の効果は未確立であり、第3相試験が並行実施される点が特筆される。WHOによる国際協調ワクチン供給の枠組みが発動しており、国際的関与・支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Sanidad acota el riesgo de ébola a los trabajadores en primera línea del brote en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health narrows Ebola risk to frontline workers in the Congo outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, Spain’s CCAES updated the Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of Congo, reporting 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths since May 15, making it the second deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. Uganda reported 20 infections and 2 deaths, with its outbreak declared over on 28 July. The risk to Spaniards traveling or residing in affected areas is deemed low, while frontline healthcare workers have the highest exposure risk. Reported imported cases in Spain are considered very unlikely to trigger sustained transmission due to adequate diagnostics and control measures. Spain maintains the Red Uatan network of high-risk infectious disease hospitals and procedures with NGOs to monitor deployed personnel. Travel to affected zones is discouraged; if unavoidable, consult an International Vaccination Center for current health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン保健省、コンゴでのエボラ流行に関するリスクを最前線の医療従事者に限定
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は5,208例・死亡2,476人に達し史上2番目に致死的な流行であり、国際的な監視・渡航制限の動きも見られるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は7月28日に終息宣言済み、スペインは輸入症例のリスク監視のみで対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 5 208 cas confirmés et 2 476 décès au 18 août, 2 000 doses d'Ervebo en Tshopo pour un vaccin non homologué contre Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths as of August 18, 2,000 doses of Ervebo in Tshopo for an unlicensed vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 18, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 5,208 lab-confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality 47.5%), with 1,115 recoveries and 730 patients in isolation or hospital. Contact tracing stands at 84%. Six provinces and 56 health zones are affected: Ituri (28/36), North Kivu (12/34), Tshopo (7/23), Haut-Uélé (6/13), Bas-Uele (2/11), and South Kivu’s Miti-Murhesa (79 days without a new case). On Aug 5, the government launched large-scale vaccination with Ervebo; 2,000 doses are available in Tshopo and a request for 500,000 additional doses was filed, with no International Group of Coordination decision announced. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola Zaïre, used here under a cross-protection hypothesis against Bundibugyo; efficacy data are not conclusive. Kinshasa engaged the GIC on Aug 12. Remdesivir is introduced; obeldésivir is considered for post-exposure prophylaxis, and 18 high-risk zones will pilot limited distance learning for 2026-2027.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:8月18日時点で5,208例の確定症例と2,476人の死亡、ツショポ州にはブンディブギョ型に対する未承認ワクチン用にエルベボ2,000回分
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（5,208症例、致死率47.5%）が6州56保健地区に拡大しており、未承認ワクチンの使用や国際調整グループへの支援要請など、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的懸念事項に該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対しエルベボ（ザイール型用ワクチン）の交差防御仮説に基づく使用が行われているが有効性データは未確定。国際調整グループ(GIC)への追加50万回分の要請が未決定である点にも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS a anunțat că RD Congo va primi 70.000 de doze de vaccin Ervebo împotriva Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced that the DRC will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, WHO announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine. Ervebo is identified as an Ebola vaccine, and the article centers on the planned shipment to the DRC. The piece does not provide additional information on Ebola outbreaks, case or death counts, symptomatology, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or vaccination logistics. No specifics are given about which regions within the DRC are targeted, timelines for delivery, or whether the doses are for ongoing immunization programs or outbreak response. The article's focus remains the vaccine allocation rather than epidemiological details or imported/exported-case information.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国がエボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受け取ると発表した
triage.triage_reason: エボラワクチンのDRCへの供給が発表されたのみで、実際の感染者数や死亡者数、発生地域などの疫学的詳細が一切示されておらず、現時点でアウトブレイクの実態が確認できないため。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: توفير 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح إرفيبو لسلالة بونديبوجيو من إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Providing 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) requested the release of Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses from the global stockpile to tackle the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. A first allocation of 70,000 doses was approved: 20,000 for a Phase 3 clinical trial to assess vaccine effects on Bundibugyo, and 50,000 for frontline health workers in line with SAGE recommendations. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks (formerly Ebola Zaire). It remains unclear whether Ervebo provides protection against Bundibugyo in humans; preliminary laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection, and the clinical trial is expected to yield critical evidence for policymakers. Informed consent and clear communication of risks/benefits are emphasized for trial participants or vaccine recipients. Global partners include WHO, IFRC, MSF, UNICEF, with Gavi funding, and Africa CDC alongside WHO supporting the DRC’s community-led response to end Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対しエルベボワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ・ブンディブギョ株のアウトブレイクが継続しており、WHOが世界備蓄からワクチン7万回分の放出を承認するなど国際的対応が進行中であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するエルベボワクチンの有効性は未確定であり、フェーズ3臨床試験（2万回分）と最前線医療従事者向け予防接種（5万回分）が並行して実施される。WHO、IFRC、MSF、UNICEF、Gavi、Africa CDCなど複数の国際機関が関与しており、社会的・政治的関心も高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, 70.000 dosi di Ervebo ma l'efficacia contro Bundibugyo resta da dimostrare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, 70,000 doses of Ervebo, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo remains to be demonstrated.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo to address a Bundibugyo virus outbreak. The WHO and Africa CDC announced the allocation via the International Coordination Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG): 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 randomized trial to assess Ervebo’s efficacy against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) and 50,000 doses for frontline health workers and response personnel per SAGE guidance. Ervebo, licensed for Ebola virus (EBOV, Zaire species), uses a recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus vector and has not demonstrated clinical efficacy against BDBV. Preliminary lab/animal data suggest possible protection, but human efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. The ICG mandates informed consent and ongoing evidence collection with community engagement to protect exposed individuals and inform future outbreaks. Since 2021, ICG allocations to DRC exceed 56,000 doses, with additional use in other African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ、エルベボ7万回分供給もブンディブギョ株への有効性は未証明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)のアウトブレイクに対しWHO/Africa CDCが大規模ワクチン供給を実施しており、公衆衛生上の重大性・国際的関与が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクへのワクチン対応が主題であり、ワクチン自体の分類上「Vesicular Stomatitis」がタグ付けされているが疾病発生ではなくワクチンベクターの説明である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: चिड़ियाघरों में वन्यजीवों से मनुष्यों तक संक्रमण रोकने की तैयारी, भोपाल की निहसाद लैब में बनेगा 'हेल्थ सेंटिनल' सिस्टम - bhopal nihsd to build health sentinel system for zoos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preparation to prevent transmission from wildlife to humans in zoos, a 'Health Sentinel' system will be built at NIHSAD Lab in Bhopal
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, India unveils a One Health-based Health Sentinel system to be developed at NIHSAD in Bhopal to prevent pathogen transmission between wildlife in zoos and people. The system will monitor areas around cages, feeding zones, caregiver access points, and touch zones. Regular sampling from wildlife, zoo staff, and surrounding environments will screen for zoonotic pathogens, including avian influenza (bird flu), swine influenza (swine flu), and rabies. Early alerts will be issued if animals or staff show abnormal symptoms, enabling rapid containment. Health data from each zoo will be entered into a central portal to analyze disease patterns and inform preparedness. NIHSAD scientists will train veterinarians and zoo personnel in sample collection, biosafety, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 動物園での野生動物からヒトへの感染拡大を防止するための準備、ボパールのNIHSAD研究所に「ヘルスセンチネル」システムを構築
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、動物園における人獣共通感染症の予防的モニタリングシステム構築に関する報道であるため、シグナルとして扱う対象ではない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、インド・ボパールのNIHSADにおける動物園向け予防的サーベイランスシステム（One Healthアプローチ）の構築に関する記事。具体的な感染症発生や症例報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: 70.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo τίθενται στη διάθεση στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine are being made available in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine are being allocated by WHO to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak health infrastructure. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will serve a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s impact on the Bundibugyo strain, while 50,000 are for frontline workers and health professionals in the DRC. The outbreak has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, per WHO, making it the deadliest Ebola surge in the DRC to date. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus but not Bundibugyo; early lab and animal data hint at possible protection. On Aug 7, WHO recommended evaluating Ervebo in-country. Two Bundibugyo vaccines—Moderna (mRNA) and University of Oxford—are in clinical trials, while a promising rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine from Hilleman Laboratories is under development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：エルベボワクチン7万回分がコンゴ民主共和国で使用可能に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（確定5,105例、死亡2,420例）は同国史上最悪規模で、WHOがワクチン配布や臨床試験を主導するなど国際的対応が続いており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本流行はザイール株ではなくBundibugyo株が主体で、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）の効果が未確立なため、臨床試験（第3相）を通じた評価が進行中。致死率・死亡者数が過去最悪であり、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDC Recorre à Vacina Ervebo Para Travar Surto Causado Pela Estirpe Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DRC Resorts to the Ervebo Vaccine to Halt an Outbreak Caused by the Bundibugyo Strain
article.articleSummary: DRC has been allocated 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses from the global stock managed by the ICG, with 20,000 earmarked for an advanced-stage trial to test Ervebo against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The eastern DRC outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccines or treatments are currently approved. WHO cautions that Ervebo’s protection against Bundibugyo in humans is unproven and will depend on clinical trial results. Ervebo is approved to prevent disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus, the more common strain. Confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC exceed 5,000, making this the 17th outbreak in the country and the largest by case count; by late July, 2,378 deaths were reported, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. ICG members include WHO, IFRC/Red Cross, MSF, and UNICEF.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ株による流行を食い止めるためエルベボワクチンを使用
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した過去最大規模（5000例超、死亡2378人）のエボラ流行であり、承認薬・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による国際的懸念事項であるため。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEICが宣言された史上最大規模のエボラ流行（DRC、Bundibugyo株）。承認済みワクチン(Ervebo)は本来Zaire株用であり、Bundibugyo株への効果は臨床試験結果待ちで未確定。ICG（WHO、赤十字、MSF、UNICEFなど）による国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果將獲得7萬劑Ervebo伊波拉疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo to receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, the World Health Organization announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine. Ervebo is approved for preventing Zaire ebolavirus but not yet for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain underlying the current outbreak; early laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will support a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 will be allocated to frontline health workers per WHO guidance. The DRC outbreak has reached 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths—the highest counts on record—with rapid transmission and many new cases not linked to monitored populations, challenging surveillance and relief efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴがEbolaワクチンErvebo 7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は過去最多の5,208症例・2,476死亡に達し、追跡不能な新規感染も多く発生。WHOによるワクチン供給・第3相試験実施など国際的関与が高く、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses as Bundibugyo outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses from the UN’s ICG will be shipped to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to confront the Bundibugyo outbreak. The vaccine targets Zaire ebolavirus; early lab/animal data suggest it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, but clinical trial results are essential for policy. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for a clinical trial in the DRC and 50,000 for frontline health workers. As of 20 August 2026, the outbreak has reached 5,021 cases and 2,325 deaths; more than 160 health workers infected, 40 killed. Ongoing eastern DRC conflict with the M23 group hampers containment, with reports the group suspending cross-border travel to affected zones. WHO welcomed the allocation as global solidarity; the ICG has previously allocated 56,000 doses to DRC outbreaks since 2021.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行拡大を受けワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,021症例・2,325死亡に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、紛争により対応が阻害され国際的なワクチン支援が行われていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: M23武装勢力による紛争が対応を妨げており、医療従事者への感染・死亡も多数発生。国際調整グループ(ICG)によるワクチン配分は今後の流行制御の鍵となる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo to get 70,000 Ebola vaccines to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has been allocated 70,000 Ervebo vaccines from the global stockpile to contain the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. The WHO (2026-08-20) allocates 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to assess vaccine impact on Bundibugyo virus and 50,000 for frontline and health workers, per SAG-E recommendations. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease (Zaire ebolavirus), with early laboratory/animal data suggesting possible protection against Bundibugyo, though human efficacy is unconfirmed. WHO calls this a global solidarity effort. The Congo outbreak has 5,208 confirmed infections and 2,476 deaths (case fatality 47.5%), across 56 health zones in Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo. About 730 patients are in isolation, 1,115 recovered; the outbreak is a public health emergency of international concern, and death toll now exceeds 2018-2020.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行を抑制するため7万回分のワクチンを取得へ

triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。ブンディブギョ・ウイルスに対する有効なワクチン・治療薬は未確立で、Ervebo(Zaire ebolavirus用)の有効性は未確認のまま第3相試験と最前線医療従事者への接種が進められている。既に2018-2020年流行の死者数を上回っており、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: ΟΗΕ: Εβδομήντα χιλιάδες δόσεις του εμβολίου για τον Έμπολα τίθενται στη διάθεση της ΛΔ Κονγκό (ΠΟΥ)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Seventy thousand doses of the Ebola vaccine are made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (WHO).
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization allocates 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid its 17th outbreak. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to assess the vaccine’s impact against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while 50,000 doses are for frontline workers and health professionals in the DRC. The outbreak, declared May 15, peaks in northern and eastern regions with weak governmental presence and strained health infrastructure. WHO reports 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, rendering it the deadliest Ebola surge ever recorded in the DRC and spreading at an unprecedented pace. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; efficacy against Bundibugyo is being evaluated in the ongoing trial.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الكونغو الديمقراطية ستتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح مضاد لفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of an Ebola virus vaccine.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, announced by the WHO and partners. Ervebo has proven effectiveness in past Ebola outbreaks, though it is not yet confirmed to protect against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; laboratory and animal data suggest potential protection. The vaccine shipment aims to strengthen containment as the outbreak persists, with authorities stating that, if adequately resourced, transmission could be controlled within three months. As of August 20, 2026, Africa CDC data report 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths in the current outbreak, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, a relatively rare form of Ebola. Clinical trials continue for prevention and treatment options. Officials warn transmission remains active within the DRC and could spread to neighboring countries. Imported/exported case details are not provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続中で、確定症例5,021人・死亡2,378人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、近隣国への拡大懸念もあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は比較的まれなエボラウイルス株で、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確認である点にも注意が必要。CFRが約47%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ الصحة العالمية: الكونغو الديمقراطية ستتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح مضاد لفيروس (إيبولا)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization and partners announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine. The DRC is contending with a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with confirmed cases surpassing 5,000 and 2,378 deaths reported by Africa CDC’s AFRO as of August 20, 2026. Ervebo has proven efficacy in prior outbreaks, but it is not yet clear whether it provides protection against Bundibugyo; laboratory and animal studies suggest it may offer some protection. Distribution of these doses is expected to bolster containment efforts; officials say the outbreak could be brought under control within three months if adequate resources are available. The current transmission remains within the country, though there are warnings about continued spread and potential spillover to neighboring countries.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo to use Ervebo vaccine in Ebola outbreak after 70,000-dose allocation
article.articleSummary: DRC to deploy Ervebo vaccine to curb the Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak after allocation of 70,000 doses from the global stockpile. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven, though early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will support a Phase 3 trial to assess impact against Bundibugyo, with 50,000 for frontline health workers per WHO guidance. The trial could clarify cross-species vaccine efficacy and inform broader use. Vaccination is described as a central pillar; 2,000 doses are already in Tshopo, and there is a request for an additional 500,000 doses to expand coverage. As of Tuesday, the DRC reported 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with 1,115 recoveries and 730 in isolation. The outbreak, declared May 15, is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-largest globally.

triage.notes: 本流行はDRC史上最大・最も致死的なエボラ流行であり、世界でも2番目に大きい規模。Bundibugyoウイルス種に対するErvebo(ザイール株用)の有効性は未確認で、Phase 3試験が進行中。追加50万回分のワクチン要請あり、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго направлены 70 тысяч доз вакцины против Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine have been sent to DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC welcomed allocation of 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to tackle the ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Of the doses, 20,000 will be used in a Phase 3 trial to evaluate efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while 50,000 are planned for frontline health workers and responders, per WHO’s Strategic Advisory Group of Experts (SAGE) guidance. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks caused by Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unproven in humans, though preliminary laboratory and animal studies indicate potential protection. Vaccination will be voluntary with informed consent. The effort, supported by WHO and Africa CDC, emphasizes community engagement. The global stock is managed by the International Coordination Group for Vaccine Provision, whose members include WHO, IFRC, MSF, and UNICEF.

article.articleHeadline: No Dia D da Multivacinação, Saúde também vacinará contra Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On Multivaccination D-Day, Health will also vaccinate against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination drive alongside multivaccination efforts will take place on 22 August in the municipality. Ten UBSs will be open 08:00–16:00 to vaccinate children and adolescents under 15. Adults 18–59 can receive a single-dose chikungunya vaccine at Plaza Avenida Shopping (Teatro Plaza Cultural, 2nd floor) on 22 August, 12:00–17:00. Riopreto Shopping hosted a chikungunya vaccination on 15 August, administering 133 doses; the municipality currently has 1,000 doses stored in a temporary stock. The chikungunya vaccine is single-dose. Contraindications: pregnant or breastfeeding women, immunosuppressed individuals, and those with comorbidities. Outside the shopping event, vaccination is available Monday–Friday at all UBSs and at the Regional North Pediatric Care Center. This initiative supports SDGs 3, 16, and 17.

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح إرفيبو المضاد لفيروس إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo receives 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine - Al-Shorouk Portal.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) receives 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to curb what officials call the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, spreading across six eastern provinces with rising deaths. Ervebo is licensed against Ebola virus but not Bundibugyo, the strain driving this outbreak; laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, though efficacy remains unproven. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a Phase 3 trial to assess the vaccine's impact on Bundibugyo, and 50,000 will vaccinate frontline health workers and others in contact with patients, per WHO recommendations. DRC will receive and deploy the doses upon government request. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called this a tangible global solidarity effort, emphasizing surveillance, rapid detection, care, community engagement, and vaccination to contain transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Health department observes World Mosquito Day with intensive vector-control drives across Keralam
article.articleSummary: On World Mosquito Day, observed on August 20, 2026, Kerala's Health department launched intensified vector-control drives and urged households, institutions, and communities to eliminate mosquito-breeding sources to curb vector-borne diseases, notably dengue. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan inaugurated the observance at Vattiyurkavu, a dengue and chikungunya hotspot. Despite extensive surveillance and control, mosquito-borne diseases remain entrenched in the state, with dengue particularly acute; other diseases reported include malaria, filariasis, West Nile, and Japanese encephalitis. A Nature study (August 2025) across Wayanad, Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, Idukki, and Thiruvananthapuram found 108 mosquito species, with 14 established vectors; Aedes albopictus dominated, while A. aegypti remains the primary dengue vector. Artificial habitats such as discarded plastics, tyres, pots, and coconut shells drive breeding. Control emphasis is on source reduction around homes, hotspots, migrant camps, and construction sites; rainfall patterns and warm spells in Thiruvananthapuram accelerate breeding. Community participation remains central.

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ отправит в ДР Конго 70 тыс. доз вакцины от лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO will send 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO will send 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Of these, 20,000 doses are allocated for a Phase III clinical trial involving volunteers, while 50,000 doses will go to clinicians and social-service workers on the front lines of response. The Ervebo vaccine, designed to protect against Zaire ebolavirus, may not be fully protective against the Bundibugyo strain under current evidence. Preliminary laboratory data and animal studies suggest some level of protection. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the decision a demonstration of global solidarity and pledged continued support for intensified surveillance, rapid detection, quality medical care, public education, and vaccination efforts to bring the outbreak under control. Latest reports show 5,021 Ebola cases in the DRC, with 2,378 deaths.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Distribution of 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization stated that the Democratic Republic of the Congo requested release of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses from the global stock managed by the International Coordinating Group to address an ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Of these doses, 20,000 are allocated for Phase 3 clinical trials to evaluate the vaccine’s effect on Bundibugyo, and 50,000 are reserved for frontline health workers, in line with WHO/UNAIDS SAGE guidance. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks (formerly Zaire ebolavirus). Early data suggest potential protection against Bundibugyo, but human efficacy remains unproven, necessitating trials to inform future policy on vaccine use. The release follows the Congolese government’s request and aims to bolster outbreak response and protection for health workers.

triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はエボラウイルス属の中でも稀な株であり、既存のエルベボワクチン（ザイール株用）の有効性は未確立。国際調整グループ(ICG)からのワクチン放出要請および第3相臨床試験の実施が進行中で、アウトブレイクの規模・地理的拡大状況については記事内に具体的記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo bekommt 70.000 Impfdosen gegen Ebola und hofft auf Wirksamkeit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo receives 70,000 vaccine doses against Ebola and hopes for efficacy.
article.articleSummary: WHO to deliver 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help contain the current outbreak, dominated by the Bundibugyo variant for which no licensed vaccine exists. Twenty thousand doses will support a third-phase clinical study to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo; the remaining 50,000 go to frontline health workers and health-sector staff. Ervebo is a live-attenuated, single-dose vaccine; UNICEF says it can confer protection and may be used reactively after exposure. It was first deployed in DR Congo during the 2018–2020 outbreak among contacts of the Zaire variant. The vaccine is not widely used, reserved for those at highest risk. The outbreak has caused more than 2,400 deaths and over 5,200 infections since it was declared in mid-May; vaccination is expected to begin on Monday. Lab and animal data hint protection against Bundibugyo, but specific efficacy against this variant remains under study.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo to get 70,000 Ebola vaccines to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has received 70,000 Ervebo vaccines from the global Ebola vaccine stockpile to contain the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to better understand the vaccine’s impact on Bundibugyo virus, while 50,000 shots are allocated for frontline and health workers, following Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization recommendations. No vaccine or specific treatment is approved for Bundibugyo virus; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease and may offer protection against Bundibugyo in humans only by early laboratory and animal data, according to the WHO. The outbreak is the deadliest in Congo’s history, with 5,208 confirmed infections and 2,476 deaths (case fatality rate 47.5%), spanning 56 health zones in Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo. About 730 patients remain in isolation or hospital, and 1,115 have recovered. The WHO has declared this outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC welcome allocation of Ebola vaccines to DRC
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses allocated to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) by the International Coordinating Group: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess Merck’s Ervebo vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 for frontline and health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Early laboratory and animal studies suggest Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, but human efficacy is unproven. The trial is expected to provide evidence to guide future use. WHO and Africa CDC emphasize informed consent due to risks, benefits, and trial limitations. Government data show confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC have surpassed 5,000 with about 2,378 deaths; the outbreak became the country’s largest on record in late July. WHO Director-General Tedros reaffirmed the outbreak as a global emergency.

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果获世卫提供7万剂伊波拉病毒疫苗

Ervebo has proven safe and effective against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unconfirmed. Distribution via the International Coordination Group for Vaccine Provision aligns with guidance from the Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization. Vaccine allocations reflect ongoing international support while authorities continue containment and treatment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果、WHOより7万回分のエボラワクチン提供を受ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が発生し、5000人超の症例・2300人超の死亡（過去最多）を記録しており、新型株（Bundibugyoウイルス）への対応も含め国際的な緊急支援が行われているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行は2026年5月15日に宣言され、致死率が高い状況。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株に対するErvebo(rVSV-ZEBOV)ワクチンの有効性は未確認であり、第3相試験を通じて評価予定。

article.articleHeadline: MP: Probe ordered after 62-year-old woman dies following H1N1 treatment in Indore
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026 a 62-year-old woman from Ujjain who tested positive for H1N1 died at her home in Ujjain after treatment at a private hospital in Indore, where she had been admitted and discharged against medical advice on 18 August. Indore CMHO Dr. Madhav Hasani said the hospital initially withheld her H1N1 status; the health department later confirmed the infection and issued a notice and notifiable-disease reporting obligations. A high-level team of two specialists and an epidemiologist was formed to review the patient’s medical records and hospital files; action against the facility will follow the investigation findings, with notices already issued through the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) and Nursing Home Act provisions. June–August’s seasonal humidity can amplify viral infections; residents were urged to guard against vector-borne diseases by eliminating standing water and keeping stored water covered.

triage.headline_ja: MP州：インドール市でH1N1治療後に62歳女性が死亡、調査命令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)による単発の死亡例であり、病院の対応や報告義務違反に関する行政調査が主題。公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性H1N1による単発死亡例とそれに伴う病院の情報隠蔽・報告義務違反への行政調査が主題であり、感染症の異常発生や集団感染を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Maceió reforça importância do combate ao mosquito Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maceió's Health Department emphasizes the importance of combating the Aedes aegypti mosquito.
article.articleSummary: On World Mosquito Day, August 20, Maceió, Brazil's Municipal Health Department emphasizes combat against Aedes aegypti to reduce dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever risks. The SMS maintains ongoing surveillance, breeding-site control, and health education, with field agents identifying and eliminating breeding spots and expanding community awareness in public spaces and schools. Dengue vaccination, in partnership with the Ministry of Health, targets children and adolescents aged 10–14, with school-based immunization driven by the Immunization Coordination and the Health in School Program. Preventive actions focus on eliminating standing water, keeping water tanks sealed, cleaning gutters, and discarding unused containers. A historical note recalls 20 August 1897, when Sir Ronald Ross identified the malaria parasite in a female Anopheles, confirming mosquitoes as disease vectors.

triage.headline_ja: マセイオ保健局、ネッタイシマカ対策の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日に合わせた啓発・予防活動の紹介記事であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生広報活動である。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発活動と歴史的トリビア（ロス卿のマラリア原虫発見）を紹介する内容で、実際の症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Over 87,600 TB cases detected in Bihar screening drive: Official
article.articleSummary: During July 2–August 14, 2026, Bihar detected 87,623 TB cases through an intensive statewide screening after screening 2.36 crore people against a target of 1 crore. Among detections, 21,550 were asymptomatic. The state's diagnostic network includes 491 digital X-ray machines (140 AI-powered handheld), 768 binocular microscopes, 89 CBNAAT machines, 562 Truenat machines, plus LPA and CDST labs. Identification of 11,055 high‑risk villages and over 5.4 lakh camps since March 24, 2026, bolster TB detection. Governance notes: governor-supported TB-free panchayats; chief minister and chief secretary weekly reviews. Of the 87,623 cases, 74,871 (85%) were assessed for differentiated TB care. Bihar reported an 88% TB treatment success rate in 2024, with mortality dropping from 21 to 20 per lakh between 2023 and 2024. Under TB-Free India, 547 panchayats achieved TB-free status; TB Preventive Treatment is in place across all 38 districts.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州のスクリーニング活動で8万7600件超の結核症例を検出：当局発表
triage.triage_reason: 既存の国家結核対策プログラム（TB-Free India）の一環としての計画的スクリーニング活動による症例発見数の報告であり、突発的な異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではない。治療成功率88%、死亡率も減少傾向にあり管理下にある。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性的な風土病であり、本記事は州政府の既存スクリーニングプログラムの実績報告（治療成功率88%、死亡率減少傾向）。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: بعد ظهور أول حالة في الصين .. اكتشف أعراض إنفلونزا الخنازير
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the first case appeared in China, discover the symptoms of swine flu.
article.articleSummary: First reported case of H1N2v swine flu in a child in China sparked global concern. HealthandMe lists symptoms for H1N2v as fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, cough, runny nose, sore throat, eye irritation, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. The US CDC notes illnesses caused by mutated influenza viruses are generally mild and resemble seasonal flu, but some cases have been severe, requiring hospitalization and, in certain instances, resulting in death. As of 2026-08-20, the article emphasizes that H1N2v can lead to serious outcomes despite typically mild presentations.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で最初の症例が確認された後...豚インフルエンザの症状を発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国におけるH1N2v豚インフルエンザの初症例報告で異常性はあるが、感染経路・重症度・ヒト-ヒト感染の有無など詳細情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な症状解説が中心で、中国での症例の詳細な臨床経過や公衆衛生対応についての情報が乏しい。アメリカも発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは中国の症例が主題であり、米国での発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS destina vacunas para combatir brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO allocates vaccines to combat Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO allocates 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to confront the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Of the total, 20,000 doses fund a phase 3 trial to test Ervebo’s protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses shield health workers and frontline staff per SAGE guidance. This comes during the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths as of 12 August, spanning six provinces and 54 health zones. Ervebo is the only vaccine authorized for Ebola caused by Zaire ebolavirus, but there is no vaccine specifically approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; evidence of cross-protection is limited and use is within a controlled research framework. Response measures include surveillance, contact tracing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, and community engagement, as WHO and Africa CDC coordinate with Congo authorities to intensify the response. The outbreak originated in Ituri province and has since expanded.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行対策のためワクチンを配分
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）流行が記録上最大規模（4,665症例、2,184死亡）に達し、6州54保健地域に拡大しており、国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性のいずれにも該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行の継続報道であり、既にWHO・Africa CDCが介入中。Bundibugyoウイルスに対する承認済みワクチンがない点も注視すべき異常性要素。

article.articleHeadline: Cataluña declara su primera semana sin positivos por peste porcina africana desde el inicio del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Catalonia declares its first week without positive cases of African swine fever since the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Catalonia reports its first week with no positive African swine fever cases since the outbreak began in November last year, after authorities captured 333 wild boars in high- and low-risk areas over seven days and found no infections. No positives means the region does not reset its status; to regain disease-free status, a full year must pass without new positives from the last case. Measures stay in place: restrictions on access to natural areas within the risk zone, including Collserola Park and 19 municipalities. The wildlife-control plan uses 24 traps, 94 pig brigs, and 353 closures to reduce boar movement. Economically, humans are not at risk, but the sector suffers: more than 100 export certificates blocked. Live pig price averages €1.18/kg; production cost €1.34/kg (-30.2% YoY). Exports rose 0.8% to 2.745 million tonnes, value down 3.4% to €8.486 billion, with China down 34.2% to €199.1 million (Jan–Mar).

triage.headline_ja: カタルーニャ州、アフリカ豚熱の発生開始以来初めて陽性例ゼロの週を報告
triage.triage_reason: 発生国スペイン（カタルーニャ）は対象国リストに含まれず、疾患は動物由来で人への健康リスクはないと明記されており、状況も改善傾向にあるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・カタルーニャ州における豚のASF流行状況と輸出経済への影響を報告するもので、対象国（中国等）は貿易統計の文脈でのみ言及されており、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: Εβδομήντα χιλιάδες δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo τίθενται στη διάθεση της ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Seventy thousand doses of the Ervebo vaccine are made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak has prompted the World Health Organization to release 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses. Of these, 20,000 are for a phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 are for frontline workers and health professionals in the DRC. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak state presence and strained health systems, has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, the deadliest in the DRC to date. Last week the DRC requested Ervebo from the global stockpile, with UNICEF, the IFRC, MSF, and Gavi supporting; GIG notified of the first immediate allocation. It is not yet known if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo in humans; early data suggest possible protection. Other Bundibugyo vaccines are in trials (Moderna; Oxford), and a rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by Hilleman Labs is in development. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：エルベボワクチン7万回分がコンゴ民主共和国に提供される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ第17次流行は確定症例5,105人・死者2,420人と過去最悪規模で、WHOによるワクチン大量放出など国際的対応が進行しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約47%）、脆弱な保健システム地域での流行拡大が懸念される。第3相試験を含む複数のワクチン開発・展開が進行中で、国際機関（WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, Gavi）の支援が動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS a anunţat că RD Congo va primi 70.000 de doze de vaccin Ervebo împotriva Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced that DR Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization announced that the Democratic Republic of Congo will receive 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against the Bundibugyo strain and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15 in northern and eastern regions with fragile governance and weak health infrastructure; the outbreak has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, the deadliest Ebola episode in the country to date. The allocation comes via the Interagency Coordinating Group for Vaccine Provision (ICG), with WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF and support from Gavi. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the decision as international solidarity. Experts still do not know if Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo in humans; early lab data suggest possible protection. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials (Moderna ARNm and University of Oxford); an rVSV Bundibugyo candidate by Hilleman Laboratories is in development. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in the last five decades.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国にエボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を提供すると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響（過去最悪の死者数）と異常性（同国史上最悪のエボラ流行）の2項目に該当し、社会的関心・国際支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 本件はDRCで5月15日に宣言された第17回目のエボラ流行で、確定症例5,105件・死者2,420人と同国史上最悪規模。WHO・UNICEF・IFRC・MSF・Gaviが連携しワクチン提供を実施しており、既知の進行中アウトブレイクに対する国際対応の一環として継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: بعد ظهور أول حالة إنفلونزا الخنازير في الصين .. هل وقع في بلدان أخرى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the first case of swine flu emerged in China, has it spread to other countries?
article.articleSummary: First swine flu case reported in China involves a child under three diagnosed by genomic sequencing, raising global concern. HealthandMe notes the virus remains limited in China and worldwide, with very few non-Chinese cases. Past H1N2v infections have been sporadic in the United States and Europe, mainly after pig exposure. The CDC lists 44 confirmed H1N2v cases in the United States from 2010 through May 2026. During the 2024–2025 influenza season, one adult in Iowa with H1N2v was hospitalized and recovered. By May 2026, the CDC reported two cases in the 2025–2026 season. Human infections with H1N2v remain rare, with concern increasing only if there is evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で豚インフルエンザの最初の症例が確認された後…他国でも発生しているか？
triage.triage_reason: 中国で初のH1N2v（豚由来インフルエンザ）症例が報告されたが、持続的なヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、世界的にも散発例にとどまるため、現時点では続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 米国アイオワ州等の症例は過去の散発事例として文脈的に言及されているのみで、本記事の主題は中国での初症例。ヒト-ヒト感染の持続的証拠がないため重症度・拡大リスクは低いが、豚由来インフルエンザの新規発生として動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC recibirá 70.000 dosis de la vacuna contra el ébola pese a que...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine despite ...
article.articleSummary: DRC will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to tackle the Bundibugyo virus outbreak. The allocation from the International Coordinating Group (ICG) includes 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate vaccine impact against Bundibugyo and 50,000 doses for frontline health workers, per WHO SAGE guidance. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks (formerly Zaire ebolavirus) but there is no human evidence yet that it protects against Bundibugyo; early lab and animal data suggest potential protection. The trial is expected to yield crucial evidence for policymakers on future use of Ervebo. Informed consent is emphasized for all recipients, whether in the trial or outside it. WHO and Africa CDC support a community-led response and continued protection of affected populations, aiming to end the outbreak and strengthen Africa's preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、未実証にもかかわらずエボラウイルスワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHO/ICGによる国際的なワクチン配布支援が行われていることから、国際的関心と管理必要性が高いシグナルと判断される。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するErvebo（rVSV-ZEBOV）ワクチンのヒトでの有効性は未実証であり、第3相試験と最前線医療従事者への予防接種が並行実施される。WHO SAGEガイダンスおよびAfrica CDCの支援を受けたコミュニティ主導対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: UA: brote de ébola en RD Congo podría ser tres veces mayor al número de casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UA: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo could be three times as large as the number of confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo could be up to three times larger than the 5,208 confirmed cases reported. The African Union's Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) warned that only about 30–40% of infections are currently detected. Models from the RDC analysis team in collaboration with Imperial College estimate the real outbreak size may reach roughly triple the confirmed figure. In a weekly virtual briefing, Africa CDC stated that fewer than 10% of cases come from known contacts and less than 40% have a clear epidemiological link to a confirmed case. The report underscores gaps in testing and contact tracing as major challenges for understanding and controlling this outbreak. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of Congo, Africa CDC, outbreak size, under-detection, contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は確定症例数の3倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患で、確認症例5,208例と大規模、かつAfrica CDCが実際の規模は確認数の3倍に達する可能性を指摘し、接触追跡・検査体制の不備を示唆しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行の過小検出を指摘。Africa CDCとImperial Collegeの分析による推計であり、感染源や国際的伝播の具体的証拠は記事中に明示されていないが、既知の大規模流行として継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बिहार में विशेष अभियान के दौरान टीबी के 87,623 नए मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 87,623 new TB cases reported in Bihar during a special campaign.
article.articleSummary: During a two-week Bihar state-wide TB campaign (July 2–August 14), 87,623 new TB cases were detected, including 21,550 asymptomatic individuals. Against a target of screening 1 crore people, 2.36 crore were tested. Of the detected cases, 74,871 (85%) have been assessed for differentiated TB care. Bihar's diagnostic network now includes 491 digital X-ray machines, 140 portable AI handheld X-rays, 768 binocular microscopes, 89 CBNAAT, 562 TrueNat machines, plus LPAs and culture-based drug-sensitivity testing labs. The state identified 11,055 high-risk villages and has conducted over 540,000 camps since March 24, 2026. Under the TB Free Panchayats initiative, 547 panchayats meet all six central criteria. Broader TB control includes universal TB preventive therapy across all 38 districts. In 2024, treatment success was 88%; TB mortality fell from 21 to 20 per lakh from 2023 to 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州で特別キャンペーン中に87,623件の新規結核症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核対策キャンペーンによる積極的症例発見の結果であり、異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。既存の公衆衛生プログラムの成果報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 積極的スクリーニングキャンペーンによる症例発見増加であり、地域の既存結核対策プログラムの一環。治療成功率88%、死亡率も改善傾向にあり、新興感染症的な懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: Aulas são suspensas em escola de JP após surto de catapora entre alunos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classes are suspended at a JP school after a chickenpox outbreak among students.
article.articleSummary: In João Pessoa, Brazil, a local school suspended classes after chickenpox (varicella) cases were identified among students. The precautionary suspension is being kept while authorities monitor the situation; no case counts are disclosed. Chickenpox is caused by the varicella-zoster virus and is highly transmissible, spreading mainly through respiratory secretions and fluid from skin lesions. Common symptoms include fever, malaise, and a vesicular rash that progresses to blisters and later crusts. While more common in children, adults can be affected. Preventive measures and follow-up are being implemented to curb transmission in the school community. Infected individuals should avoid contact with others, especially those who have not had the disease or are not immunized.

triage.headline_ja: JPの学校で水痘の集団発生後、授業が休止
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症であり、単一校での局地的な発生であるため、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくい。
triage.notes: 水痘は既知のワクチン予防可能疾患であり、単一校での発生に留まる情報のみ。症例数や重症度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's M23 rebels announce movement restrictions over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where two travellers from the government-held town of Lubero tested positive for Ebola in a village under M23 control, prompting new movement restrictions. Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) and March 23 Movement (M23) authorities suspended access along the Goma-Kirumba road for one month from Saturday, though taxi buses would continue on the route under health and safety controls, and trucks transporting goods would be allowed. The confirmed cases were reported by a response team established by rebel authorities. The measure reflects the effort to contain the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, in a context of ongoing hostilities between the Congolese government and the Rwanda-backed M23, which complicates public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのM23反乱軍、エボラ懸念により移動制限を発表
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が紛争地域で進行中であり、反乱軍支配地域での症例確認と移動制限が公衆衛生対応を複雑化させているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州での「史上最速拡大」とされるエボラ流行と、M23反乱軍による移動制限措置を報じている。ルワンダは反乱軍への支援国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plusieurs décès notifiés suite à la résistance communautaire en Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Several Deaths Reported Following Community Resistance in Ituri - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, the Mangala health zone in Djugu territory reports at least 27 Ebola-related deaths over four days due to community resistance to the outbreak response. The figure was shared by Michel Meta, president of UNADI (Union nationale des associations culturelles pour le développement de l'Ituri). He notes Mangala's toll has not reached the level seen in Biringi health area in Aru territory but stresses a significant human cost. Meta calls for intensified community sensitization and closer involvement of local authorities and traditional leaders to counter resistance and improve adherence to the Ebola response. Dated Bunia, 20 August 2026, the report emphasizes that community engagement is essential to effectively combat Ebola in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:イトゥリ州で住民の抵抗により複数の死者が報告される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱による死者が多数(27名以上)報告されており、コミュニティの対応拒否により感染対策が阻害されているため、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 2476 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,476.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 5,208 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,476 deaths since the outbreak began, according to INSP. In the last 24 hours, 103 new cases and 35 deaths were recorded, with 24 recovered, bringing totals to 5,208 cases and 2,476 deaths. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is caused by a Bundibugyo strain of Ebola that has no approved vaccines or treatments. The World Health Organization announced a shipment of 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to DRC to protect healthcare workers and support clinical testing. WHO hopes to bring the outbreak under control within three months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が2,476人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで拡大を続けており、WHOが介入してワクチン供給を行うなど国際的関心・支援が既に発生しているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 5,208症例・2,476死亡（致死率約47.5%）、直近24時間で103新規症例・35死亡と拡大継続中。承認済みワクチン・治療薬のないBundibugyo株が原因で、WHOがErvebo7万回分を供給し3ヶ月以内の制圧を目指すとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo dobija 70.000 vakcina protiv ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccines.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the World Health Organization reports 5,208 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Congo, with 2,476 deaths. The Congo will receive 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses. Ervebo is approved for Ebola virus disease but not for Bundibugyo virus, which is driving the current outbreak; early laboratory and animal data suggest it could offer some protection against Bundibugyo, though efficacy against this strain remains unproven. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for a Phase 3 trial to determine protection against Bundibugyo, while the remaining 50,000 doses will vaccinate health workers and other frontline responders per WHO recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラワクチン7万回分を受け取る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）による大規模流行が継続しており、確定症例5,208例・死亡2,476例と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクや国際支援（ワクチン供給）が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 現在の流行はブンディブギョウイルスによるものであり、既承認ワクチンErvebo（ザイール株用）の有効性は未確認。WHOが第3相試験を含む大規模ワクチン投入を支援している点は国際支援の必要性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le pays va recevoir 70 000 doses d'un vaccin approuvé par l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the country will receive 70,000 doses of a vaccine approved by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, approved for protection against the Zaire Ebola virus strain, but not specifically for the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the country. The World Health Organization announced the doses, provided by the International Coordinating Group for Vaccine Provision, will support clinical trials and limited use against Bundibugyo. As of 20 August 2026, the outbreak—DRC’s 17th Ebola event—has recorded over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths since it was declared three months ago, the deadliest on record. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are for a phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 are for frontline health workers and healthcare professionals. This allocation complies with WHO’s SAGE guidance. Earlier in the month, WHO vaccinology experts urged a large-scale Ervebo trial to determine potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、WHO承認ワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（症例5000超、死亡2300超）の第17次エボラ流行が継続中で、新規株（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン効果が未確立であり、国際的な緊急対応（ワクチン供給・臨床試験）が行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（第17次）で、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo）が現在流行中のブンディブギョ株に対して未承認であるため、交差防御効果を検証する第3相試験が実施される点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح إرفيبو المضاد لفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo receives 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization and partners announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) Ebola vaccine. Of these, 20,000 doses are allocated for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving the current outbreak, while 50,000 doses are for frontline health workers per WHO guidance. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus (Zaire ebolavirus) but not Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo. The eastern DRC outbreak has caused 2,476 deaths among 5,208 confirmed cases, described as the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, spreading about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (which killed over 11,000). A shortage of vaccines and approved therapies for Bundibugyo, plus surveillance gaps with cases outside monitored contacts, hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルスワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株による流行は史上最速のペースで拡大しており（症例5,208件中死者2,476人）、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現行流行株（ブンディブギョ株）に対してエルベボワクチンは未承認であり、承認薬・ワクチンの不足とサーベイランスの隙間が対応を妨げている。史上最速の拡大速度との記載あり、致死率・拡大速度ともに重大。

article.articleHeadline: RDC.- RDC recibirá 70.000 dosis de la vacuna contra el ébola pese a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine despite...
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) will deliver 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The stock, managed by the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG), is allocated as 20,000 doses for a phase 3 trial to assess vaccine impact against Bundibugyo and 50,000 doses for frontline health workers. This follows confirmation that the current outbreak in the DRC, centered around Goma, has reached 381 cases and 63 deaths. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola viruses such as Zaire ebolavirus, but there is no human evidence yet that it protects against Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest possible benefit. The WHO and Africa CDC emphasize informed consent, a community-led response, and using trial results to guide future vaccine use.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、未検証にもかかわらずエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが継続中で381症例・63死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的なワクチン供給・臨床試験が実施されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはZaire型ではなくBundibugyo型エボラウイルスであり、既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)のヒトでの有効性が未確認のため、第3相試験と並行したワクチン接種が計画されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: RD e Kongos do të marrë 70.000 vaksina kundër Ebolës për të frenuar shpërthimin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo will receive 70,000 Ebola vaccines to curb the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo will receive 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses (Ervebo) to curb the Bundibugyo outbreak. WHO allocated 70,000 doses from global stock: 20,000 for a phase 3 trial to understand vaccine impact against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers, per the immunization advisory group. No vaccine or treatment is yet approved specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola (formerly Zaire ebolavirus), and early lab/animal data suggest potential protection against Bundibugyo. WHO Director-General Tedros emphasized global solidarity and support for surveillance, rapid detection, community engagement, and vaccination. The outbreak has 5,208 confirmed infections and 2,476 deaths (case fatality 47.5%), across 56 health zones in Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s history. About 730 people are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,115 have recovered. WHO previously declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行阻止のためワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認感染5,208例・死亡2,476例（致死率47.5%）に達する史上最悪のエボラ（バンディブギョ株）流行であり、WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言されている進行中の大規模流行であり、フルリスク評価対象として即時対応が必要。バンディブギョ株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Indore hospital under probe after 62-year-old woman's H1N1 death
article.articleSummary: 62-year-old woman from Ujjain tested positive for H1N1 and died at home on August 19 after discharge from a private hospital in Indore on August 18. Indore CMHO Dr. Madhav Hasani said the hospital initially did not disclose the H1N1 status, though reporting is required under notifiable disease provisions. A high-level investigation team, including two specialists and an epidemiologist, has been formed to review medical records, and notices have been issued to the hospital under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme and the Nursing Home Act; further action will follow based on findings. The health department has launched a probe into the case. Separately, CMHO cautioned that June–August humidity can raise viral infections and urged precautions against vector-borne diseases by preventing stagnant water in pots, tyres, coolers, and by keeping stored water covered.
