triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発死亡例で、地元保健当局が病院の届出義務違反について調査中。公衆衛生上の広範な脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Skrining tuberkulosis santri Tebuireng Jombang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis screening for Tebuireng santri in Jombang
article.articleSummary: AI-enabled portable chest X-ray was used in a mass TB screening integrated with Free Health Check (CKG) at SMA A Wahid Hasyim Ponpes Tebuireng in Jombang, East Java, on August 18–20, 2026. The Ministry of Health-led program screened 2,678 santri (boarding-school students) and teachers at Tebuireng. From the screening, 26 individuals were identified as TB suspects and require further examination and treatment. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin, accompanied by Jombang Health Office head Hexawan Tjahja Widada, observed the X-ray collection process as part of the integrated CKG and TB screening. The initiative uses AI-assisted portable radiography to aid early TB detection during ongoing TB control efforts in the region, underscoring TB surveillance in East Java’s pesantren settings.

triage.headline_ja: ジョンバンのテブイレン学生に対する結核スクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な結核スクリーニングプログラムの実施報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 保健省主導の通常のTB対策・早期発見プログラムであり、26名の疑い例が確認されたのみで、集団感染や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 科学家破译危害百亿大黄鱼产业的寄生虫"基因密码
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists Decipher the Parasite's 'Genetic Code' That Threatens the 10-Billion-Yuan Large Yellow Croaker Industry.
article.articleSummary: Researchers from Fujian Province's Academy of Agricultural Sciences produced the first chromosome-level, gapless reference genome for the large yellow croaker coneworm, totaling ~51.04 Mb organized into 35 pseudochromosomes with 97.96% anchored. Using PacBio HiFi sequencing and Hi-C, the assembly achieved 99.99% read-back accuracy and >99% BUSCO completeness. Published in Scientific Data as of 2026-08-20, the work enables full-genome analysis of a parasite that threatens the Ningde-based large yellow croaker industry, valued at over 20 billion yuan, and associated with Sandu’ao Bay. Disease in fish includes anemia, pale gills, skin hemorrhages and ulcers with high mortality. Comparative genomics identified 515 expanded gene families enriched for host–pathogen interactions, immune evasion, metabolism and signaling, offering clues to virulence and host adaptation. The dataset provides a foundation for diagnostic markers, surveillance, evolutionary tracing, risk assessment, and targeted control.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が100億元規模のタイセイヨウキグチ産業を脅かす寄生虫の「遺伝暗号」を解読
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は養殖魚（タイセイヨウキグチ）に寄生する寄生虫のゲノム解読に関する科学研究であり、ヒトの感染症事例や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 対象は水産養殖業の寄生虫感染であり、人獣共通感染症やヒトへの健康リスクの記載はない。バイオセキュリティ上の関心事ではなく、科学研究発表として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Balneário Camboriú registra queda nos casos de dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balneário Camboriú records a drop in dengue cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Balneário Camboriú, Brazil, recorded a dramatic reduction in dengue cases in 2026, reporting five confirmed cases from January through March, versus 92 in the same period in 2025—a 94.57% decrease. The dip follows intensified prevention and control efforts targeting Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. Despite the improved indicators, authorities urge continued vigilance to prevent new transmission and sustain the reduction in cases. The article notes ongoing public health measures to curb mosquito populations and reduce dengue risk, without detailing hospitalizations or laboratory methods beyond case confirmations. The reported trend highlights the effectiveness of vector control and community engagement in Balneário Camboriú during early 2026, emphasizing that sustained precautions are needed to maintain progress.

triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱症例の大幅な減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例の減少を報告する内容であり、Brazilは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 2476 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,476.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, with 103 new cases reported and 35 deaths in the past 24 hours; 24 patients recovered. The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or proven treatments. International aid organization MSF notes the epidemic is gaining momentum and that containment is increasingly challenging, criticizing slow global response. They emphasize the need for more coordinated and decisive international measures to control spread and to shift from reactive to proactive prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる死者数が2,476人に達した
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模流行し（5,208症例、2,476死亡）、ワクチン・治療法未確立で国際的拡大・対応の遅れが指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: MSFが流行の勢いが増していることと国際対応の遅れを批判。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行である点も重症度・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Michigan cyclosporiasis cases rise to over 14,200 in a week, health officials say
article.articleSummary: Michigan reports 14,277 cyclosporiasis cases as of Aug 20, 2026, tied to a multistate outbreak, up 368 from the prior week. Michigan is the worst affected state. Two related deaths have been reported, both in individuals with significant underlying health conditions. The update notes the outbreak spans multiple states but provides no additional details on transmission sources or laboratory confirmation. Cyclosporiasis is a parasitic illness, and the rising case count reflects ongoing transmission within the outbreak. The information comes from the Michigan health department and Reuters coverage by Mariam Sunny in Bengaluru, with editing by Tasim Zahid. Reported updates are current through Aug 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ミシガン州のサイクロスポーラ症、1週間で1万4200人超に増加と保健当局
triage.triage_reason: 米国ミシガン州における多州にまたがるサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクであり、対象国（インド等）は記者の所在地に過ぎず実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域として挙げられているインド(Bengaluru)は記事執筆者の所在地であり、実際の感染発生国は米国ミシガン州である。対象国リストに米国は含まれないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kích hoạt cao điểm phòng, chống dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Activation of the peak period for disease prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: From Aug 7–14, Hanoi recorded 316 dengue cases across 74 communes/wards, up 81 from the prior week, with 11 new outbreaks; 2026 total: 1,598 cases in 115 communes/wards and 24 active outbreaks. Hand-foot-mouth disease rose to 142 cases, up 39. The Health Department links the rise to delayed response and incomplete '4 at the spot' plans, with gaps in staffing and equipment. Hanoi activated a high-alert prevention mechanism, directing 126 communes/wards to review and finish the plan and to intensify sanitation and larval-source elimination. It is standardizing 'larval killer' teams led by village heads, with health staff guidance, using QR-based larval surveillance and Zalo for information sharing. Dong Anh reports 13 dengue cases with no active outbreaks; Duong Noi ward mobilized 300 volunteers to end a 12-case outbreak. With the school year approaching, authorities urge school disinfection, ventilation, and hygiene; parents should monitor health and keep sick children at home.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症予防・対策のピーク期間を活性化
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでのデング熱・手足口病の季節的増加であり、行政が対応強化中だが国際的拡大や異常性は認められないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱・手足口病ともにベトナムの季節性流行パターンに合致し、地方当局が予防体制を強化している段階。重症度や死亡例の言及はなく、国際的な波及リスクも示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Receives 70,000 Ebola Vaccine Doses As Bundibugyo Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), linked to the Bundibugyo strain, prompts a UN ICG allocation of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses. Of these, 20,000 will support a clinical trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 will be directed to health workers; some residents in affected areas may be vaccinated outside the trial. Ervebo, designed for Zaire ebolavirus, has unclear effectiveness against Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest potential protection, but clinical evidence is pending. The move follows the outbreak declared May 15, now the deadliest on record for the DRC with 2,325 deaths and 5,021 reported cases as of August 20, 2026 (data cited Wednesday). WHO welcomed the allocation as global solidarity; decisions await trial results for policymakers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ型エボラ流行拡大に伴いエボラワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（死者2,325人、症例5,021人）のエボラ流行が継続し、既存ワクチンの有効性が不明な新型（ブンディブギョ株）であるためIHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な対応（UN ICG・WHO）も動いている。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するErvebo（ザイール株用ワクチン）の有効性は臨床的に未確立であり、治験結果待ちの状況。史上最悪規模の流行として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: 72,735 cases of flu-like illness logged
article.articleSummary: From Jan. 4 to Aug. 1, 2026, the Philippines Department of Health (DOH) logged 72,735 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases and 38 deaths nationwide, a 23% drop from 94,399 cases in the same period last year. Despite the overall decline, the case trend is rising, with 4,466 ILI cases in the July 5–18 window, 1% higher than the June 21–July 4 period (4,442). Regional totals place Northern Mindanao highest at 12,895, followed by Calabarzon (10,578), Davao Region (7,396), Central Visayas (7,100), and Ilocos Region (4,527). Males account for 51% (36,904) of cases; the most affected age group is children 5–14 years (16,929; 23%). Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, colds, body aches, and headaches. Health authorities urge flu vaccination; WHO notes vaccination helps prevent severe disease and hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：インフルエンザ様疾患72,735件を記録
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン保健省による季節性インフルエンザ様疾患(ILI)の定例サーベイランス報告であり、前年同期比で23%減少している。直近でやや増加傾向はあるが、季節性の範囲内であり異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例統計報告。前年同期比で減少しているが、直近数週間はわずかに増加傾向。ワクチン接種の呼びかけがなされているのみで、特段の異常事態は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta médica: el brote de ébola del Congo podría ser tres veces mayor de lo que se cuenta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical alert: the Congo Ebola outbreak could be three times larger than what is being reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri epicenter; also affecting North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo; two cases in Buta, Bas-Uélé near the Central African Republic border). As of August 20, 2026, official counts show 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, with estimates suggesting the true outbreak size could be up to three times higher. Africa CDC notes fewer than 10% of cases come from known contacts and less than 40% have a clear epidemiological link to a confirmed case. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, whose milder symptoms and lack of overt hemorrhagic manifestations delay care, contributing to transmission; about 97% of recent deaths occur in community settings or general health facilities without adequate isolation or infection prevention. Cross-border vigilance includes mobile labs near the RCA border and surveillance for potential export to neighboring countries. The outbreak began May 15 and ranks as the second deadliest in DRC history, well below the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 医療警戒：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行は報告されているより3倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で5,208例・2,476人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、実際の規模は報告の3倍に達する可能性が指摘されており、隣国への越境拡大リスクもあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国国境付近での症例（ブタ、バ・ウエレ）はDRC国内に位置するため、中央アフリカ共和国自体での確認症例ではない。国境監視体制が敷かれている点は越境拡大リスクとして評価。対象国リストにCARは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: La sequía podría explicar el regreso de la fiebre amarilla a Brasil: no ocurría desde hace casi 80 años
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The drought could explain the return of yellow fever to Brazil: it had not occurred for almost 80 years.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever re-emerged in Brazil in 2017 after decades of urban transmission absence since 1942, with over 2,000 infections and more than 700 deaths by 2019. A Science Advances modeling study suggests that an extreme drought, rather than humidity alone, forced non-human primates to leave forests for water, carrying Haemagogus mosquitoes and enabling urban spillover. The team parameterized a transmission model on Minas Gerais data, incorporating primate lifespan, bite-to-infection probabilities, recovery, and incubation; one simulation reproduced the outbreak trajectory. Drought likely acted with rising temperatures and deforestation, while waning vaccination coverage increased vulnerability. In 2026 Brazil and broader South America face ongoing risk; OPS alerts show continued transmission with 346 cases and 143 deaths in 2025 across seven countries (Brazil 120/48; Colombia 125/46; Peru 49/19; Venezuela 32/19; Bolivia 8/2; Ecuador 11/8; Guyana reported).

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつがブラジルでの黄熱病再興を説明できる可能性：約80年ぶりの発生
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2017-2019年の黄熱病再興要因に関する学術研究（干ばつ仮説）が主題で速報性は低いが、2025年時点でブラジルを含む南米7カ国で346例・143死亡という継続的リスクに言及しており、動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主に2017-2019年のブラジルにおける黄熱病再興メカニズム（干ばつ仮説）に関する学術研究の紹介。2025年の南米全体データ（ブラジル120例/48死亡等）にも言及しているが、ペルー・コロンビア・ベネズエラ・ボリビア・エクアドル・ガイアナは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Balangan tracing tuberkulosis, putus mata rantai penularan penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balangan Health Office conducts tuberculosis contact tracing, breaks the chain of disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Balangan Regency Health Office in Indonesia is conducting tuberculosis (TB) contact tracing to break transmission. Led by the Disease Prevention and Control division (P2P), the activity centers on screening contacts of TB patients and performing examinations to enable immediate treatment if positive. The program emphasizes early case finding to interrupt spread, with household contacts who are not TB-positive potentially receiving preventive therapy based on medical assessment. The initiative aims to reduce TB transmission and improve public health indicators in Balangan. Desa Baruh Panyambaran Handiansyah highlights village-level facilitation of screenings for residents who may not visit a health clinic, noting the activity also serves as education on TB prevention and the critical importance of adhering to treatment when TB is detected.

triage.headline_ja: バランガン保健局、結核の接触者追跡を実施し感染連鎖を遮断
triage.triage_reason: 地域の日常的な結核対策活動の報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方流行病であり、通常の公衆衛生活動（接触者追跡・スクリーニング）の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: India News | MP: Probe Ordered After 62-year-old Woman Dies Following H1N1 Treatment in Indore
article.articleSummary: A 62-year-old woman from Ujjain died at home on August 19 after treatment at a private Indore hospital, which later reported she tested positive for H1N1. She had been admitted to BCM Kokilaben Hospital, Indore, and discharged against medical advice on August 18. Indore CMHO Dr. Madhav Hasani noted the hospital initially did not disclose the H1N1 status; it was subsequently confirmed. Because H1N1 is a notifiable disease, notices were issued to the hospital under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme and the Nursing Home Act. A high-level investigative team, including two specialists and an epidemiologist, has been formed to review the patient’s medical records and the circumstances of care, with further action to follow. Officials cited seasonal factors during June–August and urged precautions against vector-borne diseases, including preventing standing water in pots, tyres, and coolers.

triage.headline_ja: インド:H1N1治療後に62歳女性死亡、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州で調査命令(インドール)
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による単発の死亡例で、病院の情報開示不備に関する行政調査が主題であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: インドでは6～8月にH1N1が季節的に発生することが一般的であり、本件は単発の死亡例に対する病院の対応・情報開示に関する行政調査が中心。感染拡大の兆候は記事から確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : الكونغو تتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح إرفيبو المضاد لفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: The Congo receives 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization and partners say, as of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine. Of these, 20,000 doses are for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving the current outbreak, while the remaining 50,000 doses will be reserved for frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease but not specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; early laboratory and animal data suggest it may offer some protection. The eastern Congo outbreak has reached 5,208 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, making it the fastest Ebola outbreak on record, about three times the pace of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Limited vaccines/therapies for Bundibugyo pose major challenges, with many new cases outside monitored contacts, signaling rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラワクチン「エルベボ」7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は確認症例5,208例・死亡2,476例に達し史上最速の拡大ペースであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCの流行とワクチン供給のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は記載されていないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株はエルベボの適応外であり有効性データは限定的な点も留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nữ nghiên cứu sinh 27 tuổi mắc HIV: Lời cảnh tỉnh từ ca lây nhiễm hy hữu qua dịch vụ nha khoa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 27-year-old female PhD student infected with HIV: a cautionary tale from a rare transmission case via dental services.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, a 27-year-old female PhD student with an otherwise meticulous health record tests positive for HIV during a routine annual checkup. Health personnel report abnormal HIV-related markers and urge confirmatory testing. The patient, who had never had sexual activity, blood donation, or cosmetic surgery, recalls a dental visit for scaling and oral ulcer treatment at a private dental clinic. A senior clinician suspects the HIV infection was most likely acquired during those dental procedures, given potential gingival bleeding and mucosal disruption. The case highlights risks of cross-infection in small or unlicensed clinics where instrument sterilization, including autoclaving, may be inadequate. Instruments like drills and dental scalers can transmit HIV if not properly sterilized between patients. The report serves as a cautionary tale on choosing high-quality, licensed dental services and maintaining stringent infection control.

triage.headline_ja: 27歳の女性大学院生がHIVに感染：歯科診療を介した稀な感染事例からの警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例であり、HIVは既知の風土病的感染症で、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す要素がないため。
triage.notes: 単一症例の医療機関における感染管理の注意喚起記事であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, 에볼라 확산 민주콩고에 자이르형 백신 긴급 투입
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urgently deploys the Zaire-type Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths reported as of May 18, 2026, a case-fatality rate of 47.5%. The spread is centered in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. In response, WHO approves rapid deployment of Merck’s Ervebo vaccine (Zaire-type Ebola vaccine) to the DRC; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and is not yet approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though early lab and animal data suggest some cross-protection. A total of 70,000 doses will be shipped, including 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial evaluating cross-protection against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The government has already received 2,000 doses and has requested up to 500,000. The International Coordination Group on Vaccine Provision, along with WHO, UNICEF, MSF, and the IFRC, will oversee distribution. SAGE previously recommended human trials to confirm cross-protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ拡大の民主コンゴにザイール型ワクチンを緊急投入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定5,208例、死亡2,476例、致死率47.5%）が継続しており、国際的な緊急ワクチン投入が行われていることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関与を要する事案としてフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対する交差防御を検証する第3相試験も並行して実施中であり、変異株の関与や地理的拡大の可能性についても続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo reforça alerta para diagnóstico precoce das hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July reinforces the alert for early diagnosis of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Global hepatitis deaths are about 1.3 million per year, mainly from cirrhosis and liver cancer linked to hepatitis B and C, per WHO's 2026 Global Hepatitis Report. Brazil has advanced viral hepatitis control with expanded diagnostic testing, better vaccination coverage, and effective treatments—especially for hepatitis C—yet faces ongoing challenges in early diagnosis, broader vaccination, and follow-up care. The July Yellow campaign emphasizes surveillance, prevention, and control; World Hepatitis Day is July 28. Hepatitis A–E differ in transmission and chronicity: A and E are primarily food- and waterborne and usually acute; B, C, and D spread mainly through blood and sex and can become chronic, risking cirrhosis and liver cancer. Most infections are asymptomatic; when present, fatigue, malaise, nausea, loss of appetite, and abdominal discomfort may occur, with jaundice in some acute cases. Prevention includes vaccination against A and B via SUS, condom use, avoiding sharing items that may contact blood, and using disposable or sterilized equipment for procedures.

triage.headline_ja: 「黄色い7月」キャンペーン、ウイルス性肝炎の早期診断への注意を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、啓発キャンペーンに関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの「7月黄色（Julho Amarelo）」肝炎啓発キャンペーンに関するもので、WHO報告書の統計や一般的な予防啓発内容を紹介する定期的な公衆衛生広報記事。特定の感染急増やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cruzeiro do Sul registra queda de 84% nos casos prováveis de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cruzeiro do Sul records an 84% drop in probable dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre, Brazil, reports an 84% reduction in probable dengue cases in 2026 for weeks 1–32, with data updated on Aug 18. Total notifications reach 2,547, of which 2,161 were discarded, 215 confirmed, and 171 under investigation, yielding 386 probable dengue cases versus 2,450 in the same period of 2025. The decline is attributed to sustained vector-control efforts and community cooperation. Health teams operate in 53 neighborhoods with daily visits across 1,025 blocks. Despite the drop, ongoing vigilance is urged. Main breeding sites include ground-level water tanks and small containers that accumulate water; reservoirs should be kept sealed and any container that could serve as a mosquito breeding site eliminated. Symptomatic individuals—fever, headache, body pains, or red rash—should seek evaluation at a health unit.

triage.headline_ja: クルゼイロ・ド・スル市、デング熱の推定症例数が84%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数の大幅な減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例の減少傾向とベクター対策の成果を報告する内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Congo receberá 70 mil doses da vacina Ervebo para combater o vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Congo to receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to combat the virus.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) receives 70,000 Ervebo doses from WHO for the Ebola outbreak caused by Zaire ebolavirus, with 20,000 set for a Phase 3 trial to evaluate the vaccine's impact on the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating in the DRC, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. The allocation addresses the ongoing 17th Ebola epidemic in the northern and eastern DRC, described as the deadliest yet, spreading at an unprecedented pace. As of the latest WHO data, the outbreak has caused more than 2,000 deaths among 5,105 confirmed cases. The DRC government declared the epidemic on May 15, with health systems strained by weak state presence and fragile infrastructure. The country has requested vaccines from the Global Coordination Group reserves (led by WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, and Red Cross with MSF), funded by Gavi, to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴがウイルス対策としてエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が2,000人以上の死者・5,105人の確定症例を伴い過去最悪規模で急速に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 過去最悪規模とされる第17次エボラ流行で、WHO・UNICEF・IFRC・MSF等の国際支援とGaviによる資金提供を受けたワクチン配布が行われている。ブンディブギョ株に対する第3相試験も実施予定であり、疫学的にも科学的にも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Agencia de salud pública de la Unión Africana: El brote de ébola en RDC podría ser tres veces mayor al número de casos confirmados - EFE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health Agency of the African Union: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC could be three times larger than the number of confirmed cases - EFE
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC warns that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) could be up to three times larger than the official 5,208 confirmed cases, with only 30–40% of infections detected. Models by RDC analysts and Imperial College suggest the true size may triple the confirmed total. Fewer than 10% of cases arise from known contacts, and less than 40% have a clear epidemiological link to a confirmed case. Under-detection is tied to the Bundibugyo strain, whose milder symptoms and lack of severe hemorrhage delay care. Consequently, about 97% of recent deaths occur in the community or in general health facilities without adequate isolation or infection-control protocols. Ituri is the epicenter; transmission also affects North and South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. Two cases have been reported in Buta, Bas-Uélé near the Central African Republic border. Death toll stands at 2,476, making this the second-deadliest outbreak in DRC and the largest by infections in the country.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合公衆衛生機関：DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は確認症例数の3倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な過小報告率、国境地域への拡大）し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき案件。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国国境付近のButa(Bas-Uélé)で症例報告があるが、対象国リストに中央アフリカ共和国が含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。実際の感染者数が確認数の3倍に達する可能性があり、DRC史上最大規模かつ2番目に死者数が多い流行との報告。Bundibugyo株による軽症化が過小検出の要因。

article.articleHeadline: إعلان أممى: شحن 70 ألف جرعة من لقاحات "إيبولا" السابقة إلى جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Announces Shipment of 70,000 Doses of Previous Ebola Vaccines to the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine will be shipped to the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the government’s request, with 20,000 doses allocated for a Phase III trial to test efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus and 50,000 doses for frontline health workers. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo, and early laboratory and animal data suggest some protection against Bundibugyo, though its effectiveness remains unproven. The UN-led group including WHO coordinated the delivery. The eastern DRC outbreak, spanning six provinces, is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, with over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths; case fatality is about 47.5%, rising to 70% in hard-to-reach areas such as North Kivu. Officials believe the virus began spreading from the Mongala mining town in February, before the May 15 outbreak declaration. Vaccines are expected to bolster containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国連発表：エボラワクチン7万回分をコンゴ民主共和国へ出荷

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak worsens as fatality rate tops 46%, nears pandemic level
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, has 4,945 confirmed infections and 2,325 deaths as of Aug 16, 2026, with a case-fatality ratio above 46%. The outbreak, Congo’s 17th, began May 15 in Ituri Province and was designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO on May 17. Transmission has spread to additional provinces, and health systems are disrupted, harming malaria and maternal care. The Bundibugro strain has no approved vaccine or proven virus-specific treatment, hindering death-reduction efforts. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections are detected, implying a larger true scale. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed cases and two deaths during the regional outbreak and later declared itself Ebola-free. Global response includes CEPI funding up to $8.5M to accelerate a Bundibugyo vaccine, a $518M six-month regional plan, and up to $60M in UN emergency funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が悪化、致死率46%超えパンデミックレベルに接近

The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo, whose symptoms are milder and delay care-seeking. article.articleHeadline: Una malattia respiratoria potenzialmente fatale, in Italia 5 casi dal 2000: cos'è la Difterite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Potentially Fatal Respiratory Disease, Five Cases in Italy Since 2000: What Is Diphtheria?
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria is an acute, potentially fatal infectious disease caused by toxin-producing Corynebacterium diphtheriae. The toxin can cause local tissue necrosis and systemic injury; the severe respiratory form features pseudomembranes that can obstruct the upper airway and cause death by suffocation. In Italy, five cases have been reported since 2000, with a concurrent cutaneous form described. Toxin production can also involve Corynebacterium ulcerans and Corynebacterium pseudotuberculosis; human C. ulcerans infections have risen in Europe and the United States, usually presenting as skin ulcers linked to animal contact or raw milk; C. pseudotuberculosis is very rare and associated with occupational exposure. Diphtheria is endemic in parts of Southeast Asia (India, Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia), Nepal, Africa, and Brazil; Europe reports sporadic cases, including Latvia, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Italy. In 2022 Italy reported three toxigenic C. diphtheriae cases (two cutaneous, one with respiratory and cutaneous manifestations), all imported; two microbiologically confirmed by the Istituto Superiore di Sanità.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な呼吸器疾患、イタリアで2000年以降5例:ジフテリアとは何か
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリアに関する一般的解説記事であり、イタリアでの散発的輸入症例の紹介に留まる。新規アウトブレイクや急激な変化を示す情報はなく、対象国での具体的な発生報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事はジフテリアの一般解説であり、インド・インドネシア・フィリピン・マレーシアなどは「流行地域」として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生事例や新規アウトブレイクの記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго направлены 70 тысяч доз вакцины против Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventy thousand doses of Ebola vaccine have been sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine have been allocated to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help fight the ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The decision follows a request from the DRC government to the global stockpile managed by the International Coordinating Group on Vaccines. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo virus, while 50,000 are earmarked for healthcare workers and other frontline responders, aligned with WHO’s Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization guidance. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks caused by Zaire ebolavirus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus remains unproven. Preliminary laboratory and animal data hint at potential protection, but human efficacy data are not yet available. Vaccination will require informed consent, and community engagement will be central to the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国にエボラワクチン7万回分が送付される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクに対し、国際ワクチン備蓄からの大規模供給と第3相試験が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる稀な株のアウトブレイクであり、Ervebo（本来Zaireエボラ株用）の有効性は未確認。第3相試験の実施やICG/WHO SAGE関与など国際的関心が高い継続中の公衆衛生危機。

article.articleHeadline: Mohoba News: गो आश्रय केंद्र में गोवंशों पर लंपी वायरस का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mohoba News: Lumpy skin disease virus threat to cattle at a cow shelter center
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease (LSD) suspected in cattle at a government cattle shelter in Rupnagar (Punjab), specifically Kanha Goshala and the adjacent mela ground. Staff reportedly failed to vaccinate animals showing LSD symptoms, instead moving them from the shelter into open areas, risking transmission to other cattle. Alleged poor sanitation and hunger among sheltered cattle amplify disease risk. Citizens demand vaccination and proper care. Municipal Executive Officer Amarjit promises a full investigation and action if negligence is found. Chief Veterinary Officer Dr. Ranjan Singh says a team will vaccinate affected animals after verification. No laboratory confirmation or outbreak counts are reported. The piece highlights concerns over oversight of the government’s cattle conservation efforts amid ongoing LSD threats.

triage.headline_ja: モホバニュース：牛保護施設でランピースキン病ウイルスの脅威
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のみに感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはなく、検査確認もない単一施設での疑い例報告に留まるため。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病(LSD)は牛特有の疾患でヒトに感染しない人畜共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生上のリスクは想定されない。地域の家畜管理・行政対応に関するローカルニュース。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'OMS offre 70.000 doses du vaccin Ervebo contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO offers 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO allocates 70,000 Ervebo doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Of this allocation, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to assess Ervebo’s efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses are reserved for frontline workers and health staff. The outbreak in the DRC shows intense transmission and rapid geographic spread, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths reported as of 12 August 2026, across 54 health zones in six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus, but not specifically for Bundibugyo, and cross-protection data are limited. A WHO technical group recommended using Ervebo in a Phase 3 trial to generate evidence while protecting exposed health workers, as surveillance and response efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHOがエボラ対策としてエルベボワクチン7万回分を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは6州54保健区に拡大し、確定症例4,665例・死亡2,184例と極めて深刻。WHOが第3相治験を含む大規模ワクチン供給を実施しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するエルベボワクチンの交差防御データが限られており、第3相治験を通じたエビデンス収集が進行中。致死率が高く(約47%)、多州にまたがる拡大が続いているため continued monitoring と国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Destacan los avances contra el Chagas en la provincia, pero advierten: No hay que naturalizar la enfermedad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advances against Chagas disease in the province are highlighted, but they warn: Do not normalize the disease.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, Santiago del Estero, Argentina, highlights progress against Chagas disease, with policy measures since 2005, including social housing and a safe-blood bank that reduced transmission in most departments. Two departments: Jiménez and Río Hondo remain with vector transmission, having completed two OMS-mandated transmission cycles. Director Sandra Seu warns against normalizing Chagas and stresses early diagnosis and treatment, with provincial funding for therapies and higher cure indicators in children. The observance of Día de Argentina sin Chagas underscores ongoing prevention needs. Dengue has caused outbreaks in the province over the past four years, with four dengue serotypes circulating and some imported from Brazil; the same vector transmits chikungunya. Preventive actions, eliminating mosquito breeding sites and personal protection, remain essential, as Santiago del Estero remains an endemic area requiring continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 州内でのシャーガス病対策の進展が強調される一方、専門家は「病気を当たり前のことと思ってはいけない」と警告
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サンティアゴデルエステロ州における既知の風土病（シャーガス病・デング熱）に関する定例的な進捗報告であり、対象国での発生でもなく、国際的拡大や異常性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはブラジル・メキシコが含まれるが、記事主題はアルゼンチン国内（対象国外）の風土病対策に関するもの。ブラジルは輸入デング症例の由来地として言及されているのみで実際の発生地ではないため、対象国リストとの合致なし。

article.articleHeadline: Chegada de milhares de vacinas à RD Congo busca conter surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of thousands of vaccines to the DR Congo seeks to contain an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst and fastest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 5,208 cases and 2,476 deaths across the 17th epidemic. The virus is spreading three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The World Health Organization and partners have delivered 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses (approved in 2019, the first Ebola vaccine) to halt transmission in the eastern regions. Of these, 50,000 doses protect frontline health workers and essential personnel, while 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase 3 clinical trial. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there were no prior approved vaccines or treatments; early laboratory and animal data hint at cross-protection from Ervebo, but full efficacy against bundibugyo is not established. WHO, CDC Africa, and local authorities emphasize surveillance, rapid detection, community engagement, and quality care to curb spread, which has often occurred outside contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 数千本のワクチンがコンゴ民主共和国に到着、エボラ出血熱の流行抑制を目指す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪・最速のエボラ流行（5,208症例、2,476死亡）であり、新規株（Bundibugyo株）による国際的懸念とWHO主導の大規模ワクチン投入が行われているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCの流行のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。Bundibugyo株は既存承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、感染拡大速度が過去最速であることから高い懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Guinea-Bissau faces first mpox outbreak: UNICEF - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: Guinea-Bissau reports its first mpox outbreak, UNICEF says. As of Aug 17, seven confirmed mpox cases, all adults; 46 suspected cases, including 23 children under 15; no deaths reported. Mpox causes fever, muscular aches and large boil-like skin lesions and is transmitted via animal contact or close person-to-person contact. First detected in humans in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of Congo. UNICEF warns Guinea-Bissau's surveillance is fragile, risking undetected cases, especially among children who are vulnerable. Reopening schools next month could facilitate spread. The outbreak marks Guinea-Bissau's first mpox cases; no laboratory details beyond confirmation. Africa CDC noted in January that Africa is no longer under a public health emergency for mpox, though the virus remains endemic in several settings.

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Στη διάθεση του Κονγκό 70.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo - Σε φάση κλινικής δοκιμής για το στέλεχος που θερίζει τη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo — In a clinical trial phase for the strain ravaging the country.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine were allocated to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to address the current Bundibugyo-strain outbreak, announced 20 August by the World Health Organization. Ervebo is licensed against Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo, which is driving this epidemic. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are for a phase 3 trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo; 50,000 are for frontline health workers in the DRC. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on 15 May in northern and eastern regions, with weak health infrastructure; the outbreak has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, per WHO. Distribution is coordinated by the GIG and involves UNICEF, MSF, and FICR, with support from Gavi. Early lab data show possible protection against Bundibugy o; other vaccine candidates—Moderna and Oxford—are in trials, and a rVSV Bundibugyo candidate from Hilleman Laboratories is in development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国に7万回分のワクチン「エルベボ」を提供 ― 国を席巻する株に対する臨床試験段階へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続中で、致死率も高く(5,105症例・2,420死亡)、国際支援(WHO・UNICEF・MSF・Gavi等)が展開されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行(17回目、ブンディブギョ株)に対するワクチン供給の続報。承認済みワクチンEIrveboはブンディブギョ株には未承認で臨床試験段階である点が重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Letos zaznamenalo africkou chřipku u prasat dvanáct evropských států | Náš chov - vše o chovu hospodářských zvířat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year twelve European states have recorded African swine fever in pigs | Our Livestock - all about keeping farm animals.
article.articleSummary: European Commission’s Animal Diseases Information System (as of 12 Aug 2026) records 12 EU states with African swine fever (ASF) in domestic pigs this year, Bulgaria the latest, bringing regional domestic pig outbreaks to 618. In 2025, 13 states reported 940 such outbreaks. From 6–12 Aug, five countries reported 39 outbreaks, with 32 in Romania. Wild boar ASF remains widespread: 6,264 outbreaks in 18 countries this year, led by Poland (1,575), then Italy (1,045) and Lithuania (848). Finland disclosed its first ASF cases in late July; the core zone expanded 7 km north along the Russian border. Italy also reports its first wild boar case in Bologna, with new foci in Liguria, Piedmont and Tuscany. Outside Europe, Kenya’s Kiambu region shows ~1,470 farm losses; Tanzania near Dodoma ~1,420 pigs affected. In the Philippines, ASF persists across Luzon, Mindanao and Visayas (65 municipalities); Negros implements price controls to stabilize trade.

triage.headline_ja: 今年、欧州12カ国で豚のアフリカ豚熱（ASF）を記録
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜（豚）の疾病であり人の健康への直接的影響はないが、欧州・アフリカ・アジアで継続的に拡大しており貿易面でのリスクが存在するため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は欧州委員会の家畜疾病情報システム（ADIS）に基づく定期報告で、欧州（ブルガリア・ルーマニア・ポーランド・イタリア・リトアニア・フィンランド等）、ケニア、タンザニア、フィリピンでのASF発生状況をまとめたもの。対象国のうちフィリピン（ルソン・ミンダナオ・ビサヤ）でのASF継続流行が言及されているためverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・タンザニア・欧州各国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。人への感染性はなく、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、養豚業への経済的・貿易的影響が継続している点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Liên tiếp ca tử vong vì bệnh dại, người dân cần chủ động phòng bệnh, giảm nguy cơ tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Series of rabies deaths: the public should take proactive preventive measures to reduce the risk of death.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a public health concern in Vietnam in 2026. Đồng Nai Province has multiple fatalities after exposures to unvaccinated dogs: a 10-year-old boy died after contact with a family dog not vaccinated against rabies; another case is a 68-year-old woman who died after months of a dog bite without receiving rabies serum or vaccine; and Mr. D.V.T. (b. 1954), who died on May 8 from rabies with unknown exposure. Tây Ninh reports a concerning pattern: eight animal rabies outbreaks across six communes and nine human deaths across nine communes, the highest in the country. Lam Dong also notes persistent risk; Bình Thuận records one rabies death in 2026. Ben Tre reports 27 deaths 2022-2025 and five human deaths plus four animal outbreaks in 2026 to date across several communes. Urges immediate post-exposure care, wound washing, vaccination, and rabies immunoglobulin when indicated; Long Chau Vaccine Center provides vaccines and scheduling.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病による死亡が相次ぐ、住民は予防策を積極的に講じ死亡リスクを減らす必要がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内で狂犬病による死亡例が複数州で報告されているが、狂犬病は同国で既知の風土病であり、人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクはないため、国内の動向を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 複数州（ドンナイ、タイニン、ラムドン、ビントゥアン、ベンチェ）で狂犬病による死亡が報告されているが、いずれも未接種の犬による曝露が原因で、既知の風土病パターン。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての性質は低いが、国内での予防啓発強化の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu recebe evento regional sobre diagnóstico, prevenção e controle da Leishmaniose Visceral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu hosts a regional event on the diagnosis, prevention and control of visceral leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: On August 20, 2026, Botucatu hosted a regional event at the Noble Hall of the Botucatu School of Medicine (FMB/Unesp) focused on the diagnosis, prevention, and control of visceral leishmaniasis. The gathering, organized by the São Paulo State Health Secretariat, Botucatu Municipal Health Department, and FMB/Unesp, brought health professionals and experts to discuss the current epidemiological situation in São Paulo state and the surrounding region. Topics covered included diagnostic methods, treatment options, prevention strategies, and control measures, with emphasis on early detection of cases. The program highlighted Botucatu's experience in disease response and the collaboration between health services, educational institutions, and reference agencies as crucial for expanding surveillance and strengthening prevention and control measures. The initiative aims to qualify professionals and enhance public health vigilance for visceral leishmaniasis in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ボトゥカトゥで内臓リーシュマニア症の診断・予防・制御に関する地域イベント開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は内臓リーシュマニア症に関する教育・啓発イベントの開催報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増等の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病啓発・研修イベントの告知であり、具体的な症例数増加やアウトブレイクの記述はない。ブラジル・サンパウロ州での既知の風土病対策活動の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: DRC to receive 70 000 Ervebo vaccines to contain Ebola outbreak: WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC allocated 70,000 Merck Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to help contain its largest outbreak to date, as of 20 August 2026. Of these, 20,000 will be used in a late-stage trial to evaluate Ervebo's impact on Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which currently has no approved vaccines or treatments. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus prevention; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo in humans is unproven. The outbreak has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, making it the country’s biggest Ebola epidemic by case count since the 2018-2020 outbreak, with late July marking the peak period. WHO has declared the outbreak a global emergency. The 70,000 doses are drawn from the WHO-managed Ebola vaccine stockpile via the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG), a partnership including WHO, IFRC, MSF, and UNICEF.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ流行抑制のためエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領へ:WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（5000例超、死者2378人）が発生し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがすでに国際的緊急事態を宣言済みであり、フルRRAへの移行が必要。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対するワクチン効果は未確認である点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de febre amarela e febre maculosa após morte de macacos em Cachoeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever and Brazilian spotted fever alert after the death of monkeys in Cachoeiro.
article.articleSummary: Monkeys' deaths in Pacotuba National Forest, Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, Brazil, have triggered alerts for yellow fever and Brazilian spotted fever. Environmental Surveillance notes primates act as sentinels for yellow fever virus, meaning these deaths can signal viral circulation before human cases are recorded. A meeting on August 14, 2026, involving Environmental Surveillance, the Regional Health Superintendency of Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, and ICMBio, defined actions: entomological studies in the forest with collection and analysis of vector mosquitoes; reinforced biosafety guidelines for field teams handling collected samples. Officials, including Environmental Surveillance manager Fábio Gava, emphasized integrated monitoring and coordinated action to expand population protection. The agency will continue monitoring primate mortality and coordinating with involved bodies to adjust prevention measures in the region.

triage.headline_ja: カショエイロでのサル死亡を受けて黄熱病とブラジル紅斑熱の警戒
triage.triage_reason: サルの死亡により黄熱病ウイルスの循環兆候が示唆されているが、現時点でヒト感染例は報告されておらず、当局が予防的モニタリングを実施している段階のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: サル(霊長類)の死亡は黄熱病ウイルスの森林内循環のセンチネル指標であり、ヒト感染拡大の前兆となりうるため、当局が昆虫学的調査とバイオセーフティ強化を実施中。ヒト症例の有無など続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）获赠7万剂埃博拉疫苗，本迪布焦病毒疫情持续蔓延
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo receives 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine as the Beni-Butembo Ebola virus outbreak continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo received 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine targeting Zaire ebolavirus from the UN-coordinated vaccine stockpile to protect frontline communities in the Beni–Butembo area as the outbreak continues. The vaccine was developed for Zaire ebolavirus; WHO notes its efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unknown, though early data suggest possible protection, with clinical trials expected to provide critical evidence for policy decisions. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for clinical trials in DRC, while the remaining 50,000 are designated for healthcare workers. The outbreak, declared on May 15, has reached 5,021 confirmed cases and over 2,300 deaths; more than 160 healthcare workers have been infected, with 40 deaths. Ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo, involving the March 23 Movement and other groups, hampers response by limiting access, destroying or closing medical facilities, and displacing thousands, complicating contact tracing and safe burials. WHO welcomed the distribution as an example of global solidarity; trials may inform future use of the vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン7万回分の提供を受ける ― ベニ・ブテンボ地域のエボラウイルス流行が継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行（5,021症例、2,300人超死亡、医療従事者感染多数）が継続しており、紛争による対応阻害と国際支援（ワクチン供与）が発生しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種に対するワクチン有効性は未確立であり、臨床試験結果が今後の政策判断に重要。東部コンゴの武力紛争（M23等）が接触者追跡や安全な埋葬を含む対応活動を著しく阻害している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Sanidad asume que el riesgo de contagio de ébola en el Congo se centra en los sanitarios "en primera línea"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Ministry assumes that the risk of Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is centered on frontline healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: Health Ministry reports frontline healthcare workers are the most exposed, while infection risk for tourists and other travelers is low. The latest situation report lists 5,208 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 2,476 deaths in six provinces and 56 health zones, with Ituri the hardest-hit province. Spain’s Emergency Coordination Centre (CCaes) notes daily epidemiological intelligence; exposure risk for Spanish travelers/residents in affected areas is low, but travel is discouraged. If travel is unavoidable, consult an International Vaccination Center for updated guidance. Context: Ebola virus disease, identified in 1976, is severe with high fatality. Six species exist; three cause large human outbreaks: Zaire ebolavirus, Sudan ebolavirus, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with Zaire ebolavirus responsible for most African outbreaks. The West Africa 2014-2016 outbreak is the largest (Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia) with >28,600 cases and >11,325 deaths. The most recent DR Congo outbreak occurred in Kasai Province (Sept 4–Dec 1, 2025): 64 cases (53 confirmed, 11 probable) and 45 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン保健省、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ感染リスクは「最前線」の医療従事者に集中していると認識
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例5,208例・死亡2,476例に達する大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地域ではないため除外。スペインは渡航者リスク評価・モニタリングの主体であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Uma cidade da Bahia tem incidência de chikungunya 40 vezes maior que a média estadual; veja qual
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A city in Bahia, Brazil has a Chikungunya incidence 40 times higher than the state average; see which one.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya incidence in Bahia, Brazil rose sharply, with 8,117 cases from January 4 to August 10, 2026, per the Bahia State Health Secretariat (Sesab). The overall incidence is 54.6 per 100,000 population over 31 weeks. Alagoinhas records the highest municipal incidence at 2,340.63 per 100,000, followed by Rio Real (894.42) and Muritiba (878.06). Of 417 municipalities, 188 reported cases; 18 exceed 100 per 100,000. One local death has been reported. Chikungunya commonly causes fever and severe joint pain; persistent arthralgia affects 30–60% of patients and can last months to years, with swelling and morning stiffness as warning signs. Differential diagnosis with dengue and Zika is challenging. El Niño–driven higher temperatures and irregular rainfall may boost Aedes aegypti proliferation. Prevention emphasizes eliminating breeding sites, repellents, and indoor protection. Dengue cases declined to 20,980 and Zika rose to 284 in the same period.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・バイーア州のある都市、チクングニア熱の発生率が州平均の40倍に
triage.triage_reason: バイーア州の一部自治体でチクングニア熱の発生率が州平均の40倍に達し、死亡例や重篤な後遺症（慢性関節痛）も報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染を介さないが蚊媒介感染の急拡大が確認されている。WPRO基準を複数満たし、地域メディアでも報道されている。
triage.notes: エルニーニョによる気候変動でAedes aegyptiの繁殖が助長されている可能性が指摘されている。特定自治体（Alagoinhas等）での局所的な急増が主眼であり、州・国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生危機や国際拡大の兆候は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Gets 70,000 Ebola Vaccine Doses Amid Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has received 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to address the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 clinical trial to evaluate the vaccine’s potential effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus; 50,000 doses are earmarked for frontline and health workers per WHO SAGE recommendations. It remains unknown whether Ervebo confers protection against Bundibugyo virus in humans; early laboratory and animal studies suggest possible protection. The International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision approved the release after the DRC government sought vaccines from the global Ebola stockpile. The stockpile is funded by Gavi; ICG includes WHO, IFRC, MSF, UNICEF. WHO and Africa CDC emphasized protecting affected communities through a community-led response while generating scientific evidence to strengthen preparedness for future outbreaks; informed consent is required for vaccine recipients in and outside the trial.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、アウトブレイク下でエボラワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHO/Africa CDC・国際機関が関与するワクチン投入という重大な公衆衛生対応が行われているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo virus disease）はエボラの中でも稀な亜種であり、既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確認のため第3相臨床試験が並行実施されている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Гепатит Е: симптомы, причины возникновения, диагностика, лечение
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis E: Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis, Treatment.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor Epidemiology Research Institute announced the development, registration, and production launch of the country’s first domestic Hepatitis E test. Hepatitis E is a viral liver disease transmitted mainly by the fecal-oral route via contaminated water or poorly processed food; it can also spread through close household contact. Undercooked pork, venison, and shellfish are listed sources, with blood transmission being rare. Symptoms mirror other hepatitis: fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, jaundice, dark beer-colored urine, and pale stools. Diagnosis relies on PCR to detect viral RNA, complemented by blood panels to identify the hepatitis type. There is no specific antiviral therapy; most cases are mild and self-limiting, though infection in the third trimester of pregnancy can cause fulminant liver failure and death. Vaccination exists only in China; Russia has none. The new test detects RNA 7–10 days before symptoms, aiding asymptomatic and donor screening.

triage.headline_ja: E型肝炎：症状、原因、診断、治療
triage.triage_reason: ロシアが新たなE型肝炎検査法を開発したという医療技術・啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はE型肝炎の一般的な疾患説明とロシアでの新規検査キット開発に関する内容であり、具体的な感染発生や流行の報告ではない。中国はワクチン保有国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti Mosquito Study: Early Signs of Insecticide Resistance in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Delhi study on Aedes aegypti (dengue vector) reports an early sign of potential insecticide resistance to α-cypermethrin in a laboratory colony. At the diagnostic dose of 10 μg per bottle, 97.91% of adult female mosquitoes died, just below the 98% threshold for full susceptibility, suggesting a small survival gap and a detoxification response. Five enzymes were analyzed: β-esterase showed the strongest predicted binding to α-cypermethrin with activity increasing about 21.4-fold at LD50 and 17.5-fold at LD90; CYP450 doubled; α-esterase rose >7-fold; glutathione S-transferase decreased; acetylcholinesterase had the weakest predicted binding. The colony, not sourced from current outbreak areas and maintained without insecticide pressure since 2009/2017, did not prove resistance but warrants field verification in wild populations to inform dengue control in India. Findings published in Frontiers in Tropical Diseases (2026).

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ研究：デリーにおける殺虫剤耐性の初期兆候
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病アウトブレイクではなく、実験室内コロニーを用いた基礎研究論文の報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 研究対象は2009/2017年から殺虫剤圧のない実験室コロニーであり、野外の流行株や現行のアウトブレイクとは無関係。デング熱の実際の発生状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Stop Waiting For Foreigners To Save Nigerians From Mosquitoes' -- Group Blasts Tinubu Govt Amid Malaria Crisis
article.articleSummary: Malaria burden in Nigeria takes center stage as #EndMalariaInNigeria blasts the Tinubu administration on World Mosquito Day 2026. The group decries donor-financed malaria control, citing the 2025 U.S. suspension of major global health aid and Nigeria’s subsequent emergency $200 million health outlay as evidence that malaria prevention remains under domestic leadership and funding. It warns that thousands die from preventable, mosquito-borne disease and urges the government to internalize responsibility, fund a universal malaria diagnosis and treatment program, and terminate reliance on foreign donors. Lagos and other cities are tied to poor environmental management—blocked drains, refuse, stagnant water and under-maintained water infrastructure—that fuel breeding and transmission. Citing Zambia (222%) domestic malaria funding and Sudan (400%), the group calls for sustained investment in sanitation, dam maintenance, vector research, education, and retention of Nigerian scientists, entomologists, and public health professionals, with vector control embedded in the health system.

triage.headline_ja: 「外国人に頼るのはやめよう」―マラリア危機の中、団体がティヌブ政権を批判

triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）のマラリア対策資金政策に関する批判。ザンビア・スーダンは資金増加率の比較対象として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生イベントではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Como o desmatamento da Amazônia pode desencadear novas epidemias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How deforestation in the Amazon could trigger new epidemics
article.articleSummary: Oropouche fever, caused by Oropouche virus (OROV), historically confined to the Amazon and transmitted mainly by the maruim midge Culicoides paraensis, is now spreading beyond its traditional range. A new lineage, OROV BR-2015-2024, has traversed Brazil more than 3,000 km from the North, with Espírito Santo reporting over 6,300 cases in 2025. The virus has also appeared in other Latin American countries and among travelers in Europe. Since the 1960s, Brazil’s Amazon region may have seen over half a million infections, with the latest pattern showing emergence in new areas. Deforestation and frontier development bring humans into closer contact with wildlife and domestic animals at forest edges, increasing spillover risk via shared vectors and resources. Biodiversity can buffer transmission, but increased interspecies contact elevates risk. Fiocruz’s 2025 survey mapped 1,025 microorganisms across 343 wild mammal species, of which 162 could potentially transmit to humans, underscoring ongoing spillover risk amid Amazon occupation and infrastructure pressures.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの森林破壊がいかにして新たな感染症流行を引き起こしうるか
triage.triage_reason: オロプーシュ熱の新系統がブラジル国内で拡大し国際的にも症例が報告されているが、本記事は森林破壊とスピルオーバーリスクに関する解説的特集記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの探知情報ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は一般誌による解説記事で、エスピリトサント州で2025年に6,300例超のオロプーシュ熱報告、新系統BR-2015-2024がアマゾン北部から3,000km以上拡散したことに言及。既存の流行状況のまとめであり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、拡大傾向は継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 5 bini aştı: Ölüm oranı bazı bölgelerde yüzde 70'e ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases: the fatality rate has reached 70% in some regions.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases, with an overall case fatality rate around 47.4% and regional rates up to 70% in North Kivu. The epidemic concentrates in remote, insecure areas, notably Ituri province’s capital Bunia, where health workers face burnout, wage delays, and strikes, complicating response efforts. The WHO warns the transmission is rapid, potentially outpacing the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus, hindering care. Security threats, armed groups, and violence disrupt interventions, especially in rural mining zones and displacement camps. A suspected case in Aru preceded an attack on a health team and an ambulance. Authorities suspect Mongbwalu mining city as the origin; the government declared the outbreak on May 15. MSF emphasizes information gaps and community involvement to control spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数が5000人を突破：一部地域では致死率が70%に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が5000症例を超え致死率も高く、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない上、治安悪化により対応が困難であり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOはこの流行の伝播速度が2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性があると警告。治安不安、武装勢力による攻撃、医療従事者のストライキなどが対応を著しく困難にしている。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Gawat, 76 Ibu Hamil di Kabupaten Serang Terindikasi Terpapar Positif HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent: 76 Pregnant Women in Serang Regency Suspected to be HIV-Positive
article.articleSummary: Serang Regency, Banten, Indonesia reports 76 pregnant women suspected HIV-positive after routine prenatal screenings conducted since January 2026, per the Serang District Health Office (Dinkes). The screenings test for HIV, syphilis, and tuberculosis. Health Chief Efrizal warned that HIV-positive pregnancies risk mother-to-child transmission, prompting strict medical management to interrupt transmission chains. Authorities urge that HIV-suspected or confirmed pregnant women adhere to antiretroviral therapy (ART) consistently. They also recommend cesarean delivery to reduce transmission risk during birth. The findings highlight the importance of ongoing screening and treatment to manage the situation locally, with focus on ART adherence and delivery planning for affected pregnancies.

triage.triage_reason: 地域的なHIV母子感染事例であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域の公衆衛生対応能力や継続的なスクリーニング状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病（HIV）の地域的な母子感染管理事例であり、新興感染症や国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。地元保健当局が既に対応（ART、帝王切開推奨）を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में टीबी का कहर, 42 दिन में मिले 12 हजार से अधिक नए मरीज - delhi sees 12000 new tb cases in 42 days screening reveals
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB havoc in Delhi: over 12,000 new TB cases detected in 42 days.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 12,078 new TB cases in a 42-day screening window (24 March–5 May), with 71,603 tested (1,323 children, 10,755 adults). About 42% of cases are extrapulmonary TB. Under the TB Free India initiative, by 1 July 2026 Delhi had screened 2.883 million people, conducted 2.167 million chest X-rays and 365,000 molecular tests, and notified 175,000 TB patients. TB notifications have exceeded 100,000 for three consecutive years (2023: 100,523; 2024: 105,343; 2025: 112,977). The 2019–21 National TB Prevalence Survey reported Delhi prevalence at 747 per lakh. Thirty-eight high-risk wards across 11 districts have been identified for intensified active case finding, chest radiography and molecular testing, aiming to cover over 80% of Delhi’s TB burden. TB deaths totaled 65,985 between 2005–2024, with 2024 reporting 5,093 deaths (4.86% of all deaths).

triage.headline_ja: デリーでTB猛威、42日間で1万2000人以上の新規TB患者が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドで既に地方病として知られており、今回の報告は積極的スクリーニング強化による症例発見数の増加であり、新規・異常な感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: デリー州の「TB Free India」イニシアチブによる積極的症例発見の成果報告であり、既存の国家結核対策プログラムの一環。突発的な流行や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak out of control in Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO says: 'It is spreading faster than our ability to contain it'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected more than 5,100 people and caused at least 2,420 deaths since it began circulating earlier this year, making it the DRC's deadliest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The outbreak spans six eastern provinces—Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—with more than 55 health zones affected and over 1,000 people recovered after symptomatic treatment. The WHO and UN warn the situation remains very high risk for the DRC and high for Uganda, with the rest of Africa at low risk. There is no approved vaccine or treatment effective against Bundibugyo; existing products target the Zaire strain. Late detection stemmed from diagnostic tests designed for Zaire and misdiagnoses with malaria or typhus. A large share of deaths occur in communities rather than hospitals, though Uganda recently contained a Bundibugyo outbreak in July via rapid contact tracing.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, Malaria Risk Can Continue Beyond Monsoon, Doctors Warn
article.articleSummary: Dengue, malaria and chikungunya risk in Hyderabad can extend beyond the monsoon as rising temperatures, irregular rainfall, urbanisation and changing weather broaden year‑round mosquito breeding. Stagnant water in coolers, flower pots, open containers, construction sites and terraces can sustain vectors; hence mosquito control must be year‑round. Prevention methods include removing standing water, covering water storage and using measures to prevent bites. Symptoms overlap with other infections and include fever, headache, body pain, weakness, nausea and vomiting; fever outside the monsoon should not be dismissed as routine. In dengue, a critical phase can occur around days 3–7 after illness onset even as fever falls, with potential complications. Overall risk depends on local temperature, rainfall, humidity, mosquito activity and environmental conditions rather than calendar season. Timely evaluation is advised for persistent or alarming symptoms, on World Mosquito Day (20 August 2026) in Hyderabad.

article.articleHeadline: RDC : un bouclier sanitaire fluvial contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a riverine public health shield against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths (WHO), making it the country’s deadliest on record. To curb spread along the Congo River corridor from Kisangani to Kinshasa, the government launched the multisectoral initiative "Fleuve Sans Ebola." The plan establishes fixed-point hubs at major sites—Kinshasa, Mbandaka, Kwamouth, Kisangani—plus secondary hubs and floating units on vessels traversing the river. Activities include surveillance, prevention kits, and rapid initial case management, with shipowners and crews trained as community surveillance agents via a mobile app that reports to a land platform connected to the river police. Governance is led by the Interior Ministry/Civil Protection, with Transport and Health providing coordination and technical support. The project aims to be sustained and scalable beyond Ebola to strengthen the Congo-Oubangui-Sangha basin’s resilience to outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラに対する河川防衛シールド

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյի Դեմոկրատական ​​Հանրապետությունում Էբոլա վարակից մահացածների թիվը հասել է 2476-ի

The World Health Organization announced it would provide 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to protect health workers and support clinical trials. Declared May 15, this outbreak is distinguished by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no established vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス病による死者数が2,476人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（症例5,208件、死者2,476人）で、致死率が高く、ワクチンや治療法が未確立の株（ブンディブギョ株）による発生であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・支援が既に動いている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses for outbreak response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, continues to surge with more than 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths in the past three months. The World Health Organization has released 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses for limited use, including 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to test protection against the Bundibugyo strain and 50,000 for frontline and health workers. Ervebo is approved only for the Zaire strain; no licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. The affected areas suffer from limited health infrastructure and ongoing armed-group activity. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Early animal studies suggested Ervebo could offer some protection, and the trial will determine whether this extends to humans. As of 2026-08-20, these measures aim to bolster outbreak response and frontline protection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、アウトブレイク対応のためエボラワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo株エボラ流行が5000症例超・死者2300人超に達し、承認済みワクチンがない中で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチンがなく、Ervebo（Zaire株用）の第3相試験が実施される点、武装勢力の活動により医療インフラが制限されている点が特筆される。致死率が極めて高い（2300/5000超）ことも重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliche Virus-Variante breitet sich unkontrolliert aus - sieben neue Zonen betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous virus variant spreads uncontrollably — seven new zones affected.
article.articleSummary: Since May, an exceptionally fast-spreading Bundibugyo variant of Ebola has driven a severe outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 5,000 infections and nearly 50% case fatality. By August 2026 seven additional health zones — Gombari (Haut-Uélé), Lubero (Nord-Kivu), Bafwasende, Kabondo, Tshopo, Wanie-Rukula (all in Tshopo Province) and Buta (Bas-Uélé) — reported infections, broadening the geographic reach. Ituri Province accounts for more than 80% of confirmed cases and about 80% of deaths. There is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Approximately 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers, underscoring challenges in detection and isolation. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak could last longer than a year and become the largest globally. Neighboring Uganda and South Sudan face spillover risk. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the deadliest in the country’s history.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス変異株が制御不能に拡大 ― 新たに7地域で感染確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブジョ変異株がDRC東部で5000人超感染、致死率約50%に達し、7つの新たな保健地域に拡大、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクが指摘されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。DRC史上最大・最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、Africa CDCも長期化・世界最大規模化の懸念を表明している。

article.articleHeadline: Los fallecidos por ébola superan los 2.400 en República Democrática...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths exceed 2,400 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,400 deaths with more than 5,200 infections as of August 20, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 103 new cases, 35 deaths, and 24 recoveries were reported, bringing totals to 5,208 cases and 2,476 deaths since the mid-May start. Africa CDC warns the outbreak remains a very high public health risk and shows signs of a potential pandemic emergency. The surge across more provinces is straining health systems, notably maternity care and malaria services. The case fatality rate exceeds 46%, with limited treatments. Africa CDC estimates only 30–40% of cases are detected, suggesting the true burden could be about three times higher. The outbreak has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with a higher-level pandemic alert under consideration by the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者、コンゴ民主共和国で2,400人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者2,400人超、致死率46%超）がPHEICに指定され、パンデミック化の懸念もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC指定済みであり、WHOによる更なる警戒レベル引き上げが検討されている。検出率が30-40%と推定され、実際の感染規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО предоставя от ваксината "Ервебо" за справяне с епидемията от ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO provides the Ervebo vaccine to tackle the Ebola epidemic in Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO is providing 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to address the outbreak in DR Congo. The vaccine is approved to protect against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but not against the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating in the country. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 are allocated for a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses are designated for frontline workers and healthcare professionals. The DR Congo Ebola epidemic is described as the deadliest in the country’s history. The effort underscores vaccination for frontline protection alongside research to evaluate cross-strain effectiveness, with imported vaccine supply prioritized for health workers and a trial to determine performance against the circulating Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行対策として「エルベボ」ワクチンを提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最も致死的とされるエボラ流行が継続中で、既存承認ワクチンが効かないブンディブギョ株が流行しているという異常事態であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性）に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ・ザイール株用ワクチン「エルベボ」は現在流行中のブンディブギョ株には未承認であり、20,000回分は第3相試験用、50,000回分は最前線の医療従事者向けとして配分されている。国史上最悪規模の流行とされ、WHOによる国際支援が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo: United Nations (UN) supports scaled-up response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with over 5,200 confirmed cases and nearly 2,500 deaths as of 18 August. The UN and partners are scaling up the response with five priorities: tripling safe-care capacity, strengthening community engagement, doubling safe burials, expanding surveillance, and increasing support for the most vulnerable. The Government launched the 'Congo River Without Ebola' initiative along the 1,700-kilometre Congo River to bolster surveillance at ports and transit points, improve early warning and referrals, and bolster riverine preparedness. CERF, IOM, WHO, UNICEF, WFP and partners fund the effort. WHO has allocated 70,000 doses of Ebola Zaire vaccine to the DRC to assist frontline workers and a clinical trial to evaluate the vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国連（UN）がエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応拡大を支援
triage.triage_reason: 5,200例超・死亡者2,500人近くと大規模拡大が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国連機関による大規模国際支援が実施されている。
triage.notes: コンゴ川流域1,700kmにわたる監視強化イニシアチブ「Congo River Without Ebola」が開始され、CERF・IOM・WHO・UNICEF・WFP等の国際機関が資金提供・対応拡大を実施。WHOはワクチン7万回分をDRCに配布し、Bundibugyoウイルスに対する臨床試験も実施予定。
