article.articleHeadline: CEPI funds $4.17m studies to test Ebola vaccines against Bundibugyo virus
article.articleSummary: CEPI commits $4.17 million to four research projects to test whether existing Ebola vaccines elicit immune responses against Bundibugyo virus amid the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern in May. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is licensed; Zaire ebolavirus vaccines, including Ervebo, may offer cross-protection, and studies will analyse stored samples from thousands previously vaccinated. UCLA Fielding School of Public Health will receive $2.05 million to examine immune responses among Ervebo and Ad26.ZEBOV/MVA-BN-Filo recipients, using data from over 1,700 participants and about 1,800 stored sera. ITM Antwerp gets $1.02 million for EBO-BOOST-BRIDGE to assess cross-protection in >600 participants and transfer methods to DRC’s NIBR, with first antibody results in 2–6 months. Oxford’s Nuffield Department of Medicine receives $975,000 to test Ervebo recipients and Zaire ebolavirus survivors for potential protection against Bundibugyo. MRC-Glasgow Centre for Virus Research receives $120,000 to study antibodies in vaccinated close contacts and Ugandan healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: CEPI、ブンディブギョウウイルスに対するエボラワクチンの有効性を検証する研究に417万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCで既に発生し5月にPHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクに関する研究資金提供のニュースであり、新規の感染症イベントや状況変化を報告するものではないため、新規シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究資金提供（CEPI拠出）に関するもので、DRCでの既存エボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているのみ。新規アウトブレイクや状況悪化の報告ではないため、既にPHEIC宣言済みの既知事案として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo ar putea fi mult mai gravă. Numărul real al cazurilor, de trei ori mai mare - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo could be much more serious. The real number of cases is three times higher - ProTV News
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), driven by the Bundibugyo variant, may be three times larger than confirmed cases, with only 30–40% detected. CDC Africa notes under 10% of cases are linked to known contacts and under 40% have a clear epidemiologic link to a confirmed case. The Bundibugyo strain causes milder, less hemorrhagic symptoms, hindering risk perception and delaying care. About 97% of recent deaths occurred in community settings or general health facilities lacking adequate infection prevention and isolation protocols. The government raised the death toll to 2,476 since the outbreak was declared in eastern DRC on 15 May. By comparison, West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic caused roughly 28,000 infections and 11,000 deaths, affecting Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行はさらに深刻な可能性。実際の症例数は3倍多いとみられる - ProTVニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）は検出率が30-40%と低く、実際の症例数が過小評価されている可能性が指摘されており、死者数も2,476人に達している。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクと国際支援の必要性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアにも言及しているが、これらは2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較のための記述であり、現在の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。実際の発生地域はDRC東部のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana steps up Ebola surveillance amid rising cases in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, Ghana has stepped up Ebola surveillance at airports, land entry points, and health facilities in response to a surge of Ebola cases and deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, raising cross-border transmission concerns. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh said surveillance systems have been activated from entry points to facilities to detect and contain any imported case promptly. Ghana is collaborating with the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research and has procured reagents and equipment to strengthen testing and response capacity. The aim is early detection at points of entry and rapid containment if cases arise, with a call for stronger regional cooperation across Africa to share information, expertise, and technology and to bolster local production of essential health commodities and coordinate regional responses. Lessons from COVID-19, Marburg, and Mpox underscore the importance of preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、アフリカでのエボラ症例急増を受けてサーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例・死亡が急増しており、隣接地域への越境拡大リスクからガーナが水際対策を強化している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的・政府関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はガーナの水際対策強化だが、実際のエボラ発生・流行はDRCで進行中。ガーナ国内での感染確認は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 5,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, with transmission extending into northern and eastern regions where state presence is weak and health infrastructure is severely limited. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain; there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though clinical trials are underway. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak killed 2,299 of 3,381 confirmed cases, highlighting the severity of Ebola in the region. WHO Director‑General Tedros warned the epidemic is far from under control and that the risk of further national and international spread remains high. Community mistrust and testing refusals hinder surveillance and response, and criticisms point to slow, poorly organized responses. The EU has pledged 2.5 million euros in testing kits to bolster efforts, while Africa CDC coordinates ongoing measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例数が5,000人を超える

In the last 24 hours, 103 new cases, 35 deaths and 24 recoveries were reported, lifting totals to 5,208 infections and 2,476 deaths. The CDC warns the outbreak remains a very high public health risk and carries indications of a potential pandemic, noting the spread across more provinces is disrupting health services, including care for pregnant women and malaria patients. article.articleHeadline: Dia Internacional do Mosquito mobiliza ciência e sociedade contra epidemias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Mosquito Day mobilizes science and society against epidemics.
article.articleSummary: International Mosquito Day highlights the global toll of vector-borne diseases, with mosquitoes linked to more than 700,000 deaths annually. Four WHO-listed diseases are transmitted by mosquitoes—dengue, Zika, yellow fever, and lymphatic filariasis—while vector-borne infections account for over 17% of all infectious diseases. Malaria causes about 249 million cases and 608,000 deaths each year, mainly among children under five. In the Americas, dengue reached 4.5 million cases in 2025 across 103 countries; in the first half of 2026, confirmed cases total 2.7 million with over 4,800 deaths. OPAS reports dengue cases rising since the 1980s from 1.5 to 16.2 million. Aedes aegypti, originating in Egypt, transmits more than 30 viruses; Brazil eradicated it in 1955 but it is now present in all states. Innovations include Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes via World Mosquito Program and the Butantan dengue vaccine (79.6% efficacy, <0.1% severe events). Preventive actions include household measures and vaccination in forested regions.

triage.headline_ja: 国際モスキートデー、科学と社会を疫病対策へと動員
triage.triage_reason: 世界規模の啓発記事であり、特定の異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO ta ayyana ƙasashen Afrika 5 a sahun waɗanda suka kawo ƙarshen annobar Polio
article.articleSummary: Five African countries—Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Uganda—are lauded by the World Health Organization for leading efforts that have halted the polio outbreak, specifically polio type 2. From January to June this year, no new polio cases were reported in these five nations. WHO Africa region director Dr. Mohamed Janabi says the countries have achieved containment of the type 2 outbreak, but vigilance remains essential to prevent re-emergence and to obtain certification of eradicating the disease worldwide, which typically requires at least three years without any outbreak. Polio remains untreatable; prevention relies on vaccination and health measures. The eradication push reflects a long-running collaboration among governments and partners, including WHO, the U.S. CDC, UNICEF, the Gates Foundation, and Gavi.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカ5カ国をポリオ流行終息の先導国として表彰

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RD Congo pode ser o triplo de casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be three times the number of confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo could be up to three times larger than officially confirmed, with 5,208 cases reported, Africa CDC says. Only 30–40% of real infections are detected; models from RD Congo and Imperial College estimate the true outbreak size could triple the confirmed tally. Fewer than 10% of cases originate from known contacts, and under 40% have a clear link to a confirmed case. The Bundibugyo strain causes milder symptoms than Zaire, with fewer hemorrhagic signs, hindering risk perception and delaying care. About 97% of recent deaths occur in community settings or general health facilities lacking isolation and infection control. No active transmission for over 42 days in three health zones; Ituri remains epicenter, with North and South Kivu reporting no cases in 79 days. Two cases in Buta, Bas-Uélé near the CAR border, with mobile labs and cross-border surveillance. Outbreak surpasses 2018–2020 eastern DRC event but is not as deadly as 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRC東部で拡大しており、実際の感染規模が公式確認数の最大3倍に達する可能性があるとAfrica CDCが指摘。検出率の低さや国境地帯での新規症例発生など、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bas-Uélé州ブタでの2例は中央アフリカ共和国との国境付近で報告されており、越境監視が実施されているが、CARでの発生は確認されていないため対象国リストには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola aggrave la crise dans l'Est, alerte le BCNUDH | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola worsens the crisis in the East, UN Human Rights Office warns | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak worsens the rights crisis in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, notably Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, according to the UN Human Rights Office. In June 2026, the BCNUDH documents 657 rights violations affecting at least 1,187 victims, up 33% from May. In conflict-affected provinces, 574 violations impacted 904 people, versus 83 violations for 283 victims in non-conflict areas. Conflict-related sexual violence totaled 46 cases affecting at least 73 victims (56 women, 15 girls, 2 men), with North Kivu accounting for about 73% of victims, South Kivu 16%, and Ituri 11%. The report highlights the Ebola epidemic as an additional driver of vulnerability and protection challenges in these provinces. BCNUDH emphasizes continued monitoring to inform state action and accountability for those responsible.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが東部の危機を悪化させる、国連人権高等弁務官事務所（BCNUDH）が警告

triage.notes: 記事は主にBCNUDHの人権侵害報告に焦点を当てているが、エボラ流行が紛争地域での脆弱性を悪化させている点が明記されており、DRC東部での継続的なエボラ発生が示唆される。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的疫学データは記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: 70.000 δόσεις του εμβολίου Ervebo τίθενται στη διάθεση της ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine are made available to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak was declared May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak state presence and strained health systems, reaching 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths—the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. The World Health Organization announced the allocation of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses for the Zaire ebolavirus strain, though protection against Bundibugyo remains unproven. Of the total, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to evaluate Bundibugyo protection, while 50,000 doses are reserved for frontline health workers in the DRC. The distribution follows coordination by the Global Intervention Group (GIG) with WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MSF, and Gavi. Trials in the DRC are planned; two Bundibugyo vaccines—Moderna (mRNA) and Oxford University—are in development, with rVSV Bundibugyo from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) touted as most promising. Ebola transmits via body fluids and has caused substantial Africa-wide mortality over five decades.

triage.notes: シンガポールはBundibugyo株向けワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内の弱体な保健システムと地理的条件から国際拡大リスクをYesと評価したが、実際の越境事例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo receberá 70 mil doses da vacina Ervebo para conter surto de Ebola, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to contain an Ebola outbreak, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Ervebo will be shipped to the Democratic Republic of Congo to help contain the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, with over 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or treatments are approved, and whether Ervebo offers protection remains unproven; 20,000 doses will be used in an advanced-stage clinical study to assess vaccine impact against Bundibugyo. The shipment is funded by Gavi, with about US$7 million for delivery and US$6 million to support vaccination in high-risk areas, and is coordinated by the International Coordination Group (ICG) for Vaccine Provision (WHO, IFRC, MSF, UNICEF). The WHO continues to treat the eastern Congo outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. Ervebo is approved for the more common Ebola Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ流行を抑えるためWHOがエルベボワクチン7万回分を提供へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行（症例5,000超、死者2,378人）が継続中で、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として扱っており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本疾患株はBundibugyo型で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、Ervebo（Zaire株用）の有効性は未証明。20,000回分は臨床試験に使用予定。Gavi・ICG（WHO/IFRC/MSF/UNICEF）による国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Numărul real al cazurilor de Ebola ar putea fi de 3 ori mai mare: Are un ritm record de răspândire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The real number of Ebola cases could be three times higher: It is spreading at a record pace
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-variant Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows 5,208 confirmed infections and 2,476 deaths across five provinces; OMS data cited 5,105 cases and 2,420 deaths. Health authorities warn the true scale may be up to three times higher, with only 30-40% of infections detected. MSF notes rapid growth: confirmed cases tripled in less than five weeks and deaths rose at least fivefold, with about 97% of recent deaths occurring in communities or general health centers lacking proper isolation and infection-control protocols. The Bundibugyo form presents milder symptoms and fewer hemorrhagic signs, hindering recognition. WHO allocated 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses to DRC (20,000 for a Phase 3 trial and 50,000 for frontline health workers), though Ervebo targets the Zaire strain and does not cover Bundibugyo. The WHO also launched the EBO PEP trial to evaluate obeldesivir’s antiviral efficacy in contacts of confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例数、実際は3倍多い可能性:記録的な速さで拡大中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラが5,000例超・死亡2,000例超に達し急速拡大中で、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存のZaire株ワクチン(Ervebo)はBundibugyo株に対応せず、検出率も30-40%と低いため実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性が高い。WHOはEBO PEP試験や追加ワクチン配布を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Navarra registra uno de los tres casos de Zika diagnosticados en España este año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Navarra records one of the three Zika cases diagnosed in Spain this year.
article.articleSummary: Navarra reports one of Spain's three Zika cases in 2026. Across the year, Navarra has confirmed eight Dengue, seven Chikungunya, and one Zika among travelers returning from Brazil, Bolivia, Cuba, Guatemala, Indonesia, the Maldives, the Dominican Republic, Senegal, and Sri Lanka. Aedes albopictus is established in Navarra, raising the risk of local transmission if an infected traveler passes the virus to local mosquitoes. Autochthonous transmission has occurred in France, Italy, and Spain in recent years. Spain's chikungunya total reaches 119 (up from 42 in 2025), all imported, with Catalonia reporting 30 cases, Valencia 27, and Madrid 13. Dengue totals 143 (vs 195 in 2025), with many linked to travel to the Maldives; Catalonia 41, Madrid 18, Valencia and Andalusia 17 each. Zika totals three (2 in Valencia, 1 in Navarra). Public health measures emphasize vector control, personal protection, and seeking medical care for febrile illness after travel.

triage.headline_ja: ナバラ州、今年スペインで診断されたジカ熱3症例のうち1例を記録
triage.triage_reason: スペイン国内における輸入症例（渡航関連）の報告であり、対象国（ブラジル・インドネシア等）は感染者の渡航先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はスペインであるため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン（ナバラ州等）における輸入性ジカ・デング・チクングニア症例の年間集計に関するもので、感染者はブラジル・ボリビア・キューバ・グアテマラ・インドネシア・モルディブ・ドミニカ共和国・セネガル・スリランカへの渡航歴を持つ。実際の発生（感染）地はスペインであり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Govt Starts Distributing Cholera Prevention Supplies - ZNBC
article.articleSummary: Cholera prevention supplies, including Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) and zinc, are being distributed in cholera hot spots in Lusaka by the Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI). The effort targets more than 9,000 households with cholera sensitisation over the next 14 days. In Chilanga district, Dr. SHEMPELA said the door-to-door programme will equip communities with information on preventing cholera and responding to cases. ZNPHI National Cholera Coordinator MASUZYO ZYAMBO added that the institute will continue sensitising communities on preventive measures to reduce cholera spread. The activity is part of broader cholera preparedness aimed at ensuring community members are well informed and equipped to reduce the spread of the disease.

triage.triage_reason: ザンビアの既知のコレラホットスポットにおける予防・啓発活動の報道であり、新規の急激な感染拡大を示す情報はないが、コレラの継続的な発生状況を示しており経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Over 2.36 crore screened for TB in special drive
article.articleSummary: During a TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan special drive in Bihar from July 2 to Aug 14, over 2.36 crore people were screened, exceeding the target of one crore. Officials reported 87,623 TB cases detected, including 21,550 asymptomatic. The state backs community-based screening, modern diagnostics, and regular follow-up; 547 panchayats were certified TB-free in 2025. Public-private partnerships are pivotal, with private-sector TB notifications at 62% as of Aug 13. Bihar houses 487 fixed X-ray machines and 101 AI-enabled portable X-ray units, plus 651 molecular diagnostics machines. Since March 24, 2026, more than 5.4 lakh Ayushman Arogya Shivirs have occurred. Focus areas include daily medication, Nikshay Poshan Yojana nutrition, CBNAAT and Truenat diagnostics, and shorter regimens for drug-resistant TB, with stronger private engagement. Dr B K Mishra stresses timely diagnosis, uninterrupted treatment, and continuous monitoring to prevent drug resistance. The workshop involved Global Health Strategies, WHO, Piramal Health and CFAR.

article.articleHeadline: MP: Health Dept probes Indore hospital after Ujjain woman's H1N1-linked death
article.articleSummary: Indore health authorities probe a private hospital after a Ujjain resident died from H1N1 (swine flu). The patient, reported as around 60–62 years old, tested positive for H1N1 while at an Indore facility; she was discharged on 18 August against doctors’ advice and died at home in Ujjain on 19 August. The Indore Chief Medical and Health Officer said the hospital failed to inform the Health Department about the case. A three-member investigation team (Abhishek Nigam, Anshul Mishra, Virendra Rajgeer) has been ordered to examine the matter and report findings. H1N1 is a notifiable disease under IDSP, and private hospitals are required to report such cases; actions under the Nursing Home Act may follow. With monsoon humidity rising in June–August, timely reporting and surveillance are emphasized as authorities monitor the situation and await the investigation results.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の単発死亡例であり、医療機関の報告義務違反という行政的問題が主眼。国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクはなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | четверг: Украина, Газа, Эбола, Южный Судан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Main News of the Day | Thursday: Ukraine, Gaza, Ebola, South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemns Russia's massive strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, citing civilian casualties and damage to infrastructure; he warns of escalation and potential spillover into Russia, urging an immediate halt to hostilities under international humanitarian law. In Gaza, UN OCHA reports ongoing civilian harm from Israeli airstrikes and shelling, while restrictions on heavy machinery and cargo impede relief and debris clearance; 50 bodies have been buried recently, including 19 children, following rubble extraction. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with over 5,200 cases and about 2,500 deaths as of Aug 18; WHO notes 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses allocated for health workers and for a clinical trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. In South Sudan, the UN Human Rights Commission warns that renewed fighting raises the risk of atrocities, including genocide and ethnic cleansing, if elections proceed without security guarantees.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak expands in DR Congo: UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand, with more than 5,200 cases and nearly 2,500 deaths reported as of Aug. 18, UN spokesman Stephane Dujarric said. Humanitarian agencies warn of continued spread as authorities and partners intensify response. Senior Ebola coordinator Julian Harneis and colleagues prioritise five operational goals: tripling safe care capacity, strengthening community engagement, doubling safe and dignified burial teams, expanding disease surveillance, and increasing support for the most vulnerable. In support, the Congolese government launched the 'Congo River Without Ebola' initiative with UN backing to bolster surveillance along the Congo River, a 1,700-km route linking numerous communities and provinces. The WHO allocated 70,000 doses of Ebola Zaire vaccine to Congo. The outbreak has affected 56 health zones across six provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大：国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で6州56保健地域に拡大し、5200症例・2500人以上の死者が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率は約48%と高く、国連・WHO・コンゴ政府が大規模な国際支援体制を敷いている。North Kivuは対象国リストの地域IDに含まれていないが、DRC自体は対象国のため国単位で計上。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria Municipal de Saúde monitora casos de arboviroses em Vitória da Conquista na 32ª Semana Epidemiológica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Health Secretariat Monitors Arboviral Disease Cases in Vitória da Conquista During the 32nd Epidemiological Week.
article.articleSummary: During epidemiological week 32 (Aug 9-15), 2026, Vitória da Conquista’s Municipal Health Secretariat reports 15 dengue, 1 chikungunya, and no Zika notified; 12 dengue and 1 chikungunya probable. Week 32-2025 had 22 dengue probable and 2 chikungunya probable, showing reductions. Dengue probable cases are distributed across Alto Maron, Boa Vista (2), Brasil, Guarany, Ibirapuera, José Gonçalves, Lagoa das Flores, Patagônia, São Pedro, Universidade, and Vila Elisa. Year-to-date 2026: dengue 887 notified (684 probable, 25 confirmed); chikungunya 70 notified (64 probable, 1 confirmed); Zika 2 notified (2 probable, 1 confirmed). Data from Sinan On-line and subject to change as investigations continue. Endemic-control teams reiterate vector prevention: eliminate standing water, keep water tanks closed, and proper waste disposal. Seek care for fever, body pains, rash, or nausea; contact Centro de Controle de Endemias at (77) 3229-3151.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RDC supera 5 mil casos y es el segundo brote más letal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC surpasses 5,000 cases and is the second deadliest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases, becoming the second-deadliest global outbreak. As of August 17, 2026, the DRC reports 5,105 infections and 2,420 deaths (case fatality 47.4%). About 782 patients are isolated or hospitalized, with 1,091 recoveries; contact tracing covers 84.1% of contacts. The outbreak has surpassed 4,000 cases in under two weeks, marking the fastest growth in the country. It exceeds the 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases) but remains below Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (approximately 28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the situation could reach a magnitude similar to that historic emergency. The World Health Organization maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern designation after reviewing the past three months of response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、5000症例を超え史上2番目に致死的な流行に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が5000人を超え、致死率47.4%と極めて深刻。WHOがPHEICを維持しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCのみを主題としているため除外した。WHOはPHEIC指定を継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Gavi commits additional $7 million to Ebola response in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts Gavi to commit an additional $7 million, providing 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses from the global Ebola stockpile. The International Coordination Group on Vaccine Provision allocated these doses to DRC for rapid deployment under WHO SAGE guidance. Gavi also approves $6 million from the First Response Fund to protect routine immunisation and prepare for Ebola vaccination, part of roughly $50 million FRF support since May. About $4 million will help sustain immunisation for more than 1.17 million children under two across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele; the rest strengthens immunisation monitoring, reporting and community engagement. An additional $1.5 million funds technical guidance from Africa CDC, WHO and UNICEF; $500,000 strengthens routine immunisation and data systems in Uganda. Described as the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, deployment will follow WHO guidance.

triage.headline_ja: Gaviがコンゴのエボラ対応に追加で700万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行に対し、Gavi・WHO・UNICEF・Africa CDCが大規模な国際支援を実施しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は『コンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行』と明記。ウガンダへの支援も言及されているが、これは免疫システム強化目的であり、ウガンダでの流行発生は記載されていないため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde avança na construção do edital para desenvolver teste portátil inédito de tuberculose - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health advances in drafting the tender to develop a novel portable tuberculosis test - Ponta Porã Informa - Ponta Porã News - Mato Grosso do Sul and Pedro Juan Caballero, Paraguay.
article.articleSummary: Cross-border Brazil-Paraguay effort to develop a portable tuberculosis diagnostic device advances as part of Brazil's Ministry of Health Encomenda Tecnologia (Etec). In August 2026, the process has drawn 24 contributions from Brazilian and international companies to the first technology order, with July–August consultations led by the Secretariat for Science, Technology and Innovation in Health (SCTIE/MS). Feedback, including 15 electronic responses after a July 8 public market hearing and 9 virtual meetings, emphasized expertise in clinical diagnostics, biotechnology, and rapid molecular tests. The resulting guidance will inform a final report expected this month; the public call is planned for October and contract signing in December. Unlike conventional bids, Etec funds R&D to deliver an unprecedented portable TB diagnostic to the SUS, addressing public health challenges for the Mato Grosso do Sul border region with Paraguay (Ponta Porã and Pedro Juan Caballero).

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核の新型ポータブル検査機器開発に向けた入札公告の作成を推進
triage.triage_reason: これは結核診断機器の研究開発・調達手続きに関する行政的な進捗報告であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増等の感染症イベントを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の症例発生ではなく、ブラジル保健省による携帯型結核診断機器開発の技術調達プロセス（Etec）に関する行政報告。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、疾病発生事象ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: ДР Конго получит 70 тысяч доз вакцины от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: DR Congo to receive 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization announced that the Democratic Republic of Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ebola vaccine Ervebo to protect health workers and support clinical testing. Of the total, 20,000 doses are allocated for a phase 3 trial to evaluate the vaccine's performance against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 doses are designated for frontline workers and medical staff in accordance with current WHO recommendations. The package illustrates a dual aim: advancing evidence on vaccine efficacy against Bundibugyo virus while enhancing frontline protection in DR Congo's Ebola response. By distributing doses between experimental testing and frontline protection, the plan highlights ongoing international efforts to address Ebola through vaccination in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国がエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で稀なブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに対するワクチン第3相試験および最前線医療従事者への予防接種が進行中であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給に関する内容だが、ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる進行中のアウトブレイクとWHOによる国際支援の存在を示唆している。感染規模や死亡者数など詳細情報は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Corporators Slam BMC Fogging Drive As Malaria Cases Rise, Demand Action At Construction Sites
article.articleSummary: Mumbai, India, 20 Aug 2026: BMC corporators demand stronger fogging and mosquito control at construction sites amid rising malaria and dengue. They allege fogging is largely on paper, with stagnant water left untreated; call for at least one fogging machine per ward and more effective larval control. Concerns include old fogging machines, lack of site visits, and poor notification when teams operate. Standing Committee chairman Prabhakar Shinde urged immediate preventive action during the monsoon and ordered a detailed report for the next meeting. Civic data show malaria cases rising in the June 1–Aug 15 window from 2,852 in 2025 to 3,177 in 2026 (+325, +11.4%), while dengue cases declined from 1,217 to 1,079 (-138, -11.3%).

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ市議会議員、マラリア症例増加を受けBMCの防蚊活動を批判、建設現場での対策強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱はムンバイで季節的（モンスーン期）に例年発生している疾患であり、今回の増加も既存の公衆衛生対応の枠内で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ市議会レベルでの防蚊対策の不備を批判する地方政治的な内容であり、マラリア症例数は前年比+11.4%、デング熱は-11.3%と変動は限定的。モンスーン期の季節性増加として通常の公衆衛生対応範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго отримає 70 тисяч доз вакцини від Еболи - ВООЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo to receive 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine - WHO
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses from the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG) stockpiles. Of these, 20,000 doses are for a Phase III trial; 50,000 doses will vaccinate healthcare workers and frontline social service staff involved in outbreak response. The Ervebo vaccine targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but officials caution its effectiveness against the current Bundibugyo strain in DR Congo is unproven. Preliminary laboratory data and animal studies suggest some protection. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus welcomed the ICG decision as a global solidarity signal and reaffirmed support for enhanced surveillance, timely detection, quality medical care, risk communication, and vaccination to control the outbreak and save lives. The ongoing DR Congo Ebola outbreak is the deadliest in the country's history, with at least 2,325 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、エボラワクチン7万回分をWHOから受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上最悪規模（死者2,325人以上）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現地流行株はBundibugyo株であり、配布予定のErvebo（Zaire株対応）ワクチンの有効性は未確認。史上最悪規模のアウトブレイクとして継続監視・支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi u Kongu. Preko 5200 zaraženih, gotovo 2500 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo. Over 5,200 infected, nearly 2,500 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand: 5,208 cases and 2,476 deaths reported as of August 18 by the United Nations, spanning six provinces (Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo) across 56 health zones. The current epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed specific vaccine or treatment exists. The WHO has announced an allocation of 70,000 Ervebo doses, though Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus; preliminary lab and animal data suggest limited protection against Bundibugyo, with 20,000 doses for a third-phase trial to assess efficacy and 50,000 for frontline health workers. UN and partners emphasize intensified response, including tripling capacity for safe treatment, community engagement, expanded safe and dignified burials teams, enhanced epidemiological surveillance, and aid to the most vulnerable. A government initiative, “Congo River without Ebola,” aims to boost surveillance along ~1,700 km of the Congo River amid insecurity, displacement, fragile health services, and attacks on facilities complicating contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大。感染者5,200人超、死者約2,500人。
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（5,200例超、致死率約48%）が継続し、既存ワクチンの有効性が不明なBundibugyo型であるため、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、認可済みのワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、既存対策（Ervebo）の有効性検証中。治安不安・住民避難・医療施設への攻撃が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola:l'OMS déploie 70 000 vaccins " hors-label " pour tenter d'endiguer la pire épidémie de l'histoire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO deploys 70,000 off-label vaccines to try to stem the worst outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) escalates. By August 12, 2026, the nation reports 4,665 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths across 54 health zones in six provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé. The WHO deploys 70,000 Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine doses, though this vaccine is not licensed for Bundibugyo; the operation is described as a humanitarian and scientific gamble. Of the total, 20,000 doses will support a Phase 3 real-world trial to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses will vaccinate frontline health workers and responders. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials (Moderna’s mRNA candidate and Oxford University’s), plus a promising rVSV Bundibugyo candidate from Hilleman Laboratories. Laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection, but human efficacy remains unproven; this is the worst Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history, spreading across multiple provinces amid fragile health systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが史上最悪の流行阻止のため7万本の適応外ワクチンを配備
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が6州に拡大し、4,665症例・2,184死亡を記録。WHOが未承認ワクチンを緊急展開するなど国際的対応が必要な深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模とされるブンディブギョ株エボラ流行。標準ワクチン(Ervebo)は本来ザイール株用で本株には未承認のため、人道的・科学的賭けとされる緊急対応が行われている。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito-Borne Diseases Infected Over 1 L In State From '14 To '24: Docs
article.articleSummary: World Mosquito Day 2026 underscores mosquito-borne diseases in West Bengal, India. From 2014–2024, the state recorded over 100,000 infections from dengue, malaria and chikungunya and about 400+ deaths, with Kolkata contributing roughly 20–30% of casualties. In Kolkata, over 100,000 infections occurred across these diseases during the period. The city faced its most severe dengue outbreak in 2023, surpassing 2022. Across West Bengal, official estimates show 90,000–100,000 infections and over 100 deaths. Within Kolkata, dengue alone exceeded 13,000 cases with 25–40 deaths. Dengue presents with sudden high fever, headache, muscle and joint pain, weakness and sometimes a rash; malaria fatalities are rare; chikungunya deaths have not been reported. Aedes mosquitoes transmit dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Preventive messages stress eliminating breeding sites, bite protection, early symptom recognition and timely care.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州で蚊媒介感染症、'14年から'24年で10万人以上が感染:医師
triage.triage_reason: 2014年から2024年までの10年間の統計データを振り返る内容であり、新規の急性発生や異常事態を示す情報ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界蚊の日(World Mosquito Day)にちなんだ過去10年間の統計を振り返る啓発記事であり、直近の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。デング熱は毎年季節的に発生する既知の風土病であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: M23 Rebels Restrict Travel to Curb Ebola Spread
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-20, Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo: M23 rebels controlling parts of North and South Kivu have imposed travel restrictions after two people from a government-held town tested positive for Ebola in a rebel-controlled village. Shared taxis and passenger boats on key routes will be suspended for a month; trucks and safety-screened buses can continue operating. The measures aim to govern effectively amid an outbreak, as the group previously declared areas under its control Ebola-free. The Congo-wide outbreak persists with confirmed cases surpassing 5,000, in a context of ongoing fighting between Congo's army and rebels. The restrictions illustrate how conflict complicates public health response, potentially hindering surveillance, contact tracing, and vaccine or treatment delivery in affected provinces, including Goma and Bukavu.

triage.headline_ja: M23反政府勢力、エボラ拡大を抑えるため移動を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の感染者が5000人を超え、紛争地域での移動制限措置がとられるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクの高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（M23支配地域）での感染症対応の困難さが、サーベイランスや接触者追跡、ワクチン・治療提供を妨げる可能性がある点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: A epidemia de Ebola mais rápida da história avança tão agressivamente que nem a ciência consegue ter tempo de detê-la
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest Ebola epidemic in history is advancing so aggressively that even science can't stop it in time.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is the fastest-spreading epidemic in history, concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of mid-August 2026, the outbreak has more than 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths in the DRC, spanning 49 health zones across five provinces. In Uganda, there are 20 confirmed cases and two deaths. The overall case fatality rate is 44–47%. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026. This crisis is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, and it currently lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、科学も食い止める時間がないほど猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心にエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速のペースで拡大し、致死率44〜47%、WHOがPHEICを宣言するなど極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダでの症例（20例、死亡2例）は主に情報として記載されているが対象国外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Sanidad limita el riesgo de contagio del ébola a los trabajadores en primera línea del brote en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health limits the risk of Ebola transmission to frontline workers in the DRC outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persist with 2,476 deaths and 5,208 confirmed cases since 15 May. Uganda reports 20 infections and 2 deaths, its outbreak declared over on 28 July. Spain’s Ministry of Health via the CCAES regards risk to Spanish travelers as low overall, but frontline healthcare workers face the highest exposure. Infections abroad include two U.S. cases among citizens evacuated to Germany, one French case in a physician returning from the DRC, and a UK withdrawal of an NGO employee after possible exposure. Spain maintains diagnostic capacity and the Red Uatan network to manage imported or repatriated cases and tracks personnel deployed to affected areas. Travel to affected zones is discouraged; if unavoidable, consult an International Vaccination Center for updated guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行における最前線労働者への感染リスクを制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（死者2,476人、症例5,208人）が継続し、既に米国・フランス・ドイツ・英国への感染拡大事例が報告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行を主題とし、他国（米国・フランス・ドイツ・英国・スペイン・ウガンダ）は輸入症例や渡航者管理の文脈で言及されているため対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダの流行は7月28日に終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Com quase 10 mil casos de chikungunya, MS prepara saúde para efeitos do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With nearly 10,000 chikungunya cases, Mato Grosso do Sul prepares the health system for the effects of El Niño.
article.articleSummary: With nearly 10,000 confirmed chikungunya cases and 30 deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul this year, the state is training health workers to anticipate El Niño–driven changes in disease patterns. Exercises simulate respiratory surges during burn-season smoke, followed by rising dengue and chikungunya demand, testing staff reallocation, patient transfers, and expanded capacity across nine regional health areas. Training in Campo Grande’s region will be intensified due to higher staffing needs, followed by Norte (Coxim) and Centro-Sul. A session on August 31 will target vulnerable populations (indigenous, quilombola, riverine communities). The program aligns with broader warnings of arbovirus transmission under climate variability; Brazil-wide projections (InfoDengue/Fiocruz) estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. In Mato Grosso do Sul, by August 11 there were 12,520 probable and 9,961 confirmed chikungunya, and 4,551 probable and 1,933 confirmed dengue through week 31.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がまもなく1万例に迫る中、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州はエルニーニョの影響に備え医療体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱が約1万例・死亡30例に達し、エルニーニョによる感染症動態変化への懸念から州保健当局が積極的に体制強化を行っており、重症度・流行しやすさの観点で注視が必要。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱・デング熱ともにブラジルでは季節性・地域流行性の感染症であり、本記事は州保健当局による予防的訓練・体制強化を報じるもの。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例30件・症例数増加傾向、El Niñoによる媒介蚊活動増加の懸念から経過観察・フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinas Ervebo vão ser usadas na República Democrática do Congo no surto de Ébola pelo vírus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ervebo vaccines will be used in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has received 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccines from the global stock managed by the International Coordination Group for Vaccine Provision to support the Bundibugyo virus outbreak. Of these, 20,000 doses are allocated for a Phase 3 clinical trial to assess the vaccine's impact against Bundibugyo virus, while 50,000 doses are designated for frontline health workers responding to the outbreak. The distribution aligns with the WHO Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization recommendations. Ervebo is licensed and recommended for Ebola outbreaks caused by Ebola virus (previously designated Zaire ebolavirus), but it is not yet proven to confer protection against Bundibugyo in humans. Preliminary laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection. The WHO stresses informed consent, clear communication of risks and benefits, and limitations for trial participants and other vaccine recipients.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行に対しエルベボワクチンを使用へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）の流行に対しWHO主導で大規模ワクチン接種が実施されており、国際的関心・支援が明確であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウ株によるエボラ流行は稀少で、既存ワクチン（エルベボ）の有効性が未確立であるため臨床試験と並行した緊急接種が行われている点が特筆される。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・死亡率等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MPRR recomenda ações para controle de cães e gatos e prevenção de zoonoses em Alto Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPRR Recommends Actions for the Control of Dogs and Cats and Prevention of Zoonoses in Alto Alegre
article.articleSummary: Alto Alegre, Roraima, Brazil, is urged by the Ministério Público de Roraima (MPRR) to control the municipal dog and cat population and expand zoonoses prevention. Key measures include establishing the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ), conducting mass spay/neuter campaigns, and rabies vaccination, plus a plan to confront Visceral Leishmaniasis in both animals and humans. The city reportedly hosts more than 800 dogs in vulnerable conditions with ongoing street reproduction. The CCZ is to be inaugurated soon, following prior meetings with the municipal administration. An animal census should begin within 30 days to identify populations and high-risk areas, with 500 doses of rabies vaccine and dewormers already provided and prioritized for affected zones. The municipality has 15 days to confirm compliance and provide documentation; non-compliance may trigger a Public Civil Action.

triage.headline_ja: MPRRがアルト・アレグレにおける犬猫の個体数管理と人獣共通感染症予防のための対策を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 行政の予防的措置に関する記事であり、実際の症例急増や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 検察機関(MPRR)による動物管理・ゾーオノーシス予防のための行政勧告記事。狂犬病・内臓リーシュマニア症の新規症例急増を示す情報はなく、予防的・行政的な内容にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo gets 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses amid record Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is amid its deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths. The World Health Organization has allocated 70,000 doses of Merck's Ervebo vaccine from the global Ebola stockpile to Congo, of which 20,000 doses will be used in a late-stage clinical trial to test protection against the Bundibugyo strain. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus; there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus. The trial seeks crucial evidence on human protection against this strain. Congo’s 17th Ebola epidemic became the country’s largest by case count in late July, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus has described the situation as a global emergency. The vaccine stockpile is managed by the International Coordinating Group, comprising WHO, UNICEF, the IFRC, and Médecins Sans Frontières.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、記録的なエボラ流行の中で7万回分のエルベボワクチンを取得
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、WHOがグローバルエマージェンシーと表現するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的関心があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 5000例超・死者2378人という記録的規模で、WHO事務局長が『グローバルエマージェンシー』と表現。新規株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチン治験も実施中であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Youth Cong workers stage protest over dengue spike in Margao
article.articleSummary: Dengue spike in Margao, Goa, prompts a protest by Youth Congress outside the South Goa District Hospital on Thursday, urging the health department to scale up facilities for dengue prevention and treatment. The demonstrators cite a sharp rise in dengue infections across the town and accuse the government of inadequate resources, highlighting an acute bed shortage that leaves patients on the floor due to space limits. While criticizing governmental handling of the crisis, they commend hospital doctors and nursing staff for continuing to provide care under strain. They call for immediate action and a concrete health department plan to contain the outbreak, emphasizing the need for enhanced prevention measures, expanded treatment capacity, and timely resource allocation to address the surge.

triage.headline_ja: マルガオでデング熱急増、青年会議派が抗議activo
triage.triage_reason: インドゴア州マルガオでデング熱の急増と病床不足が報告され地元政治団体が抗議しているが、症例数や死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクも低いためフルRRAには至らない。
triage.notes: 地域限定的なデング熱流行で、地元医療体制の逼迫と政治的抗議が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータは記事に記載なし。季節性デング熱の一環である可能性が高く、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz mantém Acre entre estados em alerta por incidência de SRAG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz keeps Acre among states on alert for SARS incidence.
article.articleSummary: Acre is among 11 Brazilian states with SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) incidence at alert, risk, or high risk in the last two weeks (Week 32, Aug 9–15), per Fiocruz's InfoGripe. Other states in that level include Amazonas, Bahia, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima and Sergipe. Overall trends show falling or stable SRAG, with RSV-related SRAG remaining high in Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima, São Paulo, Santa Catarina, Sergipe and Rio Grande do Sul. Influenza B–related severe cases rise in Rio Grande do Sul, though growth is decelerating in Espírito Santo and Minas Gerais. Vaccination remains the main prevention. Age patterns: RSV dominates in ≤4 years; influenza A drives mortality in the elderly; rhinovirus contributes notably in elderly and under-2s. COVID-19 SRAG remains low across ages.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)発生率警戒州にアクレ州を継続指定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器疾患（RSV、インフルエンザ等）のサーベイランス報告であり、全体傾向は横ばい〜減少傾向。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、通常の季節性モニタリング情報に留まる。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、ライノウイルス）のルーティンサーベイランス報告。COVID-19関連SRAGは低水準。全体的に減少・安定傾向であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly v Kongu se vymkla kontrole, zemřely tisíce lidí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled out of control; thousands have died.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has become the country’s deadliest, with over 5,100 infections and 2,420 deaths. As of 2026-08-20, WHO and national authorities warn the epidemic is far from under control, with about one death every 30 minutes. No approved vaccine or licensed treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Delays stem from diagnostics calibrated to the Zaire strain, causing clinicians to mistake early symptoms for malaria or typhus. Uganda’s rapid contact tracing contained a spillover to about 20 cases. UNHCR notes the region is destabilized by hundreds of armed factions, driving displacement of millions and hampering isolation. Funding shortfalls, including a 70% cut in U.S. contributions to the DRC health system, worsen outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が制御不能に、数千人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(感染5,100人以上・死亡2,420人)で制御不能状態にあり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、越境事例(ウガンダ)も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（米国拠出金70%削減）が対応能力にさらなる懸念を与えている。

article.articleHeadline: Maior surto de sarampo nas Américas em duas décadas avança e já faz vítimas no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Largest measles outbreak in the Americas in two decades advances and has already claimed victims in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak across the Americas has reached Brazil, with at least 24 confirmed cases in the country. Overall, more than 50,000 cases have been recorded in North and Central America, with about 95% concentrated in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States, and Peru. The virus is highly contagious; among unvaccinated individuals, a single case can transmit to about 12 others. In Brazil, infections have emerged in the Greater São Paulo area, triggering a saturation vaccination campaign including a dose-zero strategy for people up to 59 years old and broader vaccination through the age group to prevent an outbreak and protect Brazil’s measles-elimination status (reclaimed in 2024). Authorities say the circulating strain in Brazil originated in the United States and Canada. Vaccination remains critical: two doses provide roughly 95% protection, while last year’s national first-dose coverage was 92.9% and second-dose 78.3%; 38 imported cases in 2025 did not spark larger outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米州で過去20年間最大の麻疹アウトブレイクが拡大、ブラジルでも死者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刺性、異常性、国際的拡大の3つに該当し、米州全体で5万例超・ブラジルでも感染確認と麻疹排除ステータスへの影響が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内での麻疹症例拡大（24例確認、サンパウロ都市圏中心）と、それに伴う国家規模のワクチン接種強化キャンペーン（ゼロ回接種戦略含む）に焦点を当てている。米国・カナダ由来の株が流行株とされ、2024年に回復した麻疹排除ステータスへの影響が懸念される。ペルー・グアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・カナダ・スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: South dist hospital hits full capacity amid gastro, vector-borne illnesses
article.articleSummary: South Goa District Hospital (SGDH) is at full capacity due to a seasonal surge in respiratory, gastrointestinal, and vector-borne illnesses as of 2026-08-21. OPD visits are about 1,500 per day, with all 500 beds occupied; patients are temporarily managed on trolleys and in ward hallways. Authorities opted for admission rather than transferring to Goa Medical College or discharging, aiming to treat everyone as beds become available, typically after 2 pm when diagnoses and initial treatments are completed. Dengue cases are rising and described as widespread, linked to monsoon rainfall that fosters mosquito breeding. SGDH remains the sole major government facility in South Goa and continues to handle the influx with regular preventive measures, urging public cooperation to maintain clean surroundings and prevent stagnant water. No specific laboratory-confirmed outbreak data or death counts are provided.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging reinforces the fight against Aedes mosquitoes in Novos Estados - CGNotícias
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risk addressed by ultra-low-volume (ULV) fumigation against Aedes aegypti in Novos Estados, Campo Grande, Brazil. On Thursday, August 20, 2026, from 16:00 to 22:00, teams from the Vector Endemic Control Management (GCEV) of the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) will spray the neighborhood. Residents are advised to keep doors and windows open during the fumigation to maximize coverage in areas where mosquitoes are likely to rest. The product targets adult female mosquitoes and is applied with care, given potential effects on non-target species. The operation may be delayed or canceled due to rain, strong winds, or fog that impairs dispersion. The article does not report any case counts or outbreaks; this remains a preventive measure aimed at reducing arboviral transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Campinas aponta 33 bairros com alto risco de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas City Hall identifies 33 neighborhoods at high risk of dengue.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, Campinas Health Department issued the 34th Arboviroses Alert for 2026, identifying 33 neighborhoods with high dengue transmission risk and calling for intensified Aedes aegypti control. The risk areas span six regions: East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South, and Southeast, with representative neighborhoods in each zone highlighted. From Jan 1 to Aug 17, 2026, Campinas recorded 3,735 dengue cases. Health workers conducted 1,101,634 home visits for vector-control and education, plus 53,382 fogging operations. The alert emphasizes community participation, noting about 80% of breeding sites occur inside homes. Preventive actions include removing standing water, refreshing plant-water every two days, cleaning saucers with soap, sealing water tanks, and keeping toilets closed to reduce Aedes aegypti proliferation and dengue transmission citywide.

article.articleHeadline: City hospitals report sharp rise in monsoon illnesses and infections
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Lucknow reports a surge in monsoon-related illnesses. Fungal skin infections and eczema have risen nearly tenfold in OPDs, from 40–50 to 300–400 daily, linked to high humidity, sweating, and damp clothing. Fever cases surged ~40% across Balrampur Hospital (~250), SPM Civil Hospital (~150), and KGMU (~200–250) daily, with viral fever and typhoid most common; doctors urge medical evaluation rather than self-medication. Conjunctivitis has increased, with Balrampur reporting 40–50 daily vs 10–15 previously. Dengue is reported daily (2–3 cases) as stagnant water around coolers and containers fosters Aedes aegypti breeding. KGMU notes three leptospirosis and eight scrub typhus cases; leptospirosis from water/soil contaminated by rodent urine, scrub typhus from chigger bites in vegetation. Public health advice emphasizes hygiene, avoiding floodwater, mosquito control, and prompt treatment for persistent fever.

article.articleHeadline: Marataízes emite alerta após surto de catapora - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marataízes issues warning after chickenpox outbreak - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: Marataízes, Espírito Santo, issued a public health warning after a chickenpox (varicella) outbreak, with 13 schools and daycares reporting infections. The municipality reports no severe cases so far, and its Secretariat of Health (Semus) released a contingency plan on August 8, aligned with the Ministry of Health and World Health Organization protocols. Marataízes is the only municipality in Espírito Santo to implement a targeted varicella strategy and continues to monitor outbreak evolution. Varicella is a highly contagious yet usually benign disease caused by the Varicella-Zoster virus, common in children with incidence rising toward late winter and early spring. Characteristic lesions progress from macules to papules, vesicles, pustules, and crusts, accompanied by itching. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blister fluid, respiratory droplets, saliva, or contaminated surfaces and objects, with both direct and indirect routes possible.

article.articleHeadline: Numărul cazurilor de Ebola în Congo ar putea fi de trei ori mai mare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo could be three times higher.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo may be up to three times larger than the official tally. Confirmed cases are 5,208, but CDC Africa, cited by Xinhua, estimates only 30–40% of infections are detected. Models by DRC authorities and Imperial College London indicate the real size could be about threefold the confirmed number. Fewer than 10% of identified cases have links to known contacts, and fewer than 40% have a clear epidemiologic connection to a confirmed case. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which tends to cause milder symptoms and fewer hemorrhagic signs, potentially delaying care. Nearly all recent deaths occurred outside specialized centers, with the death toll at 2,476. The outbreak began May 15 in the east and remains among the deadliest Ebola episodes, compared with the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (approximately 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths).

article.articleHeadline: WHO: DR Congo to Receive 70,000 Ebola Vaccine Doses
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, announced by the WHO and partners on August 20, 2026. The allocation aims to bolster containment of the ongoing outbreak, with Africa CDC reporting 5,021 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,378 deaths to date. The current outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain; laboratory and animal testing data suggest Ervebo may offer some protection, though effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unconfirmed. Officials say the vaccine boost could help bring the outbreak under control within three months if necessary resources are available. The development underscores intensified vaccination as a key measure amid warnings the virus could continue spreading within DR Congo and potentially reach other countries. Clinical trials continue to explore prevention and treatment options.

article.articleHeadline: Africa must deepen health cooperation to contain Ebola outbreaks -- Health Minister
article.articleSummary: In the latest Ebola outbreak in Africa, the Democratic Republic of Congo accounts for the majority of reported cases and deaths, prompting Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh to urge deeper regional health cooperation to prevent and contain outbreaks. Countries should improve sharing of information, expertise, and technology to detect emerging threats before they cross borders. He stressed that isolated national responses are insufficient and called for regional solidarity to prevent spillovers and to bolster preparedness. Akandoh also urged increased investment in Africa's local pharmaceutical and medical production to reduce dependence on external suppliers during emergencies. While praising Africa CDC for coordinating responses, he urged deeper regional coordination. Lessons from COVID-19, Marburg, and Mpox demonstrate the value of early detection, rapid response, and sustained preparedness to curb cross-border transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in Africa: the Ebola outbreak in Congo could be three times higher than the confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: East DR Congo Ebola outbreak may be up to three times larger than confirmed cases, per Africa CDC. As of the report, 5,208 cases are confirmed, but only an estimated 30–40% of infections are detected. Models from RDC emergency response with Imperial College London indicate the true scale could be triple the confirmed tally. Transmission chains are hard to follow: fewer than 10% of detected cases are linked to known contacts, and under 40% have a clear epidemiological link to another confirmed case. Authorities are boosting surveillance and response; meanwhile, 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses will reach the DRC, though the vaccine used has not been specifically tested against Bundibugyo, the outbreak’s strain. The situation underscores ongoing detection challenges in eastern DRC and the need for vigilant public health measures.

article.articleHeadline: O que é pielonefrite? Entenda a infecção que atingiu Bianca Andrade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pyelonephritis? Learn about the infection that affected Bianca Andrade.
article.articleSummary: Pyelonephritis is a kidney infection that can follow an untreated urinary tract infection, as illustrated by Brazilian influencer Bianca Andrade (Boca Rosa). Escherichia coli, from the bowel, causes up to 90% of UTIs. When infection stays in the bladder, it's cystitis, with burning on urination, frequent urge, small volume voids, and lower abdominal pain; urine may be red or cloudy. Asymptomatic bacteriuria can occur, more common in women, pregnant people, diabetics, and catheter users. When bacteria reach the kidneys, fever and back pain are typical, with chills, malaise, nausea, and vomiting; cystitis symptoms may persist. Fever helps distinguish the two. In severe cases, bacteria can enter the bloodstream and cause sepsis. Treatments may be at home or in hospital; antibiotics last 7–14 days. Hydration and bladder emptying are advised. Investigate recurrent infections or urinary tract abnormalities.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : L'OMS annonce l'envoi de 70 000 doses du vaccin Ervebo en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO announces shipment of 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to the DRC.
article.articleSummary: 70,000 doses of Merck's Ervebo Ebola vaccine are to be shipped to the Democratic Republic of the Congo for an advanced clinical study and frontline use, according to the World Health Organization. Twenty thousand doses will be used in a final clinical trial to assess vaccine efficacy, while the remaining 50,000 doses will be allocated to frontline workers and health practitioners in line with SAGE guidance. The shipment, coordinated by the Global Coordination Group on Vaccines (GIC) following a request from Kinshasa, reflects ongoing efforts to combat the outbreak. Separately, WHO notes uncertainty about whether Ervebo protects humans against Bundibugyo virus, although early laboratory and animal data suggest potential protection. In DRC’s outbreak, authorities report 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, with 730 patients isolated or hospitalized and 1,115 recovered.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo to receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine as Ebola infections surge
article.articleSummary: DRC to receive 70,000 Ervebo doses from the global Ebola vaccine stockpile to confront the Bundibugyo-virus–driven outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. About 20,000 doses will be used in a late-stage trial to assess Ervebo’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine exists; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus but not Bundibugyo. The current outbreak has 5,208 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths. No approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo to date. The government requested release of Ervebo vaccines; 50,000 doses will go to frontline health workers per WHO recommendations. Gavi provides $7 million for shipment and $6 million for vaccination efforts in high-risk areas. WHO Director-General Tedros declared the outbreak a global emergency; UN partners emphasize scalable response, including the Congo River Without Ebola initiative. Outbreak declared mid-May; some experts suggest February onset.
