Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used in a late-stage trial to assess effectiveness against the Bundibugyo strain, for which Ervebo's protection is unknown; the vaccine is approved for Ebola Zaire. The eastern Congo outbreak now exceeds 5,000 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, according to government data, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the outbreak remains a global emergency. DRC had requested the vaccine release from the ICG-managed stockpile before allocation. The allocation supports ongoing outbreak response and vaccine access amid uncertainties about cross-strain protection."}

triage.headline_ja: DRC、7万回分のエボラワクチンを受領へ、WHOは現行株には未承認と発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行（5000例超、死者2378人）が継続し、WHOが世界的緊急事態と位置付けており、ワクチンの株特異性に関する不確実性も存在するため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは本流行を国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として継続認識。ワクチンの新株(Bundibugyo)への有効性が未確認である点が今後のリスク評価で重要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID Infections Growing in All 50 States, CDC Says
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections are rising in all 50 states as of the CDCs August 12 update, up from 37 states three weeks earlier. The CDC uses emergency department data and other health information to gauge trends; national wastewater activity remains very low for the week ending August 8. Despite overall low respiratory illness visits, projections show COVID accounting for about 0.43 percent of ED visits in the week ending August 22, up from 0.31 percent on August 8, with about 2,400 new hospital admissions expected (versus 1,800 previously). Variants circulating globally include XFG Stratus, an Omicron descendant first documented in January 2025, and BA.3.2 Cicada, first identified in South Africa in November 2024; the United States detected BA.3.2 in June 2025 in a traveler from the Netherlands, with the first clinical case in January 2026. Older adults and immunocompromised people are at greatest risk; antiviral treatment should begin within 5–7 days of symptoms for high risk patients. WHO reports 6,849 new cases for the week ending August 2, led by Thailand about 5,800, Brazil 316, Greece 169, Colombia 156, Mexico 98; total worldwide 779.3 million.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、全50州でCOVID感染が増加していると発表
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に十分に特性が把握された疾患であり、米国内での季節的な感染増加報告に過ぎず、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国内のCOVID-19感染動向。タイ・ブラジル等はWHOの週間新規症例数の統計として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Η ΛΔ Κονγκό έλαβε 70.000 δόσεις εμβολίου για τόν Έμπολα, σύμφωνα με τον ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo received 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: DRC receives 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses from the WHO-coordinated vaccine provision group after a government request. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus but not yet approved for Bundibugyo, the strain driving the current outbreak; early lab and animal data suggest it may offer some protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will fund a Phase 3 trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 will be given to frontline health workers and responders. The outbreak spans six eastern provinces, with more than 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo history. Case fatality is about 47.5%, rising to 70% in hard-hit areas like North Kivu. The virus is believed to have spread from the Mongbualu mining town since February; the outbreak was declared May 15. Distribution aims to strengthen surveillance, rapid case finding, care quality, community engagement, and vaccination campaigns, with Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calling it a global solidarity milestone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、WHOによるとエボラワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5000例超、致死率47.5%、一部地域70%）が継続しており、新規株への対応や国際的なワクチン支援が行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本流行はコンゴ史上最悪の致死率・規模を記録しており、Bundibugyo株に対するErvebo有効性のPhase3試験が実施中。国際的な資源投入（WHO調整によるワクチン配布）が継続しているため、既存の重大イベントとして継続的モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le projet " fleuve Congo sans Ebola " lancé à Kinshasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The 'Congo River Without Ebola' Project Launched in Kinshasa - ACP.
article.articleSummary: DRC launches the 'Congo River Without Ebola' project in Kinshasa to strengthen surveillance and rapid response to Ebola along the Congo River corridor. The initiative targets Ebola virus (Bundibugyo strain) along corridors Kinshasa-Kisangani, Kinshasa-Brazzaville-Bangui via the Ubangi, and Kinshasa-Ilebo via the Kasai River, spanning five riverine provinces (Tshopo, Mongala, Équateur, Mai-Ndombe, and Kinshasa) and major hubs Kisangani, Mbandaka, Kwamouth, and Kinshasa. Six strategic axes cover coordination, logistics, workshops, capacity building, partner management, quarantine, port improvements, and the construction of Ebola Treatment Centers and floating units, with fixed and mobile laboratories and community surveillance. A One Health, multisectoral approach unites health, interior, transport, environment, fishing, education, research, communities, and technical partners; multisectoral coordination with interior, transport, and health ministries. Goals include keeping the Congo River free of epidemic-prone diseases; measures include port temperature screening and banning bush meat. Challenges cited: community resistance and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:「エボラのないコンゴ川」プロジェクトがキンシャサで始動 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: これは新規のエボラ発生報告ではなく、コンゴ川流域における監視・対応能力強化を目的とした予防プロジェクトの立ち上げに関する記事であるため、直接のシグナルとは言えないが、エボラという疾患特性上、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規のエボラ発生を報告するものではなく、DRC政府主導の予防・監視強化プロジェクト（コンゴ川流域）の立ち上げに関する報道。中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño extremo amenaza a Latinoamérica con inundaciones, sequías y más enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extreme El Niño Threatens Latin America with Floods, Droughts, and More Diseases.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could trigger extreme rainfall and drought across Latin America through early 2027, with 72–82% odds of full development and Pacific surface-temperature anomalies potentially exceeding 3°C by December 2026, comparable to 2015–2016. Peru, Ecuador, Chile, Uruguay, and northern Mexico face intense rainfall and floods; the Dry Corridor of Central America, northern Brazil, Colombia, and Venezuela may endure prolonged drought. Mosquito-borne diseases, notably dengue, are a major concern, as warming can speed mosquito development and shorten viral incubation; the 2023–2024 cycle was among the region’s worst dengue seasons. Water access challenges include flood-related contamination of wells and networks, and drought-driven water scarcity affecting hygiene. Preventive actions: environmental and epidemiological surveillance, vector-control measures, elimination of standing-water containers, waste management, robust sanitation, secure water supplies, and emergency protocols for floods and droughts. Preparedness is essential, not certainty of outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの極端現象がラテンアメリカを脅かす：洪水、干ばつ、そして感染症の増加
triage.triage_reason: 気候予測に基づくデング熱等蚊媒介感染症の将来的リスクに関する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な発生報告や症例数データはないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョ現象による気候影響（洪水・干ばつ）とそれに伴う感染症リスクの将来予測に関する一般記事。ブラジルは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事内では干ばつの文脈での言及であり、デング熱の具体的発生報告国としては特定されていないためverified_locationsから除外した。実際の症例数や発生の確定情報は記事内に存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Конго ще получи 70 000 дози от ваксината Ervebo срещу ебола, доказала ефективността си при предишни епидемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine against Ebola, proven effective in previous epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, described as effective in previous outbreaks, according to the WHO and partners. The supply is intended to support what officials call the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease but not for Bundibugyo virus, which is causing the current outbreak; preliminary lab data and animal studies suggest it may offer some protection. Of the 70,000 doses, 20,000 will be used for a Phase 3 trial to determine efficacy against Bundibugyo, while the remaining 50,000 doses will be reserved for frontline health workers and health personnel, per WHO expert recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、これまでのエボラ流行で有効性が実証されたエルベボワクチンを7万回分受け取る予定
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速で拡大しているとされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対し、WHOが緊急ワクチン供給・臨床試験を実施しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 現地流行株（ブンディブギョウイルス）はErvebo未承認株であり、有効性確認のための第3相試験が並行実施される点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo pode 'apagar' parte da memória do sistema imunológico e aumentar risco de infecções
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles can 'erase' part of the immune system's memory and increase the risk of infections.
article.articleSummary: Measles can trigger immunological amnesia, erasing 11%–73% of antibodies accumulated before infection, Harvard researchers report in Science. In unvaccinated children followed before and after measles, the virus reduced part of the preexisting antibody repertoire, while memory B cells were durably altered, per a Science Immunology study. This loss of acquired immunity can leave individuals more vulnerable to infections previously protected against, even after general recovery. Symptoms include high fever, dry cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, Koplik spots, and a red rash; disease progresses through incubation, catarrhal, exanthematous, and convalescent phases. Although studied in children, adults may also be affected. Global cases are rising, with Brazil’s São Paulo state recording 23 confirmed measles cases in 2026 as of Aug 19: 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Vaccination remains the primary preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: はしかは免疫システムの記憶の一部を「消去」し、感染リスクを高める可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の免疫学的影響に関する科学解説が主だが、ブラジル・サンパウロ州で2026年に23例の麻疹確定例が報告されており、発生動向として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は麻疹による免疫学的記憶喪失に関する研究紹介であり、ブラジルの症例数（23例）は付随情報。重症度や致死率、ワクチン接種状況などの詳細情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | четверг: Украина, Газа, Эбола, Южный Судан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Thursday: Ukraine, Gaza, Ebola, South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: 20 August 2026 – UN chief denounces Russian missile strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, with dozens killed or wounded and widespread infrastructure damage; calls for immediate cessation and notes violations of international humanitarian law. In Gaza, UN OCHA reports continued civilian casualties from Israeli airstrikes and shelling; 50 bodies, including 19 children, have been buried after being retrieved from rubble in recent days; access remains constrained by bans on heavy equipment, spare parts, and other cargo. Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists: more than 5,200 cases and about 2,500 deaths as of 18 August; WHO has delivered 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine to protect health workers and for a trial assessing efficacy against Bundibugyo virus. In South Sudan, OHCHR warns renewed clashes raise the risk of mass atrocities; holding nationwide elections without security guarantees could trigger genocide and ethnic cleansing.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜木曜日：ウクライナ、ガザ、エボラ、南スーダン
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が5,200例・約2,500死亡（致死率約48%）に達し、WHOがワクチン配布や治験支援を行うなど深刻かつ継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国の速報をまとめたもので、エボラ関連情報はDRCの継続流行に関する部分のみ。ガザ・ウクライナ・南スーダンは感染症事象と無関係のため対象外。Bundibugyoウイルスに対するワクチン治験の記述があり、株の変化に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte Ebola : douze attaques recensées par l'OMS depuis le 17 mai, huit incendies de structures documentés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response: twelve attacks recorded by the WHO since May 17, eight structure fires documented.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists. As of 14 August 2026, WHO reports 12 attacks on health care since the May 17, 2026 PHEIC declaration, with additional verifications pending. Eight arson attacks on outbreak response facilities occurred between 21 May and 18 August, plus an ambulance burn and a thwarted attack; at least 12 response vehicles were damaged (including four ambulances). Incidents span Bunia (Rwampara isolation unit), Mongbwalu (isolation tents), and Bafwabango in Nia-Nia, Mambasa, where a center hosting two confirmed Ebola cases and seven suspected cases burned; nine patients fled and response activities were later suspended. In Butembo, four additional fires targeted health facilities (Zawadi Mapendo, Crinovic, Bora Maisha), and a checkpoint north of Bunia was burned. Butembo exhibits the highest fatality rate (85.6%), with Bunia at 29.8%; burial teams have repeatedly been attacked. Laboratory confirmation noted at Bora Maisha and Bafwabango.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：5月17日以降、WHOが12件の攻撃を記録、8件の施設放火が確認
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのDRCエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続し、医療対応施設への攻撃・放火が多発、致死率も高く公衆衛生・治安両面で深刻な状況であるため。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言されている進行中のエボラアウトブレイク。医療施設への放火・攻撃により対応活動が妨害されており、患者の逃亡や活動停止も発生。地域は全てDRC国内（Bunia, Butembo, Mambasa等）。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de catapora coloca cidade do ES em estado de alerta - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox outbreak puts a city in Espírito Santo on high alert - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) outbreak in Marataízes, Espírito Santo, Brazil, with 55 cases, 2 suspected under investigation, and 5 discarded as of Aug 19. No severe cases reported. Transmission identified in educational settings, affecting 13 schools and childcare centers. Marataízes is currently the only Espírito Santo municipality to implement a dedicated contingency plan for varicella, published Aug 8. The plan, developed by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semus) and implemented in coordination with the Municipal Education Secretariat (Semed) and other municipal sectors, provides guidance for schools and outbreak documentation, and outlines measures to monitor progression and contain spread. Semus continues active surveillance and response, adjusting control measures as cases evolve. This scenario highlights a targeted public health response within a single municipality to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘の集団発生でエスピリトサント州の都市が警戒態勢に - Sim Notícias
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症であり、重症例なし、単一自治体内での局地的発生で既に対策計画も実施済みのため、国際的懸念やIHR基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 水痘（Varicella）はブラジル国内での局地的アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが判定基準上重大な公衆衛生リスクとは言えない。verified_locationsは対象国リストにBrazilが含まれるため本来は列挙対象だが、記事内容が軽微な地域限定事案のため参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le comité d'urgence de l'OMS s'est réuni le 18 août, quatre jours avant l'expiration automatique des recommandations du 22 mai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO Emergency Committee met on August 18, four days before the automatic expiry of the May 22 recommendations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), Bundibugyo, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains under IHR Emergency Committee oversight. The Aug 18 meeting kept the May 22 temporary recommendations in force until Aug 22, when they automatically expire; WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and plans updated guidance for Congo and exposed countries in the coming days. The formal risk assessment (June 6) lists DRC risk as Very High, Uganda and border countries High, with 159 health zones affected or at risk (19 high-risk, 115 at risk) and DRC’s control capacity risk rising to Very High. The Africa regional office’s Aug 16 update notes very high intra-DRC spread and elevated cross-border risk; Uganda, South Sudan and Central African Republic are particularly exposed to importation; Kisangani is a key dissemination node. Case counts vary by source: WHO 4,665 cases/2,184 deaths (Aug 12); Africa CDC 4,449/2,061; Congolese INSP 4,945/2,325 (Aug 15); regional office 5,021/2,378 (Aug 16). Ituri leads with 4,194/1,838.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:WHO緊急委員会が8月18日開催、5月22日勧告の自動失効4日前に対応協議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEICとして継続中で、DRC国内での感染拡大が非常に高いリスクと評価され、ウガンダ・南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国への越境拡大リスクも指摘されているため、フルRRA相当の重大事案と判断。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みの継続中アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストにはウガンダ・南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国が含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。国際的な緊急委員会審議が続いており、フルリスク評価の継続的更新が必要な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri: un programme national nutritionnel recommande la séparation temporaire mère infectée-enfant - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: A National Nutrition Program Recommends Temporary Separation of the Infected Mother and Child - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the National Nutrition Program (PRONANUT) says breast milk is temporarily contraindicated when a mother or her infant is infected with Ebola. PRONANUT provincial coordinator Cosmas Bakemwanga explains that direct separation of the infected mother and child helps limit transmission via breast milk, noting that the infant can also contaminate the mother. The measure aims to constrain spread while ensuring the child's nutritional needs are met during the infection. He adds that breastfeeding can resume after the mother recovers, subject to sanitary precautions. Families are urged to adhere to outbreak response teams’ recommendations to protect both mothers and children during this Ebola period in Ituri, including in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：国家栄養プログラムが感染した母親と子どもの一時的分離を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する公式対応情報であり、母子感染防止策が国家プログラムにより指示されている。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準の複数該当及び国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は母乳育児に関する感染対策ガイダンスを扱っており、イツリ州（ブニアを含む）で継続的なエボラアウトブレイクが発生していることを示唆している。過去のDRCエボラ流行では国際的な支援・注目が高かったため、フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu : près de 6 millions d'enfants ciblés par une campagne contre la rougeole, la rubéole et la polio | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: nearly 6 million children targeted by a campaign against measles, rubella and polio | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo launches a five-day vaccination campaign in Beni to immunize nearly 6 million children against measles, rubella, and polio across the province. Measles and rubella vaccines target children aged 6 months to 14 years; polio vaccine targets 0–5 years. The effort comes amid continued measles transmission and circulation of poliovirus variants. Health authorities urge parents to bring all eligible children to vaccination sites. The campaign was inaugurated at the June 30 roundabout under the leadership of Prisca Luanda Kamala, senior adviser to the governor for health. In Beni, some parents brought children to sites as authorities push for broad coverage. In 2023, the DRC reported 311,500 measles cases and 5,799 deaths, underscoring the ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:麻疹・風疹・ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンで約600万人の子どもを対象に | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・ポリオの継続的な感染拡大を背景とした大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、公衆衛生上の懸念は存在するが新規の異常事態ではなくルーティン対応のため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2023年にDRCで麻疹311,500例・死亡5,799人という高い疾病負荷が背景にあり、継続的なポリオウイルス変異株の流行も報告されている。既存の予防接種キャンペーン活動であり新規発生事象ではないが、麻疹・ポリオの流行状況は引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情失控 世衛：傳播速度已超乎圍堵能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo out of control; WHO says transmission rate has exceeded containment capacity.
article.articleSummary: As of August 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control, driven by the Bundibugyo variant. Since the year began there have been over 5,100 infections and 2,420 deaths. WHO warns transmission far exceeds containment capacity, with 60–70% of deaths occurring in communities or outside health facilities. The outbreak centers on Ituri province’s Bunia area amid a long‑running eastern conflict that has displaced about 6.9 million people. The Bundibugyo variant renders vaccines and therapies developed for the Zaïre strain ineffective. Diagnostic delays—from initial misclassification as malaria or typhoid to Zaïre‑strain tests—hampered early response. A funding shortfall leaves roughly $46 million of the $115 million needed unfunded. WHO is scaling up surveillance, treatment, and two experimental vaccines; bed capacity targets 3,000 if funds arrive. Uganda’s July containment is cited as a contrasting success.

triage.headline_ja: 剛果民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が制御不能に　WHO「拡大速度が封じ込め能力を超えている」と表明
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を「制御不能」と公式警告しており、感染者5,100人超・死者2,420人、資金不足、既存ワクチン無効という深刻かつ異常な事態でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブンディブギョ株によりザイール株用のワクチン・治療薬が無効という点が特に重大な異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Receives Vaccine Shipment Amid Surging Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: DRC to receive 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses from WHO stockpiles as the country confronts its largest outbreak to date, with nearly 2,500 deaths among more than 5,208 confirmed cases. Of the total, 20,000 doses will back late‑stage trials assessing Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus—the strain driving this epidemic—while 50,000 doses are slated for frontline workers. Ervebo is licensed for one Ebola type; effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven, trials needed. Vaccines were allocated after a Congolese government request via the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision; Gavi contributes $7 million for shipment and $6 million for vaccination in high‑risk areas. The government’s 'Congo River Without Ebola' plan aims to strengthen surveillance and preparedness. UN officials cite five priority actions: expand safe care, fortify community engagement, double safe burial teams, boost surveillance, and support vulnerable populations. The outbreak began mid‑May (possible earlier), and WHO still declares a global emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例急増の中でワクチン出荷を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（確定5,208例、死亡約2,500人）が継続中であり、WHOがグローバル緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際支援も進行中のためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 本流行は過去最大規模で、原因株はBundibugyoウイルス。既存承認ワクチンErvebo（本来Zaire株用）の有効性は未確認で、臨床試験と並行して緊急接種が実施されている。WHOは既にグローバル緊急事態を宣言済みであり、渡航・貿易制限の実施有無については記事内に明記がないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: تشدید شیوع ایبولا؛ کانگوهفتاد هزار دوز واکسین ضد این بیماری دریافت می‌کند
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Escalation of the Ebola outbreak; Congo will receive seventy thousand doses of Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: WHO announced that the Democratic Republic of Congo will receive 70,000 doses of Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine to bolster the response to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Of these, 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase III trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; 50,000 will go to frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and is not licensed for Bundibugyo; its protective effect against BEL remains unproven, though early laboratory and animal data suggest partial protection. As of the latest Health Ministry update, Congo has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (overall CFR about 47.5%), rising to 70% in North Kivu. The outbreak—Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak—began May 15 and now spans six eastern provinces, becoming the largest by case count and outpacing 2018–2020’s ~3,500 cases and >2,200 deaths. WHO warns it could exceed previous totals; Tedros calls it an emergency that remains far from under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大;コンゴが7万回分のエボラワクチンを受領
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）の大規模流行が進行中で、症例数・死亡数が過去最大級となり、致死率も極めて高く、WHOが緊急事態として警戒しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 既承認ワクチン(Ervebo)はザイール株用でブンディブギョ株への有効性は未証明。CFRは全体47.5%、北キブ州では70%と極めて高い。WHOは過去最大規模になり得ると警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: African Nation To Receive 70,000 Doses Of Ebola Vaccine - 100PercentFedUp.com - by Danielle
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak (DRC) continues, declared mid-May with suspected onset as early as February. The outbreak has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths. Bundibugyo virus lacks approved vaccines or treatments, and Ervebo’s protection against Bundibugyo is unproven, though early data suggest possible protection. WHO allocated 70,000 Ervebo doses from the stockpile: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess impact on Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline/health workers per SAGE guidance. The DRC requested immediate release; ICG partners (WHO, IFRC, MSF, UNICEF) coordinate, with Gavi funding. Five UN-partner priorities include tripling safe care capacity, community engagement, safe burial teams, expanded surveillance, and support for the vulnerable; the Congo River Without Ebola initiative supports these efforts. The outbreak is spreading about three times faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, with many new cases outside monitored contacts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのある国、エボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクが5,208例・2,476死亡という大規模な規模に達し、過去のアウトブレイクより3倍速く拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが付与されているが、記事サマリー本文中ではAngolaへの拡大に関する言及がないため、verified_locationsから除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョウイルスに対し、エボラワクチン(Ervebo)の効果は未確認であり、フェーズ3試験として投与される点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 100 giorni di Ebola: la "cura" di Medici Senza Frontiere in Repubblica democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 Days of Ebola: MSF's "cure" in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed cases total 5,021 and deaths 2,378 (case fatality 47.4%) as of 16 August, per the Congolese Ministry of Health. The epidemic persists in hard-to-reach areas amid fragile health systems and ongoing conflict, with communities grappling with fear, distrust, and isolation. MSF’s Mirella Riccardi, head of mental health, describes how containment measures—avoiding contact, frequent handwashing, and minimizing gatherings—and the handling of deaths reshape daily life and rituals, necessitating culturally aware engagement. The response centers on recognizing the historical and social roots of distrust, mobilizing community and religious leaders, and involving families in care to reduce contagion while respecting culture. A case illustrates progress: a severely ill woman admitted after extended mediation; initial fear of poisoning and treatment rejection, overcome through coordinated work of doctors, psychologists, and health promoters, building trust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行100日目:コンゴ民主共和国における国境なき医師団の「治療」
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.4%の大規模エボラ流行(症例5,021人、死亡2,378人)が継続しており、紛争と脆弱な保健システムにより制御が困難な状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中エボラ流行の状況報告記事。MSFによる対応活動と地域社会の信頼構築に焦点を当てているが、症例数・死亡数から見て公衆衛生上深刻な状況が継続していることが確認される。フルRRAでの詳細評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情加速蔓延，刚果将获得7万剂Ervebo疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak accelerates; the Democratic Republic of the Congo to receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, the World Health Organization announced that the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine. Of these, 20,000 doses will be used in Phase 3 trials to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; the remaining 50,000 doses will be provided to frontline health workers per WHO guidance. Ervebo, produced by Merck, is approved for Zaire ebolavirus and is not approved for Bundibugyo virus—the strain driving the current outbreak. WHO cautions it is unclear whether Ervebo protects against Bundibugyo, though early laboratory and animal data suggest possible protection. The most recent DRC update reports 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, a national CFR of 47.5% (70% in North Kivu due to response challenges). This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, the largest on record, spreading to six eastern provinces and outpacing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Tedros says the outbreak remains a PHEIC and that we must be honest: it is far from under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が加速、コンゴ民主共和国が7万回分のErveboワクチンを受け取る予定
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言されている過去最大規模のエボラ流行で、致死率47.5%、6州に拡大するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がPHEIC継続かつ「制御には程遠い」と発言。新たな変異株(Bundibugyo)にはErveboワクチンの有効性が未確認であり、第3相試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo to Receive 70,000 Doses of FDA-Approved Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern provinces grapple with the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality about 47.5%; up to 70% in North Kivu). Congo will receive 70,000 Ervebo (rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP) doses: 20,000 for a Phase III trial testing protection against Bundibugyo, and 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo; early lab and animal data suggest it may offer some protection, but effectiveness is unproven. The outbreak is spreading about three times faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak and has affected six eastern provinces; origins trace to Mongbwalu mining town, with circulation beginning as early as February and the outbreak declared May 15. Doses were pledged after a Congo government request, with WHO emphasizing surveillance, rapid detection, and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、FDA承認のエボラワクチン7万回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大中で、致死率約47.5%、6州に拡大しており、既存ワクチンの有効性も未確認であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（東部6州、Mongbwalu起源）の流行のみが記述されており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。既承認ワクチンErveboはZaire株用でBundibugyo株への効果は未証明である点がリスク評価上の重要論点。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Macapá reforça combate ao Aedes aegypti com ação integrada na zona norte da capital - Diário do Amapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macapá City Hall strengthens the fight against Aedes aegypti with integrated action in the capital's northern zone - Diário do Amapá.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, Macapá City Hall, via the Municipal Health Surveillance Secretariat (SMVS), led an integrated action in Novo Horizonte, a northern-zone neighborhood, to prevent dengue and control Aedes aegypti. The event combines health education, vector-control fieldwork, and social services for local families. Vector-control agents inspect sites for breeding points and instruct residents on eliminating mosquito habitats. Secretary Jefferson Oliveira emphasized that resuming field operations after at least six years strengthens prevention and brings health services closer to the population. The effort also involves the Municipal Secretariat of Social Assistance (Semfa), which registers vulnerable families and provides legal guidance during visits. The program continues on 27 August, 08:00–12:00, in Beirol, with ongoing guidance and Aedes aegypti control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: マカパ市役所、州都北部地区で統合対策によりネッタイシマカとの闘いを強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、通常の予防的なベクター対策活動を伝える行政広報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの発生を報告しておらず、6年ぶりに再開された定期的なベクター対策活動の広報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in swine flu cases reported amid humid, variable weather conditions
article.articleSummary: Spike in H1N1 (swine flu) cases reported in Delhi-NCR and several parts of India amid humid, variable monsoon weather. Health experts say monsoon conditions drive seasonal respiratory infections, with influenza symptoms including sudden high fever, cough, runny nose and body pains; elderly, those with comorbidities or pre-existing respiratory conditions face higher complication risk and are advised to vaccinate. In Bengaluru’s SPARSH Hospital, five to six flu-like patients present daily, with two to three admissions; in Delhi, dengue and H1N1 have risen through July and August. Aakash Healthcare notes dengue and H1N1 spikes, linked to stagnant water and indoor transmission in damp weather. Asian Hospital reports dengue, H1N1 and H3N2 with a range from simple throat pain to pneumonia. Authorities urge respiratory hygiene, masks in crowds, early testing, and vaccination for high-risk groups; awareness campaigns and fogging drives have improved care-seeking behavior.

triage.headline_ja: 多湿で不安定な天候の中、豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例の急増が報告される
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季に伴うインド国内の季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2）とデング熱の増加であり、専門家も気象要因による例年の傾向と説明しており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のモンスーン関連疾患（H1N1、H3N2、デング熱）の国内報道であり、医療機関は通常の診療体制内で対応している。重症度や異常性を示す具体的な統計（死亡数、重症化率等）は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا: تخصيص 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح "إيرفيبو" للكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 70,000 doses of the ERVEBO vaccine allocated to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-20, WHO and partners said the Democratic Republic of the Congo will receive 70,000 ERVEBO Ebola vaccine doses to bolster the response. ERVEBO is the sole officially approved vaccine, targeting Zaire ebolavirus, not the current Bundibugyo strain causing the 17th outbreak in the DRC. Data suggest it may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, but evidence remains limited. The allocation includes 20,000 doses for Phase III trials to assess impact on Bundibugyo, with 50,000 for frontline health workers and caregivers. Since May 15, six eastern provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Ou-Wil, and Tshopo—have faced a rapid outbreak. Gavi provides $7 million to fund this stockpile, plus $6 million from its Rapid Response Fund to support broader vaccination. Tedros described the move as a sign of global solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国に「エルベボ」ワクチン7万回分を配分
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱流行（Bundibugyo株）に関する内容で、複数州への拡大、医療従事者への感染リスク、国際的なワクチン支援（WHO・Gavi）が報告されており、重大な公衆衛生イベントとしてフルRRAの対象となる。
triage.notes: 既存の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に関するワクチン配布の続報。承認ワクチンERVEBOは主にZaire株を対象としており、現行株への有効性は限定的なデータしかない点が新たな懸念材料。5月15日以降、東部6州（イトゥリが震源地）で急速な拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-hit DR Congo gets 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, is the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, with over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths as of 20 August 2026. The World Health Organization announced the release of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses—tested and approved for the Zaire strain—for trials and limited use against the Bundibugyo strain driving this surge. Of these, 20,000 doses fund a Phase 3 trial to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, while 50,000 doses are allocated for frontline health workers. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; Ervebo’s proven safety/efficacy is for Zaire, though early animal data suggest some cross-protection. Allocation follows WHO SAGE immunization guidance and a government request. The outbreak spans the north and east, where governance is weak and health infrastructure is limited amid armed-group activity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国、Erveboワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで17回目のエボラ流行が発生し、症例5,000件超、死者2,300人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、新たなブンディブギョ株による流行拡大と武装勢力地域での対応困難さから国際的関心・支援が必要な状況である。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、Phase3試験と限定使用によるリスク管理が進行中。武装勢力活動下での保健インフラ脆弱性も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, 콩고민주공화국에 에볼라 백신 7만 도스 지원
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO to provide 70,000 doses of Ebola vaccine to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO will provide 70,000 Ervebo Ebola vaccine doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help contain the fastest-spreading outbreak. The International Coordinating Group will release 20,000 doses for a Phase 3 trial to test efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while 50,000 doses are allocated to frontline health workers per WHO guidance. Ervebo, Merck’s vaccine, is approved for Zaire ebolavirus and not yet approved for Bundibugyo; WHO notes human protection against Bundibugyo remains unproven pending trial, though early lab/animal data suggest potential protection. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls the move a milestone of international solidarity. Since May 15, Congo reports 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths (case fatality rate 47.5%, up to 70% in North Kivu). The 17th outbreak has spread to six eastern provinces with over 11,000 deaths, accelerating 3x faster than 2014–2016 West Africa; WHO warns it could extend beyond Africa. Bundibugyo virus was identified in 2007 in Uganda; no approved vaccine or therapy exists.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国にエボラワクチン7万回分を支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が進行中で、致死率最大70%、6州へ拡大、WHOがアフリカ域外への拡大懸念を表明しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大リスクと判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはブンディブギョウイルスが2007年に初めて確認された歴史的背景として言及されているのみで、現行流行地ではないため verified_locations から除外。アンゴラも現行流行地としての言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Surpasses 5,000 Cases Amid Violence and Community Resistance
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases, concentrated in Ituri Province near Bunia. Violence and community resistance—attacks on health workers and ambulance vandalism—continue to impede containment efforts. In August, five civilians were killed and about 50 farmers abducted in Mambasa Territory, following a prior assault that killed 16 and displaced more than 15,000. The World Health Organization has convened its emergency committee for a second time and is deploying 100 epidemiologists alongside more than 500 community health workers for contact tracing and case identification. Funding remains a hurdle, with roughly 60% of the $115 million appeal raised. Officials warn the outbreak could become the deadliest on record, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that claimed more than 11,000 lives, if trends continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、暴力と地域社会の抵抗の中で5,000症例を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5,000症例を超え、WHOが緊急委員会を招集するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC（イトゥリ州、ブニア、マンバサ）に限定されており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外。WHOが史上最悪の流行になり得ると警告しており、資金調達も課題。

article.articleHeadline: Tin tức sáng 21-8: Quốc hội bàn định hướng sửa Luật Đất đai; Nguy cơ quá tải do bệnh sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morning News, Aug 21: National Assembly outlines the direction for amending the Land Law; risk of overload due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City and the southern region face rising dengue fever with risk of hospital bed overload. In the first 30 weeks of 2026, dengue cases total 56,364 with 10 deaths; hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) counts reach 61,234 with 11 deaths, EV71 accounting for 55% of severe HFMD cases; meningococcal meningitis records 33 cases and 5 deaths. Measles has fallen 97% after vaccination; measles, pertussis, diphtheria and COVID-19 remain at low levels. These data were shared at the 2026 Tropical Diseases Scientific Conference in Ho Chi Minh City on Aug 20 by Dr. Nguyen Thanh Dung, director of the City’s Tropical Disease Hospital, who warned of bed overload and prolonged ICU stays from August to November 2026 due to dengue and HFMD. Authorities emphasize surveillance, prevention, and rapid treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 8月21日朝のニュース：国会が土地法改正の方向性を議論；デング熱による病床過剰負荷のリスク
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市を中心にデング熱・手足口病（EV71）の症例数・死亡数が多く、病床過剰負荷とICU長期滞在のリスクが医療専門家から警告されており、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・手足口病流行に関する定期報告だが、死亡例と病床逼迫の懸念が具体的に示されているためPICKUPと判定。麻疹・百日咳・ジフテリア・COVID-19は低水準で特段の懸念なし。

article.articleHeadline: Entire health system under pressure from biggest flu outbreak in 10 years - health boss
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is driving a spike in cases, with Auckland's flu-related hospitalisations at a 10-year high and national infection rates at a four-year high and rising. Health NZ says the entire health system is under pressure, from triage lines to emergency departments, primary care, St John, and telehealth. A national coordination centre set up this week is diverting staff where needed; Health NZ reports a 27% increase in staff off sick in the past week. Infections also include RSV, cold viruses, and some Covid-19 cases circulating. About 1,500 patients who arrived at ED were redirected to urgent care; 264 extra staff are in place, with 64 doing additional duties, and extra beds are available, though some Auckland workers say there is little sign of relief. The Winter Plan is in action, but rapid-build wards are delayed: Hawke's Bay opens next month; Nelson in November; Middlemore, Wellington, Waikato next year.

triage.headline_ja: 過去10年で最大のインフルエンザ流行により医療システム全体が逼迫 - 保健当局責任者
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・RSV・COVID-19によるニュージーランド国内の医療逼迫に関する記事であり、対象国（フィリピン等）への言及はサマリー中に見られず、対象国リストに該当する発生国も確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフィリピン（Calabarzon, Bay）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはニュージーランドの季節性インフルエンザ流行に関する内容のみで、フィリピンへの言及はない。ニュージーランドは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo voltam a preocupar e lembram importância da vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases once again raise concern and remind us of the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Brazil have reached 24 in 2026, marking a resurgence after the disease was declared eradicated two years earlier. The infections are described as imported, indicating cases linked to travelers rather than sustained local transmission. The report emphasizes vaccination as the central strategy used by health authorities to prevent further spread and to protect vulnerable populations. It provides no details on clinical symptoms or laboratory confirmation beyond the imported status. Dated 2026-08-20, the article underscores the importance of vaccination campaigns as a key preventive measure against reestablishment of measles transmission. No additional locations or outbreak specifics are provided beyond the national context.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例が再び懸念を呼び、ワクチンの重要性を再認識させる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹の輸入症例が24件確認され、根絶宣言後の再燃事例だが、持続的な地域内伝播の証拠はなく情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例は輸入例とされ、臨床詳細や検査確定情報は記載なし。根絶宣言後の再燃という点で異常性はあるが、重症度や地域伝播の情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Família luta há oito meses por marcapasso para mulher com doença de Chagas internada em estado gravíssimo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Family has been fighting for eight months to obtain a pacemaker for a woman with Chagas disease who is hospitalized in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: 57-year-old rural producer with Chagas disease remains intubated in critical condition at Santa Casa de Misericórdia de Anápolis, awaiting transfer to a facility capable of implanting a dual-chamber pacemaker with a cardioverter-defibrillator (CDI). Silemar Ferreira da Fonseca’s health has deteriorated over about 20 days due to cardiac complications from Chagas disease. She originated from a Goianésia area property and was referred to Hospital Estadual Alberto Rassi in Goiânia before moving to Anápolis for evaluation. The family has sought the implant for eight months; two court rulings were issued on August 4 and 7 but had not been complied with by August 20. The latest court order requires Goiás State and Anápolis to transfer her within three days to a high-complexity cardiology center with interventional capabilities and CDI implantation, with a potential fine of R$108,300 for noncompliance. Anápolis’ Health Secretariat says it awaits a SUS vacancy; SES-GO says no request was recorded and that the procedure is not in contracted services.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病の女性、ペースメーカー確保を求め家族が8か月間闘い続ける
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の医療アクセス・行政対応に関する個別症例報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や感染拡大の懸念を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人患者の医療アクセス問題（ペースメーカー移植の遅延）に関する報道であり、シャーガス病の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての要件を満たさないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo to receive 70,000 doses of Ervebo Ebola vaccine, which has been effective in past outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak in six eastern provinces has 5,208 confirmed cases and 2,476 deaths, described as the fastest Ebola outbreak in history and spreading about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Congo will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine; 20,000 doses are for a Phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo virus, with the remaining 50,000 for frontline health workers. Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus but not Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest it may provide some protection against Bundibugyo. Doses will be released immediately after Congo’s government request via the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision. Overall case fatality rate is 47.5%, up to 70% in North Kivu. Authorities believe the outbreak began in Mongbwalu mining town with spread since February and was declared May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros urged continued vaccination, surveillance and rapid care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、過去の流行で効果を示したエボラワクチン「エルベボ」70,000回分を受領へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で確定症例5,208例・死亡2,476例、致死率47.5%（一部地域で70%）に達し、史上最速の拡大速度とされる重大なエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長も継続的なワクチン接種・サーベイランス・迅速な医療対応を呼びかけており、国際的な支援体制（ICG経由のワクチン供給）が既に稼働中。史上最速の拡大速度との報道は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma por el ébola en República Democrática del Congo: el brote ya dejó 2.476 muertos y más de 5.200 contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the outbreak has already left 2,476 dead and more than 5,200 cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province since May 15, has surpassed 2,476 deaths and more than 5,200 cases. In the last 24 hours, 103 new infections and 35 deaths were recorded, with 24 recoveries, per the Congolese National Public Health Institute. The outbreak is the second deadliest and fastest-spreading on record, with a case fatality rate above 46%. The CDC estimates only 30–40% of cases are detected, suggesting the true burden could be about three times higher. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain circulating there has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, severe hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, and diarrhea. Six provinces are actively affected; the virus has crossed into Uganda, which declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. The WHO reaffirmed the PHEIC status, while a Science study points to earliest infections possibly dating to January.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が警戒：死者2,476人、感染者5,200人超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当し、WHOがPHEICを再確認している重大なエボラ流行であるため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICステータスを再確認しており、致死率46%超、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株が原因。

article.articleHeadline: Rabia: Sedes refuerza control en la frontera con Brasil con vacunación de más de 6.200 animales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies: Sedes reinforces border control with Brazil through vaccination of more than 6,200 animals.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign by Bolivia’s Santa Cruz Department Health Service (Sedes) along the Brazil border targets Puerto Suárez and Puerto Quijarro. The binational weekend effort (August 22–23) aims to vaccinate more than 6,200 animals to curb rabies spread across the frontier, with teams deployed in coordination with Germán Busch province health networks and Brazilian authorities. Epidemiological update: 15 rabies cases in dogs have been recorded in the department; affected animals underwent appropriate epidemiological control. People who had contact with infected animals are receiving preventive vaccination as part of surveillance to prevent human rabies. Sedes urges families in Puerto Suárez and Puerto Quijarro to participate and facilitate vaccination of their dogs and other domestic animals.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病：セデスがブラジル国境での動物6,200頭以上のワクチン接種で管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ボリビア・サンタクルス県における狂犬病（主に犬）に対する通常の予防接種キャンペーンであり、人への感染拡大や国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はボリビア国内の狂犬病対策活動が主題であり、ブラジルは国境協力先として言及されているのみでブラジル国内での発生報告はないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Em comunicado, Sorocaba confirma caso de sarampo | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In a statement, Sorocaba confirms a measles case | TVS+.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 20, 2026, Sorocaba confirmed a measles case near a Vila Jardini school; no students or staff are affected so far. The Epidemiological Surveillance of Sorocaba’s Health Secretariat initiated preventive vaccination checks, asking guardians to bring their child’s vaccination card and ID to UBS Cerrado (Rua Visconde do Rio Branco, 885) within three days to verify and update doses if needed (phone 15-3221-7445). Statewide in São Paulo, SES-SP reports 23 measles cases in 2026: 20 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos; 16 patients unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Age distribution includes 15 cases under 2 years and 8 between 15 and 50 years. In 2025 there were two cases, both in the capital. First-dose coverage is 88% and second-dose 73.8% statewide, below the 95% target. Vaccines are procured via the National Immunization Program; 645 municipalities are stocked, with residents 6 months–59 years urged to vaccinate in the listed cities.

triage.headline_ja: 声明により、ソロカバが麻疹症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹の散発例（州内23例、うち16例が未接種または不完全接種）が継続しており、ワクチン接種率が目標を下回っているため今後の拡大に注意が必要だが、現時点で深刻な影響や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州全体でワクチン接種率（1回目88%、2回目73.8%）が目標の95%を下回っており、未接種者を中心に麻疹症例が継続的に発生している点は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تتلقى 70 ألف جرعة من لقاح "إرفيبو" لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine to combat an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo receives 70,000 doses of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine to help curb a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. As of 20 August 2026, the outbreak has 5,021 confirmed infections and 2,378 deaths, according to the African CDC. WHO and partners note that Ervebo has shown efficacy in previous Ebola outbreaks, though it is not yet proven to protect against Bundibugyo; laboratory data and animal studies suggest some level of protection. The vaccine deployment aims to bolster containment, with organizers stating the outbreak could be controlled within about three months if sufficient resources are available. The current outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain, while clinical trials continue to seek effective prevention and treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対策のためエルベボワクチン7万回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行（確定感染5,021例、死亡2,378例）であり、IHR基準の複数該当と国際支援（ワクチン提供）の実施が確認されるためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47%と高く、まれなブンディブギョ株による流行。ワクチンの有効性は未確認だが、WHO・African CDC・国際機関による支援が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Fortaleza e Itaitinga realizam ação conjunta de combate à dengue no bairro Pedras - Contexto Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortaleza and Itaitinga carry out a joint action to combat dengue in the Pedras neighborhood - Contexto Notícias
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza and Itaitinga conduct a joint action to combat dengue and other arboviruses (dengue, chikungunya, Zika) in the Pedras neighborhood at Fortaleza-Itaitinga border, as part of the 2nd Border Operation 2026. About 2,000 properties are to be visited; the effort involves endemic health agents from both municipalities and prioritizes eliminating breeding sites, resident guidance, and treating water-holding deposits when needed. Fortaleza cites roughly 700 confirmed dengue cases and two deaths, underscoring persistent transmission and the need for community engagement. The broader 2nd Border Operation 2026 previously ran August 6–11, with Fortaleza (47 agents) and Caucaia (27 agents) visiting 1,621 and 1,500 properties respectively; 54 and 490 deposits were treated, and 26 and 36 positive breeding sites identified. Additionally, about 1,502 kg of waste was removed in Caucaia to reduce vector habitats.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザとイタイチンガが共同でペドラス地区のデング熱対策を実施 - Contexto Notícias
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で流行が継続しているが、本記事は定例の防除活動（媒介蚊対策）の報告であり、新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とする。地域の恒常的なデング対策活動であり、既存の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Pelastakaa Lapset: Kongossa jää joka päivä kaksi lasta orvoksi ebolan vuoksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Save the Children: In the Congo, two children are orphaned every day because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two children in the Democratic Republic of Congo are orphaned every day due to the Ebola epidemic, according to Save the Children. Orphaned children face risks including trafficking and sexual exploitation. Authorities report at least 180 children orphaned since the outbreak was declared in May. The Ministry of Health says nearly 5,000 people have been infected with Ebola, with almost half dying. Among those with known ages by early August, children account for nearly one-third of deaths. The situation is worsened by transmission in regions already affected by crises. About three-quarters of Ebola fatalities occur in communities rather than health facilities, suggesting delays in seeking care. The outbreak has spread unusually quickly in recent months. Africa CDC notes confirmed cases are roughly nine times and deaths six times higher than during the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, the deadliest on record.

triage.headline_ja: セーブ・ザ・チルドレン：コンゴでは毎日2人の子どもがエボラの影響で孤児になっている
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は感染者数約5000人、致死率約50%、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を大幅に上回る規模と異常な速さの拡大が報告されており、深刻性・異常性ともに高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRCのみが言及されており、Angolaへの越境拡大の記述は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Kolera di Myanmar, Ratusan Warga Dilarikan ke Rumah Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Myanmar, hundreds of people rushed to hospital.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon Region, Myanmar, with a surge of hundreds of acute gastrointestinal illness cases reported on Monday, 17 August 2026. Laboratory-confirmed cholera infections are spreading in Myanmar’s economic hub, raising public health concerns. As of 20 August 2026, authorities are intensifying efforts to curb transmission and manage patient admissions. Disaster management officials have activated all health facilities to provide emergency care for affected patients. The report notes that confirmed cholera infections are driving the outbreak, but does not provide a death toll. The rapid mobilization of health services signals an urgent response to a cholera outbreak centered in Yangon, the country’s economic center.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーでコレラ流行、数百人が病院に搬送される
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー経済の中心地ヤンゴンでコレラの検査確定例が急増し数百人が入院、緊急医療体制が発動されており公衆衛生上の懸念とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 死者数は報告されていないが、経済都市ヤンゴンでの急速な感染拡大と緊急医療対応の発動が確認されており、続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК сообщили о заражении младенцев Эболой при грудном вскармливании
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC reports Ebola infections in infants through breastfeeding.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease infections detected in infants through breastfeeding in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with some fatalities. Reported by Radio Okapi citing PRONANUT. Health authorities advise that breastfeeding is contraindicated during Ebola; infected mothers should be separated from infants, and may resume after recovery. PRONANUT and the World Health Organization emphasize that the virus can persist in breast milk, though it is not always clear whether infant infection is from milk or close contact with an infected mother. The WHO recommends resuming breastfeeding only after two consecutive negative PCR tests of breast milk with a 24 hour interval. The current outbreak in DRC is the largest in the country’s history, with more than 5,000 confirmed cases and over 2,300 deaths as of 19 August, and has spread from Ituri to six provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで母乳育児を介した乳児のエボラ感染が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（5,000例以上、死者2,300人超）が6州に拡大しており、母乳を介した乳児感染という異常な感染経路も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行で、6州に拡大し死者2,300人超。母乳育児による乳児感染という新たな感染経路が報告され、WHOが母乳のPCR検査を推奨するなど公衆衛生対応が継続中。国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Capital paulista vacinou 1 milhão de pessoas contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The city of São Paulo vaccinated 1 million people against measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo, Brazil: the city accounts for 20 of 24 confirmed national cases, making it the outbreak hotspot this year. Since Aug 3, São Paulo has administered 1,045,758 doses of measles vaccine as part of a multivaccination campaign. The first case in the city was confirmed in February, imported from Bolivia; the second in March, imported from Guatemala. Additional cases occurred in June–July across districts Vila Medeiros (8), Vila Maria (2), Capão Redondo (1), Água Rasa (4), Sapopemba (2), and Jabaquara (1). No new confirmed cases since July 7, but 472 suspected cases remain under investigation. All residents aged 6 months to 59 years should receive a new measles vaccine dose, regardless of prior doses, while children under 1 year may receive a zero-dose (6–11 months). Campaign runs through Sep 1 at 483 health units (Mon-Fri 7:00–19:00; Sat at AMAs/UBSs); locate the nearest unit via Busca Saúde.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市、麻疹予防接種100万人達成
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロで麻疹アウトブレイク（全国24例中20例）が発生し、大規模予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。麻疹排除国での再興例であり、政府の強い関与と社会的関心が認められるためフルRRAが妥当。
triage.notes: 輸入例（ボリビア・グアテマラ由来）が発端。7月7日以降新規確定例なしだが、疑い例472件が調査中であり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情奪逾2300命　民主剛果獲7萬劑疫苗但保護力仍未知
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has claimed more than 2,300 lives; the Democratic Republic of the Congo has received 70,000 doses of vaccine, but its protective efficacy remains unknown.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) marks the 17th wave since May 15, with over 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths, the deadliest on record in the region. The World Health Organization (WHO) and the International Coordinating Group (ICG) released 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses for trial and limited use: 20,000 for a phase 3 trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and 50,000 for frontline healthcare workers under SAGE guidance. Ervebo has proven safety and protection against Zaire ebolavirus but is not approved for Bundibugyo; early laboratory and animal data suggest some potential protection. The Bundibugyo-driven outbreak currently lacks approved vaccines and therapies, complicating response efforts. Recent case introductions from outside initially monitored groups indicate rapid, widespread transmission and challenging outbreak tracking.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行で死者2,300人超、コンゴ民主共和国に7万回分のワクチンが到着も防御効果は未知数
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（症例5,000超、死者2,300超）が継続中で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ型による流行かつ監視外からの症例流入で急速な拡大が懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、既存のErveboワクチン（ザイール株用）の効果は未確認。WHO/ICGによる第3相試験と最前線医療従事者への限定使用が進行中。監視対象外からの症例発生が報告されており、感染拡大の追跡が困難化している点は国際的拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis claims more lives in Iloilo from Jan. to Aug. 2026
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Iloilo Province, Philippines, has claimed at least 10 lives from January to August 2026, across eight towns: Dueñas (2), Dingle (2), Dumangas (1), Oton (1), Barotac Nuevo (1), Zarraga (1), San Dionisio (1), and Concepcion (1). A total of 84 cases have been recorded in 2026, with Tigbauan (6), Janiuay (5), Dumangas (5), Tubungan (5), Passi City (4), Dingle (4), Oton (4), and Pototan (4) reporting the most infections. Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, head of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, said 32 of the cases are agriculture-related, urging farmers to take prophylaxis if exposed. In Tigbauan, authorities intensified campaigns as floods correlate with transmission. Dr. Jeffrey Rivas, officer-in-charge, advised wearing protective gear and boots when wading floodwaters or working in paddies, and to seek health care if injuries occur.

triage.headline_ja: イロイロ州でレプトスピラ症による死者が増加、2026年1月から8月にかけて
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・イロイロ州における例年発生する洪水関連のレプトスピラ症であり、地域保健当局が通常の予防啓発活動で対応しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで洪水期に毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は地方保健局による年次集計・注意喚起の内容。人-人感染はなく、農業従事者や洪水浸水地域の住民への曝露が継続する点のみWPRO基準に該当するが、全体として通常の季節性報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: น่าน ระดับน้ำเริ่มลดลง เร่งฟื้นฟูพื้นที่ เฝ้าระวังดินสไลด์ อ.เฉลิมพระเกียรติ เตือนภัยโรคฉี่หนู
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nan Province: Water levels begin to fall; accelerating restoration of areas; landslide monitoring in Chaloem Phra Kiat District; leptospirosis warning.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 August 2026 22:00, Nan Province flood conditions are receding, with a leptospirosis warning in effect. Water at major gauges N.64 (Ban Phakhwan) and N.1 (Northern Development Bridge) has fallen; N.1 remains about 85 cm below the dyke, and monitoring continues in Wiang Sa District. Relief teams have delivered supplies to Ban Tha Li and Don Chai in Wiang Sa and to Phu Phiang (Fa Kaew Sub-district), while aerial surveys assess floodwater direction to guide mitigation. In Nan Municipality, three large pumps operate 24/7 at Khlong Chao Fa to drain floodwater, with cross-dyke pumping to the Nan River planned as levels fall. A 103 mm, 12-hour rainfall in Chaloem Phra Kiat triggered landslide warnings for several districts. Recovery work spans Pua, Tha Wang Pha, Mueang Nan, Phu Phiang, and Wiang Sa; power largely restored; drinking-water turbidity persists. Hotline 054-716-174.

triage.headline_ja: ナーン県:水位低下、地域復旧を加速、チャルームプラキアット郡で土砂崩れ警戒、レプトスピラ症(ネズミの尿による感染症)への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症警戒情報であり、実際の患者発生数など具体的な健康被害の記載がなく情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 台湾の地名がBluedot発生地域に含まれているが、記事はタイ・ナーン県の洪水後のレプトスピラ症警戒情報であり、台湾は主題に含まれないため除外した。具体的な感染者数などの記載はなく、洪水後の予防的注意喚起の段階と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo supera 1 milhão de doses aplicadas na campanha contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo surpasses one million doses administered in the measles vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo has administered 1,045,758 measles vaccine doses since the Aug 3 multivaccination campaign began, aiming to curb the spread of measles. The city accounts for the majority of confirmed cases in Brazil this year, with 20 of 24 nationwide. Epidemiological surveillance shows 472 suspected cases under investigation; no new confirmed cases since Aug 7. Transmission started with imported cases from Bolivia in February and Guatemala in March; from June/July onward, local transmission concentrated in Vila Medeiros (8), Água Rasa (4), Vila Maria (2), Sapopemba (2), Capão Redondo (1), Jabaquara (1). Current guidance targets everyone aged 6 months to 59 years to receive a new vaccine dose, regardless of prior vaccination; under-1-year-olds are particularly vulnerable, with 10 of 20 cases in this group. Campaign runs until Sept 1; 483 Basic Health Units are open weekdays 7–19, Saturdays at AMAs/Integrated UBSs. Use Busca Saúde to locate nearest vaccination site.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、麻疹予防接種キャンペーンで100万回接種を突破
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロを中心にブラジル国内で麻疹の輸入・局地伝播例が確認されているが、8月7日以降新規確定例はなく、大規模ワクチン接種で対応中であり深刻な公衆衛生上の危機とは言えない。
triage.notes: ボリビア・グアテマラからの輸入例に端を発する局地流行だが、8月7日以降新規確定例なし。ワクチン接種キャンペーンで対応中であり、国内主体で管理可能と見られる。続報（新規症例の有無）を注視。

article.articleHeadline: 53 ca sốt xuất huyết ở Đăk Mar: Lộ điểm yếu trong phòng dịch tuyến cơ sở
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 53 dengue fever cases in Đăk Mar: Exposing weaknesses in the local epidemic prevention system.
article.articleSummary: 53 dengue fever cases recorded in Dak Mar Commune, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, from early July 2026 to August 19, 2026, with 48 cases concentrated in Hamlet 7. Hamlet 7 houses 2,941 residents across 396 households, predominantly ethnic minority DTTS. The outbreak expanded from initial cases to the entire hamlet; high fever patients often delay clinic visits, with some self-medicating at home. Example: a mother and sister of Y Thaih required hospitalization at Dak Hà Regional General Hospital. About 70% of Hamlet 7 residents have health insurance, yet cost fears and preference to avoid long hospital stays deter care. Local authorities have organized environmental cleanup and larval control; commune health staff conduct daily outreach. The commune lacks a chemical spraying machine, relying on borrowed or rented equipment; procurement is stalled by bidding processes. Provincial support for equipment and technical guidance is requested to strengthen prevention efforts. Key locations: Dak Mar, Quảng Ngãi; Hamlet 7.

triage.headline_ja: ダクマーでのデング熱53例：地域防疫体制の弱点が露呈
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地区（コミューン）内での局地的なデング熱発生であり、症例数も限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、媒介害虫対策の設備不足や医療アクセスの障壁など継続的な感染拡大要因があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの流行地域で季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、今回の事例は特定コミューン（Dak Mar、Quảng Ngãi省）内の限定的な集団発生。地方当局が薬剤散布装置不足を訴え、省レベルの支援を要請しているが、全国的・国際的な注目度や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Así es Cómo el Mosquito se Convirtió en el Mayor 'Asesino' de la Humanidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Is How the Mosquito Became Humanity's Greatest 'Killer'
article.articleSummary: Annual mosquito-borne diseases kill 750,000–1,000,000 people worldwide. World Mosquito Day, observed on August 20 since 1987, honors Ronald Ross’s discovery linking Anopheles bites to malaria. Malaria (paludismo) accounted for 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024 per the WHO. Dengue infections number 100–400 million annually, with about half the global population at risk. Despite efforts, malaria remains far from eradication. In Mexico, the Qdenga dengue vaccine was approved, administered in two doses with reportedly lower risks than similar vaccines. For dengue, only two WHO-approved vaccines exist to prevent severe disease, given in a four-dose schedule and targeting children. Brazil is a leader in dengue prevention through mosquito-based strategies: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to block virus transmission and genetically modified mosquitoes to reduce mosquito populations. The article highlights persistent global burden and ongoing vector-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊はいかにして人類最大の『殺し屋』となったのか
triage.triage_reason: 世界蚊の日にちなむ一般的な啓発・解説記事であり、特定の国での異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア・デング熱の世界的な負担に関する一般的解説記事であり、メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルはワクチン・媒介制御の取り組み事例として言及されているが、急性の発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Spike in Swine Flu Cases Reported Amid Humid, Variable Weather Conditions
article.articleSummary: As of 21 August 2026, Delhi-NCR and other parts of India report a spike in H1N1 (swine flu) amid humid, variable monsoon weather. Health experts say monsoon conditions boost seasonal influenza, with vaccines available to prevent influenza; vulnerable groups face higher complication risks. In Bengaluru, SPARSH Hospital sees about five to six flu-like patients daily, with two to three admitted to IPD. In Delhi, Aakash Healthcare reports rises in both dengue and H1N1 in July–August, linked to stagnant water and humid conditions. Asian Hospital notes dengue, swine flu, and H3N2 in OPD. Symptoms range from fever and cough to severe pneumonia; awareness campaigns encourage timely testing and treatment. Public health guidance emphasizes respiratory hygiene, masks in crowded places, avoiding self-medication, and vaccination for high-risk groups.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 5000 as vaccines arrive to combat outbreak
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola infections exceed 5,000 with 2,378 deaths (case fatality rate 47.4%) and over 1,000 recoveries; 5,021 cases confirmed since May. Declared mid-May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the fastest on record, with about two-thirds of deaths occurring outside hospitals and many new cases not linked to monitored contacts. Transmission continues via contact with bodily fluids, and authorities warn the true toll may be higher, with the outbreak possibly starting as early as February. The WHO will distribute 70,000 Ervebo doses to Congo—20,000 for a phase 3 trial against Bundibugyo and 50,000 for frontline workers—though Ervebo is licensed for other Ebola species and not yet proven against Bundibugyo; early laboratory/animal data suggest possible protection. The outbreak remains a global emergency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例が5000人を超え、感染拡大を抑えるためワクチンが到着
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速のエボラ流行が5000症例・致死率47.4%に達し、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として世界的な関心が高いため、フルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 史上最速の流行拡大速度、多くの死亡が病院外で発生、追跡不能な新規症例の存在、種特異的ワクチン有効性の不確実性など、複数の重大な懸念事項あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO - Africa CDC welcomes Ebola vaccines to the DRC
article.articleSummary: DRC authorities requested release of Ervebo Ebola vaccine from the ICG stockpile to respond to the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. An initial 70,000-dose allocation was approved: 20,000 for a Phase 3 trial to assess vaccine impact on Bundibugyo virus and 50,000 for frontline and health workers per WHO SAGE guidance. Human efficacy against Bundibugyo virus remains unconfirmed; early lab/animal data suggest possible protection, making informed consent essential for trial participants and vaccine recipients. ICG partners—WHO, the International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, MSF, UNICEF; funded by Gavi—manage the stockpile. WHO and Africa CDC welcome the allocation, supporting a community-led response to protect people and end the outbreak while generating evidence for future preparedness. Since 2021, the ICG Ebola stockpile has allocated over 56,000 doses to DRC outbreaks and used 167,000 doses in preventive campaigns in DRC, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Sierra Leone and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国へのエボラワクチン提供を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のブンディブギョウウイルス病（エボラ関連）アウトブレイクに対しWHO/Africa CDCが大規模ワクチン配布を承認しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際機関の関与が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのブンディブギョウウイルス病アウトブレイクに対するエボラワクチン(Ervebo)配布に関するもの。他国（シエラレオネ、ケニア、ギニアビサウ、ウガンダ）は過去の予防的キャンペーンの文脈で言及されているのみで、現発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Guinea-Bissau đối mặt với đợt bùng phát bệnh đậu mùa khỉ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guinea-Bissau faces a monkeypox outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Guinea-Bissau faces its first monkeypox (Mpox) outbreak, with 7 confirmed cases (all adults) and no deaths as of 17 August 2026. There are 46 suspected cases, including 23 children under 15 (50% pediatric share). UNICEF warns that reopening schools in September could raise transmission risk, given the vulnerability of children. Mpox is a virus related to smallpox that can spread from animals to humans and between people through close contact, presenting with fever, muscle pain, and skin lesions. The disease was first identified in humans in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Africa CDC had previously lifted a regional public health emergency for Mpox earlier this year due to improved control; no other laboratory details beyond the confirmed cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ギニアビサウでサル痘（Mpox）の流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: ギニアビサウ初のMpox流行で、疑い症例の50%が小児であり学校再開による感染拡大リスクが指摘されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と国際機関（UNICEF）の関与があり、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域として挙げられているDRCは1970年の初発見に関する歴史的言及のみであり、現在の流行地はギニアビサウ（対象国リスト外）。そのためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC déploie l'initiative " Fleuve Congo Sans Ebola " pour protéger l'artère vitale du pays contre le risque de propagation du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC rolls out the "Congo River Without Ebola" initiative to protect the country's lifeline from the risk of the virus spreading.
article.articleSummary: On 20 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo launched the multisectoral 'Fleuve Sans Ebola' initiative to shield the Congo River corridor from Bundibugyo virus disease after 10 cases were reported in Kisangani. The program aims to secure the Kisangani–Kinshasa corridor, prevent spread to Mbandaka and Kinshasa, and cut cross-border risk to the Republic of Congo and Central African Republic. Backed by WHO, IOM, UNICEF, and WFP, with $9 million in UN funding via OCHA, it mobilizes over ten ministries, fourteen public institutions, provincial authorities, river operators, civil society and partners. Measures include port/entry surveillance, an integrated alert-and-response system, upgraded sanitary infrastructure, community alert networks, training for mariners and health workers, isolation capacities in Kisangani, Mbandaka, Kwamouth and Kinshasa, plus floating-quarantine logistics and mobile laboratories along the river. OMS’ Anne Ancia and Dr Body Ilonga, Secretary General of the Ministry of Public Health and Hygiene, emphasize early detection, community engagement, and durable cross-sectoral coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ウイルス拡散リスクから国の生命線を守るため『エボラなきコンゴ川』イニシアチブを展開
triage.triage_reason: キサンガニでブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ関連）10症例が報告され、国際機関の大規模支援を伴う多部門対応が開始されており、国境を越えた拡大リスクもあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患名はBluedotで'Ebola'とされているが、記事本文ではBundibugyo virus disease（エボラウイルス属の一種）と明記されている。キサンガニで10例確認され、コンゴ川流域（マンダカ、キンシャサ）への拡大防止と、コンゴ共和国・中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスク低減を目的とした大規模対応がWHO・IOM・UNICEF・WFP・OCHA（900万ドル支援）主導で開始された。

article.articleSummary: Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), an Ebola vaccine approved for Zaire ebolavirus, is being used to help contain the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province. The WHO and Africa CDC announced 70,000 doses donated, with 20,000 allocated to clinical trials and the remainder for frontline healthcare workers. Efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain remains unknown, though animal studies suggest a potential preventive effect. The current outbreak in Ituri has 5,208 infections and 2,476 deaths. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic caused more than 11,000 deaths. Contact tracing is challenging, with many confirmed cases not being tracked as contacts. The vaccination effort is coordinated by the WHO International Coordinating Group, aiming to curb transmission and protect medical personnel.

The report also notes burial efforts in Ituri Province, underscoring the ongoing human toll of the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: 首都專線｜北京市民爭相飲用「不老泉」　檢測屬硬水且有菌　疾控中心警告易染寄生蟲（陳樂陶報道）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Capital Hotline | Beijing residents scramble to drink the "Fountain of Youth" as tests show it is hard water and contains bacteria; the Center for Disease Control and Prevention warns that it is easy to contract parasites (Chen Letao reports).
article.articleSummary: Beijing residents flock to Mentougou's 'Fountain of Youth' and Pinggu's 'Golden Dove Spring' for mountain spring water, despite authorities indicating these are not drinking sources. On-site tests show extreme hardness with a purity index of 150 (0–20 ideal; 50–100 not suitable) requiring softening before use, and downstream areas littered with debris. Some locals prefer the water for taste, drinking boiled or even untreated, while others still boil before consumption. Beijing's Center for Disease Prevention and Control warns open environmental waters are highly susceptible to contamination and may harbor pathogens such as E. coli and Salmonella, causing abdominal pain and parasitic infections. Boiling does not remove heavy metals or chemical pollutants, and long-term intake poses health risks. This situation is reported as of 2026-08-21.
