article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms a case of canine rabies in Palmas; the case resulted in death - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in Palmas, Tocantins, Brazil: an eight-month-old female dog that had not been vaccinated showed clinical signs in May and died; a sample was collected and lab-confirmed rabies last week. In anticipation and after confirmation, the municipal health secretary sought aggressive control: vaccination blocks in risk areas, mass vaccination of dogs and cats, home visits, contact tracing, and territorial surveillance by the Zoonoses Surveillance and Control Unit (UVCZ). A Dia D of Animal Rabies Vaccination is planned for August 29 at multiple sites across the capital. The owner was advised on exposure risks and seeking post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP); others potentially exposed are evaluated case-by-case. Health authorities report ongoing intensified surveillance, with trained clinicians and a network of facilities ready for human PEP, including 24/7 emergency units Norte and Sul and several vaccination sites.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、パルマスで犬の狂犬病症例を確認；症例は死亡に至った - Conexão Tocantins ニュースポータル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での単発の犬の狂犬病死亡例であり、人への感染は確認されていないが、曝露者へのPEP対応や地域的なワクチン接種強化が行われており、動物由来感染症としての経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 動物（犬）の狂犬病単発症例で人への感染報告はなし。地方自治体が予防的にワクチン接種キャンペーンとPEP体制を強化している段階であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa still bears 94% of world's malaria burden, research network warns
article.articleSummary: According to WHO's World Malaria Report, Africa accounted for 94% of malaria cases and 95% of deaths in 2024, with children under five making up about three-quarters of regional malaria deaths. In Nigeria, the DRC and Niger, together, account for more than half of Africa's malaria deaths. AMRREN, issuing the statement in Accra, warns gains against mosquito-borne disease remain fragile even as new prevention tools emerge, citing three pressures on control programmes: rising insecticide resistance among mosquitoes, environmental and climatic shifts that alter breeding and range, and the spread of invasive mosquito species. The network notes, while artemisinin partial drug resistance has been documented in Eritrea, Rwanda, Uganda and Tanzania, the focus here is on vector control challenges. Ongoing vaccine and vector-control advances offer new possibilities. Mosquitoes transmit dengue, yellow fever and chikungunya as well. Three priorities: sustained surveillance/R&D; community-centered prevention and timely care; and stronger health communication.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカが依然として世界のマラリア負担の94%を占める、研究ネットワークが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次マラリア報告書に基づく既知の疾病負荷に関する定期的な統計発表であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO世界マラリア報告書に基づく年次統計のまとめであり、特定の急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。DRC、Nigeria、Nigerがマラリア死亡数上位国として言及されているが、Nigeria・Nigerは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Ghanaは発表場所（Accra）としての言及のみで、Ghana国内での発生が主題ではないため除外した。殺虫剤耐性やベクターの拡大など長期的な曝露継続の懸念は示されているが、新規性・緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bảo vệ trẻ nhỏ, người lớn & mẹ bầu khỏi vi rút hợp bào hô hấp RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protecting young children, adults, and pregnant women from the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
article.articleSummary: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is the leading cause of respiratory illness in Vietnamese children and older adults. In children under one year, more than 70% are infected annually, with about 3.6 million hospitalizations and roughly 100,000 deaths under age 5 each year. In older adults, RSV often worsens underlying conditions, causing pneumonia and respiratory failure with high mortality. To promote prevention, VNVC will host an online counseling program on Friday, 21 August 2026 at 8:00 PM, titled 'Protecting children, adults, and pregnant women from RSV causing pneumonia and severe bronchiolitis.' The panel includes Nguyễn Thanh Thùy, Lê Thị Trúc Phương, and Nguyễn Tiến Đạo from Tan Anh General Hospital and VNVC. It will be broadcast on Thanh Niên, vnvc.vn, tamanhhospital.vn, and VNVC social channels; call 028 7102 6595 or visit vnvc.vn for advice and vaccination bookings.

triage.headline_ja: 小児・成人・妊婦をRSウイルス(RSV)感染から守る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はRSV予防に関する啓発・オンライン相談会の告知であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVに関する一般的な疾患啓発・ワクチン接種案内のプロモーションであり、アウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi-NCR Sees Rise In Swine Flu, Other Respiratory Infections Amid Monsoon
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR is seeing a surge in H1N1 (swine flu) alongside other respiratory infections during the monsoon, with dengue and H3N2 also reported. Delhi hospitals note rising H1N1 and dengue cases; July saw dengue and H1N1, with August showing a marked rise in H1N1. At SPARSH Hospital, Bengaluru, about five to six patients daily present flu-like symptoms, with two to three admitted, often due to severe breathing difficulties in vulnerable patients. Common symptoms include runny nose, cough, fever, body aches and fatigue; elderly individuals, those with chronic conditions, or respiratory illnesses like COPD/asthma face higher complication risks. Experts urge respiratory hygiene, wearing well-fitted masks in crowded places, avoiding self-medication, and seeking medical advice promptly when flu symptoms develop; high-risk individuals may consider influenza vaccination. Early help is increasingly sought due to rising seasonal illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: デリー首都圏でモンスーンの時期に豚インフルエンザや他の呼吸器感染症が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1・デング熱の増加は例年のモンスーン時期の傾向であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠はないが、症例増加の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1、H3N2）とデング熱のモンスーン時期の増加に関する記事。重症例の詳細な統計や異常な広がりは報告されておらず、通常の季節的パターンとして扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn răng miệng tấn công tim gây nhiễm trùng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oral bacteria attack the heart, causing infection.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a 24-year-old woman with two months of fever and cough was diagnosed with infective endocarditis caused by oral Streptococcus sanguinis. Echocardiography showed severe mitral regurgitation from ruptured chordae tendineae with a mobile mitral vegetation. She had poor oral health and braces, facilitating bacteremia. After three weeks of antibiotics, surgery repaired the valve: removal of damaged leaflet portion and vegetation, shortened chordae, closure of the left atrial appendage, and placement of a prosthetic ring to restore mitral valve shape and competence, preserving the native valve. Extubation occurred four hours post-op with good cardiac function and ongoing antibiotics. The report notes risks of untreated IE—heart failure, abscesses, and embolic events—and urges rigorous dental hygiene and regular dental care to reduce mouth-origin bacteria entering the bloodstream, especially for those with prior heart disease or dental work.

triage.headline_ja: 口腔内細菌が心臓を攻撃し感染を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 個人の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく、感染症アウトブレイクとしての性質を持たない。
triage.notes: 個人の口腔内細菌による感染性心内膜炎の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや感染症危機管理の対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Terceiro caso fatal de febre maculosa em Americana reforça alerta para cuidados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third fatal case of spotted fever in Americana reinforces the warning to take precautions.
article.articleSummary: Third fatal case of spotted fever in Americana, São Paulo, Brazil, in 2026 highlights tick-borne disease precautions. Spotted fever, caused by Rickettsia rickettsii, is transmitted by the star tick (Amblyomma sp.). The article contrasts this with the brown dog tick (Rhipicephalus sanguineus), which in urban settings transmits canine hemoparasitoses such as ehrlichiosis and babesiosis. Dogs, sharing homes and outdoor activities with people, play a central role in One Health surveillance and prevention. Antiparasitic medicines do not create a 100% barrier; a tick may bite or latch on before the product takes effect, potentially transporting the tick into homes. Canine infections can be subclinical, with latency that may reactivate later. Guidance includes post-walk checks focusing on ears, paws, abdomen; regular antiparasitic and deworming as advised by a vet; protective clothing in grassy areas; yard maintenance; periodic health monitoring to tailor prophylaxis. Dr. André Cutolo emphasizes interrupting transmission cycles through preventive care.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカーナ市で紅斑熱による3人目の死亡例、注意喚起強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州アメリカーナ市でダニ媒介性の紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever）による死亡例が続いているが、既知の風土病であり人-人感染はなく、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。死亡例が続く点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: ダニ媒介性のRocky Mountain Spotted Fever（紅斑熱）はブラジルで既知の風土病であり、局所的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起記事。人-人感染のリスクはなく、国際的な拡大の可能性は低い。死亡例の継続には注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 제주 소·염소 4만1천여마리 구제역 백신 일제접종
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeju's cattle and goats, around 41,000 animals, vaccinated against foot-and-mouth disease in a mass vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Jeju Island, South Korea, launches a mass vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in cattle and goats for September, targeting 41,415 animals across 739 farms (37,111 cattle on 624 farms; 4,304 goats on 115 farms). Exemptions allowed for animals under 4 weeks since vaccination or late-pregnant cattle upon farm request. Small farms (<50 cattle or <300 goats) are supported by 16 vaccination teams (40 personnel) from Sep 1–30; large farms self-vaccinate Sep 1–14. Pigs receive ongoing farm-based FMD vaccination. Four weeks post-vaccination, authorities test SP (antibody) positivity and NSP (infection) antibodies. Thresholds: cattle SP ≥80%; goats and breeding pigs ≥60%; fattening pigs ≥30%. Farms below thresholds face fines and re-vaccination with re-testing; missing animals to be identified via the Livestock Traceability System for catch-up vaccination. Jeju remains a WOAH-recognized FMD vaccination-clean zone and warns against illegal meat imports and travel to recent SAT1 FMD-affected regions like China and Mongolia.

triage.headline_ja: 済州の牛・ヤギ約4万1000頭、口蹄疫ワクチン一斉接種
triage.triage_reason: これは韓国済州島での定期的・予防的な口蹄疫ワクチン接種事業に関する報道であり、実際の発生や感染拡大を示すものではない。対象国（中国・モンゴル・韓国）のうち中国が言及されるが、あくまで韓国が渡航注意を促す文脈での言及に過ぎず、中国国内での発生事実は確認できない。
triage.notes: 韓国済州島は対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題は予防的ワクチン接種事業。中国・モンゴルでのSAT1型FMD発生への言及があるが、詳細情報がなく本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱に未承認ワクチン　7万回分、効果の可能性　AUの対策センターとWHOが声明
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unapproved Ebola vaccine: 70,000 doses with potential efficacy; Africa CDC and WHO issue a statement.
article.articleSummary: As of August 21, 2026, the Africa Union (AU) CDC and the World Health Organization (WHO) issued a statement that 70,000 doses of an unapproved Ebola vaccine will be supplied to help contain the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The vaccine, Ervebo, is approved for Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against the Bundibugyo strain remains unproven in humans, though animal data suggest potential protection. The International Coordination Group on Vaccine Provision will allocate 20,000 doses for clinical trials, with the remaining doses reserved for healthcare workers. In eastern Congo’s Ituri Province, 5,208 infections and 2,476 deaths have been reported. The current outbreak is contextualized by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which claimed more than 11,000 lives. The effort underscores international public health coordination to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱に未承認ワクチン　7万回分、効果の可能性　AUの対策センターとWHOが声明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは感染5,208例・死亡2,476例と極めて深刻で、未承認株（ブンディブギョ株）への対応や国際的なワクチン供給調整が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）のみが言及されており、Angolaは主題として扱われていないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンEbrevoの有効性は動物実験のみで人での効果は未証明である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: जम्मू में डेंगू ने बढ़ाई टेंशन! एक हफ्ते में 15 नए केस, 130 पहुंचा आंकड़ा; प्रशासन ने बढ़ाई निगरानी - kashmir dengue cases rise 130 confirmed this year
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue raises tensions in Jammu! 15 new cases in a week, tally reaches 130; administration intensifies surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Jammu and Kashmir rise as of 20 August 2026, with 130 confirmed infections this year and 15 new cases in the past week. A total of 9,085 tests have been conducted, yielding 130 positives (vs 76 from 5,386 tests in 2025). Weekly confirmations include 3 in Jammu district, 4 in Samba district, and 1 from another state; overall district totals: Jammu 72, Udhampur 15, Samba 9, Rajouri 9, Kathua 5, Reasi 4, Poonch 5, Doda 2, Ramban 2, Kishtwar 2, plus 5 cases from other states. Authorities have intensified surveillance and launched vector-control campaigns to target larval habitats. Public advisories urge residents to eliminate standing water, secure water-storage containers, and routinely change water in domestic coolers. Dr. Harbakhsh Singh is overseeing response as acting State Malariologist.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムーでデング熱が緊張を高める！1週間で15人の新規感染、累計130人に到達；行政が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加事例であり、行政が通常のベクター対策・監視強化を実施している段階。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、前年比で症例数が増加しており経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: デング熱はジャンムー・カシミール地方（インド）における季節性の毎年報告される感染症であり、前年比で症例数が増加しているものの、地方行政による通常のベクター対策で対応可能なレベル。重症度・死亡例に関する情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Severe malaria strain emerges in Northeast India, study flags rising risk in Tripura
article.articleSummary: Severe vivax malaria emerges in Tripura, Northeast India, the first documentation of severe Plasmodium vivax in the region. An 18‑month ICMR‑NIHR study in Tripura found 11 severe cases among 223 vivax infections; in 444 malaria patients, 183 falciparum, 223 vivax, and 38 mixed infections, with severe disease in 9% of falciparum, 5% of vivax, and 13% of mixed. Vivax now accounts for about half of northeast malaria infections, up from under 10% five years ago. Diagnostic gaps: microscopy detected roughly two‑thirds of vivax infections; PCR identified 121 cases missed by rapid tests and microscopy. Implications include rethinking vivax treatment and expanding molecular diagnostics, given vivax dormancy and relapse potential. Context: Tripura’s overall malaria burden declined (2023 ~22,000; 2024 ~9,000; 2025 ~6,000); northeast states accounted for 19% of India’s cases and 34% of deaths in 2023.

triage.headline_ja: インド北東部で重症化するマラリア株が出現、トリプラ州の研究がリスク増大を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 北東インド・トリプラ州で重症三日熱マラリアの初報告があり異常所見だが、全体の症例数は減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はICMR-NIHRの疫学研究報告であり、急性の集団発生イベントではない。三日熱マラリアの重症化・診断ギャップに関する知見として今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Putus Rantai TBC, Universitas Pakuan Perkuat Deteksi Dini di Bogor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking the TB Transmission Chain, Pakuan University Strengthens Early Detection in Bogor.
article.articleSummary: TB (tuberculosis) transmission is addressed in Bogor through Universitas Pakuan's PKM program 'Keluarga Tangguh Lawan TBC' in Pasirjaya, Bogor Barat, Kota Bogor, on August 18–19, 2026, engaging about 100 residents. The initiative combines TB education, case finding and contact tracing, Free Health Checkups (CKG), and family- and community-empowerment. Led by Lusi Agus Setiani, the program emphasizes that early detection starts at home; families should recognize symptoms, understand risk, know contact history, and seek care promptly. It works with the Bogor City Health Office and Pancasan Health Center for CKG and tracing. The project also teaches using local plants and jamu as health resources, cautioning that they do not replace TB treatment. Funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology in 2026, cross-sector collaboration aims to sustain TB control through informed, proactive participation.

triage.headline_ja: 結核感染の連鎖を断つ、パクアン大学がボゴールで早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 大学と地域保健所による通常の結核啓発・早期発見プログラムの紹介であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地域の結核対策啓発活動に関する一般的な報道であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu cases rise amid humid weather; doctors urge caution, respiratory hygiene
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR and Bengaluru report rising H1N1 (swine flu) and other respiratory infections amid humid monsoon conditions as of August 2026. In Delhi-NCR, clinicians note influenza-like illness with runny nose, cough, fever, body aches and fatigue; elderly individuals, COPD or asthma patients, and those with comorbidities face higher complication risk. In Bengaluru’s SPARSH Hospital, five to six flu-like patients present daily, with two to three admitted. Aakash Healthcare records dengue cases in July and rising H1N1 in August, linked to monsoon-associated stagnation and indoor crowding. Asian Hospital also reports dengue, swine flu and H3N2. Health professionals urge basic respiratory hygiene and fever precautions; mild cases may be treated symptomatically, while severe cases require hospital care. Vaccines for influenza are available, and high-risk individuals should discuss vaccination with their providers.

triage.headline_ja: 湿気の多い天候の中で豚インフルエンザ症例が増加、医師らが注意と呼吸器衛生を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1・H3N2・デング熱の増加が報告されているが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。医療体制の逼迫や重症例の急増などの情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリー・NCRおよびベンガルールにおける季節性の呼吸器感染症（H1N1、H3N2）およびデング熱の増加であり、モンスーン時期の典型的な傾向。重症度や医療逼迫の具体的データは記載されていない。
